tei:div.tei:p: man ngag lhan thabs kyi brda ba 4rnam rgyal gser mdog gi phreng ba/ /dmyungasabodalugasabasoris stoba'ajugakhanganasabasder tshulang ste/des 4zarwa7 sna nga blo — / lha'i
༄:/ /man ngag lhan thabasarnam rgyal gser mdog 6bod ljongs bod lugs gso rig zhib 'a

sgrig pa po'i gtam/༄byu / /bod lugs gso rig ni bod mi dmangs kyis dus yun ring po'i nang nad rigs sna tshogs dang 'thab rtsod byas nas grub pa'i phul byung rig gnas shig red la/ mes rgyal gso ba rig pa'i gter mdzod nang gi nor bu rtsa chen zhig kyang yin/ dzodapal ldan gso rig rgyud bzhi 〉ni spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad par gangs can ljongs kyi sman pa'i rgyal po g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos phyi phyogs gso rig gi nying khu bsdu len dang / rang mi rigs sa khul gyi sman bcos nyams myong dngos phyogs bsdoms mdzad nas legs sgrig gnang zhing / rjes rabs — rnams kyis bod kyi gso rig slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug byed skabs khungs gtugs sa'i gzhung lugs rtsa chen zhig tu gyur/ gong gsal 〈gso rig rgyud bzhi'i sminang tshan man ngag rgyud la kha bsnon nam lhan thabs kyi tshul du bod rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing khyi ( spyi ske lo1694)lor ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rje btsun 'jam mgon sangs rgyas rgya — mtsho mchog nas yig cha'i ngo bo rnam rgyalagrags bzang dang / mi'i nyi— ma mthong ba don ldan gyi yig cha'i rigs dang / dgos 'dod kun— 'byung sogs dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs brjod kyis mi lang ba'i mnaskongag zabaca rnams la gzhi bcol te /bdud ji snying po yan lag brgyad

pa gsang ba man ngag yon tan rgyud kyi lhan thabs zug rngu'i tsha gdung — sel ba'i gcu ra dus min 'chi zhags gcod pa'i ral gri zhes bya ba 〉rtsom sgrig mdzad/ phyag dpe 'di ni phyis 'byung nad thog lag len nang spyod pa'i yig rigs rin thang bral ba zhig red/ dus rabs bcom brgyad pa'i dus dkyil du sog po lung rigs bstan dar gyis 〈man ngag lhan thabs 〉la slob sbyong dang lag len gnang skabs kyi dngos tshor dang nyams myong la gzhigs nas man ngag lhan thabs kyi brda don go dka' ba rnams la dum bu dang le'u'i rim pa ltar 'grel bshad — mdzad pa dang / da dung lhan thabs kyi nad gzhi dang 'brel ba yod — pa'i sman sbyor mang dag cig kha skong gnang ba ma zad sde srid mchog nas snod ngan rnams la gsang phyir sman sbyor la gsang sman dang sman rdzas la mngon brjod mi nyung ba zhig bkod gnang yod pa layongs su rdzogs pa sba gsang med par gsal bkrol mdzad pa'i mtshan byang la (man ngag lhan thabs spyi brda bkrol rnam rgyal gser mdog gi phreng ba 〉zhes: bya'o/ /phyag dpe 'di'i ma dpemakhas dbang yon pong byams pa 'phrin las mchog nasamakho 'don gnang bas zad/ gna' dpe legs sgrig —bya rgyu'i thad la thugs 'khur chen po gnang nas gang mgyogs 'phral myur du legs sgrub dgos pa'i zhal bkod thob/ yin na'ang ma dpe —shin tu rnying song yin par brten yi ge ma gsal ba dngan dpe shog —ral skyon gyis nang don khag gcig ༵ ma tshang ba/ de bzhin yig nor:

shor ba sogs kyi skyon cha che tsamayod pa'i dbang gis 'phral mar legs sgrig ma thub par lo gcig tsam ring mang che ba las zhor dus tshod spyadarkonas 〈rgyud bzhi nyidangan rgyud bzhi'i brda sprod rnam rgyal a ru'i phreng mdzes〉/ (man ngag lhan thabs 〉kyi tshig don la sogs par khungs gtugs lta bsdur yang yang byas te dpe cha'i mgo nas mjug b.rasnyegatsang bshus brgyab ste legs sgrig byas rjes gzhi nas glog klad thog nas yig par bsgrigs pa yin/ da dung klog pa pos dang don 'tshol bde'i ched du dkar chag kyang bsgrigs yod/ zhus dag byed pa'i dang mngon gsal dod pa'i nang don 'dzol rigs dang yig nor shor rigs khag gcig 'brel yod yig cha btsal 'tshol byas nas khungs lung rnyed pa rnams do nan du dag bcos byas pa las/ de min khungs: lung ma rnyed pa dang the tshom gyi rigs dag la rtags ( )'di'irnanang bcug nas bzo bcos byas yod pas de don dgongs 'jags zhu rgyu dang sbrags dpyod ldan rnams kyis dag bcosayod pa zhu/dpe rnying 'di nyid legs sgrig byed pa'i nang mkhas dbangayon— krang byams pa 'phrin las mchog nas thugs 'gan zhal bkod gnangarkob dang / dgra 'dul yon krang mchog nas dpar bsgrun gron dngularkothad rgyab skyor chen po gnang ba/ zhib 'jug pa sku gzhonayam pa lags nas kyang glog klad yig par sgrig dus rogs ram ci che gnang byung bas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ 3

dpe rnying 'di nyid dpe sgrun byas rjes 〈man ngag lhan thabs 〉la slob sbyong dang / lag len/ zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi rgya che'i sman slob dngaka sman don mi sna/ zhib 'jug pa rnams la phan nus nges can thon rgyu yin pa gor ma chagayin na'ang sgrig pa po rang nyid kyi blo rig khab mig ltar phra zhing nyams myong sogs zhan pa'i dbang gis 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i cha mchis srid na/ mkhyen can yangs pa'i mkhas dbang dge rgan spyi dngaskesdu/ /gas rnam pas rtsa che'i dgongs 'char lhug stsol yong ba mkhyen/bod spyongs bod lugs gso rig zhib 'jug khang gso rig dang sman rig rig gzhung zhib 'jug so'o yi tshe brtan 'jigs med nas/ spyi lo2008zla 8pa'i tshes 6nyin — sugasbras bgyis pa'o/ /4

dkar chagale'u dang po/ nad kyi rgyu bstan pa/ (1)le'u gnyis pa/ rlung nad khye brag bcos pa (14)le'u gsum pa/ srog rlung bcos pa (27)le'u bzhi pa/ ce spyang mgo bcos pa (30)le'u lnga pa/ khrag rlung stod 'tshangs bcos pa (30)le'u drug pa/ mkhris nad3) bye brag bcos pa (34)le'u bdun pa/ bad kun skya ser bcos pa (38)le'u brgyad pa/ 'dus nad smug po bcos pa (48)le'u dgu pa/ ma zhu ba bcos pa/ (59)le'u bcu pa/ skran nad bcos pa (62)le'u bcu gcig pa/ skya rbab bcos pa (64)le'u bcu gnyis pa/ 'or nad bcos pa (65)le'u bcu gsum pa/ dmu chu bcos pa (65)le'u bcu bzhi pa/ gcong chen zadabyed bcos pa/ (71)le'u bco lnga pa/ tsha bci bcos pa (71)le'u bcu drug pa/ tsha grang gal 'gags la/ (78)le'u bcu bdun pa/ ri thangasatshams bstan pa/ (79)le'u bco brgyad pa/ ma smin tsha ba bcos pa (801)

le'u don dgu pa/ gcin 'gags bcos pa/ (147)le'u brgyad cu pa/ gcin snyi'i nad bcos pa/ (147)le'u gya gcig pa/ tshad 'khru bcos pa (148)le'u gya gnyis pa/ dreg nad bcos pa (149)le'u gya gsum pa/ grum bu bcos pa (150)le'u gya bzhi pa/ grum gsar bcos pa (151)le'u gya lnga pa/ chu ser bcos pa (151)le'u gya drug pa/ rtsa dkar bcos pa (153)le'u gya bdun pa/ mkhas rtsa bral ba bcos pa/ (157)le'u gya brgyad pa/ lpags nad bcos pa 4 (157)le'u gya dgu pa/ mdzer pa bcos pa (158)le'u dgu bcu pa/ phran bu'i nad bcos pa/ (158)le'u go gcig pa/ mes tshig bcos pa (158)le'u go gnyis pa/ nu ma smrangs pa bcos pa (159)le'u go gsum pa/ bse dri bcos pa/ (159)le'u go bzhi pa/ tsher lhog bco pa/ (159)le'u go lnga pa/ 'bras nad bcos pa (160)le'u go drug pa/ gzhang 'brum bcos pa (160)le'u go bdun pa/ me dbal bcos pa (161)le'u go brgyad pa/ sur ya bcos pa (1615)

le'u brgya bco brgyad pa/ ma bcos pa (182)le'u brgya bcu dgu pa/ mgo me bcos pa (183)le'u brgya nyi shu pa/ ske rma bcos pa (186)le'u brgya nyer gcig pa/ byang khog rma bcos pa/ (187)le'u brgya nyer gnyis pa/ yan lag gi rma bcos pa/ (192)le'u brgya nyer gsum pa/ sbyar dug bcos pa/ (196)le'u brgya nyer bzhi pa/ gyur dug bcos pa (200)le'u brgya nyer lnga pa/ sha dug bcos pa (201)le'u brgya nyer drug pa/ sha nad bcos pa/ (202)le'u brgya nyer bdun pa/ dngos dug bcos pa/ (202)le'u brgya nyer brgyad pa/ reg dug bcos pa/ (202)le'u brgya nyer dgu pa/ khyi dug bcos pa (205)le'u brgya sum cu pa/ ro tsa bar bya ba (206)le'u brgya so gcig pa/ bud med btsa' thabs bstan pa/ (208)le'u brgya so gnyis pa/ tshangs dbyangs skad kyi gdams pa bstan pa/ (209)le'u brgya so gsum pa/ rgas pa gso ba bcud len bstan pa/ (210)7

༄ / /man ngag lhan thabs kyi dka' gnad bkrol ba rnam rgyal gser mdog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ ci // le'u dang po/ nad kyi rgyu bstan pa/ na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni sarba dharma pā la khyu/ /sangs rgyas sman bla rig 'dzin pad+ma sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i lha/ /sman gyi drang srongaske mkha' 'gro bstan bsrung bcas/ /gus pas mchod do brtse ba'i thugs rjes bzung / /pad+mas lung bstan lnga rig mi spe rje/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhes grags paṇ+ḍi tas/ /man ngag yon tan rgyud kyi nor bu la/ /zabaske don lhan thabs rin chen phra tshom btab/ /de yi 'od gzis snyigasaskyidus rgud pa'i mun/ /ming mthar byas pa'i ngo mtshar de mthong nas/ /dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor rab bkod de/ /dka' gnad bkrol ba'i rnam rgyal phreng bas mchod/ /gdams ngag de yang 'chol du mi 'jugasnyeched // / gab sbas gsang tshig brda yis bcings pa rnams/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'dir ni gsal byed na/ /chos bdag bka' rgya 'khrol zhing gnang ba stsol/ /de la thog mar rgya gar zhes pa la 'dod tshul mi/

'dra ba kha shas yod kyang / grong khyer chen po drug dang skad rigs mi — 'dra ba bzhi yod pa'i 'phags pa'i yul gyi dngos ming ste 'dod rgyal gyi sgra'o / / yul de'i skad la bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la shaphyo'i ta zhes sogs 'byung / de yang skad gnyis shan sbyar byas na/ shaphyos ta pa na ni zug rngu'i tsha gdungan an+ta kro jini serme ba'i kuji ra/ a sprul srita pā byu ni dus min 'chi zhags/ cadasu khaṅga tsā0ni gcod pa'i ral gri zhes bya ba/ a bri ta hri da ya aṅgām ni bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa/ gu phyopa de sha ni gsang ba man ngag su na tan+ta sug shig ni yon tan rgyud kyi lhan thabs/ zhes sbyor/ bod ces pa la 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las lung bstan pa ltar/ rgya gar ba'i skad du lha ṭa zhes yod pa lo tsā ba rnams kyis sgra sor bzhag mdzad pa zur chags nas bod ces 'dod rgyal du btags pa'o/ /'dod rgyal gyi don yang thog ma'i brda sbyar mkhan pos rang 'dod kyis ming ji skad sbyar ba rgyal te phyis su ming de sus kyang 'gog mi nus pa'i don te/ rnam 'grel las/grags pa brda yi rjes 'gro can/ /de yang brjod 'dod rjes 'gro can / / tha snyad don du byas pa ste/ /bsdebs sbyor ming dang sgra cha bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de la rgya skad smos pa la rgyu mtshan ci yod snyam na/bod kyi bstan bcos phal che ba la rgya skad smos pa mi snang yang / paṇa — chen thams cad mkhyen pas bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga'i 'gor rgya skad smos ༵ / cho ga de rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i gsang sngags rgyud kyi

gdams ngag yin pa go ba'i ched yin par gsungs pa ltar/ lhan—thabs 'di yang ston pa shākya thub pasagasungs pa'i dpal ldan rgyudasgo bzhi'i gdams ngag yin pa go ba'i ched yin no/ /bdud rtsi ni dusam min gyi 'chi ba thams cad 'joms pa lha'i bdud ji lta bu dang / snying:po ni gso ba rig pa thams cad kyi nying khu dam pa 'o ma'i snying po maram yin pa lta bu ste dpe'i sgo nas btags pa/ yan lag brgyad pa ni/gso bya'i yul gyi yan lag brgyad la gso byed thabs kyi yan lag brgyad du phye nas ston pa ste brjod bya'i sgo nas btags pa/ gsang ba ni sdod min rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pa ste snod la ltos nas btags pa/man ngag ni/ rgyud pa'i zam ma chad pa las nye bar thongs pa ste ngo bo'i sgonas btags pa/ yon tan rgyud kyi lhan thabs zhes pa'i yon tan rgyud ni man ngag rgyud yin la/ lhan thabs ni kha bskong ngam bsnon ma'i don te kha bskong btab bya'i yul bshad gzhi man ngag rgyud la kha bskong 'debs byed kyi dngos po man ngag gi gnad kyis kha bskang nas bshad pa ste 'chad tshul gyi sgo nas btags pa/ zug rngu'i tsha gdung sel ba'i kuji ra ni/ dpe can nad kyi zug rngu de dpe tsha gdung gi gzugs su bkod/ dpe can nad sel byed bstan bcos de dpe kukhyura'i gzugs su bkod/ dus min 'chi zhags gcod pa'i ral gyi ni dpe — can dus min 'chi ba de dpe zhags pa'i gzugs su bkod/ dpe can 'chi ba gcod byed bstan bcos de dpe ral gri'i gzugs su bkod sdo

phyi ma gnyis bstan bcos kyi che ba'i sgo nas btags pa'i mtshan yin/des na 'di dag gis bstan bcos kyi mtshan don bshad zin to/ /dpal ldan ni tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan pa/ bla mni gong ma ste de'i gong mar gyur pa'i zhing med pa/ rtsa gsum ni/ chos sku'i rtsa bsnyesnang ba mtha' yag longs sku'i rtsa ba pad+ma dbang chen/ sprul sku'i rtsa ba pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes 'byung ba'i don thu'u kwan chos rjes bshad pa de ltar ram/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam/'phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong zhes grags/ zil gnodaskyibazhad pa rtsal ni kun gzigs lnga pa chen po'i gsang mtshan/ sgo gsum gus pas ni/ lus gus pas 'dud pa ngag gus pas bstod pa yid gus pas dang ba/ phyag 'tshal ni gus pa gsum tshogs pa'i skyabs 'gro/'gro kun ni 'gro mchog gtso bor gyur ba mi'i lus can/ 'du ba ni: gnod bya bcu dang gnod byed bco lnga ste/ gnod byed la 'du ba'i sgra 'jug pa yang phyi rgyud las/ de yis 'du ba rnam gsum mi 'khrugs gsal/ /zhes pas shes so/ /dus ngan snyigs ma ni snyigs ma lnga bdo: ba / bya spyod log pa ni chos min gyi spyod pa ste/ 'og nas/ khrims la mi gnas mna' za nang dme byed/ /ces sogs kyis bshad pa de yin/gnyan rims ni/ rgyu gnyan gyis gtong ba'i nad rims kyis 'gos pa/papo ta'i yams ni/ rgyu nad bdag tre tre ho 'am patha ta zhes pas gātong ba'i nad bdal ka che ba ste 'di gnyis rgyu ming 'bras bu la:

btags pa 'og tu rgyas par 'chad/ thar ni mi 'byung bar bsrung bcu dang 'byung ba las sgrol ba/ gsol lo ni zhu'o/ /tshogs gnyis ni/mgon po klu'i zhabasakyis/ bsod nams ye shes las 'byung ba'i/dam pa sku gnyis zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang 'bras gzugs sku'i lag —rjes 'jog byed bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / rang 'bras chos sku'i lag rjes 'jog byed ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis/ chu gter ni rgya mtsho/gzis ni gzi brjid kyis/ skyegu ni skyebo thams cad/ bde gshegs — mched bdun ni/ mtshan legs sogs brgyad brgya pa las gsungs pa'isangs rgyas bdun te/ de la mched bdun du bzhag pa sngon dus pha gcig gi bu bdun du skyeb bzhes pas sam/ sangs rgyas gcig gi spyan sngar sems bskyed dus gcig tu mdzad pa sogs gang gi sgo nas yin khungs btsal bar bya'o/ /tsit+ta ni snying ngam yid/ dag zhing mgon ni/bde ldan te bde ba can gyi mgon po 'od dpag med/ gru 'dzin mgon ni po ta la'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ tha dad gcig gyur rnga yabacu gling pa ni/ mgon po de gnyis rnam pa tha dad kyang ngo bo gcig du gyur pa rnga yab gling pa ste slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ srid gsum ni sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum la 'dod kyang / 'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med khams te khams gsum/ zil gnon ni de gsum la dbang bsgyur ba/ thod phreng rtsal ni slob dpon chen po'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs gcig gangs can ni bod yul/ ngad ni ldang ba/ 'dapa

brgya dgod pa ni 'dab ma mang po bzhad pa/ciyod do 'tshal ni yod pa:thams cad/ rjes chags slad ni rjes brtse phyir/ rigs kun khyabasnyebadag ni rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bdag po rigs drug pa/ gzhung lugs che ni sman gyi rgyud bzhi/ mgrin sngon can ni dbang phyug chen po/ padarkodakar mig ni khyab 'jug mtshon ni gtso byas/ 'phags yul ni 'phags lam thob pa mang du 'byung ba rgya gar ba'i yul/ paṇa grub ni: paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub pa thob pa/ lam 'di ni gso ba rig pa 'di/ ri bong can ni gza' zla ba/ bstan bcos ni/ sman dpyad sbyor ba brgya pa yan lag brgyad pa zla zer sogs/ dge ba'i dbang ni slob dponaskyidapa' bo/ dbus 'gyur ni ma gha da sogs rgya gar gyi yul/ bsam 'phel dbang rgyal ni yid bzhin nor bu/ skad gnyis smra ba ni lo chen be+e ro tsa na/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dbyig gu dge slong shākya blo gros/ltar snang lnga ni tsha grang gal mdor bshad pa'i lnga phrugs/ dug gsum ni / rgyu 'dod khro gti mug 'bras bu rlung mkhris bad kun/ gsang ba ni sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha/ rig 'dzin ni zung 'jug brnyes pa/ ma ra ba ni yid 'dzin ma zhes pa yin snyam te slob dpon chen po'i zung ma/ḍā gi ni 'dod pa/ bsnyen ni khang nye bar bsten/ ma dang mkha' 'gro —zhes pa'i ma ni las kyis skyes pa'i phyag rgya ma dang mkha' 'gro la zhing sngags lhan skyes gsum yod/ mngar mo ni zhim po/ grwa mngon ni/ grwa —dī nyis stong tsam la chos mngon pa bshad pas grwa pa mngon shes te rgyud —

bzhi'i gter bton pa po yin la mtshan dngos dbang phyug 'bar/dor 'bum grags pa ni mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung gi gter bton pa po/lus dkar dbang ni ngang pa'i rgyal po ste 'o chu 'dres pa la ngang pas: mchu bzhag pa tsam gyis 'o chu so sor 'byed nus pas so/ / 'khyogasnyebashad ni don gzhan gyi rgyas 'gebs pa/ rnam par 'khyams ni don: log par song ba/ dran dbang ni mkhas pa/ zhang blon ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtso 'khor drug pa phyi sgrub dang / nang sgrub zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtso 'khor dgu/ gsang sgrub zhal gsum phyag drug gtso 'khor lnga / gsum ku'ang mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs dam can rgya mtshos bskor/ dam can sde dgu ni/ zhang blon rta nag ma/ sngags srung e na dza ti/ gza' bdud khyab 'jug rā hu la/ mkha' 'gro lce spyang mchu: dmar/ gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar po/ bdud mo sharnying ro zan/dam canasreg gi spu gri/ srin po dgra 'dul 'jigs byed/ srog bdag hag se nag po/ kun kyang sgrol ging grangs yas kyis bskor ba/ chos — srung ni 'das pa bshad ma thag pa dngan ma 'das pa bstan ma bcurna gnyis phyogs skyong zhing skyong sogs/ bshad yams ni bshad pa ha cang —che ba/ dbang po'i gzhu ni 'ja' tshon/ nad brgya sman gcig ces pa'i mchan du brag mjug pa'i tshad bcos dang sgor ba pa'i gi brag sogs zhes yod pa pe cing par mar phal cher mi gsal/ kusku ma ni gur gum/nyams bcos ni nyams myong ltar snang / nor bsrung bsad pa'i sha ni|

khyis bsad pa'i gtsog sha ma gsu ni/ chu lha'i bu skar ma ri ṣi ste de dbyar dang ston gyi dus mtshams su lho phyogs su shar ba na chu thams cad yan lag brgyad ldan du gyur te sus longs spyad kyang phan gdags paske dang // gos kyi dri ma 'khrud pa la dag byed kyi nus pa che ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs/ 'byung ba ni sa chu me rlung nam mkha'/ gtsug tor ni — spyi gtsug sarga ni le'u/ sprel ni phreng bar brgyus pa/ nyin mor byed pa ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ lhun po ni ri rab/ kurtu ra ni lus rgyas zhes pa yin snyam la de zur chag pas kupar dang de yang zur chag pas ga — bur / phyogs lhung ni rang phyogs la 'khrul pa'i skyon mthong yang rlom pa'i dbang gis bstod pa dang / gzhan phyogs la bden pa'i yon tan mthong yang nga rgyal dang phrag dog gis smod pa/ brlams ni bslad pa/sto 'gro ni dug sgrul/ ma gi ta ni gla rtsi'i gab ming du 'jug pa yod kyang sbrul dug sel ba'i rtsi ma zhes pa yin zhing de yang sngo sman rtsad ces pa de yin/ phyur bur ni bkang bar/ 'di la mtshan dang sngon 'gro'i tshigs bcad dag gi sdeb sbyor dang sabashad skabs kyi tshigs bcad rnams la don rgyan gang yin ngos bzung bar sngon mchan yig btab pa rnams la zhib mo'i blos bshad pa rgyag dgos kyang / skadas 'dir spros na dngos don sgrib pa ltar 'gyur bas logs su 'chad par bya'o/ /'gro mchog gtso bor gyur pa'i mi lus zhes pa/ 'dzam gling rten can gyi pal ldan gyis tshe thung gcig la sangs rgyas thob pa'ang yod pas 'gro —

mchog gtso bo zhes bya la/ kla klo mu stegs lta bu ni ma yin te bstan pa bshig pa'i rig can de gso thabs yod kyang spang bar bshad pasasnyesne/pe ma rig 'khrul bani stong pa nyid kyidon larmongs pa/ 'khor ba ni:las nyon gyi dbang gis 'gro ba rigs drug gang rung du nying mtshams — sbyar ba/ gti mug ni las 'bras la rmongs pa/ 'dod pa ni rang bde bar 'dod pa'ilhad pa/ zhe snang ni kun nas mnar sems/ gnad du btsugs ni gnod pa drag po byed pa/ phrag dog ni gzhan gyi dpal 'byor mthong na mi bzod pa/ nga rgyal ni rang mchog du mthong nas khengs pa/ khyad du bsad ni sngar mide lasakyang dma' ru btang ba/rig pa spyang ni tshor ngas che ba/ rtsom pa ni don med don log gi bya ba/mdo don chung ba ni brtson shes chung ba/ yun gyi da ni thar payan du mi 'gyur pa'i rgyal da de byang chub gsum gang rung / las ngan bag chags ni 'jug shes mi dge ba drug gis rang nyid 'gag pa la mngon du phyogs tshe kun gzhi la bsgos pa'i bag la nyal gyi ldan min/ rgyun 'khrigs ni gcig rjes gcig 'brel ba/ kha brgyud ni rgyun mi 'chad du 'khyams pa/ las dang nyes pa las 'byung ni/ myong bar nges pa'i las kyi bag chags sad pa dang rnam par ma gyur ba'i rlung mkhris bad kun gsum 'phral rkyen gyis rnam par gyur pa las 'byung ba/ bzhi brgya rtsa — bzhi'i nad ni/ nyes pa/ gtso bo/ rigs/ gnas te bzhi'i sgo nas phye ba re re la brgya dang gcig re re/ bdag med don ni/ zung 'dzi/

gnyis stong gi de kho na nyid/ ma rig ni/ 'di la lhan skyes gtso bo dang kun brtags kyang 'jog ma rig ldan pas nad dang 'bral mi srid/ /zhes pa ma rig bag chags kyi las dang zag med las kyi dbang gis: 'dod par bsam bzhin du skyes pa la'ang gnod bya khams bcu dang gnod byed nyes pa bco lngacad tshul de bstan/ nyis gsum ni/ nyes gsum zhes pa yin pasagi gu 'byung ba yig skyon/ nges bstan med ni/rnam pa'i sgo nas bye ba'i dbang du byas/ 'on kyang ni/ gong du bshad pa'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi re re la 'chad 'gyur gyi mtshan nyidasnyebazhi re sbyar bas nad rigs stong dang drug brgya bcu drug 'byung ba'i sgra bsdus pa/ ltar snang 'phral ni/ rang rgyu 'chi bar ma nges pa'i las — dang 'phral rkyen gnyis stobs chung ngu las 'byung zhing rang nyid gso ba gso dpyad la ltos mi dgos pa'i nad/ yongs grub tshe ni/ rang nyid 'chi bar ma nges pa'i las dang 'phral rkyen gnyis stobs che chung gang rung las 'byung zhing rang nyid gso ba gso dpyad la ltos dgos pa'i nad / kun btags gdon ni/ grib ma 'drer 'dzin ltar blo 'khrul bas gzhan la gnod pa'i lan chags de mchod sbyin rim gros gzhal ba la ltos dgos pa'i nad/ gzhan dbang sngon las ni/ 'phral rkyenayod med la ma ltos par dus der nges par 'chi ba'i las kyi rnam smin smin zhing rkyen gang gis kyang bzlog tu med pa'i nad/ gnod bya bcu ni/zhi~Xs ma khrag sha tshil rus rkang khu ste lus zungs bdun dang bshang gci

rngul ste dri ma gsum rnams so/ /rang bzhin bdunani/ rlung rkyang pa'i rang bzhin can sogs rkyang pa gsum/ bad mkhris ldan pa/ bad rlung ldan pa/ rlung mkhris ldan pa ste ldan pa'i rang bzhin gsum/ nyes — gsum 'dus pa'i rang bzhin can gcig ste bdun/ na tshod gsum ni/byis pa dar ma rgas pa gsum/ me drod rnam pa gsum ni/ rlung gi me drod mi snyoms pa/ mkhris pa'i me drod rno ba/ bad kun gyi me drod chung ba / nyams so ni/ stobs kyi ming yin pas 'am zhes 'dam nga sbyar ba —yin la/ phal skad du theng khe'am thang ha zer/ zas spyod ni 'ogaske bshad/ dmar khrid ni/ gzo dang lag yod nye bar mkho nges la dmar gyi tha snyad byas pa ltar dngos su ston pa'am gzhan la lam gyi rgyus stonam pa na don spyi khog tsam ma yin par lag pas khrid nas 'gro ba lta bu/dus ngan snyigs ma drug cu khoral zhes pa 'og du 'chad 'gyur ro/ /ma mo gtso gyur lha srin gdug can zhes pa/ de dag la skabs 'gar phan pa'i las byed pas mgon dang lha/ res 'ga' gnod pa'i las byed —pas 'dresan yang bya/ thog ma nas phan gnogaso sor byed pa'i rang bzhin pa'ang gsum yod/ spobs pa ngal ni/ lta rtog thebs mi nus/nag po 'gro shes ni/ go sla bar bsgrigs pa'i don du gzhan du ma las bshad pas kha dog gi nag por bzung gami rigs so/ /srog rlung ni/snying dang srog rtsar rlung zhugs pa/ ce sbyang ni/ rlung khrag pus mor zhugs nas ce spyang gi mgo'i dbyibs su skrangs pa 'dra ba rgyu mtshan snyi/

byas pa/ zad byed ni/ lus zungs zad byed/ gal mdo ni/ tsha grang 'khrul so che ba'i sa yin pas ma 'khrul ba gal che ba'i mdo 'gag riske thang mtshams ni/ ri zad pa'i rjes thang la spebs pa ltar tsha ba zad pa'i rjes grang ba la spebs nges pa'i so mtshams/ ma smin ni/ tsha brna gsar pa'i dus su bad rlung gi grogs kyis smin du mi ster ba/ rgyas ni/tsha ba bad rlung gi grogs dang bral nas rang shugs rdzogs pa/ stongs pa ni / gnas dus sogs kyi dbang gis tsha ba rlung dang bsdongs nas tshaskoba'i rtags ston yang grang ba'i ngo bor gnas pa/ gab pa ni/ tsha ba — babs sa'i dbang gis bad rlung grang ba'i 'og tu sbas pa'i me ltar gnas pa/ rnyings ni/ tsha ba'i ngo bo ma chad par zla gcig phan chad: 'das pa/ rnyogs ni/ tsha ba'i steng du rlung khrag chu ser 'dus nas chu mig rnyogs can ltar 'dres pa/ 'grams ni/ pha rol pos ldeg pa sogs rkyen drag pos rma yod med gang ltar yang phyi nang gi lus zungs dkrugs pa ste phal skad du pir thing gi zer/ 'di byed pa'i ming du: bzung nas tsha ba byer ba'i don du 'khrul te gso ba byed dus su'ang rims rnying byed pa la 'grams tshad kyi gso thabs sbyar bas nad pashe'achor ba 'ga'apasang thos so/ /'khrugasani/ khrag tshad shas chaba'i:mkhrisatshad stobs ldan yin yang stongs 'khrugs zhes pa'i grang 'khrugs kyang yod pa/ bal nad ni/ 'go ba'i rims tsam po ba cham pa ni// stag gnyis dang kha da chad du gnas pa'i rtsa'i bu ga rdul 'tshub dang

grib kyis bkag pa ste/ tshad gsar yin tshad cham pa yin phyin glo luṣ+kadagos par mi bzung ngo / /klad gzer sogs kyi sgra bshad le'u sum cu par shes kyangaka 'dzum bu ltag dgye ni/ 'dzum shor ba ltar mchu brjes so cig ge 'byung nas ltag pa dgye bor 'gro bas de skad zer/kha med ni/ rtags med de tsha grang mi gsal bas de skad zer/ 'khyam po ni/ gnas ma nges pas de skad zer/ 'bar 'bur ni/ gnas ma —nges par 'bur te skrangs pas so/ /ngam ru ni/ gnyan mkhris rlung gis mgrin par ngam ngam du byed pas so/ /rgyu gon ni/ dus rgyun par thur du 'khru ba/ bse dri ni/ lus kyi dri ngan/ tsher lhog ni/ tsher ma zug pas skrangs pa/ mir khi ni/ klad srin gyis brgyal ba/ stong dang rtsa gnyis bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi sogs zhes pa'i stong dang rtsa gnyis ni yig nor yin te/ de ni phyi rgyud du/ rgyas par phye na stong dang nyis brgya yod / / ces pa'i don 'chad byed yin pas stong dang nyis brgya zhes 'byung dgos pas so/ /stong dang nyis brgya 'dren tshul yang / sngar bshad pa'i nad stong dang drug brgya bcu drug las gso yul ma yin pa'i nad gzhan dbang bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zur du phyungs/ lhag ma ltar snang tso yongs grub kun btags kyi bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi re yod pa bsdoms pas stong dang nyis brgya bcu gnyis 'byung ba ni skabs 'di'i stong nyis brgya yin zhing bcu gnyis de tshigs bcad kyi dbang gis brjod mi bde — bas shugs las thon par dgongs so/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi ni/ phyi rgyu~X —

du / gso yul nad la gzhi brgya rtsa bzhir gsungs/ /zhes pa'i don 'chad byed yin pas/ nyes pa gtso bo rigs gnas bzhi'i brgya rtsa gcig re re la gso dpyad nges par 'jug dgos pa yongs grub sbyar ba'i bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi de'o/ /gyur cog ni gyur ba kun/ /le'u dang po — nad kyi rgyu sogs bstan pa'i brda bkrol lo// le'u gnyis pa/ rlung nad spyi bye brag bcos pa/ sna 'dren ni/bsags pa kun slong bar byed/ mjug sdud ni/ tha mar 'chi bar 'jug pa'am tshad mjug 'bud/ mtshan nyid drug ni/ mtshan nyid kyi zur drug ste/ rlung gi mtshan nyid tsub cing yang ba dang / /grang zhing phra la sra zhing g.yo ba yin/ /zhes bshad rgyud las so/ /tha mas gnas ni/rnam par ma gyur par gnas pa/ bser bus bus ni/ rlung gis bud pa / ga chad ni/ yi chad/ len la gtad pa ni/ rkyang pa bsten pa/shugs bkag ni bshang gci 'byung ba'i shugs bkag pa/ dbye ba nyi shu la sogs mang gsungs kyang / /zhes pa la/ rigs kyis dbye ba'i rlung —nad gzhan rgyud can nyi shu/ gnas kyis dbye ba'i rlung nad rang rgyud can nyer brgyad/ bye brag gi rlung nad bco lnga ste man ngag rgyud kyisarna dngos bstan gyi rlung nad drug cu rtsa gsum mo/ /de la dang po nyi shu ni/man ngag rgyud las/ rlung nad a warta (1)dang da rgan (2)gnyis/'grams pa (3)nyams (4)dang rtse sdib (5)phyogs gcig gug(1ni)/ rtsa 'dzin (7)gzhogs byed skams(8)dang lus kun—

skams (9)/ /shing rengs (14)dpung 'ja' (11)ji gotse (12)dang ni/ /sra 'theme (13)dang ni brla rengs (14)ce spyang mgo(15)/ /tsher ma (16)gzugs 'khums (17)kha li (18)rkang brtse (19)dang / /rkang pa tsha ba (20)zhes bya nyi shur bshad/ /ces dang / gnyis pa nyer brgyad ni/ lpags gram shar rgyas rtsa ru rgyu ba dngan /rus la zhen dang don babs snod du lhung / /dbang po lnga la me tog shar ba'o/ /zhes mdor bstan nas de nyid rgyas par ske bstan pa la/ de la dang po lpags la gram pa(1)gcig /gnyis pa sha (2)dang tshil (3)la zhugs pa gnyis/ /gsum pa rtsa ('ag)chu(5)khrag (6)la zhugs pa gsum/ /bzhi pa rus (7)tshigs (8)rkang (9)dang bcud (10)zhugs bzhi/ /lnga pa glo (11)snying (12)mchin (13)mcher (14)mkhal (15)zhugs lnga/ /drug pa zas:(16)dang ma zhu (17)zhu (18)ba'i gnas/ /mkhris pa (19)bshang (20)gci (21)mngal (22)du zhugs dang bdun/ /dbang po mgo (23)mig (24)rna ba (25)sna (26)so (27)dang / / kun (28)la zhugs dang nyi shu brgyad du bshad/ /ces dang /gsum pa bco lnga ni/ /bye brag dbye ba srog 'dzin gyen rgyu dngan /khyab byed me mnyam thur sel rkyang pa lnga/ /bad kun mkhris par 'dres pas bcu ru bshad/ /ces so/ /mdor bsdus zhes pa'idon/ lhan thabs 'dir mdor bsdusanas mgo rlung sogs bcur bsdus nas bshad /bye

yin pas rgyaspobashad de dag gi rtags bcos sogs phra zhib shes par: 'dod na man ngag rgyud rtsa 'grel las shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa ste don 'di le'u phyi ma phal cher la sbyar ro/ /mtshan nyid rtags ni/ mtshan nyid drug rnam par gyur ba'i rtags/ stong la rgyal ba ni/ khong stong la rkyal ba bus pa ltar steng shed yod kyang mnan na dma' ru song ba/thus 'debs ni/ thang chad pa'i skad ltar kha nas shus zhes byed/ 'phyo ni / yul gcig la mi gtad pa/ 'gul khyab zug ni/ 'gul bskyod bya tshe lus kun khyab par ram ko ler zug snyom ni/ skyid lug pa'am bya ba gang yang byed mi 'dod pa/ rengs 'khums bye chag 'byin dang dkris snyam byed/ /ces pa lus dang yan lag rengs pa dang / rkang lagacu 'khums te zha ba dang / sha lpags bye ba ltar na ba dang rus rkang chag snyam byed pa/ yan lag thag pas dkyis pa snyam byed pa/ spu brtse ni/ba spu'am reg bya zhes pags pa'i dzirlung gi rgyu lam yin pa dang brtse ni / rkang pa brtse ba rkang brtse zhes bya ste/ /zhes pa ltar ber red ba'i — don yin pas ba spu'i bu ga brtse zhing na ba/ phum ser khyer zhes pa'i: ser ni/ kha dog ser ba'i don min par/ bser bus bus dang zhes: pa ltar grang lhags kyi ming yin bas/ phyam ser khyerachaṭarlung gis sog —pa ltar lus po grang shum byed pa/ rlung gsang ni/ an stong dang tshigs pa dang po/ kha bye ni/ gsang mu der rlung smyu bas rang nyid bye/sdi /thom ni/ shes pa za zir gyur te 'thom pa/ 'gyel bubani/ 'gro

ba'i tshe sar 'gyel pa/ phyi yul 'khyoms ni/ yul snang za zir snang gastod rgyangs ni/ stod dbugs kyis gang ba ltar na ba/ nub glo mang ni/mtshan dus su glo lu/ 'phyongs thag chad ni/ mchin pa de nyid gyang la btags pa lta bu'isachin dri dang 'brel ba ste chad snyam byed/ zab snyam ni / tsher mas brab snyam pa/ bsku mnye ni/ mar rnying sogs byug cing—phur ba/ lo shur ni/ sran ma sogs kyi lo ma zhag lon nas rad pa/smyung ni/ yan lag rnams brkyang ste bya cang byed 'dod pa/ bcos pa'i thabs ni/ spyir 'dodadon sgrub byed kyi bya ba thams cad la thabs zhes bya zhingaka 'dir nad la gso byed kyi gnyen po bsdebs pa la gso thabs zhes bya/ zan skam ni/ g.yos su byas pa'i zan skam po/ rus tshod ni/ sre long sog yu gzhug chung mar bcug ste bzhi lo lon pa'i tshod ma/ lo yib ni/ lo gcig 'das pa'i sha skam po yang min rlon pa gsar pa yang ma yin pa'i dri bsungs dang ldan pa ste/ de las phar — 'das pa la sha rnying bya ba yin pas/ kha cig sha rlon pa dri bsungs: mnam zhing ham pa chags pa la byed pa mi rung gsungs/ 'o ma ni/bzhos thog 'o ma/ g.yeng ba med ni/ lus ngag sdug bsngal ba'i bya ba med pa/ mun khung ni/ skar khung sogs bser bu thong sa med pa/sman ni/ zug rngu de la phan pa'i ngas/ 'don ni/ khu jigs gnyis namalhan cig tu bskol ba ste rlung nad yul nas 'don par byed pa/ sre long sog yu gzhug chung bsdus khu dang / /zhes pa la/ stod rus kun1 gi

bcud bsdus sog pa'i sla nga'i yu ba/ smad rus kun gyi bcud bsdus:gzhug chung gi 'phang lo gsum/ yan lag kun gyi bcud bsdus rkang pa'igre long ste/ 'di gsum la rus bcud gsum zer/ de sasre long ni / g.yag lug sogs kyi brla rkang gi rus pa phal skad du bor pi zer ba de dang / mi la rting pa'i rus pa las logs su med pas lha nga'i rus pa la 'dod pa mi 'thad gsungs/ spod ni/ sga shing kun kha ru tsha sgog skya pi pi ling / sha mar bur rnying chang du bsdus pa'i thang / /zhes pa la/lug sha dang mar rnying bur rnying gsum chang gar por sum nyis tsam bskol ba ste 'di la bcud bzhi'i thang zer zhing 'di la sgog skya btabaskye nas bskos ba man ngag tu kha cig bzhed/ lug mgo ni/ lug thong pa'i mgo ma rul ba lo gsum lon pa sha rus klad pa bcas/ lca ba ra mnye'i zan chang ni/ ra mnye lca ba gze ma lcam pa rnams 'bras yos dang bsres nas phye mar btags la zan dron gyi mtheb kyu byas te phabs bran dro sar mnan pa langs nas chang du bsing zhing rnyings nas rtsigs ma de mnyes la bu ram bca' sga dang mar btab nas btsos pa'i skyom dzhai/ phyi rgyud las/ zan changasbyor ba ra mnye lca ba dang / /gze ma lcam pa yos bsres byer btags la/ /zan dron phabs bran langs nas chang du bsingan /rnyings nas mnyes la bu ramasna dang mar/ /btab btsos stor bsten grang rlung ma lus 'joms/ /khyad par mkhal rked gzerasnye/rdo rkang lag bshal/ /tshigs gzhi skrangs dang da rgan rna ba 'on/ /

grang bas chu 'gags smad kyi drod shor sel/ /sked pa man chad grangasnyernag 'byams pa gcod/ ces so/ /gro yi chang bsings ni/ zan chang:de la gro chang gis bsings nas nus pa lhag par 'gyur zhing bad:shas che na snga ma de la nas bsnan te bsings/ /bu ram chang ni/ gro nas gze ma cha mnyam bsres pa btsos te mnan nas langs pa'i grum la bu ram gyi chus bsings pa/ mar chang ni/ pi pi ling go snyod zhib btags phye ma lug gi mar dang bu mar zang gsum bzhus pa bsnur la —der chang blug pa'o/ /gze ma'i chang ni/ gze ma dang nas dkar glu gnyis cha mnyam bsres te bcos la khu ba rang thim byas par chang rtsis — bran la bsnyal/ gze chang des sug smel yung skyer skyu ru bzhi'i phye ma mtshan phyed la phul nas btang ba man ngag cas cig bzhed/ thong tsher rus chang ni/ lug pho lo gsum lon pa thong pa dang lug mo lo gsum lon pa tsher mo zhes bya bde gnyis kyi rusapa so so nas sbubs ril tshon po gcigachom brdung byas la/ gze chang ltar nas chan bsres pa'i chang bshad ma thag pa'i rus lus bsings/ 'di la rgyud las/ rus pa dang chan bsres pa'i grum la bur chus bsings par gsungs/ tsag bcadaske mar ni/ lug gam 'bri mar rnying pa tsag tsag zer ba'i sgra bcad par — bskol/ choms bye ni/ nas dkar mes mi 'tshig pa'i ched du chu la: sbangs nas rlan thag chod par brjos pa'i phye ma ste 'di la skam rtsam: zer / 'ol skom sbyor ni/ mar dang rtsam pa de gnyis bsres te za/ mi

rung du byas/ 'o ma ni lug gi 'o ma/ khugs pa'i glum la nye'u byas ni/kro las byas pa'i chang khugs pa ste smin pa'i glum zhes pa chang snod de'i zhabs suyod pa'i gro rul bo ste/ nye'u byas zhes pa gro rul po de mnyes zhing phur te skyo mar byas nas ras la bcir te khu ba bton pa'i rtsigs ma dor ba'i dwangs ma/ 'di don la rtsigs ma btsir te dor ba'i gro chang gar po yin/ bcos la bsnur zhes pa la de'i tshigs ma 'dor dgos/ mar dang rus kha ni lug gi'o/ /dzā ti shing kun zhes pa/ rlung tshad la dzā ti grang rlung la shing kun thun log skyed la gzhan kun so so nas de'i byed cha re sbyar/ gtsor bskyed nyer lnga'i sbyor tshad la/ shing kun dang a ru'i mjug gnyis spang gang zho drug re/ sha chen sga pi pi ling ar nag dzā ti zho brgyad re/ li shi se 'bru srang gang zho gang re/ bi ṣa ste sman chen 'bri tshil ma srang gang shing tsha spos dkar dri chenasreg thal zho drug re/ gu gul sug smel pagaspobashus zho lnga re/ pho ba ris sgog thal shu dag zho bzhi re/ go snyod ma nu spe tres rgya skyegs rgyam tshwa zhol gsum re/ tshil chen zho gnyis/ ru rta zho gcig go /de la shing kun sha chen li shi gsum gang gtso bor skyed pa gong gi tshad las gnyis 'gyur gtong ba de'i ming 'dogs/ a ru'i mjug ni/ rtsa ba las skog shun — yod pa'i ngos de yin zhing skog thun med pa'i ngos de ji tsam ring yang a ru mchu skung gi mchu yin/ stod ni snying ga yan chad/ smad ni lte dī sdud chad/ bar ni snying ga lte ba gnyis kyi bar/ sman mar zhes pa la/

se 'bru 'u su sga tsitra ka pi pi ling lnga cha mnyam khram khrum brdungs pa brel gang gi bsdus khu bre gsum la lug gi 'o ma bre bzhi 'bri mar nyag bzhi: mar nyag re lasman rta bu ram phul re gtong des sman mar che chungaske rigs bsgres sbyor/ sman mar gyi bshad pa rgyas pa 'dod na dam pa'i: phyag bzhes ltar phyi rgyud kyi brda bkroladu kho bos gsal bar bkodayod pasader shes par bya 'o/ /'jam rtsi btang zhes pa la/ ru rta pi pi ling tsitra ka shingasangar klung chen 'gram gyi shug pa'i phyes mar dang 'o mar —bskol la khyor gang tsam grod pa sogs su blug ste/ nad pa'i bshang bsal kha spub tu 'phongs bteg ste gnas pa'i bshang lam khar snumadze bskus nas grod pa'i khar gce'u sor brgyad rtse phran la snum bskus rtsa ba sbom par grod pa'i kha bsnams/ sbru gu nas sor bzhi gsum tsam btang ste steng 'og g.yas g.yon bcus gcir nas 'phro cung zad bzhag de: 'phral gan rkyal nyal/ sman 'phongs nas 'dzeg na gsus pasar tshur tsodakyu / rlung langs na gsur btangan mjug tu chu bskolaphor gang: 'thung ste sman ro 'don no/ /rgyas bshad 'dod na brda bkrol der gzigs/ reng bu ni sbom phra mdzub mo tsam dbyibs dbyug pa ltarasnebacos nas bshang lam du gzhug pa ste phan yon gong mtshungs/ man: stong tshigs pa dang po ni/ mgo bo skur byas tshe 'bur te 'don pa derna man stong dang tshigs pa dang po'i gzhi mthun du bzhed pa'i lugs gcig dang / 'bur po de an stong yin gyi tshigs pa dang po ni de/sa

'og gi nyag po de yin zhes bzhed pa'i lugs gnyis yod la/ de la sgal tshigs la mkhar te rus pa'i dum bu dang / mkhar mtshams te rus pa'i go bar dang bya 'dab ste logs gnyis su bya'i 'dab ma ltar gnas pa'i rus pa bcas cha gsum yod pas/ an stong zhes pa bar stong gi ming yin pa dang tshigs pa zhes pa mkhar mtshams la pye da pa'i dbang du byas te/ byang pa bkra shis dpal bzang dang zur mkhar ba'i rjes 'brang 'ga' zhig dang kun mkhyen sangs rgyas rgya mcho'i phyi rgyud kyi be+e sngon rnams su de gnyis gcig par mdzad/ man stong gi don sngar ltar dang tshigs pa zhes pa rus mkhar la byed ba'i dbang du byas te/ 'bri gung ba'i rgyud mchan dang mes po'i zhal lung dang / kun mkhyen blo bzang chos grags kyi rdo rje mdud grol rnams su de gnyis tha dad par mdzad do/ /dkar nag mtshams ni/ nu tog gcig nas gcig shos kyi bar du thig skud 'then pa phyed bltab tu byas pa'i brang gzhung / mgo la g.yogs ni/ bag zan mar gyis sbrus pa chu la btsos pa mgo bo ras kyis bkab pa'i steng nas zhwa'i dbyibs su bzos la g.yogs/ snum 'chos ni/ rus sna btsos pa'i zhag gis byug pa dang de'i rlangs sums bya / skam sar zhes pa yig nor te/ skam pa tshor med bya nyams sha lpags 'byar/ /zhes pa'i rlung nas bcos par zhes pa yin pas skam ske par zhes pa'o/ /snum dugs ni snum ldan gyi drod dugs/ rtsa bshal ni rdi snad ltar/ chu lums ni/ rang byung chu tshan gyi'o/ /bshal gyis

sbyangs ni/ thar nu dur byid a ru mchu sung snam rtsa sngon bu khrod bu sgri khaṇ+ḍa dan rog dan khra dong ga dzā ti pi pi ling pho ba ris shing kun sbyar/'phyes pa ni zha ba/ snum 'chos spangs ni/ bad kun dang 'dres pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /rtsub bcos ni/ man ngag rgyud kyi brla rengs bcos skabs ltar te/ nas dkar so ba sre zan skam pa'i sha /zang rtsi skyur rtsabs tshod ma tshwa med byin/ /'bras bu gsum dang tsa bya pi pi ling / / hong len zang dang sbyar ba'i lde gu btang / /zhes sogs so/ /me thur mnan ni/ /an stong tshigs pa dang po dang drug pa bdun pa rnams su me btsa' dang thur ma bya/ /'jam rtsi ni/ bkru 'jam steng shing kun kha ru tshwa bsnan/ me btsas bsal ni/ spyi gtsug an stong sor mo nyi shu myos byed kyi gsang rnams su'o/ri /mgo rlung gi shing kun lnga par / shing kun zho byed dang do/ sga gu gul zho re/ dzā ti zho do/ rgyal tshwa zho bdun no/ /sga skya drug par/ bcod mdud se 'bru dzā ti zho re/gug smel zho bdun/ la la phud skar lnga/ sga skya zho do sbyar/ mgo rlung mkhris ldan gyi ma nu bcu bar/ ma nu spe tres sga skya kuṇ+ḍa ka ri zho re/gser gyi me tog se ba'i me tog 'brum rus dur thod zho do re/ a ru ra tig ta zho gsum re'o/ /bad rlung mgo 'khor gyi shing kun brgyad par/shing kun mar nag skar dgu/ dzā ti li shi ru rta zho re/ tang kun skar lnga/go snyod skar bdun/ gu gul zho bdun no/ /gar chang ni/ chang bzang po chu dang ma 'dres pa/ gzhung bzhin bsten ni/ gur gum ka ra rgya13

ba'i sna sman de rtsi mar bzhus pa'i zhunasar dang sbyar la/ snga dro'i dus su btang yulade'i snabs khung sbyangs nas gan rkyal nyal/ gzhu rgyud yar bstan mi 'gyur ba lta bu la mjing pa bkal lasago dpyangs/ sman gyi thigs pa lnga snar blug cing rkang nas khar byung na hag ces phyir yul: byas la bzlog cing / se gol brgya gtogs bar du nyal/ de nas langs la 'phyi zhing chu bskol btang rjes dud pa bser bu spang ngo / /sdud mgo ni 'dir ltag pa'i sdud sgo g.yas g.yon tshon re bcas/ hor gyi me btsa'ani/ cong zhi go snyod tsha ba gsum bcas zhib btags mdzub rtse tsam ras la phur (gtum )nas mar du btsos pas dugs bya ba ste/'di la me btsa'i ming btags kyang me btsa'i sgra bshad du med de drod dugs yin pas so/ /spra tel ni spra ba'i me btsa' dang gser gyi tel ba/zho gsum ni/ zho sha gsum ste snying mkhal gla gor ro/ /'bras gsumani a bar skyur gsum/ 'bri mar sbyar ni der sbyar ba'i sman mar dwangasasnyesbyor / tsha ba gsum ni sga pi pho/ tshwa sna gsum ni rgya rgyam kha/ btsan dug sman mar gzhung bzhin bsten zhes pa la/ sman chen 'bri stsal ma zho gcig khram khrum brdungs pa chang dang du sbangs la skams nas zhib par btags pa dngan /de'i brgyad 'gyur gyi a ru rgya gar gyi sha phye mar byas pa gnyis bsres la chang gis 'dam 'thag byas nas skam pa mubre gsum la blug nasabre gang tsam du bsdus/ de la mdzo mo'i 'o ma bre byed dngarko'aswā marabregang blug la mar la chu bcad pa'i tshigs ma dor pa'i sman

mar dwangs sbyor byas la/ bzang drug dang bu ram btab ste sto stong la cha yis skyed de bsten/ de yang dang po a ru chung shos tsam dang de nas je cher gtong dgos kyang mthe bong tsam las cher mi rung de yangasnyesman bzi byung na chung ngu dang skabs su ngal gso btang zas spyod spang blang sman maraspya ltar bya/ de lta bu'i thabs dang mi ldan na tshe yi: bar chad du 'gyur la/ thabs dang ldan na tshe'i bcud len du 'gyur — zhing / khyad par snying rlung nad la btsan dug sman mar mchog /ces: so rdo / star bu bdun pa la sbyor tshad ma gsungs pas/ tshad med cha mnyam gtsor smos thun tshad skyed/ /ces pa ltar tshad ma bshad pa la gtso bor smos pa'i sman thun gnyis dang 'khor gyi sman rnams thun re re sbyar dgos/ 'di la ltar bu sung gang gzhan rnams zho lnga re sbyar/rigs pa 'di 'og nas bshad pa'i sbyor sde tshad ma gsungs pa thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'bri rkang ni/ 'bri'i rkang mar dngos dang a ru'i tshi gu la ngos 'dzin pa yod kyang ba ru'i tshi gu yin/ bur phug sman mar ni/ gdams pa sum cu ba'i sman mar gyi sne tshan las bshad cing sbyor ba dngos ni phyi rgyud kyi sman mar le'ur gsungs pa bzhin zhes man ngag rgyud kyi dka' 'grel las bshad pa ltar yin te/ de yang phyi rgyud — las/ a ru chang sbangs sha dang bsil gsum dang / /shing tsha shing mngar bca' sga ge sar gnyis/ /ga dur mar khu zang sbyar 'bri rkang mar / / glo nad rgyas dang rus rlung snying tshad sel/ /zhes so/ /shirdo5

sug ni shing tsha sug smel/ mchin pa spod bran ni/ lug tshon po'i — mchin pa la shing kun gyi phye ma bran pa de mar btsos/ zur gsang ni/mchin ther gyi gsang ste nu tog g.yas pa nas thur du sor brgyad gzhal pa'i sa/ rgya tsha'i chig thang zhes pa yig skyon te rgyam tshwa yin/ se 'bru — bzhi ni phyi rgyud las/ se 'bru shing tsha sug smel pi pi ling / /bur dkar sbyar ba'i se 'bru bzhi pa ste / / pho ba'i gzhi 'dzin me drod gso bar byed / / nad gzhi ci las gyur kyang dang ga 'byed/ /zhes so/ /de'i sbyor tshad yang / se 'bru zho brgyad/ shing tsha sug smel pi pi ling zho — gnyis re sbyar ba gces btus ltar ro/ /long rlung gi se 'bru bcu gnyis la/ be+e 'bru zho gsum/ sga a ru ra dzā ti shing tsha srab mo zho gnyis re / pi pi ling zho gnyis skar bdun/ gur gum zho gnyis skar lnga/ kha ru tshwa zho gnyis skar gnyis/ ka ko la zho gang skar lnga/ rgyam tshwa zho gang — skar gsum/ sug smel zho gang skar gnyis/ zi ra nag po zho gang ngo /smug po long zhugs kyi se 'bru bcu gsum ni man ngag rgyud las/ se 'bru tsha ba gsum dang bzang po gsum/ /gur gum shing tsha zi ra a ru — ra / / rgyam tshu kha ru tshwa dang bu ram sbyar/ /chu tshan phul bas sbo 'khrog long rlung 'joms/ /zhes so/ /'di'i bzang po gsum ni dzā sug kazi ra ni dag po/ spe 'jam ni phyi rgyud ltar/ long phugs ni lte ba'i g.yas g.yon tshon do/ rtsa ba lnga ni ra mnye nye shing lca ba ba spru gze ma/dī/la bcu pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ susmel sga dang rgyam tshwa pi bi ling gla

rtsi sdigalhan lcam pa 'bras sna gsum/ bur dkar sbyar ba'i suklel bcu pa ste/ /mkhal ma'i grang ba rde nad chu 'gags sel/ /zhes so/ /'di'i 'bras sna gsum ni a sra 'jam/ bsil bcud ni sha gsar mar gsar/ yang dro ni chang 'jam zan dron sogs/ khyung rgod drag po ni/a ru zho gnyis/ sman chen zho bzhi/ ru rta zho gcig shu dag skar drugagla rtsi skar gsum sbyar ba'i khyung lnga/ rang rang nad ni rlung nad gang yin pa/ rang gsang ni rgyab kyi tshigs pa lnga pa glo gsang / bdun pa snying / dgu pa mchen gsang bcu gcig pa mcher gsang / bcu bzhi pa mkhal gsang / las lnga ni/ bshal skyugs sna sman 'jam rtsi ni ru ha/ de yi kha 'dzin ni bad mkhris lta bu gang yin pa de'i gnyen po/mde khor gdags ni mda' bkang nas 'phen pa'i rtse mde'us kha bsgyur ba ltar srog 'dzin sogs bye brag so so'i gso thabs sbyar/ /( le'u gsum pa/ srog rlung bcos pa/ zhogs 'ur ni/ tho rangs kyi dus su chu rlung sogs kyi 'ur sgra/ 'byung gdon spyi ni/ gdon chen bco brgyad sogs/ rgyal po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i be ha ra/ za zi ni nyag nyog drod sman ni pi pi ling / srog 'dzin bcu gcig pa la/ dzā ti ru rta a ru ra zho bzhi re/ mar nag zho lnga/ snying zho sha zho drug cu gang nā ga ge sar zho gsum re/ spos dkar zho do bur smug sbyar ba'i a gar brgyad pa'i steng li shi sha chen shing kun zho lnga re sbyar/ go yu bcu gsum pa la/ go yu 01༷dzā ti 020snying zho ༷1 tang kusnyi 7

01 sgong thog pa 01 'bru srang re/ li shi 08 zho brgyad mar nagaske 02 srang do/ sga ༷7 pi 06 pho 07༷zho bdun re/ sman chenaX4 spang bzhi/ ru rta na zhe drug sa ru tshwa ra zho lnga/ snying sna spyir bsdoms srang do sbyar ba lag len gyi tshad yin par lcang lung pa'i gser gyi lde mig las bshad pa ltar bris pa yin la/ 'di dang mchan gyi tshad ches mi mtshungs pas mchan nas 'byung ba'i tshad mchan rangaske gis phye ste bkod pa yin zhing / gong 'og rnams su dkyus tshad dang mchad tshad mi mthun pa 'byung tshe don de ltar shes par bya zhing mchan mi snang na mthun par shes par bya ste/ gnyis ka yang man ngag gang gi dbang du byas pa dpyad par bya'o/ /srog 'dzin dgu par a ru sha chen bzhi ni rdog po bzhi/ gsang sman gtso bo ljid mnyam zhes pa'i gsang — sman ni/ mi na tshod dar la babs pa glo bur shi ba'i snyingaka 'dir grir shi zhes 'byung ba mtshon gyis shi ba'i mi min par glo bur shi ba'i mi yin —te / man rgyud du/ rta gri chu gyi rbab gri g.yang gri dngan /zhes pa'i gyi glo bur shi ba'i mi yin pa ltar ro/ /'brong ne tso'i snying ni zho re/ sbyor tshad 'di nad khams dang bstun par zhib pa ngag las bslab ces par/spyir khyab sman gzhan rnams cha mnyam shing kun bi ṣa kha ru tshwa tsha ba gsum bcas cung nyung tsam dang / sman 'dris goms na bi ṣa yang cham skyed gtong / tshad rtags che na sga chogs gzhan skyed pa sogs kyis swāhās/ dar ma'i gri snying ni mi dar ma glo bur shi ba'i snyingad ka ra zhes

pa'i dod du bye ring las gur gum byung / gsang sman gnyis ni yugs mo'i mngal khrag nal bu'i sha phyi ma 'di phru gu shor ba'o/ /dkar po chig thub ni yongs grags dngos/ gyad ni mi stobs ldan dper bzung /gsang sman gtso bo ni dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i snying / sha chen nam 'brong gi snying khrag 'khor gnyis ni shing kun kha ru tshwa/ yang na gong gsal gnyis/ gsang sman kha tshar ni ri bong gi snying / de kun mnyam par sbyor na gsang sman gyi rtsis sman chen spor/ bya rog mig ni/ske stong tsa ra khung nas bur du mtshon do sor gang bcal ba de nas g.yas g.yon mtshon re sor re na'o/ /me bum tshad ldan zhes pa lag len gces btus kyi dgongs pa ltar gzhan du bkod zin/ se 'bru brgyad pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ se 'bru shing tsha suklel pi pi lingan /de nyid gzhir bzhag brgyad pa'i kha bsgyur ba/ /sga dang dzā ti gur gum ka ko la/ / tshad ldan sbyar ba'i se 'bru brgyad pa 'dis/ /pho mchin stod kyi bad rlung snying skran 'joms/ /zhes dang / dzā ti shing kun kha ru tsha dang sga / / bsdebs pas snying gi bad rlung grang ba sel/ /zhes pa gnyis gang rung yin pas dang po'i tshad ldan la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang yang rang lugs ma zhu mchin rgud la se 'bru dang snying gi bad rlung la shing kun gtso bor bskyed pa'i gtso bo gang yin zho re dang gzhan gsum po zho phyed re btang / gnyis pa la se 'brusang gang shing tsha suklel zho gang re pi pi ling zho do sga zho bzhi dzā ti gur gum ka ko la zho gang re sbyar/ 'dus swā 9 —

gsum ni mdzod spu nas ltag khung du thig skud 'then pa'i rjes su 'brang pa'i mdun gyi smra mtshalas nas sor bzhi bcal bar mtshogs ma/ de nas sor bzhi na spyi gtsug de nas sor bzhi na ltag pa'i sdud sgo gsum// le'u bzhi pa/ ce spyang mgo bcos pa/ 'gram pa ni phog thug byung ba / bsil bu ni rlung gis btab pa/ sbal nag ni pus mo'i gnyan gong sor bzhi/ thur du mi phebs ni skas gdang lta bu las babs mi — nus / skar chu ni tho rangs skar ma ma yal gong du blangs pa'i chu/ —— shing rgya stag zhes pa stag shar ngos 'dzin pa dang byang par ngos 'dzin pa gnyis 'dug pas skabs sbyar dang min tshe gnyis ka gtod pa'i phyag rgyun yod kyang lho shing ni shing tsha/ rgya ni rgya tsha/ stag ni stag ba rtse mo ni a ru'i mchu/ spod ni pi pi ling / dur ni dur byid de tshad cha mnyam zhes pa brda bsdus shan sbyar ltar mdzad pa mang glum nye ni 'bru chang gi spang ma/ snal ma ni ras tshal/ yan par bzhag ni dkris ma med — par bzhag bldabs pa phri ni a ru ra dang ru rta gnyis kyi cha gcig bri/dngul chu bco brgyad ni/ man ngag rgyud du/ rin chen sbyor ba dngulam chu dug phral dang / /mu zi seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa bzang po drug /chu ser sman — gsum gu gul bya khyung sbyar//zhes so/ /'phrul ni rigs 'gres sbyar/ // le'u lnga pa/ khrag rlung stod 'tshangs bcos pa/ tha mal ni nad med pa/ mur 'gram ni mur gong dang za 'gram/ ltag mdud ni ltag pa/ sdud sgo/ rngam rgod ni dbugs gyen du theg 'tshangs ni rdo

bangangs pa snyam zhing brang rus 'bur nas 'bud/ gleng ni smras/ ma nu bzhi pa ni phyi rgyud du/ ma nu kuṇ+ḍa ka ri spe tres dang / /sga skya'i thang gis rims tshad smin par byed/ /bad kun skya smug stongs tshad khrag gzer sel/ / zhes so/ /gser sman ser po ni ming can ser po/ a gar brgyad nas sman gsum phri ba yi/ /zhes pa'i mchan du/ 'phri lugs dang sbyor sde chig rgyud nas shes gsungs pa'i a gar brgyad pa ni/ rlung gi mde thung las bshad pa'i man ngag a gar brgyad pa yin te/ de — yang / a gar nag po shing kun dang / /dzā ti snying zho kha ru tshwa/ /susmrel rnams ni thun re re/ /lang thang tse ni nyis 'gyur yin/ /sha chen tshad ni mtheb tshigs tsam/ /rigs bzang nu zhos ril bur dril/ /tshad ni sran ma 'bring po tsam/ /nad babs che na nyer gcig btang / /bco lnga bco brgyad babs dang bstun/ /smyo byed brjed byed stod 'tshang dang / / rlung nad a warta la sogs/ /spyo 'bog nad la thengs pas chog/ces pa 'di'i lang thang tse'i tshab tu skabs 'dir nges par sgong thog gi 'bru gtong dgos la/ 'di las tsha na shing kun kha ru tshwa sukles gsum sri/ grang na snying zho sha dang lang thang rtse sha chen gsum phri/ a gar — brgyad pa 'di phyi rgyud kyi a gar brgyad pa la byed na/ spos dkar cu — gang gnyis dang a ru ge sar mang rung phri'o/ /chang sol ni chang gsar/khrag shas che na a gar brgyad pa'i steng / /zhes pa'i a gar brgyad ni drang srong ar brgyad yin te/ a ga ru dang snying zho sha /tsan dpyi1

dkar dmar dzā ti dang / /cu gang gur gum sro lo dkar/ /ka ra sbyar bas rlung khrag dang / /mdun rgyab gzer zhing stod du 'tshangan /lud pa skya sob lu ba sel/ /zhes drang srong mu khyud 'dzin gyis tsa ra ka sder bshad pa 'di yin/ gzer 'joms gsang sman ni/ ko byi la/ a gar bcu dgu par/ ma nuX18gle tres ༷1 kaṇ+ḍa ka ri 012sga skya 01 ste ma nu bzhi dang / snying zho hong len nā ga ge sar rnams zho gang skar do/ a bar skyur te 'bras bu gsum gyi a ru ra zho gang skar do/ ba ru ra 012zho gang skar bzhi/ skyu ru ra 24zhi brgyad/ ar skya ar nag go snyod a gar ste a gar rigs gsum dang / gzer sman ser po zho do skar lnga re/ ru rta a byag ༷20li shiX ldadzā ti ko byi la zho do re sbyar / a gar so lnga par/ a gar 05 rigs gsum ru rta sro lo so so nas zho re re/ cu gang 01 gur gum ༷ 1rgya ti li shi 05sug smel ka ko la ༷ 5ste bzang po drug dang 'bras bu gsum 005ba tig zhes ba sha ga ༷༷5tig ta ༷༷5snying zho 005rnams skar bzhi re/ se 'bru hong len dang / a byag gzer 'joms a byag tsher sngon ming can ser po ste gzer sman gsum dang / sman chen ༷༷5gla rtsi ༷༷5sha chen ༷༷5gu gul 05te gnyan sman bzhi rnams skar lnga re/ spos dkar ༷ ldanā ga ge sar ༷ 5ko byi la 005/ ma nu ༷༷5gle tres 005kaṇ+ḍa ka ri 005sga skya 005rnams zho bzhi re/ tsan dan dkar )sbyar kai 5zho lnga re sbyar/ mchan tshad 'di gnyis mchan rgyab ma ltar

yin / glo skam ni glo nad chu shor/ thes bsun ni glo nad thes po/ asnyegar bco lnga ni/ sbyor tshad ngag gsungs pa/ drong srong a gar brgyadam pa nor bu bdun thang dang bsres pa ste/ de nyid kyis/ ma nu bzhi dang 'bras bu gsum/ /a brgyad bsnan pa'i bco lnga pa/ /nus pas khrag — rlung rengs pa dang / /stod 'khrugs spu sob lu ba dang / /gnyan tshad — rlung gsum 'thab pa dang / /snying tshad snying rlung kun la bsngags/ /zhes so/ /'di'i ma gar brgyad pa phyi rgyud kyi a gar brgyad pa la byed tshe a ru gcig shos kyi tshab tu tsan dan dmar po bsnan pa man ngag yin gsungs/ me 'bum 'byar ni gzer steng du'o/ /ngar gdong gi — 'bebs pa zer zhes pa/ ngar gdong gi rus zur brid rtsa ngos chod par byas la der a cug bsnams nas skad thon par bton la mnan pa dang / khrag shas la skug thab kyi mda' dang chu rdos bdug rlung shas che na snum ldan gyi dugs sogs bya/ gnyid log mnan pa zer zhes pa/rtsa gnyid log rgyab nas 'then pas rlung gnon rtsa de mnan pa dang stod 'tshangs yal 'gro/ mchan khung rtsar khug tu zhes pa/ mchan khung gi — rtsar khug ste nyer nyer po dang gzer steng dang rgyab mdun zad pa'i chu — mda' rgyob/ zab pa'i man ngag zab mo ngag tu nyan/ /zhes pa/ nad pa kha mnyam stan la bzhag lus drang por bsrang / rgyab rten bcugarkang pa gnyis brkyang pa'i rting pa sprad pa/ brla'i nang khug rtsa chen gnyis kyi steng gatshwa nas gang rigs khal gcig bzhag nas de steng rdo snyi

rim pa gsum brtsegs bya/ phebs pa'i rtags su rkang pa sbrid sha mdog smug rkang pa zug pa dang / stod zug gar song cha med song ngo / /blo — khrid ni sems gso/ shog shing pa ni re lcag thar nu ni khaṇ+ḍa dgos/dar ma'i gri snying dngos ma rnyed na 'brong g.yag ri bong gang rung gi snying / sbyongs sman 'di la pi pi ling ba ru dan rog bsnan pa man ngag yin zhing / sbyor tshad mar dag nas dan rog gi bar thun re/ gri snying thun log sbyar/ rtsi chen ni shing kun/ snying zho sha chen ni snying rlung gi kha tshar / log non ni gang gzer steng de'u chang bran bsros dugs sogs/skyugs sogs log gnon las lnga spyi dang mthun/ zhes pa'i 'phror/rjes gcod gsang bzhi bsreg la lus zungs gso/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang gcig chad song 'dug gsang bzhi ni drug bdun dkar nag mtshams an stong bzhi/ gong 'og rnams su yig skyon dang chad skyon kha shas pe cing par ma la 'byung ba yin pas 'dir de gsal bar byas pa'o/ // le'u drug pa/ mkhris nad khyi bye brag bcos pa/ lha bsnol ni rang gi lha dang rigs mi mthun pa'i 'jig rten pa gzhan bsten pas 'thab cing 'khrugs pa'am/ mi gtsang ba nyams grib phog pas skyob pa'i lha — dang bral zhing 'khu ba/ 'dre g.yos ni lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul g.yos pa'am 'khrugs pa/ thang las lhags pa ni tshad las 'das pa/ me drod mkhris pa ni 'ju byed mkhris pa/ kha lud ni skran gyis bcar bas sam go bsdus pas so/ /kha shor ni 'grams sam rlung gis so/ /thun mong —

mkhris pa ni nad gzhi me drod snod mkhris gsum/ rgyas par mkhris pa'i nad rtags bzhi bcu bdun/ /zhes pa la thang la lhags pa gcig rlung ma zhu bad kun khrag gi gnas 'gyur bzhi/ /pho skran mchin skran rang skran gsum gyis kha lud gsum/ 'grams sam rlung gis kha shor gcigamakhris pa 'grams pa dang 'khrugs tshad mkhris par babs pa re re/rims nad mkhris par babs pa'i rtsar rgyug la sha ser mig ser gnyis te rigs kyi dbye ba bcu gsum/ lpags gram shar rgyas rtsar rgyu rus zhen re re/ don babs kyi glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma lnga/ snod babs kyi pho long rgyu ma sgang pa mngal lnga/ dbang po'i mgo mig rna ba sna lce lnga ste gnas kyi dbye ba bcu dgu/ 'ju byed sogs rnam 'gyur lnga/ rlung dang bad kun 'dres pa'i lnga lnga ste bye brag gi bco lnga khyon bsdoms mkhris nad zhe bdun no/ /k+ṣa ya ni zad byed ces bsgyur/ mig zhin ni mig gi sha sprin / bzhin ni byad bzhin/ smin pa'i dus ni dus las 'das pa/mkhris las rnam rgyal la/ se ba'i me tog cha lnga/ gser gyi me tog skogs bshus/ a ru cha gcig re sbyar ba ngo mtshar spyi sman yin yang skabs 'dir gsum ka cha gnyam sbyar ba mchan dang mthun/ na mo he tu he ke swā hā/ zhes pa'i ke yig chad 'dug zag zhun dgu pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ brag zhun gla rtsi gur gum susmel dang / /dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra/ /ga dur ka ra cha mnyam brag zhun dgu/ /pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sel bar byed/ /ces dang / mkhris phye bdun 15

yang / de nyid las/ dom mkhris gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung / /gla sgang bong nga dkar po ba le ka /re skon ka ra sbyar ba'i mkhris bye bdun/ /rgyu long bsnad 'grams khrag mkhris tshad 'khru gcod/ /ces so / / 'di la gser me'i dod du pi pi ling sbyar na bsil drags mi — 'byung zhes kha cig bzhed/ sman de gnyis kyang gtso bo zho gsum re: gzhan rnams zho gnyis re sbyar la kha tshar byas tshe kha tshar bzhi skar gnyis re sbyar/ dur byid rkang shun phral ba zho do skar bzhi/ thar nu ba chu rang thim zho gang skar do/ dan rog rtse shun phral ba zho gang / tsha la chu bcad zho gang skar bzhi/ a ru mchu sung gi rtse mo skar ma lnga/ gser me skogs bshus bong dkar rtsa lo bsres pa skar do re/ dngul chu btul ma rgyal sum gur gum 'dres pa'i tig ta zho gang skar do re/ khron bu skar gangam sbyar / bong dkar bcu gsum bar/ dug nyung bong dkar rtsa lo 'dres pa srang re/ rgya tig sum tig 'dres pa srang gang rtsa mkhris g.ya' kyi ma skyer pa'i bar shun gyi rtse ba sha ka zho lnga re/ gser me gi wang par pa: ta zho brgyad re/ gur gum zho bdun/ hong len zho bzhi sbyar ba rtsa ba'i sman yin la/ de la kha bsgyur gyi sman rims la spang rtsi do bo par pa ta — srang re/ khrag la ba sha ka zho lnga pu shel tse srang gang / pho bar pyi yang ku brag zhun srang re/ rgyu mar dug zhung ba le ka spang re ga dur zho gang /kun la bdud rtsi lo ma srang do sbyar/ 'di'i mchan la/ le'u 'dir sdoXs pa la rims sogs kyi kha bsgyur byed na sman sbyor 'di ga'i kha

bsgyur lugs gong steng ldab 'phar zhes yod pa phal cher chad 'dugagar nag bcu par/ se 'bru zho gsum skar gang shing tsha skar dgu/dug nyung lo 'bras zho gang skar gang / suklel zho gsum/ pi pi lingadzirgyam tshwa zho do re/ gser me dom mkhris zho lnga re/ a ru zho gang skar bzhi/phag ril bsregs thal srang gang sbyar/ gser mdog lnga par/ a ru gser mdog gi sha srang gang zho do skar do/ se 'bru zho gsum skar gsum/ gser me skogs bshus zho gang skar bzhi/ bran zhun zho gsum skar bdun/ phag ril sung gang skar gsum sbyar/ gser mdog — bdun par/ a ru gser mdog zho lnga/ se 'bru zho gsum/ shing tsha — skar dgu/ skyu ru zho do skar bdun/ nim pa zho gang / star bu zho do skar gsum/ gar nag zho bzhi skar dgu sbyar/ rgyun spyod ni 'og tu 'byung /tib/ ta brgyad pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ tig ta gser gyi me tog bong nga dkar/ /ru rta rtswa mkhris hong len par pa ta/ /skyer shun ka ra sbyar ba'i tig ta brgyad/ /mkhris tshad mig chu sha mdangs ser ba 'joms/ /zhes so/ /gur gum bdun pa ni/ gur gum cu gang gi wang gtso bo la/ /tig ta ser gyi me tog dug mo nyungaka /bong nga dkar po mkhris pa'i tshad pa sel/ /zhes pa 'dis tsha ba tha ma sel/ tsan dan ga bur rim par bsnan pa ni/ de steng tsan dan bsnan pas tsan dan brgyad sbyor zhes tsha ba 'bring sel/ de steng ga bur cu gang gi chur sbyangs pa bsnan pas ga bur dgu pa zhes tsha ba rab sel/ tig /|

gsum ni rgya tig zangs tig lcags tig chu ser sman gsum ni spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra dza/ ga bur nag po ni phag rgod kyi ril ma nus bsreg dgung gnyis ni nyin gung dang mtshan gung / 'dzim — dkar ni/ sngo ngad kyi bye brag tu gyur pa'i 'dzim pa ma yin par bong nga'i bye brag tu gyur pa'i 'dzin pa yin pas mtha' rten na yod pa ltar — go dgos/ tshad du sbyar ni gtso bo'i byed cha/ bcu gsum bcu dgu bsreg ni bcu gsum pa bcu pa dgu pa bsreg rtsangs ni klung rtsangs dag po/ mi rgod ni mi dang bya rgod/ chu bsil ni bskol grang ma byas pa'i g.ya' chu grang mo/ rngul dbyung ni sne'u'i rlags dugs kyis so/ // le'u bdun pa/ bad kun skya ser bcos pa/ mtshan nyid bdun ldan ni/ bad gan mtshan nyid snum zhing bsil ba dang / /lci rtul 'jam brtan 'byar bag can du gnas/ /zhes bshad rgyud las so/ /gsar thog ni 'bru gser skyes ma thag pa/ bser can ni ma smin pa/sungs pa ni yun lon pa dri ro 'gyur ba/ sha rid ni jud pa/ lo shur ni sran ma sogs kyi lo ma rnying pa/ la phug rad ni la phug rad pa'am rnying pa / ma tshos ni btsos kyang ma tshos pa/ khengs po ni btsos drags pa/zho dar ni zho ma langs pa dang dar ba rad pa/ tshad las 'das pa ni/sto ba'i cha gnyis zas la cha gcig skom/ /cha bzhi pa ni rlung ni gnas su bzhag /ces bshad rgyud las gsungs pa de las 'das pa/ rang rgyud /snyi ni rang gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i rkyang pa/ gzhan rgyud can ni rang

gzhan dang 'dres pa'i ldan pa/ rang rgyud can la bzhi bcu rtsa gcigalpodang / / zhes pa la/ bad kun sten dang lcags dreg dang me drod nyams pa dang bad kun mgul 'gags dang grum bu dkar po dang bad kunaskyi'aju skem ste rigs kyi dbye ba drug /lpags grams shar rgyas rtsar rgyu rus zhen la re re/ don babs kyi glo snying mchin mcher mkhal ma lnga/ snod zhugs kyi pho long mkhris pa rgyu ma lhang pa mngal zhugs drug dbang po — mgo mig rna ba sna lce lnga ste gnas kyi dbye ba nyi shu/ bad kun rten byed — sogs rnam gyur lnga/ 'ju byed sogs mkhris pa dang 'dres pa lnga/ srog 'dzin sogs rlung dang 'dres pa lnga ste bye brag gi dbye ba bco lnga/ khyon:bsdoms bad kun gyi nad bzhi bcu rtsa gcig go/ /slong ba rgyu dang goms pa gnyis kyi khyad par nad gang gi snga rol du gnod pa dang phyi rol du gnod pa'o/ /bying ba ni gting du song ba/ gud ni stobs chung ba / zhar ni steng 'og tu mi gsal ba/ kha mngal ni ro mi gsal ba/mig dkar ni mig gi sha sprin dkar ba/ rtsam pa ni gang zos pa/ sgyid pa skyur ni bya ba gang yang byed par mi 'dod pa/ g.ya' ni phyags snying 'dod pa'am lus za ba'i rnam pa 'byung / 'khrang ni lus shing ltar rengs pa/ las mtha' ring ni las gang byed kyang le lo che ba/ nam zhod ni kha char che ba'i dus/ rten dang ma goms mi 'phrod ngo bo bzhi/ /zhes pa'i rten ni rgas sam grang rlung can/ ma goms ni sngar za ma myong ba'am nam byed du zos pa/ mi 'phrod ni nya sha dang 'o ma lhan ci/bye

bsres pa lta bu/ ngo bo ni 'bru ma smin pa lta bu/ nyams pa ni nyams snang la / stong nge ni lag pasabazung rgyu yod pa ltar snyam par na ba/ mdong mo ni zo ba/ glo langs ni lud pa lu/ ngar sog ni gre ba ngar ngar sog sog zer/ pho ba ltem ni kha cig lte ba 'bud zhing tshe zer/ yang kha cig sto ba rgyab tu 'byar zeranyang pho ba rgyun par mi bde ba/ sprug ni sbrags/kha na lci ni/ nad dang gnyen po gnyis gong 'og tu ma grub kyang gnyen —pos choms dka'/ zan dron ni/ skam pa'i nas 'bru rnying pa chur spangs nas brjos pa g.yos su byas pa'i zan/ chang nar smrin ni/ 'bru chang yun lon nas smin pa/ dro zhing yang la rtsub ni bya rgod g.yi sogs kyi sha rul sungs min pa'i gsar pa/ bde byed snyoms ldan la/ cong zhi pho mo bsres pa'i rgod btulasrang do/ cu gang tsha la btul ma zho gang skar brgyad re/ gur gum li shi la phug nus bsreg thal ba zho gang re/dzā ti sakres pho ba ris skar ma lnga re/ ka ko la zho gang skar lnga/ pi pi ling skarathog sman sga skar gang / da lis zho gang skar drug gangs thig zho drug shing tsha skar brgyad sbyar ba tshad yin/ bzang po'i kha bsgyur ni/ bad kun tsha ba rgyas pa'i zhi byed la/ /ma nu 'u su star bu — bzang bar bshad/ /skyer pa'i me tog 'bras bu bsnan na legs/ /khrag la hong len skyu ru ba sha bzangan /mkhris par bong dkar tig ta gser me bzangan /rlung la dzā ti shing kun kha ru tshwa/ /de ltar bzang po /sdum gyi kha bsgyur 'di/ /skabs bstun sbyar ba byang lugs man ngag —

lags/ /zhes bya'o/ /nad rigs mtha' dag la/ /zhes pa'i mchadabasbyor tshad sogs zhib pa ngag ces pa/ bad kun ldan 'dus gre 'gags sogs la sbyor ba 'di rang gis 'thus shing / ma zhu sogs grang shas che:ba pho ba'i me drod zon dgos rigs la cong zhi bzhag nas se 'bru sbyar/bya rgod dang spyang ki'i pho bas me drod bskyed pa la khyad che/ la phug mesgrobasreg skam po gtong ngo / /dang nad ba mo nyi shar nyid dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ sbyor ba 'di ni bde byed snyoms ldan zhes/ /tsha lung dkon mchog skyabs kyi ngag dam yin/ /zhes pa'i rkang pa gnyis chad song 'dug se 'bru bcu gsum par/ se 'bru srang do/ sga bya brun go brun zho do re/ shing tsha pi pi ling byi tang ga zho re/ rgya tshwa la la phud 'jam 'bras zho gsum re/ dbyi mong tsitra ka zho bzhi re/ pho ba ris zho gang sbyar ba bka' mchan gyi tshad yin la/ lhan thabs mchan rgyab mar byi tang ga zho lnga 'byung / se 'bru kun ldan bde byed la/ se 'bru zho lnga — skar brgyad/ shing tsha sug smel zho gang re/ pi pi ling skar dgu/ bal gur ba sha ka spang rtsi do bo skyu ru skar bzhi re/ bre ga zho gang skar gang /rgya tig brag zhun skar lnga re/ 'u su hong len 'bu su hang skar do re/ bri ut+pa sdig srin skar brgyad re/ ka ra zho gang skar bzhi sbyar/ sha rbab ces pa yig nor te sha lpags yin/ phag bcud bsten bya zhes pa'i mchan/ phag khrag gam lag len gar nag ces yod pa chad 'dugastobs 'phel nad ces pa/ khu ba 'phel ba'i de nad ces 'dod 11

dang / khu ba zad pas 'phel dgos kyi nad ces 'dod pa'i phyogs gnyis yod la/ byang sems dkar po ni cong zhi yin pas phyogs dang po ltar na pho cong drag btul dgos shing / gnyis pa ltar na mo cong bcud 'dus dgos par snang bas dpyad/ khyor gang ni lag pa ya gcig skyor te bzhag la gang ba/ gzhan yang phyi rgyud se 'bru da li yi/ /sbyor ba rnams kyang rang rang nus mtshungs bsten/ /zhes pa'i se 'bru'i sbyor ba ni/ se 'bru shing tsha sug spel pi pi ling / /de nyid bzhir bzhag brgyad pa'i kha bsgyur ba/ /bca' sga byi tang ka dang tsitra ka /'jam 'bras bsdebs pas pho ba'i me nyams gso/ /shing kun kha ru tshwa dang pho ba ris/ /bca' sga bsdebs pas pho long sbos pa sel/ /zhes pa lta bu dang / da li'i sbyor ba ni/ da lis tsha ba gsum gyi gtso bo la/ /shing tsha suklel zi ra kha ru tshwa/ /da lis brgyad pas bad kun grang ba sel/ /dzā ti susmel ka ko la dang ni/ /rgya tshwa sba tshwa dbyi mong tsitra ka /bsdebs pa da lis bcu gcig cur nis 'dis/ /grang nad kun sel lhag par bad kun 'joms/ /zhes pa lta bu ste dang po gnyis kyi sbyor tshad la/ /se 'bru srang gang shing tsha sug smel zho gang re/ pi pi ling zho do gzhir bzhag /kha bsgyur gyi sga zho bzhi re gzhan rnams zho gang re dang /gnyis pa gnyis kyi sbyor tshad la/ da lis nus bsreg srang gang tsha ba sga pi pho gsum zho lnga re/ kha bsgyur gyi sman rnams zho do skar lnga re sbyar/pas par rdo zhun sbyor ba nad 'dir bsngags/ /zhes pa la/ /rdo zhun —

dkar po 'o ma'i mdog can/ sngo skya phug ron ske'i mdog can/ skya bo go bo'i rgyab 'dra/ dmar skya glo ba'i mdog can/ sngo nag char zhin: mdog can te rdo zhun rigs lnga yod pa kun kyang brdungs tshe rwa gzhob kyi dri mnam zhing khyad par sngo nag bzang bar bshad cing sa steng thon nas char nyis khyer pa nus pa 'chor bas sa 'og nas brkos pa dgos/ de mdzub rtse tsam du brdungs la sol mes gting nad 'tshos par har bsregs byas te/ tsha ba'i nad la chu/ grang ba'i nad la chang / tsha grang cha mnyam pa'i ldan 'dus la dar ba'i nang du bskyur te rdo ro phyir bton nas khu ba zho lta bu de skam pa dang / de lag pas zhib tu phur nas dar tshags zhib mo la drangs te slar sngar gyi gnyen po des brlan par byas la zho tsam du 'dam 'thag byas nas/ me la dros tsam bsros nas gar sla ran pa'i tshe 'phang lo byas te skem mo/ /'di rgyud las/ rdo thal pho ba'i bad kun 'dril ba gcod/ /ces pa de yin zhing 'di la ma tshos pa'i rdo phye til tsam shor na dug sbyor dngos yin pas ma shor gces so/ /rdo zhun sbyor ba dngos ni/ de ltar bzos pa'i rdo thal cha gnyis la phyi rgyud kyi se 'bru gsum pa nas se 'bu cur nis kyi bar gyi sde tshan gang yang rung ba cha gcig tu sbyar nas/ chang gar mas 'dam btags byas pa'i ril bu sran ma tsam bsgril ba la/ dpal ldan zur mkhar ba'i ril dkar gyi sbyor sde che mo zhes bya ste/ sde tshan so so nas bshad pa'i sman gyi nus pa ngar ldan du song nas ma zhu me nyams sbo sgreg dmu chu nyen masnyi/

bad kun grang ba sogs la thengs pas chog go/ /cong zhi 'phrul thal zhes pa la/ dang por me thab kyi sa bzang po la zhig dka'i kong bu kha gcad gnyis rim dang ldan pa bzos la/ phyi nas sa dang sol ba bsreg pas yang yang byugs shing shing sogs kyis brdungs te sra zhing mkhras (mkhregs )par bcags nas me nyis dros par bsros nas skam thag chod par skem la me 'jam por bsregs te so btang / de nas a ru'i —sha tshal shel dkar ma rgyam tshwa shel 'dra ma pi pi ling lcags myug ma bong nga dkar po'i rtsa ba rnams cha mnyam de rnams bsdoms pa'i nyis 'gyur gyi pho cong bzang po/ mu zi gser 'dra a ru dang mnyam pa rnams zhib —par btags pa kong bu'i sum cha tsam blug la sum nyis stong par bzhagakha bcad 'og ma rgyab la bar mtshams su lci thal brdzangs/ de nas kha — bcad steng ma rgyab la sol 'dag sbyar bas legs par bsdams pa nyi — mar skem te rlangs pa mi 'chor par bya/ lung rdo sum sgrom gyi steng du bzhag la steng 'og thams cad nas sol me bzang po btang / spud pa dal gyis bus/ sbrus drags na kong bu bkas (gas )'gro/ de ltar me rgyun ma chad par nyi ma lnga tsam du bsreg me yal nas kong bu dron mo la snom pas mu zi'i dri sangs nas tshos pa yin pas 'don/ ma sangs na ma tshos pas yun bsrings la bsreg dri sangs pa dang grangs su bcug la kong bu kha bye ste bltas pas sman 'phel nas snod bkang ba dang / cu /dro ltar dkar zhing chu grang blug na khol ba dang / sha rjen la byugs

nas chu cung zad blugs pas bsreg nus de legs pa'i tshad yin par gsungs pas lag len de ltar yin/ phan yon yang / phyi rgyud las/thal ba zhig btags ka ra sbyar ba ni/ /ma zhu bad yin nyen dang lcags dreg dang / /rdo dug dbyi dug bad mkhris smug po'i skran/ /pho ba'i nad kun tsha grang med par 'joms/ /zhes so/ /thang stong ril dkar ni/a ru ra cha drug cong zhi brag zhun ma nu pa tra hong len nam spang rtsi do bo zho gsum re sbyar la sbrang gi ril bu bya/ da lis bdun ni/ phyi rgyud las/da lis shing tsha suklel ka ko la/ /zi ra pi pi ling dang na le sham/ /'khru skyugs ma zhu lcags dreg sten skran 'joms/ /zhes so/ /rgya chags ni pags pas btums pa/ skran sman khabasgyur ni gshakha gsal/ mgron thal nyer gsum sogs/ thun gsum ril bu ni/ phyi rgyud las/ rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa rtse myang kha ru tshwa/ /tsabs ru tshwa dang rwa tsha shing tsha dang / /mdze tshwa thal tshwa ya bak+ṣar dang / /tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum po rnams/ /thun gsum cha mnyam bu ram ril bur dril/ /nyen skran mngal skran khrag skran thal bar rlog /ces pa'i tshwa sna thun gcig tsha ba — gsum thun gcig 'bras bu gsum thun gcig sbyar/ bshal skyugs zags ma ni/ bshal lam yang na skyug ces mchan rgyab mar 'byung yang zags ma'i don ma tshang bas/ phyi rgyud kyi ded dpon sbyor ba drag 'jam gang rung ma nu rgyam tshwa pi pi ling gis kha bsgyur ba la spyang tsher btab ste btang na bshal smyugs gnyis ka 'byung bas de ltar bya'o/ /dkor /bye

nor rdzas kyi brda rnying pa yin pa 'dra zhing 'di la bla ma dkon mchog gi —rdzas dang / khyad par dge 'dun gyi rdzas brku 'phrog byed pa dang /dad gshin gyi rdzas la bag med du spyod pa sogs yin/ sngon las rnam — smin ni/ tshe rabs sngon mar byas pa'i dkor sogs mi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu smin pa'am/ tshe stod la byas pa'i mi dge ba'i las stobs ldan gyi 'bras bu tshe smad la lus srog gi steng du smin pa/ cong zhi rgod btul ni / phyi rgyud las/ cong zhi rgod btul sol mes tshos par bsregadakar por song nas chang ngam dar ba'i nang / sor thon tsam gyis ngad bsad phye mar 'gro/ /gag pa sha ro lhen skran lcags dreg gcod/ /ces gsungs te 'di'i bsreg tshul dang phabs tshul sngar gyi rdo zhun ltar bya/tsha ba lnga ni sga pi pi ling pho ba ris dbyi mong tsitra ga tshwa sna tshogs ni shing kun byi tang ga gnyis kyi steng du rgyam tshwa sogs tshwa sna thams cad/bzang po bzhi ni dzā li sug ku sdo yi tsha ba gsum ni/ lce tsha dbyi mong srub ma chu skol tshan mo zhes bar de'i drod du g.yag rog gi khrag dron mos 'phul ba yang skabs blta/ skabs su zhes par chu tshan la zhugs pa yang skabs sbyar/ skug sman spyi dang lag len mi 'dra ba'i zab gnad — ces pa/ skabs 'di'i sbyor ba 'di yin yang khyad par gyi snying po gabacu pa ni/ sbang ma dang mthing dang me tog lcang shog ser po lo ma kha 'bus dus su btus pa rtsa lo dang me tog kha 'bus pa rnams bsres dgos/di/ de gsum shin tu gsang ba'i man ngag yin 'dug gsungs/ star —

bu pañtsa zhes pa'i pañtsa ni lnga'i ming yin la de yangan man ngag rgyud las/'gogs dka' star bu ru rta pi pi lingan /shing tsha skyu ru ra dang zangarkosbyar btang / /zhes so/ /'di la mchan rgyab mar shing tsha'i dod du shing mngar zhes 'byung ba yi ge nor/ e 'phrod ni 'phrod dam/ /zed tsam:ni cung zad/ nyen gsang ni phyi rgyud las/ nyen sna'i rtse nas mtshonaskyigang nyen gyi gsang / /zhes so/ /ol gong tsha ba ni lug gi lto stong gri thags byas pa'i tshod ma/ tshogs gsog ni bla ma dang dge 'dun gyi sde sogs la mang 'gyed tsha ba phul ba dang mchod rten bzhengs pa sogs: kyang yin/ rim gro ni gdon bgegs lan chags kyi mgron la mchod — sbyin gyi bsnyen bkur zhu ba ste deng sang rgyal btsan sogs la yas stag gtong tshe gang ngan ngon tsag tsog nas byas pa mgron la brnyas thabs su song bas/ ma mgu ba'i khar 'khu ldog 'byung zhing rim gro'i don yang ma tshang bas gang gces gang bzang nas gtong dgos/ sgrib sbyong ni sdig rtsang sbyong ba la bsngags pa'i gzungs 'don pa sogs so/ /'bogs ni byed du chug yid 'chus ni bdag 'di las grol mi nus snyam pa/ gar nag ni ga bur nag po zhes pa'i sgra bsdus pa ste phag brun nus bsregagaser mdog ni a ru ra/ se ba'i me ni se ba'i me tog tsha grang rtas brgyunani tsha na ka ra grang na bu ram bzhi 'gyur/ cong zhi drug ni phyi rgyud las / cong zhi se 'bru sukres pi pi lingan /ma nu gur gum ka ra cong zhi drug / / bad kun brang tsha chu tshan skyug pa 'joms/ /zhes so/ /'dis

cong zhi chu grang la babs pa'i grang 'dul lam mdzo 'or 'dam btags byas pa dgos/ cha mnyam bzhi thang ni rgyam tshwa bzhi thang ngam cha mnyam bzhi thang zhes bya ste/ phyi rgyud las/ grang sel bca' sga rgyam tshwa a ru ra / / tshan mos drod chung grang nad ma lus sel/ /pi pi ling bsnan — sman ma zhu ba 'ju/ /zhes so/ /'di'i dang po gsum la rgyam tshwa gsum thang zer/ se 'bru brgyad pa ni sngar bkod pa de yin/ kha 'dzin rgyud bzhin btang ni bad dzin skya bo rigs drug las nyen dang mgul 'gags gnyis ma gtogs pa'i bcos thabs 'dir ma bshad pas so — sor kha 'dzin man ngag rgyud las blangs la se 'bru bcu gsum gyi steng du bsnan nas btang zhes pa ste/ de yig tshogs che bas 'dir yang ma bkod do/ /bya khyung lnga ni man ngag rgyud las/ sha rus rgyus pa snying khrag bya khyung lnga/ /bzhi gcig gsum gnyis byed dang sum cha sbyar/ /zhes pas / sha a ru ra spang gang zho do/ rus ru rta zho gsum/ rgyus pa thu dag zho dgu/ snying sman chen zho drug khrag gla rtsi zho gang skar lnga sbyar ba yin zhing / sman chen a ru ra dang mnyam par sbyar na khyung lnga mnyam sbyor ram khyung rgod drag po zhes bya/ // le'u brgyad pa/ 'dus nad smug po bcos pa/ dper mtshon ni nyes pa gsum tshogs pa'i steng du ming gcig btags na smug po/ grang ba snying chad ni grang ba thag pa bcad pa lta bu mtha' rdugs pa/ lo stu spya dus te/ dang po 'jug dus bar du a dus tha mar rgyas dus

co/ / sbom ni khrag gi cha nas/ khengs ni rlung gi cha nas/ zhar te misnyegasal ba ni bad kun gyi cha nas/ gud ni rtsa dma' ba/ kha 'khor ni — rgyun par ber rin/ ro rgyab sgrog ni mdun rgyab sbrags nas na/ don med nani slong rkyen ma 'phrad kyang na ba/ byas pa med ni bcos thabs ma byas pa/ drag ni bzang du 'gro/ rgya bshal ni rgya tshos kyi khu ba bshal ba / dud khu ni phying pa du tshi can chu la gcir pa'i khu ba ltar kham nagagasar thog 'bru ni ces ma thag pa'i 'bru rjen pa/ gro yos ni gro tshig par brjos pa/ phye sungs zan ni rtsam pa yun song nas dri ma can du song ba/ gnag sha ni glang thug gi 'og can gyi sha/ sha bem ni yun song rul ba/ chang skyur ni ro zhim yal nas skyur bar song ba/ zho ma langs ni zhor bsnyal yang ma khregs pa/ sol ba ni gsar pa/ chu dmar — dugs ni man ngag rgyud kyi dka' 'grel las chu mdog dmar la mog mog po zhes bshad la/ be+eḍūr sngon por dmar la dri ma che ba zhes bshad/ rlung khrag phar 'bor tshur 'bor ni rlung gis khrag phar 'bo ru 'ded cing khrag gis rlung tshur 'bo ru 'ded pa/ sha zhu ni sha dbri/gsungs ni man ngag rgyud du'o/ /sings gleg ces pa'i sings ni chang gi tha ma/ gleg ni ro yal nas nal bor song ba/ shed ni stobs/ khrid ni 'phrig 'byams ni 'dzag grum thabs ni grum bu 'dra/ sngar nad ni phyis byung pho mchin slar yang na bde sngar byung gi nad do/ /ma zhu ba'i gnas ni pho ba/ zhu ba'i gnas ni long ga bar du ni zhu ma zhu'i bar rdo rmā

ma / gnyan ni bcos dka'/ bya ra ni brtag pa/ mchan gyi dra ma ni yig skyon te gra ma yin/ de yang sgra sbyor nges par gra yag pa bong bu'i ming du bshad cing / bla rtas rgyud 'grel du gra ma ni spyir ra dang gla ba la 'dod cing / bye brag ra mo skyes nas lo gnyis lon pa'i sha gsar la bya'o gsungs la/ man ngag rgyud kyi dka' 'grel dang be+e sngon gnyis nas phag gzhon nu la ngos 'dzin zhing / de yang sha ma skyes pa'i skyes phral dang dar la babs pa'i tshil che dang rgas pa'i rid pa min pa skyes nas lo gnyis len pa'o/ /gtsang nya ni bod yul du go bde bar btang ba las chu klung chen po gang byung gi nya/ skam pa'i ni yig nor te skam sa'i yin/ skyur mo drug par/ gyi'abrum ni skyoba'i 'bru/ chu rkang ni chu rtsa sdong po gzhon tshe btus pa/ dmar po gsum ni btsod rgya tshos 'bri mog / rtsa dmar ni dmar thang / cong zhi nyer lnga la/ bzang drug ni cu gur dzā li sug ga 'bras gsum ni a bar skyur/ gnyen po gsum ni ma nu 'u su star bu/ se 'bru gsum ni se pi sga/ de'i sbyar tshad kyang cong zhi zho lnga/ bsil sman rnams zho do re/ drod sman rnams zho re sbyar/ cong zhi nyer gcig la/ spyi 'gro'i tshad dang zhal shes kyi tshad gnyis kyi dang po la/ cong zhi se 'bru star bu brag zhun sung re/ supo pi pi ling gser me gi wang tig ta zho lnga re/ dug nyung pyi yang ku ma nu zho gsum re / 'u su ut+pal ba sha ka zho bzhi re/ bse yab ru rta tsan dan dmar po sdi /rgyad re/ bong dkar a ru skyu ru zho bdun re sbyar/ gnyis pa la/

tsha shas che na bsil sman grang shas che na drod sman/ khrag mkhris shas gang che na'ang so so'i sman thun skyed sbyor/ cong zhi gtsor sman gzhan cha mnyam sbyar ba spyi khyab yin zer ba'ang yod/ glang chen me tog bco brgyad par/ gi wang zho bzhi/ gur gum zho lnga/ tsan dan dkar po zho gang skar gang / tig ta sha chen skar ma lnga re/ re skon ru rta zho do re/ut+pal ma nu bri yang ku zho re/ 'u su zho gang skar brgyad/ brag zhun zho gsum skar bdun/ ba sha ka zho gang skar drug gser me skar ma gang /a nag skar do/ sku ru'i sha zho gang skar bdun/ cu gang zho do skar dgu/tsan dan dmar po skar brgyad sbyar/ 'di'i ba ni ba sha ku rgyud kyi gangs thig bcu drug ni man ngag rgyud las/ yang na gangs thigs a ru brag zhun dngan /sgo /tsan dan mi rus btsa' ma dang / /dom mkhris yung ba khur rtsa dri chen dang / /bzang drug kur sbyar rim pas bskyed de btang / /'khrog 'gyur 'khru snyam byed na kha zas dbri/ /sman thun bskyed la chu bskol tshan mos dbul/ /nang 'gyings zho ltar chags pa thur du sbyongs/ /'khrur ma 'dod kyang rang gi gnas su 'joms/ /zhes pa ste/ 'di la zhen pa 'gog byed mi'i sog thal dang / khrag tshad sel byed tsan dan dmar po bsnan pa man ngag yin zhing / smug po la gnyen po bdun sbyor sga skya bcas sbyar/ dug la khyung sder re ral gla rtsi bong dkar bse ru bcas sbyar ba kha tshar yin/ sbyar tshad kyang bzang drug dang kha bsgyur gyi sman rnams zho re/ dri chen zho byed dang gardiswā/

khur rtsa nas gangs thigs bar cha re rim pas bskyed pa man ngag gi yang snying po yin no/ /bdud ji bsil ba'i chu rgyun la/ 'di ni gangs thigs bcu drug dang khog 'dra ste/ gangs thigs kyis tsha ba skem/ a rus 'du ba snyoms/ brag zhun gyis mchin tshad sel/ dar tshur te tsha la btul mas khrag 'chags ('khyags)'ju/ tsan dan dmar pos 7 khrag tshad sel/ mi rus kyis chu ser skem/ ma 'u se uta bzhis nad thog rgyu zhing bad smug sel/ dom mkhris kyis rtsa kha sdom/ yung bas dwangs snyigs 'byed/ khur rtsam pho ba'i dreg pa 'gog rig 'dzin gyi dri chen gyis snyigs ma sbyong / bzang drug gis don lnga srog rtsa'i nadaske sel / / sbyar tshad gong ma bskyed do/ /sman 'dis 'khru snyam byed na thun bskyed la chu bskol mang du btang /'dus nad mtha' dag 'jom mo//gzhan yang rgyud chen rdo rtsi sngo sbyor 'phrod/ /ces pa'i rdo sbyor ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ rdo sbyor gangs thigs a ru brag zhun rgyal/ /btsun mo ba sha ka dang re skon pa/ /cong zhi sras la blon po gnyen po gsum/ /smug po ma lus gso ba'i spyi sman yin/ /zhes dang / rtsi sbyor ni/ rtsi sbyor a ru brag zhun 'du ba snyoms/ /cu gang gur gum glo mchin kha gnon yin/ /se 'bru bse yab star bu 'u su dang / /ma nu at+pal pi pi ling bdun/ /bad kun tsha ba 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin/ /tig ta ba sha ka yis khrag mkhris gsod/ /tsha stobs che na snyi /tsan dan bsnan/ /༷༵ ba che na da lis sge gsher bsnan/ /stod smad bar gnas bur
