dkar zang rtsis bsgyur/ /smug po ma lus 'joms pa'i spyi sman yin/ /khyad par smug po tsha ba rgyas la bsngags/ /zhes dang / sngo sbyor ni/ sngo — sbyor bri zisku dang khur mang dang / /se rgod bar shun star bu yung ba lnga//gong ma cha bskyed gtso yin de yi 'khor/ /da lis shing tsha susmel ra mnye pa / / spe tres zhib btags ka ras rta byas la/ /tsha grang chu bsil bskol bas 'phul la btang / /smug po kun 'joms khyad par 'thab pa sel/ /zhes so/ /zla shel myu gu la/ cong zhi chur btsos dug phral mdzo thor 'dam btags grib skam spang do zho gsum skar drug tsan dan dkar po ka ko la dom mkhris ba sha ka skar drug re/ cu gang zho gang skar bdun/ gur gum gla rtsi skar do re/ li shi skar lnga/ dzā ti susmel pyi ut+pa skar dgu re/ dug nyung zho gang skar lnga/ gser me skyu ru zho re/ pi pi ling khur mang mu zi hong len skar brgyad re/ bong dkar rtsa ba lug ru smug po zho gang skar do/ tig ta skar bzhi/ a ru zho gang skar drugagi /ru rta zho gang skar bzhi/ se 'bru zho dgu skar lnga/ brag zhun btul ma zho gang skar brgyad/ lcags phye btul ma zho gsum skar bzhi/ gangs thigs zho brgyad/ chu rtsa zho do skar do/ mi'i sog pa bsreg thal zho do skar do/ mi brun bsreg thal zho bzhi/ dngul chu bco bkru zho brgyad — skar brgyad/ ut+pal zho gang skar lnga/ ko byi la zho gang skar gang / ma nu zho do skar bzhi/ ka ra zho bzhi skar lnga sbyar/ 'di'i mu zi me nyor 'jam pos mar dkar rang mnyam tsam la bzhus nas sbra snyigs phyung ste re ba57

phyis pa dang / lcags phye ni zhun thebs byas pa'i lcags bzang bseg: brdar gyis brdar pa'i phye ma 'om bu'i lo mar bcos la chu grang gis: bshal bas dug thon/ de rjes lan tshu'i chu la gtun gyis bsnur bas g.ya' phral te myur bar skam/ de nas rang mnyam gyi ma ru gser mdog gi sha'i phye ma chur bskol ba'i khu ba gar sla dar ba tsam la btab ste dro sar bsnyal bas lcags kyis seg med cing thal ba mthing nag du byung ba'o / / lcags phye gang btang thams cad la 'dus thabs 'dis chogadangul chu bco bkru ni/ dngul chu skor gsum gyi zhal gdams ltar byed dgos kyang lag len du khel dka' bas de ltar mi nus na/ lcags snod bug rdol med par dngul chu zho gang gi tshe gsha' dkar zho byed dang /zha nye gsha' dkar gyi phyed/ mar nag thur mgo gsum blug la/ me ske nyor gyis snum khol tsam byas te zhu bas gsum ga dbyer med du gyur ba— na rdo gzhong grang mor blug pas dngul skam shin tu legs pa 'byung ste/de nyid ba chu'am star bu'i chus lan gsum bkrus la spyod do/ /'di la dngul chu dkar btul lam grang 'dul zhes bya ste/ dug dang smug pocu snying tshad sogs la btang / brag zhun btul ma ni/ brag zhun chu la spangs nas rdo dar la btsags nas dor la ma 'dregs par dkrug cing /khaṇ+ḍa byas pa ste/ gang la btang yang brag zhun 'dul lugs 'di yin zhing / khyad par pho mchin mkhal tshad mig nad chu 'gag smug po dug — shāsnyi rnams la chig thub yin/ 'di la 'ga' zhig gis/ byi ba rdo dreg

zos nasakhyad btang ba'i steng du gcin 'dor babag zhun du gtong ba shin ca'akhrul te/ brag zhun de gser dngul zangs lcags tshon mo ste zha nye'i khams can gyi brag so so nyi mas gdungs pa na rang rang gi khams bur zhun ltar 'dzag pa la yan lag brgyad par gsungs pas so/ /desne la khong gi rtog pa la/ rdo dreg dang brag zhun gnyis ka rdo las byung bar mtshungs pas rdo dreg zos pa'i byi ba'i brun la brag zhun gyi nus pa yod — pa mi 'gal lo snyam pa'o/ /'o na/ gur gum dang rtswa spang gnyis ka rnam rigs yin pas rtswa spang la gur gum gyi nus pa yod pa mi 'gas zer: nas gur gum gyi dod du rtswa spang zos pa'i ba lang gi lci ba gtong zhiga'adi'i tshon mo ste ni gsha' dkar yin la/ rgyud las brag zhun rigs —lngar gsungs pa yang gsha' dkar dang zha nye gnyis gcig tu bsdus — pa'o / / dri chen ni nus bsreg dgos/ cong zhi bsil sbyor ni/ phyi rgyud las/ cong zhi mdzo 'or 'dam btags grib skam bya/ /sgo chubazang drug ut+pal tsan dan gnyis/ /gla rtsi gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung / /tig ta bong nga a ru ba sha ka /ru rta pi pi ling dang ka ra sbyar/ /cong zhi bsil sbyor dug dang smug po dngaka gab tshad tshad rnying ma lus sel bar byed/ /ces so/ /'di'i sbyar tshad mchan rgyab ma ltar byas so/ /skabs dang sbyar ni/ khrag tshad shas che na ru thung sogs gtar/ mkhris tshad shas che na dur byid hong len tsha la star bu'i bshal dang / bad rlung shas che na me btsa' dang dugs bya/ ltag sprad ni re mos/ gu/ 3—

thob ril dkar ni/ cong zhi a ru ru rta se 'bru shing tsha susmrel pi pi ling rnams snga ma zho re bskyed pa'i ril bu/ gi yodagu pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/gi /gur gum ut+pal ba le ka /tig ta brag zhun ru rta ba sha ka /gsor gyi me tog ka ra gi chudagu/ /mchin pa bsnad 'grams mchin khrag rgyas pa dang / /mchin tshad bad kun smug po rgyas pa sel/ /zhes so/ /in+d+ra bzhi thang yang de nyid las/ dug nyung bong nga ga dur ba le ga'i/ /thang gi rgyu long snod tshad ma lus sel/ /zhes so/ /gur gum bdun pa ni/ /gur gum cu gang gi chagatso bo la/ in+d+ra bzhi sdebs rgyu long snod tshad sel / / zhes so/ /gnyen po gsum ni ma nu 'u su star bu/ /g.yu ril bcu gsum ni/ 'og tu le'u brgya brgyad par/ ru rta skyu ru se 'bru ba sha ka / suklel pi pi ling dang pyi ut+pa//bca' sga 'u su ut+pal re skon pa/ /go thal byi tang ka rnams sbyar ba 'di/ /g.yu ril bcu gsum zhes bya smug po dang / /khrag mkhris bad kon pho ba'i nad la phan/ /zhes so/ /'di'i sbyar tshad ni/ ru rta zho gsum skar lnga/ skyu se ba bri uta ri go byi rnams zho re/ sug pisga 'u rnams skar bdun re'o/ /thang chen nyer lnga bar / ma nu pa tra ni/ ma nu yid 'ong dang pa tra gos dang 'dab ma dang lo ma rnams la 'jug pa las 'dir ma nu me tog ser po can gyi lo ma/puskar mu la ni rgyas byed rtsa ba zhes bya la/ 'di la ma nu puska zhes kyang bya ste puska me tog gi skad dod yin yang 'diras nu me tog dkar po can —sdi shā ba/ yang ma nu pa tra ma nu rang dang puskar mu la khams kyi ru rta la

bzhed kyang phyi ma 'di la sha pho ru rta btang ba yang 'dug 'khri shing ni/dbyi mog (mong )dkar po dang 'om bu dkar po gang rigs la bzhed/gang yin yang nyi ma ma log gong du btus pa'i lo ma/ 'di'i sbyar tshad kyang kha che zho bdun skar dgu/ ba tig hong kyi bong 'u dbyi gang uta gi rnams zho do re/ ma nu ba sha bar ta kham ru rnams zho re/ bse yab zhon bdun/ khrag zho brgyad/ re ral se 'bru zho drug re/ lug mig zho gang skar bzhi/ suklel zho gsum/ brag a zho lnga re/ sku gser zho gsum re/dug la suklel dor la su mi sbyar/ mtshal dkar ni cog la ma yin gsungs kyang de la dkar nag gnyis yod pa'i nag po ni rang byung gi mtshal rgya khab kyi gshibs pa 'dra la mdog smug shas can kha dog dag pas tshon mi nyan pa reg dug sogs la phan pa de yin zhing / dkar po la sdong ros dang dngul chu sogs la bzos pa dbyibs cog la ma 'dra ba la snod du blugs nyams yod pa mdog legs pas tshon nyan pa/ reg dug la byugs na gnod pa/ rgya nag pas/ da chu zer ba de skabs 'di'i mtshal dkar yin/ tshos gsum ni bcod tshos zhu/ rang rang rtsa ni / snying la snod ka glo bar drug mgo mchin par ru thung mcher par srin lag rgyab rtsa mkhal mar byin gzhug mkhris par mkhris pa gsha'acha rings rgyu mar rgyu rtsa pho bar rwa rtsa dang drug 'dus bsam bser byin gzhug long la long rtsa/ dom ni dom mkhris/ sran me ni lo tog sran ma'i me tog la ngos 'dzin mkhan mang ba la/ dri med shel phreng ༷swā/

sran ma'i me tog mkhal nad khrag shor skem/ /zhes bshad pas srad me yin la/ de yang smug po'i gzer zug sel ba dang khrag lam mthud pa'i nus pasasrad dmar yin snyam pa'i dogs pa skyes kyang / shel phreng gi — srad ma'i me tog de sngo sman gyi sde tshan du ma bshad par lo tog sran ma'i sde tshan du bshad pas sran ma'i me tog la byed pa nyid legs sam snyam/gser tog ni gser gyi me tog sa 'dzin bzang po ni 'bri ta sa 'dzin/pa ṇi grang mo ni chu bsil grang mo ste 'di gangs chus byed pa phyag len yin / se 'bru brgyad pa ni/ se 'bru bzhi'i steng du ma nu 'u su star bu bse yab bsnan te se 'brubang gang pi pi ling zho gnyis gzhan rnams zho re sbyar/ tshwa bsregs sbyor ba ni/ phyi rgyud las/ tshwa bsregs sbyor ba ba tshwa med pa'i tshwa/ /sngo zhing ro mngar ldan pa khyor ba do/ /ba zho bre gang rgod sha mtheb tsam sbyar/ /btsos dkrugs chu tshod phrul por song ba — dang / / rdza blug du ba mi 'chor kha bcad la/ /bong mes 'tshos par ske bsregs pa'i thal ba de/ /star bur pi pi ling dang bu ram sbyar/ /ma zhu nyen dang lcags dreg khrag skran bshig /ces so/ /'di'i rgod sha ni 'brong g.yag gi sha yin zhing / ma rnyed na bkol spyod ma byas pa'i yul —g.yag gi shas tshab byed/ 'phrul thal ni/ cong zhi 'phrul thal che 'bring chung gsum sbyor tshul lag len dang bcas pa kho bos phyi rgyud kyi brda — bkrol du bshad yod pas der gzigs shig kha bsgyur skran sman ni /spyan thal gyis kha bsgyur ba'i 'og bshad skran sman gang rigs/ ru rta

drug pa'i sbyor tshad ngag gsungs pa la/ tsha na ru rta skyu ru ba sha ka skyed/grang na se 'bru pi pi ling suklel skyed/ skabs 'dir zur 'debs zhig byas na/ smug po skyur 'don zhes bya ba/ /lcags khog nang du lcags kyi rigs/ /thams cad zhun thebs byas pa blug /de nang chu blug a rum ra / / dog po bdun ni khram khrum brdungs/ /tshur dag ma ru gcig tsam blug / dben par zhag gsum byibs la bzhag /de nas 'don la dkrug cing bskol/ /de ltar bskol ba'i khu bde/ /ja sun tsam re zhag bdun bsten/ /de yis smug po yun ring lon/ /pho ba'ingos la lcags dreg chags/ /de rnams zhus nas 'gog par byed/ /de nas bkru sman rnon pos sbyangs/ /gzhan yang smug po 'joms pa'i sman/ /phye ma lcags khus 'phul la btang / /zas sman skyug cing zungs zad la/ /lcags khu skyur 'don 'di nyid mchog /ces 'byung cong zhi tsha sbyor ni 'phrul thal dang tshwa bsregs gnyis ltag zad/ mtshal gyis bsgyur ni zho gang gis so/ /ha bo ni brag snaha bo/ nad snar ni lar ldog pa/gsang ni/ srog rtsa'i rgyab gsang tshigs pa drug pa/ pho ba'i rgyab bcu gasdus pa /dun dahās ma/ long gi rgyab bcu drug pa mdun long phugs// shā ༵ / ཿ ༵ /ma/ zhu ba bcos pa/ bsten zhes pa yig nor te/rten ni zungs ngan pa grang rlung can/ ma goms ni sngar za ma myong ba: nam byed na zos/ mi 'phrod ni thongad sogs/ ngo boni sha rid 'tshin+dha

pa sogs/ lus ngag brel ni lus stobs dang thos tshul legs pa/goms sam brid ni/ 'dris goms sgo nas cha yis bslab par bya/ /zhes pa'idon te bshad rgyud brda bkrol du bkod zin/ gyong ni skya ba/bcud ni sgreg pa dri ngan pa 'phral 'phral byung / las ni lus pa/ zhag can ni bshang gci gnyis ka rnyog pa/ khong snyom ni spro ba chung / rgod sha ni bya rgod kyi sha se 'bru lnga ni/ sngar bshad se 'bru bzhi'i steng dong gram zho bzhi bsnan pa/ rgod ma kha bye ni/ phyi rgyud las/ ka ra dang bca' sga citra ka /byi tang ga dang a ru pi pi lingan /kur sbyar ma zhu sbo sgreg 'gyings pa 'joms/ /khyad par pho ba'i me drod bskyed pa'i mchog /ces so/ /'di'i ka radzi ni 'jam 'bras/ mngon sum me 'dra'i sbyor ba ni/ de nyid las/ rgyam tshwa la la phud dang a za mo/ /pi pi ling dang sga rnams cha rim bskyed/ /kun dang mnyam pa'i a ru bsregs pa'i — thal/ / bu ram sbyar ba mngon sum me dang 'dra/ /zhes so/ /'di'i a za mo ni dbyi mong bod kyi tshwa ba ni bod tshwa ste bul tog sngo yi tsha ba gsum ni rtse tsha dbyi mong srub na phabs tsam ni ro bro ba tsam/ bya thal bcu ba'i rdo zho cong zhi drag btul rgod go'i thal ba sga pi rnams zho lnga re/sngo yi tsha ba gsum zho bzhi re/ shing tsha zho gang sbyar/ bdud rtsi ril: dkar la/ rdo zhun thal ba srang do/ sga skya star bu kha ru tshwa pi pi ling rnams zho re sbyar/ phabs ni chang rtsi/ so bya ni chur gnas pa'i nya khra'i /sdus mdog nag pa ske dang rkang pa ring ba kha la so yod pa/ rgod ni bya

rgod / sha khu ni gang ma zhu ba de'i 'o/ /sog tshigs ni changade 'bru gang gi chang yin pa de'i 'o/ /dri chu ni rang gi'o/ /chur khu ni zho dar 'o masnyesems can gang gi yin pa de las byas pa'i phyur ba/ ltag sprad ni gong:gi spyi sman dang ngo / /dug ril ni/ smin (sman )chen cha gcig a ru — bdun 'gyur sga pi pho sman chen gyi nyis 'gyur sbyar/ skyur rtsabs ni zho'i ru ma/ tsha la 'phrul bshal la/ tsha la btul ma zho gang skar brgyad/dan rog skar bzhi/ dur byin skar lnga/ rgyam tshwa skar drug pi pi ling — star bu skar gsum re/ sbrul sha skar do/ bod tshwa zho do sbyar/ brag zhun dgu pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ brag zhun gla rtsi gur gum sukles dang / /dom mkhris bong nga 'jib rtsi a ru ra/ /ga dur ka ra cha mnyam brag zhun dgu / / pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sel bar byed/ /ces so/ /se 'bru lnga pa ni/ gong bshad se 'bru bzhi'i steng gur gum zho bzhi bsnan/ zhi byed dkar po drug sbyor ni/ 'og tu le'u don bzhi par/ ma nu sum cha sga yi sum cha gnyis/ /de gnyis dang mnyam a ru ra dang ni/ /snam rtsa cong zhi bul tog drug 'gyur sbyar/ /ma zhu gsar rnying dug dang glang thabs dang / /bad zhan stod 'tshangs thur sel gyen log rlung / /sha ma thon dang dug sogs pho nad rigs/ /kun 'gro zhi byed dkar po drug sbyor te/ /zhes so/ /'di'i sbyar tshad gzhan yang yongs grags la ma nu nas bul tog gi bar zho re skyed do/ /bde byed snyoms ldan bad — ler zin las bsil drod gnyis zhes pa'ang gong bshad bsil drod sbyi1 —

trī ba/bye/ ba/cu pa/ smran nad bcos pa/ dbye ba skran rigs bcu — gcig nyi shu sogs/ /zhes pa'i skran rigs bcu gnyis ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ dbye ba bad kun zas sten rdo yi skran/ /rlung gi snying skran— khrag mkhris rtsa skran dngaka /spu srin chu span rnag skran bcu gcig po/ /zhes dang nyi shu ni de nyid las/ gnas ni glo snying mchin dri mchin mcher mkhal/ /mkhris pa pho long rgyu ma sgang pa mngal/ /zhes bcu gnyis dang / tsha skran grang skran phyi nang bar gsum sbyar/ /zhes phyi nang bar gsum gyi skran la tsha grang gnyis re sbyar ba drug dang pho ba long du smug po'i khrag skran chags/ /zhes smug po'i khrag skran gnyis bcas — gnas kyi skran nyi shu'o/ /de dag la ldan 'dus 'byung ba yang srid pa la sogs sgras bsdus so/ /zhan ni 'phar stobs chung ba/ zhar ni mi gsal bar leb mor 'phar ba/ ldang dubani res 'ga'/ myang ni lag pas brtag zungs gsum shorani/ /phyi'i zungs sha skam pa/ nang gi — zungs zas mi za ba/ srog gi zungs rtsa shed shor ba rnams so/ /mtshur gnyis ni dkar ser gyis mtshur/ rgod btul ni cong zhi rgod btul/su ru tsan dan ni shug pa'i 'bru/ 'thus ni zags/ bsil gsum ni cu gang gur gum gnyis kyi steng stod la li shi smad la suklel bsnan/ rta mig ni dkar po'i 'o/ /rnag 'gugs ni bya brun drug pa chang btsos — ༵༵nga/ dpyad ni gtar ga zabagani rdzod kyi ga'ing1 snying mngon ni

'jam zhing 'bol ba/ bshal ni/ a ru dan rog dur byid rgyam tshwa dbyi mong srub ka rtse tsha'i ril bu/ bzang po gsum ni dzā sug zha bshal sbyangs ni/ grang skran gyi sgron shing gi sbyor ba la/ dur byid bsnan nas bu ram gyis ril bu bya/ dugs ni byi brun bsros pas so/ /bum pa tshad ldan ni/ bshad rgyud las/ bum pa 'khyud 'khor sor ni bco brgyadam la / / srid sor bcu gnyis kha zlum sor bzhi pa/ /phyi skran 'ju zhingaske 'dren la sbyar bar bya/ /zhes so/ /me bum gdab thabs phyag len dang bcas pa man ngag rgyud kyi brda bkrol du gsal bar bkod yod/ me btsa' bya zhes pa'ang bum me sbar ba las logs su med/ 'jag ni ras skud phra mo/ rma ltar gso ni dan ḍa yungs dkar zar ma'am til sbyar byug / 'bras chang zhes pa'i chang yig nor te 'bras can/ spod ni/ sga pi pho yung ba g.yer ma rnams/ se 'bru drug ni/ phyi rgyud las/ se 'bru kha ru tshwa dang tsha ba gsum/ /rgyam tshwa drug gis pho ba'i me drod skyed/ /kha zas ma zhu 'ju zhing be snabs sbyong / /zhes so/ /mi brun brgyad par/brun gnyis bsregs thal dug zhung zho lnga re/ tsha la dom mkhris se 'bru tig ta zho gsum re/ mgron thal zho brgyad sbyar/ thengs ni speb/ thun gsum ril bu ni/ phyi rgyud las/ rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa rtse myang kha ru tshwa/ /tsabs ru tshwa dang rwa tsha shing tsha dang / /mdze tsha thal tsha ya bak+ṣa ra — dang / / tsha ba gsum dang 'bras bu gsum po rnams/ /thun gsum cha mnyam bu ram ril bur dril/ /nyen skran mngal skran khrag skran za~X

bar rlog /ces pa ste/ tshwa sna rnams thun gcig tsha ba gsum thun gcig 'bras gsum thun gcig sbyar/ /lto gsher chung ba ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ lto gsher chung ngu gar+bha tsa lī/ /tri byi ta dang ha ri ta ka da/ /shing tsha rgyam tshwa sge gsher cha mnyam ste/ /zhib btags zhim shing bsdus khur btab la btang / /lcag dang log gnon rjes gcod spyi dang mthun/ /zla mtshan 'khyil dang mngal skran du ro rnag /khrag tshabs ma lus mngal skyon sbyong bar byed/ /ces so/ /'di'i lto gsher ni lto bshal zhes pa yin la/ gar+bha ni spang klad/ tsa lī ni 'ol mo se/tri byi ta ni dur byid/ ha ri ta ka ni a ru ra/ sge gsher ni sga skya/ zhim shing ni snam rtsa/ rtsa gsher ni 'og tu le'u brgya brgyad par/ yang na rtsa gsher byang pa rgya tshwa dang / /zhes sogs de yin/ // le'u bcu gcig pa/ skya rbab bcos pa/ rngam 'degs ni dbugs thegs/ chu ser ni chu mdog ser/ 'phrul ni bsgres/ ba gcin ni sman rnams kyi brgyad 'gyur byas la lcags bye dang sman rnams lcags kong so sor bskol/ de nas bsres la ril bu sran tsam bdun zos pa'i rting ba'i 'o ma byed zho ru bsnyal byed bzhos ma thag pa bsres la mar phyung ba'i dar ba 'thung ngo / /lcags phye bcu gsum par/pri tsi zho lnga re/ phyisran zho drug de ba zho bzhi/ spos zho gsum/ byi tang zho bdun/ chu ma rtsi zho brgyad/ ba ru a ru gzhung bzhin/ ga dur zho // / nyi 'bras te lcam pa dang lcags phye gnyis spang do re/ se 'bru srang

gang sbyar/ glo tshad kun sel ni 'og tu byis ler bshad/ rgyan 'brum bdun pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ rgyan 'brum cu gang gur gum shing mngararkodang / / gla snang shing tsha se 'bru ka ra sbyar/ /glo yi nad dang dbugs mi bde ba sel/ /zhes so/ /glo gcong ni lu ba gcong / /ga le'u bca gnyis pa/ 'or nad bcos pa/ gnad ni yig nor te bsnad ces pa yin/ ngas ba ni thang chad pa/ ba yi rnam lnga'i sman mar ni/ phyi rgyud las/ ba gsar dmar zal chu dang lci ba dang / /'o: ma zho dang mar la zang rtsi sbyar/ /ba yi rnam lnga'i sman mar mchin nad rnying / / tsha ba rlung ldan chu ser skya rbab 'joms/ /zhes so/ /thod thal ni mi'i 'o/ gur gum bdun pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ gur gum cu gang gi wang gtso bo la/ /tig ta gser gyi me tog dug mo nyung / /bong nga dkar po bsdebs pas mkhris tshad sel/ /zhes so/ // le'u bcu gsum pa/ dmu chu bcos pa/ spyi don brgyad ni/man ngag rgyud las/ gcong chen dmu chu'i rgyu rkyen dbye ba dngan /gyur tshul gnas dang rtags dang bcos thabs dngan /phyi rjes bcad dang spyi don brgyad kyis bstan/ /ces so/ /gdon rkyen ces pa la/ 'dul ba lung las/ /sngon 'tsho byed gzhon nu skyed mos tshal rnying pa zhig tu: dmu rdzing gis thebs pa zhig dang lhan cig bsdad pas/ dmu jing gi nad bdag dmu dang skyed tshal gyi 'dre gnyis nad pade lus thob la rtsod nas dmu de na re/ mi las blun pa suyod skyed tshal 'dir ra spu'i dunā

pa zhig btang na khyod rgya mtsho'i pha mthar mi 'gro 'am zer/ skyed tshal gyi 'dre de na re/ mi las blun pa khyod la dar ba rad pa zhig la la phug gi sa bon btab nas btang na khyod kyi lus tshal bar mi 'gro'am zer ba tsho ('tsho )byed bi sha ci'i skad la mkhas pa des thos nas thabs gnyis ka byas pas skyed tshal du 'dre med cing dmu rjing rdol nas nad las grol bar bshad pa ltar yod do/ /chu rigs bco lnga ni/ man ngag rgyud las/dbye ba nad gdon dug las gyur pa gsum/ /nad chu byer zags — 'khyims chu rgyu rdol bzhi/ /byer chu khrag byer mkhris byer chu byer gsum/ /zags chu don zags snod zags skran zags gsum/ /don zags mchin mcher glo ba zags pa gsum/ /snod zags pho ba long gaske zags pa gnyis/ /skran zags khrag skran rtsa skran chu smran zags/ /dbye ba chu rigs bco lngar gyur pa yin/ /zhes so/ /'di dag 'dren tshul: yang / gdon gyur dug gyur gnyis 'khyims chu rgyu rdol gnyis/ khrag — mkhris chu'i byer ba gsum/ mchin mcher glo zags gsum/ pho long zags pa gnyis/ khrag rtsa chu'i skran zags gsum ste bco lnga'o/ /shaskyi mdangs bar ni sha dang mdog gam pags te gyichung 'og ltem ni cung zad gang ba'i nyams/ 'degs ni 'phar/ gsus pa sdig ni pho ba lci/chu so ni mtshan dbrag bem tol rgyab ni sor keg mkhal khung la rgyab pa/sdom ni dbugs ngan sdom/ glo sor ni glu yu nas sor sor zer/ slog pas dreg pa/ lhogs pa ni zlog pa/ bde byed 'bring po ni/ phyi rgyud

las/ bsil gsum ut+pal se 'bru pi pi lingan /shing tsha ka ra bzhi 'gyur cu gang bdun/ /tsha grang cha snyoms dang ga 'byed par byed/ /ces pa'i bde byed chung ngu'i steng rgyan 'brum shing mngar glo nad rnying pa sel/ /zhes pa ltar rgun shing gnyis bsnan/ tshad ldan ni cu gang zholabazhi skar drug bal gur zho do skar gsum/ li shi skar do/ ut+pal zho gang skar drug se 'bru zho gang shing tsha zho gang skar gang pi pi ling zho gsum skar gsum/ rgyan 'brum zho gsum skar brgyad/ shing mngar:skar drug de la ka ra zho do skar brgyad sbyar/ 'di'i pi pi ling khyadasko'aphags ni dbang phyogs pi pi ling zhes rgya nag pi pi ling byung na rab/de min rgya gar pi pi ling chung ngu sngo nad lcags myug ma 'bring glang po'i pi pi ling tha ma ste spang ba yin/ bshad ma thag pa'i bde byed 'bring po'i steng gze ma zho gsum skar lnga/ lcam pa zho gsum skar do/gser bye zho gsum skar bdun/ sdig srin zho do skar drug sbyar ba la bde byed chu bsgyur zer/ a drug thang gi shing mngar zho bdun gzhan lnga zho re re zhes mchan rgyab mar byung / a bhi ni saṃ bhi ste skyu ru ra'i ming /'bol sman bdun par/ gur gum kha che ma skar ma brgyad/ pri mibyu zho gang skar drug uta sngon zho gang skar gsum/ gser me skogs bshus skar brgyad/ bong dkar rtsa lo 'dres pa zho gang skar bzhi/ ba sha ka — skar lnga/ skyu ru zho gang skar dgu sbyar/ a cang che ni nad tshabs che/tsan dan brgyad ni/ cu gang gur gum sgo wang shing mngar ru rta rgyanā|

'brum a thong tsan dan dkar po ste phyi rgyud ltar ro/ /tsan dan sgo wang bsnan ni 'bolasan gyi steng du'o/ /gi wang dgu ni/ gi wang gur gum ut+pal ba le ka tig ta brag zhun ru rta ba sha ka gser me sbyar ba phyi rgyudaske ltar ro/ /hong len kyi rtse yang 'bol sman gyi steng bsnan/ lcam 'brum bcu drug par/ srad nag nyi ma ma sdog gong btus pa zho gsum/ bri 4sku chu ma rtsi zho gang skar dgu re/ sngon bu zho gang skar bdun/ sga pho skar bzhi re/ pi ling skar bdun/ ma ru zho do/ ba ru zho gang sgyu ru skar brgyad/ tsitra skar bzhi/ byi tang skar gsum/ ga dur gyi lo ma — skar lnga/ lcags phye btul ma zho gang skar lnga/ spos skar drug lcam 'bru zho do sbyar/ rig myong mthun gsungs kyang 'bras gsum gtsor smosam nas tsha ba gsum bzhag pa chos rje'i bzhed pa yin snyam/ drod sman ni se 'bru lnga'i nang gi pi pi ling nyi dga' ni lcam 'bru/ chu ma rtsi nyer lnga par/ chu ma rtsi zho bdun/ srad dag bri lasku bal gur 'bu skyogs 'u su 'jam 'bras cu gang srol dkar gsang sman tsha ba rnams zho bzhi re/glang snathod dkar skyu ru gze ma sug smel shing mngar ut+pal gsang sman grang ba zho gsum re/ nyi dga' sdig srin gser bye se 'bru gsang sman 'bring po zho lnga re/ pi pi ling zho drug lcags phye btul ma zho gcigasnyesbyar / sngo sman rnams btu dus man ngag gsungs pa/ chu ma rtsi ut+pal:nyi dga' rnams zla ba drug par btus pa/ srad nag sribs skyes khu byug stu /ba gong btu/ bri lasku byang bltas 'dab rgyas zla ba lnga par btusasnye

ba / glang sna me tog shar ma thag btus/ srad dkar nyi mas sdog gong btus pa/ gsang sman tsha grang gnyis dang 'bring po bcas/ /zhes pa la bshad tshul kha shas snang yang bzhed tshul gcig ni/ sngo sman spyi zhur zla ba drug par btus pa/ rkyal ba chu thub stesad sngon g.ya' la skyeb zla ba brgyad par btus pa/ 'jam dbyangs rtag tu ngu me tog sngon po lo ma spu chung can thang la skyeb bzang them bral rdza ma'i chu la 'gran pa ni / kha bcad dang 'dra bral ba'i rdza ma'i chu 'pho ba/ ra mo she'i gsang sman bcu gsum par/ ma cani se 'bru/ be+eḍūr+ya ni sngo zhur ram sngo de bar 'bod pa zla ba brgyad par btu ba/ ki ṣa ba ni sbi lasku me tog ma shar gong btu/ grog ma'i gzugs can ni pi pi ling mu zi mdangs med niwad nag bya ma sleb gong btu/ nang blon kun tsa ni shing tsha/ me lha ni tsitra ku bsreg rdar ril ni bug smel/ phyi blon rin sngon phye ma ni lcags phye btul ma/ khrag skem gsar skyeni skyu ru rul sungs med pa/'di la gser bye zhes byung ba yig nor te sbyor sde 'di'i sman sna rnams gab ming 'ba' zhig gis bstan pa las gser bye kho na dngos ming gis brjod mi rigs shing sbyor sde'i sman bcu gsum zhes byung ba yang mi 'thad par 'gyur pas so/ /las byed ka ka ru ni sdigasan/ rtsar rgyu ni shing mngar/ chu sman ni lcam pa/ gzugs kyi rnam par gnas ni zho re re mnyam/ man ngag ldan ni tsha chu la drod sman cha phri nas bsil bskyed/grang chu la de las ldog ldan 'dus la yang rigs bsgres/ gsang smanā/

gsum ni/ gong bshad tsha grang 'bring gsum mam/ yang na ga dur me tog rgya kha zla ba lnga par btus pa/ srad nag 'brug ma bsgrogs gong btus pa/ glang sna me tog zla ba drug par btus pa'o/ /sngo sman 'di — rnams yul dus kyi dbang gis nam rgyas tshe btus pa btu dus bshad: pa'i dgongs gzhi yin no/ /li shi 'phrul bshal ni/ mdzo mo'i dar ba —bre gang tsam gyi gang du li shi bum pa can byung na rab/ ma byung na'ang — bzang po gzhan dang lab son cha mnyam gnyis po zhib btags bye yo/ phug ron nam khyim bya'i sgong skogs gang tsam btab la 'dres par dkrugs te zhag gsum drod la snyol/ ras pa mthar thug nas chu khur song ba de yog 'thung byas pas chu dbang med du 'bab/ chu sman gang rigs kyang 'phul nas btang ngo / /chu bshal lnga dang chu sbyongs gnyis — zhes pa/ man ngag rgyud las rdzing gi thor khung bsal ba'i skabs su — bshad pa yig tshogs che bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /'bu skyogs ni chu — dang gi dung gzugs/ chung ngu zhal shes lcag ni khron pa'i chu rul la 'dod kyang ba chu shis/ sre long brda tsam thug pa ni phye thug sasre long gi tshod ma chung tsam btab pa/ dag na zhes pa la/ zhag bcu drug tshunaske nas gsus pa bri/ nan tan chu mang ni/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis su mi — 'dzad/ ngar gdong dang brla'i 'og tu yang gtar/ nad zad pa na — stong skyugs snying 'dar gnyid yer sogs byung rus tshod dang chang la rdo sduskol btab pa btang la snam byugs bya/ rjes gcod pa (ba )ru'i

lde gu la/ a ru zho brgyad/ skyu ru zho gnyis/ gla ji zho gang gzhan rnamasagrang re sbyar/ sdebs bral chang la bskug rig za ba ni/ chu ma 'dres pa'i chang bzang la zan dronade bcug ste za ba/ gad rgyangs cher sgrog ni kun la zan pa/ dkri zhes pa la/ khyi spags dro yang dang ga 'grib— pas spang /ga le'u bcu bzhi pa/ gcong chen zad byed bcos pa/ dbye ba gsum ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun rnam — gsum ste/ /zhes dang glaganyan drug ni de nyid las/ gcong chen — gnod pa ma zhu 'khru dang skyug /cham pa lud pa skad 'gags yi gaske 'chu / / de dag gcong chen nad kyi glaganyan yin/ /zhes so/ /mgul srub ni ngar ngar zer/ rgyud nang bzhin ni le'ude gar gsal/ // le'u brtso lnga pa/ tsha ba spyi bcos pa/ nad dar ni nad des thebs pa mang sna mang ni lus zungs dri ma thams cad la khyab pa/btsan po rje bo ni dbang tsheba'i rgyal po/ sna bo ni blon po/ rje bo'i thugs lon ni rgyal po'i thugs rang la brtse bar bsgyur na/ don la mi sdo ni rang gi 'dodangon 'grub pa la bgegs byed mi nus/ bzo yang ni rtsis cher ma byas kyang zod tshud ni bag zod byed na/ gnas sa rgyu dang zhes pa'i rgyu ni yig nor te rgyud kyis dbye ba zhes pa'i rgyud yin pas so/ /kha dmar ni khas 'ches shing dam bca' ba/ mgyogs ni myur ba/ rgyas ni shed che ba/ mkhrang niwa ba/ grims ni rta rnga dril dī sbyo

bu / dri dugs ni dbang po'i yul du mi sdug pa/ na so ni/ byis pa la — bad tshad dar ma la mkhris tshad rgas pa la rlung tshad byung ba shas che/bsdongs zla'i rtags ni/ gnyidayer lus brtse byung na rlung tshad/ kha kha mig chu ser ba mkhris tshad/ lus lci rmongs pa 'ju dka' bad tshad/mig chu dmar rnyog gzer dril khrag tshad/ g.yo skrangs za 'phrug shu thor chu ser tsha ba'o/ /'jug sgo ni/ sha lpags don snod rtsa rus so/ /gsham du ni 'og tu/ rngam pa ni dbugs/ sri 'chor ni 'tshag dka'acha ba'am yang na 'chor ba/ sangs ni me tog ku ya sogs sangs ba sha skyo ni sha btsos pa'i khu ba la chags pa'i nal nal po/ khrag med ni — gtar yang khrag mi 'byung ba/ chad po ni dum bur chad pa/ nag — rtsigs ni chu'i nang du nag nal byung ba/ 'dre kha rgod ni bla gnyan dang —gdon ldang ba/ khong du bros pa ni rlig 'bras khong du tshud pa/ rna ba snyi ni rgyab la 'byar ba/ ba skya ni ba mo lta bu'i skya ba/ 'drar snang ni bsrusne brid / gso ba brtsam zhes pa'i brtsam ni yig nor te spang blang mu bzhi'i nang gi gso tsam de yin snyam/ gnyen ltar bsten ni bsil gyi sgo nas: thabs mkhas kyis/ dgra ltar bsad ni/ ga bur gyi sbyor ba sogs sman gyi chu/ rtse chung gtar ba sogs dpyad kyi chu/ kha zas yen rkyang gtad pa zas kyi chu/ bsil sa bsten pa spyod lam gyi chu ste chu bzhis so/ /bu —ltar gso ni ngang gis 'jam po'i sgo nas so/ /stobs ni lus kyi stobs/kāswās 'ded tshul ni/ drod bcud kyis rlung sna glan pa tshad pa la bros

pa yin la/ bsil gyi gnyen po bsten pa tsha ba 'ded pa'i tshul lo/ /zags bcad tshul ni/ 'khru gsher bcad pa ste sbyongs kyis sbyangs nas —bsil gyis bcad/ mgo phur tshul ni/ pha rol gyi dmag ma bteg gong gdong bsu byed pa ltar stobs ma rgyas gong du macos (bcos)/ shed —dmas tshul ni/ chu rags rgyag pa ltar yin gsungs te chu bo yur bcu mang por drangs na stobs zad pa ltar gtar gas drangs/ sbyangs skem —ni thog mar bshal gyis sbyangs te tha mar skem sman sbyar/ rngul dang chu: ni rngul dbyung ba dang chu yi 'phrul 'khor/ rtsa khrus ni rtsa sbyong gtar gyis bcos ni/ snying la snod dzi glo bar drug 'go/ mchin par ruṣ+ka thung / mcher par rta mthur/ mkhal mar byin gzhug go/ /me dpungaskebasad ni chu bzhis so/ /bcud ni bsil bcud/ mgo spur bshus ni se 'bru bzhi pa sogs kyis grang ba'i mgo byibs bshus/ rtsi dang bral ni / shing la sra rtsi btang ba lta bu de'i zhen rtsi bral/ dbye bsad 'byung ni dang po thang gis dbye bar du phye mas bsad tha ma sbyongs kyis dbyung /bya ltar phur ni/ bya brgya 'ur gcig gis 'ded zer ba'i dpe ltar 'bras bu gsum tig ta ga dur ba le ka ut+pal dkar po spe tres te byam phur brgyad thang du grags pa sogs kyis sel/ 'du ba ni nyes pa gsum/ rngan pa byin ni drod bcud bsten/ thob sha ni bus thob bya ba/me bzhi ni zas spyod sman dpyad bzhi dro ba/ skyabs ni khur skya las bzos pa'i tshod ma/ khur tshod ni khur mang las bzos pa'i tshod shā/

chag tshe ni btus nas lo ma lon pa'i nas brdungs pa'i tshod ma/ chu bsil ni g.ya' chu ma bskol ba/ chu grog ni chu la rtsam pa en tsam btab/ kha g.yeng ni 'grul sna/ ma nu bzhi thang ni/ phyi rgyud las/ ma nu kuṇ+ḍa ka ri spe tres dang / /sga skya'i thang gis rims tshad smin par: byed / / bad kun skya ga stongs tshad khrag gzer sel/ /zhes so/ /'di la sbyor tshad mang yang rlung rtags la tshetros kuṇ+ḍa ka ri cha skyed/mkhris par ma nu bad kun la skyaskyed/ grang shum ma chag na/ spe tres cha che ba dngasna skyayang rgyun las mtho tsam bsnan/ spyir btang la ma nu spe tres cha mnyam/ kuṇ+ḍa ka ri nyis 'gyur/ sga skya cha gcig sbyar/ gras la ni grangs su/ 'bras bu gsum ni/ phyi rgyud las/ 'bras gsum thang gis rims 'khrugs tsha ba'i nad/ /gsar rnying ma lus sel zhing smin par byed/ /zhes so/ /'di la yang mkhris tshad la a ru ra dang khrag — tshad la skyu ru dang bad tshad dang chu ser la ba ru bskyed/ nor bu chu — dwangs ni/ ma nu bzhi dang 'bras bu gsum thun gnyis cha mnyam sbyar ba ste 'di la nor bu bdun thang yang zer/ du ni mang tsam/ sman ser chen mo la/ tsan dan dkar po zho do skar gang / gi wang cu gang zhom gsum skar do re/ gur gum zho gang skar do/ brag zhun sman chen zho gsum skar brgyad re/ bong dkar zhod skarado/ gla rtsisnar dgu/ gu gul zho gang skar drug stag sha zho gang skar dgu/ 'dzin pa me lo 'dres lha sdo gang skar gang de'i steng zhi byed du sbyar na spru nag zho lnga skar

brgyad/ sbyong byed du sbyar na thar nu ba chur btul ba zho bdun skar bzhi sbyar/ gsum 'khril ni nag po gsum 'khril zhes bya ba ste/ gzhung snga phyi bsgrigs na gnam mnyan tre tre hos sam par pa ta/ nad bdagasnyem mo/ lus gnas kyi srin bu bdun bcas 'khrugs pa la byed snyam yang don la gnyan tshad rlung gsum bsgril ba yin/ bal nad ni 'go ba'i rims tsam po'i ming yin yang skabs 'dir rgya nad mig ser/ cog 'gyel ni glo bur du 'gyel ba/ spoyor ni zi 'thom zer yang phyugs la glo yor rgyu yor zhes pa ltar khyim tshang stongs par byed pa'i rims rigs/sman ser chung ba la/ gi wang bong dkar 'dzin dkar rtsa ba zho bzhi re/cu gang zho bdun/ gur gum zho do/ gla rtsi skar dgu/ gu gul zho gang /brag zhun zho lnga skar bzhi sbyar/ rta zi ni rta ri ba/ sbyong sman gsum ni/thar nu chu rtsa re lcag ga bur nyer lnga ni/ phyi rgyud las/ ga bur bzang po drug dang a ga ru/ /tsan dan dkar dmar ut+pal ge sar gnyis/ /ru rta zi ra dkar po ba le ka /shing tsha chu srin sder mo pu shel tse/ /spang spos rdo dreg dmar po 'bu su hang / /tsha grang 'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum/ /kha bsgyur ka ra dkar po drug 'gyur sbyar/ /don snod sha lpags rtsa rus tshad pa dang / /'grams 'khrugs rims dug tshad pa gsar rnying dngan /dreg grum me dbal byang khog thigs zags rnag /lus la gnas pa'i tshad pa ma lus 'joms/ /khyad par tshad rnying byer ba gting nas 'don/ /zhes so/ /man ngag bsil sbyor la/ tsan kāswā

dkar po bong dkar rtsa me bsres pa zho gang skar bzhi re/ tsan dan dmar po a gar nag khrag 'dres pa skar brgyad re/ snyi wang a ru zho — gang skar lnga re/ ut+pal zho do skar lnga/ gser me skogs bshus zho do/sug smel cu gang zho re/ ka ko la li shi sum tig zho lnga re/ gur gum dzā —ti skar bdun re/ gangs thigs zho gsum skar gang / gla rtsi pi pi ling skar ma bzhi re/ dug nyung zho gang skar gsum/ skyu ru zho gang skar drugaru rta zho do skar gang / se 'bru zho gang skar brgyad/ cong zhi 'dam btags zho lnga sbyar/ 'di la spyi ltar bse yab bsnan pa dang dug la suklel 'dor/ byang lhun pas gangs thigs dang ba sha ka brje ba gnang /zho 'phrul ni zho dkrugs ma/ rnying tshad rnams la rgyun sbyong bsngags zhes pa la/ phyi rgyud las/ a ru mchu ring ba ru skyu ru ra/ /lham rtsa dur byid spos dkar ba chur bsdus//rgyun sbyongs dreg dang grum bu chu ser dang / /rnyogs tshad rnying tshad lus la zhen pa sbyong / /zhes so/ /'di'i lag len la/ a ru mchu ring rdog po dgu/ ba ru ra rdog po gsum/ skyu ru rdog po lnga/ 'di gsum gyi rus rkang 'dor/ tshom rtsa ston dus bskos pa mtheb tsam ste/ a ru gnyis dang bongs mnyam/ dur byid lug gi ril ma tsam/ spos dkar de'i byed khram khrum brdungs la ba chu bre gang: tsam du spangs/ khu ba thon pa na khaṇ+ḍar bsdus/ gtong dus sbrang gis ro sgyur tsam byas la nam bdun sogs su lto stong du btang bas nges pa swāhā par rgyun du 'khru/ 'khru drags na thun phri 'khru ba zhan na thun —

bskyed/ grang na pi pi ling phran bu bsnan/ mdog dmar ser dri cher — 'khru na nad dang lus shed dpags la sbyangs/ zas mdog gis 'khru ba dang dri ma sangs na bcad ran yin pas 'bras thug chag tshe sogs kyis bcad/ 'di'i thog mar thang chen nyer lnga kha shas gtong dgos/ rgyun sbyong 'di tsha ba sdud slong stong gsum gcig car byed pas tsha ba zhen pa rtsad nas 'byin pa yin/ mi rung rnam pa bdun zhes pa la/ ma smin tsha ba gtar na rnyogs par gyur/ rims la gtar na don la babs/ khrag ma phye bar gtar na zungs khrag shor/ nad khrag dang tsha ro lus shing rlung skyes/ stongs tshad gtar na rlung 'phyos zug gzer skyed / gnyan tshad gtar na khrag shul srog rtsar 'jug dug tshad gtar na byer te ro mi thon/ brungasangan gtar na srog rten chad do/ /ga bur rgyal blon ni/rgyal po ga bur blon po cu gang gi chur sbyangs pa'o/ /bcud bzhi ni sha mar bur rnying chang / rgyal blon gsum ni/ ga bur cu gang gi chur sbyar steng 'khrugs la tsan dan dkar po rims la bong dkar gyis kha bsgyur ba / srog rtsa myos byed ni nu tog nas tshon gang mchan ngos su bcal ba/sor mo nyi shu bsreg ni/ sor mo nyi shu'i snying ne'u le ser tsam bsregasha 'don la sogs ni 'don bzhi'i sbyor ba ste rlung ler song zin/ sgog chab ni sgog skya'i tshod ma/ drod sman ni pi pi ling / spyang snying sbyor ba ngag las nyan ni/ spyang khu'i snying sdig srin gi wang bu mo stag lo ma'i srin lag gi sen mo chur sbyar btang / bshal gyis sbyang ni/ thar nu sta

rtsa gser me tsha 'o/ /mgo khrol ni lug lo gsum lon pa'i mgo bsregaske 'tshos par bcos pa/ 'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar ni phyi rgyud ltar ro/ /spu 'bru ni yig nor te spru 'bu yin/ bgrang ni bran/ a gar brgyad pa ni phyi rgyud las/ a ga ru dang dzā ti snying zho sha /cu gang spos dkar ru rta a ru ra/ /nā ga ge sar ka ra gsum 'gyur sbyar/ /a gar brgyad pas snying la mtshon phog dang / /'grams 'khrugs smyo lkugs nu mchin gzer ba 'joms/ /zhes so/ /pho rog mig gi rtsa ba ni pho rog nyung ma'am pa yag gi rtsa ba/ 'khru gcod bzhi ni/ da trig smag bil ba mon cha ra bzhi/ nyen gsang ni / phyi rgyud las/ lhen sna'i sna nas thur du tshon gang bcal/ /g.yas g.yon tshon gang kha gsum nyen gsang yin/ /zhes so/ /bong thor ni/ bong bu lo gsum lon pa 'dir nag po dgos/ chu sbyar ni chu dkyil gyi skur chung myur 'gro/ ze tsha rig srin gze ma chang sbyar gyis khyad par rims tshad kyi chu 'gags sel/ chu lums ni rang byung chu tshan gyi lums/ tsit+ta ni snying / // le'u bcu drug pa/ tsha grang gal 'gag la/ gal mdo ni bag thon che ba'i mdo/ gal 'gag ni gal che ba'i gnad 'gag dgung — gnyis ni nyin dgung dang mtshan dgung / 'khrul so ni dgra nyen che ba la dgra so zhes pa ltar ro/ /sman pa'i nyams nye ni sman pa nad kyi nyams tshod rnyed/ ngo glan ni ngo 'dzin/ 'og 'grims rkun bu ni/ rtags de /sdu ngo bo gzhan du mi 'chor bar skyeb/ nad gsum ni tsha grang rlung

gsum/ zas kyi ngo glan ni drod kyis rlung sna mnan/ goms pa'i ltar:snang 'khrul so bskyed kyis bsal/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ bcos bskyedasnyeltar snang 'khrul so chu yis bsal/ /zhes pa 'di chad 'dug // le'u bcu bdun pa/ ri thang mtshams bstan pa/ ri thang: mtshams ni/ ri zad nas thang du slebs pa ltar tsha ba zad rjes grang ba—skyes pa ste/ tsha grang zhu 'khyags sam tsha grang la ma'athigs zhes kyang bya/'phrang ni nyen che ba'i dka' gnas/ sdun nas bsu ni/ rlung tshad kyi — zhu 'khyags byung sla zhing thal skyon che bas tsha ba ma zad tsam nas thor — rlung mnan pa/ 'phrang la bsgug pa ni/ mkhris pa'i zhu 'khyags bzlog dka' la rno myur che bas tsha ba zad rlung skyes mtshams las ma 'phyis par bcos pa/ phyi rjes bcad pa ni/ bad kun gyi zhu 'khyags bul zhingaske byings che bas tsha ba zad nges pa'i rjes bcad pa/ sna slad ni sngun bsu ba / rtsa rgyug ni mgyogs/ brdzis ni mnan/ phrugs ni thun/ kha zas glod ni drod bcud ma bsdams par btang / rid ni lce rtse yar 'dril — la ser ka byung / byed mar ni mnyam por/ skam ni skam la rtsub pa/zang ma ni rkang pa/ khog ni gyong / gleg ni mthug po/ zon skyor ni shes bzhin bag yod bya ba/ zon byed dang thon bcag ni bag thon/ bde byed chen mo ni gong bshad bde byed 'bring po'i steng tsan dan gi wang — bsnan/ sha chang gnyis dang zhes pa'i gnyis ni yig nor te gnyid ces pa yin/ kha zas glod pa yis ni/ kha zas glod grub kyang sngar kha za~X

gang yang len la btang ste ma zos pa'i rjes kyis/ 'phrang la ni/ tsha ba zad pa las ma sngas par zungs zad rlung 'gyur gyi tsha bar ma ldog pa'i bar der/ sna rdog ni sna rtse'i bu ga phyi 'grims ni tsha ba'i ltar snang /khong lhod ni grang ba'i ngo bo/ tha mal grangs ni dbugs gcig la lan lnga / zos grogs ni thos ma thag skra rtsa ser ni skra 'greng skra 'dab ni skra'i nyag ma/ tsho khu ni sha tshon po'i khu ba/ kha yar ni lan 'ga'/ bag la nyal ni skog tu gyur ba/ spyang po ni blo spyang po/ /ཿ le'u bco brgyad pa/ ma smin tsha ba bcos pa/ 'khyags ni lus grang ba/ dus sbyar chu bskol tshad ldan ni/ mchan ltar las kha 'gebs med cing me ran po ma bcad par bskol bas bcos pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan du 'gyur/ de zhag gcig lon par bzhag na dug tu 'gyur ro / / bzang po gsum ni dzā ti sug smel ka ko la/ dral thug ni yos dral ba'i chag tshe/ g.yung ba ni zhan pa/ // le'u bca dgu pa/ rgyas pa'i tsha ba bcos pa/ shugs rdzogs ni smin zhing stobs rdzogs pa'i tsha ba rkyang pa/ slebs chog gi sbyar tshadasbyir btang gzhung du gsal yang / khyad par du 'dzin lo zho gsum skar brgyad/ bong dkar zho gsum skar drug gla rtsi skar bdun no/ /spang rtsi bcu gnyis par/ spang rtsi zho gang skar dgu/ bong dkar stag sha zho gang skar gsum re/ par pa ta zho gang skar bzhi/ 'dzin pa'i lo me rdotā 'dres zho bzhi/ cu gang tsan dkar zho re/ brag zhun gla rtsi gu gul

zho gang skar do re/ gur gum zho do/ snyi wang skar brgyad sbyar/ gzhung du dang po lnga mnyam par gsungs pa spyir btang dngan mchan gyi ga brag byed ma ni ga dur dang brag zhun mnyam por bsres pa brag zhun gyi lcid tsam/ thengs gsos dgu par/ bdud rtsi lo ma zhes ra dug myu gu sa nas sor bzhi la 'phags pa zho bdun skar bzhi/ gi wang gur gum zho gang skar lnga re/ tsan dan dkar po zho gang skar bzhi/ cu gang zho bzhi skar drug zag zhun zho gsum skar drug stag sha zho do skar gang /gla ji skar bzhi/ gul nag zho do skar lnga sbyar/ 'di la shing bcud dgu pa'ang zer/ gtso bo brgyad pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ bsil gyi gtso bo gi /tsan+dan dkar/ /rtsi yi gtso bo cu gang gur gum gnyis/ /thang gi gtso bo tig ta ba sha ka /sngo yi gtso bo hong len bong nga dkar/ /ka ra dkar po bzhi 'gyur rta la skyon/ /don snod glo mchin khrag mkhris 'khrugs rims kyi/ /tshad pa gsar rnying ma lus 'joms par nges/ /zhes so/ /ga bur nyer lnga par/ ga bur skar drug cu gang zho do/ gur gum skar bdun/ li shi skar brgyad/ dzā ti pu shel tse skyu ru zho gang skar do re/ sug smel ka ko la zho gang skar bdun re/ ar nag ba le 'bu su hang ba ru ra zho re/ tsan dan dkar po ru rta zi ra dkar shing tsha a ru ra zho gang skar brgyad re/ tsan dan dmar po na gi zho gang skar gsum —re / ut+pal zho gang skar gangad ge sar gnyis zho do skar gsum re/spang spos zho gang skar drug rdo dreg dmar po sla ngar ser thon tsasdus

brjos pa zho do skar brgyad/ ka ra zho bzhi sbyar/ 'di tsha ba rkyang pa la 'bras bu gsum gyis kha bsgyur ba'i lugs so/ /brling bar bya ni re zhig gshol/ rmos lcags ni thong gshol gyi lcags byang ma/ bsor ni yang yang brjesapa/ bser bu ni rlung gis phog pa/ ne'u gsing ni na kha gsar pa/ nges par ni 'jam por/ tshan ni 'od tsha ba/ lud ni — phyag bdar khrod/ snying rtsa seng ni khams dwangs pa'am sems spro ba/ // le'u nyi shu pa/ stongs pa'i tsha ba bcos pa/ tshad gnya' chogs ni tshad stobs gzhom nas/ stongs pa'i tsha ba zhes pa tsha ba chung ngu la rlung stobs ldan bsdongs pa yin pas bsdongs zla byed pa'i don du 'dod pa dang / me med pa'i sa phyogs la mes stongs pa'i sa phyogs — zhes pa ltar tsha ba zad rjes kyi rlung la tsha ba stongs pa'am stongs tshad — ces pa yin zhes 'dod pa'i phyogs gnyis snang / sol mal ni sol thab kyi mal/ sbud pa ni bsil sbyor gyi dpe/ me ni tsha ba'i dpe/ rlung gsang ni tshigs pa dang po drug bdun dkar nag mtshams/ 'ba' cha —ni mar phyungs pa'i til gyi phub ma/ 'ol skom ni rus rnying gi bye ma 'bru mar rtsi mar la btab ste bcos pa/ dkar gong gi ni 'khar gong srin can te byis pa'i rtsed rar mang ba'i rdo dkar/ // le'u nyer gcig pa/ gab pa'i tsha ba bcos pa/ gyen la ngal ni langs la ngal/ phrig ni khrid/ rang rang rtsa ni/ snying la snod ka pho bar sdi snang mkhal mar byin gzhug go/ /rang gsang ni/ snying la tshigs pa —

bdun pa pho bar bcu gnyis pa mkhal mar bcu bzhi pa/ // le'u nyer gnyis pa/ tsha ba rnyings pa bcos pa/ ye nas ni — gdod ma nas/ phyogs med ni rgya yan du/ phrum ser khyer ni grang shum byed / ba spu brtse ni pags pa tsem tsem byed/ gzer 'gram ni gzer chung nges med byed/ sprin bral zla 'od kyi thang chen bdun pa ngo ma 'phrod rung nor bu bdun thang yin zer ba snang yang / sro lo bzhi dang dmar po gsum bsres pa la sro lo bdun thang zer ba de la byed na — legs/ tsan dan nyer lnga yang ngo ma 'phrod rung man ngag rin 'byung du bkod pa ltar dang / lha btsun pas phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa'i nyer lnga'i sde tshan las/ tsan dan dkar dmar gnyis dang bzang drug dang / / ru rta zi ra dkar po ba le ka /sgo chub sha ka dang shing mngar dang / / spang spos bong dkar a krong dkar po dang / /'bras bu gsum dang ut+pal ge sar dang / /rgyan 'brum a ga ru dang sgong thog glu pa / / ka ra sbyar ba'i tsan dan nyi shu lnga/ /glo ba byang khog stod la tshad — zhugs dang / /'grams dang 'khrugs sogs tshad rigs thams cad dze+e/ / thengs pas chog pa myong bas grub pa yin/ /zhes pa 'dis kyang chog par sems/ // le'u nyer gsum pa/ rnyogs tshad bcos pa/ bye chab g.yos pa ni bye ma dang chu lhan cig tu dkrugs pa/ rgya bshaX ni rgya tshos kyi khu ba bshal ba/ bkrag 'chor ni skya gleg tu 'gro/ snag chu ni yig nor rdo3

rnag chu yin/ dngul chu bco brgyad ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ rin chen sbyor ba dngul chu dug phral dang / /mu zi seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa bzang po drug /chu ser sman gsum gu gul bya khyung sbyar/ /klu yi gdon 'joms chu ser rtsad nas skem/ /zhes so/ /'di'i sbyar tshad kyang / dngul chu sung do/mu zi seng ldeng chu ser sman gsum srang gang zho lnga re/ cu gang sug smel zho bzhi re/ gur gum li shi dzā ti ka ko gla rtsi gu gul zho gsum re/ a ru sman chen sung do re/ ru rta srang gang / shu dag zho bdun sbyar/ se 'bru lnga pa ni gur gum bsnan pa'i 'o/ /gzhi dang bstun zhes pa la/ chu ser la sbrang chang rkyang khugs/ rlung la gze chang / mkhris par sro lo'i chang /bad kun la 'bras bu gsum gyi chang sbyar ba ste 'di dag gi lag len phyi rgyud du gsal bas 'dir ma bris/ 'bras bu gsum gyi chang der mi gsal kyang / gzhan yang nad dang gang 'phrod sman chus bsings/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /'ba' sam sman mar ni/ phyi rgyud las/'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga bsres pa/ /'ba' sam zhes bya stod smad kun la bsngags/ /zhes so/ /gser 'gyur rtsi ni lcags kyi pha bong la byugs pas lcags de gser du bsgyur bar byed pa'i ngas shig yod gsungs/ tig ta rnam gsum ni rgya tig bod tig zangs tig / / ga le'u nyer bzhi pa/ 'grams tshad bcos pa/ bang ni mgyogs par rgyugs pa/ mchongs ni gad kha tshur ka nas pha gir mchongs pa/dī /nga 'degs pa ni 'dom gyis mi 'khyud pa'i ljid che ba pang du

gdegs pa/ brdabs ni rgyug pa/ thibs ni lcid che ba/ 'grams ni/rma ral sogs phyi nas mi snang yang nang du bcad thigs sogs byunganakhu yis 'debs ni kha'i dbugs khu zhes byung / rtsa 'brum ni rtsa'i steng du 'brum pa lta bu byung / rnam par ni yu gu shing / tshos sna gsum ni bcod zhu mkhan 'bri mog ga bur bdun pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ bdun pa ga bur tsan dan dkar po dang / /gi wang cu gang gur gum hong len dang / / tig ta ka ra dkar po bzhi 'gyur sbyar/ /stod gzer 'khrugs tshad rgyas pa sel bar byed/ /ces so/ /ga bur dgu pa yang de nyid las / / dgu pa ga bur tsan dan cu gang dang / /gur gum dom mkhris tig ta li ga dur/ /hong len rgya skyegs ka ras 'grams 'khrugs nad / / stod gzer lud pa dmar ser dud khu 'joms/ /zhes so/ /'khrugs glo kun sel la/ spang rtsi zho gsum/ ba le skar brgyad/ a ru ru rta ma nu zho gang skar gsum re/ ba ru skyu ru zho gang skar drug re/ cu gang zho gang skar bzhi/ sro lo zho gang / ga dur zho do skar gang / bcod skar bzhi/ tshos skar lnga/ 'bri mog skar bdun sbyar/ lugs gcig la ru rta'i tshab hong len dang ga dur tshab lug mur byed pa'ang yod/ glo ro ni glo bar tshad ro lus pa/ so so'i rkyang sel ni bshad rgyud las/ zhu mkhan tshos bcod glo mkhal 'grams tshad sel/ /zhes pa lta bu/ rang rang rtsa gtar ni gong gsal/ bshal ni mkhris par bshal pho bar skyugs rgyu long la mas btang / rig pas sbyar ni/ rtsa la dugs sha rus

la lums tshigs pa la chu lcag rkang pa la zho dang 'o ma bag phye sbyar pa'i 'byar dang phying deb sogs/ bdud rtsi ni/ shug 'bru ba lu mtshe mkhan pa 'om bu ste bdud rtsi lnga/ thang btang ni/ ga dur ba sha tig ta sku ru'i thang / thang rjes ni/ stab seng skyu ru hong len ba sha ka kyi rtse'i thang rjes/ tshan rdo ni spa'u bsros pa/ btso lums zhes pa'i bco la rjes — 'jug chad pas bcos lums te/ phyi rgyud las/ mkhan pa bul tog phabs sbyar chu lums kyis/ /rma rgan skrangs dang zha rengs sel bar — byed / / ces so/ /rang byung chu tshan bsten tshul phyi rgyud kyi brda bkrol / ga~X/ nye/ra lnga pa/ 'khrugs tshad bcos pa/ rgyas 'khrugs la/yul tsha gdung can dus ston ka rang bzhin mkhris pa'i mi na so dar ma/stongs 'khrugs la/ yul ngad can grang ba dus dbyar kha rang bzhin rlung can na so rgas pa/ 'jam 'khrugs la/ yul rlan can dus dpyid ka rang bzhin bad kun na so byis pa/ dugs ni dri ma ngan pa/ sum gzer zhes yig nor te phrum ser zhes grang shum byed pa/ glo tshad 'byung ba yin zhes pa yig nor te/ rgyas tshad tsha lkugs dang dug thabs glo bur la babs pa la yang glo tsha zhes pa yin pas glo tshad 'byung zhes pa ske yin / shus 'debs ni kha na shus zer/ mi gtsang ni khrag zhad cung — zad yod pa/ bags kyis ni rim gyis/ 'khris ni 'khril/ bdud rtsi lo di / ra dug sor bzhi tsam skyes pa/ khrag 'khrugs kun sel la/ cong

zhi grang btulasrang gang zho bdun skar ma lnga/ 'bri mog zho bdun/ ma nu zho do skar drug ba sha ka zho gsum/ ga dur zho do skar do/ smyu ru zho dgu / cu gang zho do skar brgyad/ shing mngar zho gang sbyar/ rmos lcags byang ma ni/ thong gshol gyi lcags sa mang du bskos pas byang mar song: ba / mde kha bsgyur ni mda'i phog sa mde'us bsgyur ba ltar yul gang la babs pa'i kha 'dzin sbyar/ glo tshad kun sel ni 'og tu/ bsil gsum tsan dan dkar dmar li ga dur/ /gla rtsi gu gul 'dzin pa a ru ra/ /ru rta mtshal dang shing mngar sro lo sbyar/ /zhes so/ /sbyar tshad kyang /cu gang zho lnga skar brgyad/ gur gum zho gang skar bzhi/ sgo wang tsan dan dkar po zho gang skar lnga re/ tshan dan dmar po zho gang / ga dur zho bzhi skar brgyad/ sro lo zho gsum skar do/ gla rtsi skar bdun/ gu — gul zho gangaka 'dzin pa zho do skar do/ a ru zho lnga/ ru rta zho gsum/rgya mtshal zho lnga skar lnga/ shing mngar zho gsum skar gsum sbyar/ bzhi thang ni ma nu bzhi thang yongs grags sam skabs thob sbyar nas/ /tig ta hong len skyu ru ba sha nas/ /khrag 'khrugs tsha ba rol gsod dwangs — snyigs 'byed/ /zhes pa 'di yang e 'phrod blta/ ga bur rin chen zhags pa'i sbyor ba ni/ phyi rgyud las/ bcu bzhi pa ni ga bur bzang po drug / tsan dan bse ru ut+pal a ga ru/ /gla rtsi ga dur tig ta ka ra sbyar / / rims rgyas lus lci dran nyams 'bog lkugs sel/ /zhes sne/ / 'di dang bi ji'i ga bur rin zhags gnyis skabs bstun/ de zlo

lnga sbyor ni/ phyi rgyud las/ gtso bo brgyad pa'i kha tshar du/ /rims rgyas mig chu ser la za zi mang / /de ba gser gyi me tog par pa ta/ /ga dur a ru bsnan pas 'joms pa yin/ /zhes so/ /nor bu bdun steng a gar brgyad pa 'di ka bsres pa la byang lugs a gar bco lnga zer/ra gsum ni 'bras bu gsum/ /sna le'u nyer drug pa/ rims nad bcos pa/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ni / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lo lnga stong du gnas pa la lnga brgya phrag bcur byas pa'i lnga brgya dang po gsum la 'bras bu'i dus dang / bar ma gsum la bsgrub pa'i dus dang tha ma gsum la lung gi dus/ de rjes lnga brgya phrag gcig rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus zhes gzhung chen po rnams las bshad pa ltar las deng sang lung dus yin yang lnga brgya tha ma dang nye ba'o/ /nang dme ni rdo rje'i spun rnams nang phan tshun dam tshig nyams pa'i dme grib dar ba/ sde 'khrugs ni lta ba grub mtha' dgon gnas sogs rang phyogs bzung nas 'khrugs pa/ mu stegs ni lta ba ngan pa la zhen pa'i grub mtha' ba/ bad bon ni rtog thon ban+de btsun pa dang bon po gshen rabs pa mi skya/ mna' ni lha 'dre dpang btsugs kyis mna' bor ba/ thab ni lha 'dre klu gnyan gnas sar dkar dmar gyi thab gzhob shor ba/ shan dmar ni srog gcod sha khrag 'bags gtsog byed pa/ ma mo mkha' 'gro ni/ srid pa skye'ajig la dbang ba'i dī py-i bdun dang rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i 'byung po/ dri

ni nad yun song ba'i dri/ dugs ni 'byung po'i lus kyi grib ma phog pa/dris sog ni/ rims kyis na ba'i dri dngos sam de phyogs kyi du ba rlung sogs kyi dri/ yams su ni yams thabs su/ rims kyis ni gcig nas gcig la 'gos pa/ rgyud chen drug zhes pa slar grangs nas rdzongs snga —'gyur ni/ rgyud bdud rtsi mchog lung dang de'i 'grel pa paṇa chen bispa la mi tras mdzad pa bdud rtsi bam po bzhi pa sogs/ zug gu 'jug ni bsrung byed bzhag pa/ dag po dgu sbyor la/ gla rtsi zho gang gzhan rnams zho do re/ chig sbyor ni sgog gcig ma/ gnas chen brgyad ni/'og tu le'u so brgyad par/ spyi bo tshigs pa dang po snying ga dang / /lte ba bzhi dang rtse sgo mchan khung gnyis/ /zhes so/ /rgyul til ni sre mong dang te'u lo/ ze can ni bse dri can gyi srogs chags kyi sha spu/ hur thum ni rum gyis 'dril te/ du bar gdu ni du bas bdug le rgan ni khrag rgyas pa/ sgyid skyur ni bya ba mi 'dod/ shes pa myos ni yul mi rtogs/ g.yung ni zi nyog g.yo ni rtsa rgyud g.yo/ mi 'khyol ni bsil khang sogs su bskyel mi nus/ rmugs ni mi gsal/ rngul mang 'byung ni mkhris pa shas che na'o/ /samang sogs rlung grang sogs bad kun shas che na'o/ ham pa ni rul sungs kyi rnam pa/ 'tsho 'chi byed ni/ dwangs ma nas lus zungs bdun rim par khyab pa'i dbang gis lus zungs re re la zhag gsum re babs pas dwangs ma'i zhag gsum bcad pa'i zhag bco brgyad dang dwangs ma'i zhag kyang gtogs na zhag nyer gci/ 9

'das nas 'jug gzhan la ma 'khyogs pa'o/ /nyi shu gnyis zhes pa yig nor te nyi shu gcig go/ /snyan gsan phab ni snyan du zhu ba phul/spru nag nyer dgu par/ spru nag gi rtsa ba chig rgyud ldan pa'i gar nag spang gang zho lnga re/ sman chen 'dzin dkar bdud rtsi lo ma srang re/phur nag lo ma rgyas dus kyi khaṇ+ḍa sum tig tsan dan dkar gi wang cu gang ga dur de ba brag zhun nim pa par pa ta bong dkar rtsa lo 'dres pa gu gul stag sha a byag ming can gser me tsher sngon rnams zho lnga re/gur gum zho gang skar do/ gri sha zhes glo bur du shi ba'i sha shu dag nag po mu zi ser po zho do skar ma re/ gla rtsi zho gang li shi zho do sbyar/ chig — brgyud dang ldan ni nyer dgu de'i steng du ming can ser po spang rtsi zho gnyis/ re lcag me tog dang gnyan gyi rwa gang rung bsnan pas sum cu — rtsa gnyis/ pha lam ni rdo rje pha lam des phar la rin po che sra ba thams cad thub cing tshur la gang gis kyang mi thub pa dper byas pa ngag las nyan ni/ stong gzer sogs byung na gzer sman gri sha gtsor bskyed de sman chen dang mnyam/ mkhris shas che na nim pa sum tig gser me rnams gtsor bskyed/ de bzhin gnyan la gla rtsi bskyed pa sogs rig pas dpag gong gi chig brgyud dang ldan gar nag la phag brun nus bsreg gis rung yang ji skad du phyi rgyud las/ ga bur dag po'i thal sbyor phag ril dang / /srad dkar hong len de ba shing sngon bzhi/ //rdo grogs du ba ma shor so sor bsreg /thal ba dmar zal ba chus

'dam 'thag bya/ /ka ra sbyar bas ma zhu ba yi rims/ /gzer bung gnyan rims mig ser sel bar byed/ /khyad par pho bar rims babs bdud rtsi yin/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di yin/ de ba bcu par/ gser me zho bdun/ ga dur par pa ta zho drug re/ chig thub ste 'di'i skabs 'dzin pa zho gang skar drug a ru zho dgu/ spang rtsi zho brgyad/ bong dkar zho bdun/ gla rtsi skar brgyad/ gu gul zho lnga sbyar/ stong zil bdun par/ stong zil 'dzin pa srang re/ bong dkar stag sha gi wang zho lnga re/ gla rtsi gu gul zho gsum re sbyar/ bsreg tshul zhal las shes ni phyag rdor mgon po'i gces btus su bshad pa ltar yin/ sad mdas ngo blangs ni rlung gi sad mdas rtags kyi ngo glan/ spyi sman rnam gnyis ni de ba bcu pa dang stong zil bdun pa gnyis/ zed tsam ni cung zadasketsam/ srog 'dzin dgu pa nilhag rlung skabs bshad de'am gzhung gi a gar brgyad pa'i steng du sha chen shing kun li shi gang rung bsnan/ spun ni phra la myur ba/ sna lon ni sman skyed byung ba/ mkhris rimasaspya bcos ni sman ser chen mo/ nyen ni 'chi ba'i nyen/ drag po bcu gsum par/btsan dug zho do skar bzhi/ gla rtsi cu gang skar ma bzhi re/ gu gul skar gang / gyi sha zho re/ re lcag zho lnga/ shu dag zho gang skar bdun/ chu rtsa thar nu zho lnga skar ma bzhi re/ dur byid zho drug gi wang gur gum skar lnga re/ a ru zho gang skar brgyad sbyar/ dur byid cu gang snyi wang a ruṣ+ka rnams/ /zhes pa'i cu gang yig nor te gur gum chad song bas cu snyi//

'drar snang blocad ni ltar snang sasbrad/ gyong rlon ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ 'bras bu gsum dang tig ta spe tres gnyis/ /bskol grangs: yun du bsrings pa'i rlan gyis sbangs/ /zhes so/ // le'u nyer bdun pa/ 'brum pa bcos pa/ lha ba ni rus pa brdar tshe khrag ji 'byung ba/ glang gnya' ni sul las gnyer ma 'byung ste pags pa mthug por skrangs nas 'brum bu mi thon pa/ rtsel te ni yul skad du ha chig zer ba'i ga chags rta lug sogs la za ba de'i lus kyi —mdog dbyibs 'dra ba/ sha ra skyashar ni ser rdog ltar dkar ril le ba / rmog mgo ni dmag mi rnams kyisamago la gyon pa'i zhwa dbyibs lta bu / sib bu kob rtse ni 'brum bu'i dngos po chung la pags pa mthug cings ba/ brdung ni 'phar ba/ shig ni lus la shig sbyar ba 'dra ba/'chol ni bar mtshams yangs pa/ thor yan ni 'brum chen dang 'dra — yang de'i mtshan nyid med pa'i thor 'brum/ bsub ni sel/ phag ril ni skabs 'dir ma bsregs pa dgos/ rlangs lums bya zhes pa la/sne'u 'am lug ril phru chung gcig tu chang du btsos la de'i kha ras ma — gcig gis bcad mtha' ma ske rags kyis gril la/ de dbus phrang bca' ba'i 'og tu bcug la mgo gtums nas dar gcig bsdad la sog dbrag tu rdul chil 'byung ba dang 'phyis/ des kyang ma thon na sne'u mang du bcos la phya ra bkram la de'i steng du lus po yo gril la 'don — rdo / 2 / gsham ni 'og tu/ khrag chung ni me tog lug mig sgong thog ni —

'dre pad kha/ lug sho ni sho mang dngos/ gangs chus ril bur bsgril: ba chu tshan 'bul/ /zhes pa'i mchan du/ dkar nag so sor kha bsgyur —mi 'dra sogs ngag ces yod pa de chad song / de la so sor kha bsgyur tshul ni/ gtong dus phye ma las myur zhing gong steng gsang sman dang po dang / bse ru dkar po/ ra khrag phag brun/ re lcag gi me tog kun la bsnan/ dag por sngags pa nus ldan gyi brun/ khyi nag snying dkar gyi brun/ phag nag po'i brun dang gsum gsang sman bcas nus ldan du bsregs pa yin/ dkar smug bzhi ni mdung rtse dkar smug dang sbal rgyab dkar smug bzhi'o/ /mtshal dkar ni rgya mtshal cog la ma/gsang sman rnams zhes pa'i gsang sman ni/ rang shi'i thod pa dngul chu tsha la stag sha bcas/ myos khu ni chang gar/ gsang ba'i sman zhes pa'i gsang sman ni/ rang shi'i rkang mar/ gangs thigs bcu drug par/gangs thigs mdung rtse dkar cu gang spang re/ sbal rgyab dkar smug 'dres pa cong zhi spang gang zho lnga re/ gur gum tshal zho brgyad re/ li shi ka ko la a ru zho bdun re/ sug smel dzā ti zho drug re/ mtshal gla rtsi zho lnga re/ 'dzin lo dbyar gyi nyi ma ma log gong du btus pa srang do/dngul chu tsha 'dul sung gang sbyor/ ga bur bsnan zhes gsung gi rgyun la snang / 'on te dag por kā la bdun thang bsngags/ /zhes pa'i rkang pa phyi ma chad song / de la kā la bdun thang ni/ phur nag khaṇ+ḍa spru dag stag sha nag gu gul nag po tog tsam/ phag nag khyi dag snying dkar gyi bru)3

gnam ma mthong ba sngags pa bskyed rim dang ldan pa'i bla ma dang de min mi brun bcas gnam ma mthong ba'i brun gsum nus ldan bsreg pa'o/ /bse ko brgyad pa/bse ko glang ko mu zi gar nag g.yer shing gsang sman zho bzhi re srad nag zho brgyad phur khaṇa zho gsum rnams sbyar ba'o / / de'i gsang sman ni/ sman ma song ba'i 'brum skogs/ nad 'bras ni 'brum skogs/ gsang ba'i sman gsum ni/ rang shi'i thod pa rkang mar 'brum skogs/ 'bras shing me tog ni/ kham bu'i me togabatogs kyang ni skogs kyang / drug yar ni snga dgong srod thor dgung gnyis/ ma nu khrag can ni/ go bye zhes bse shing gi 'bras bu reg dug gi gtso bo yin pas sha rjen la byugs na rma skrangs shin tu ma rungs pa byung bas 'di lag len du mdzad tshe bsrung bya'i smin mtshams su zha nye'i g.ya' thug por btab pa'i steng go bye'i nang khrag sman pa'i lag pa la ma reg par cung zad re byug pa yin/ lnga bdun ni lnga 'am bdun/ pra (sbra )nag ni phya ra nag po/ bse ko ni ri dwags bse'i ko ba/ glang gnya'i ko ba ni glang 'og can gyi'o/ /spyi sman ni rdo rtsi gang rung gi sbyor ba / dug pus ni ra drug (dug )gi lo ma/ rdo sbyor bsnan ni rdo sbyor gyi steng du'o/ /thibs kyin ni dran pa nyams pa/ 'dred du ni gnyen — po'am bsnon mar/ dngul chu ni tsha 'dul dgos/ bdug ni gre bar zhal zhal bya/ mgo khugani mgo'i rnag lci ba seng khani ston dus kyi lci b.ri sar ga ma/ khugs ni smin/ /

/ le'u nyer brgyad pa/ beg ge bcos pa/ dam sel ni dam tshig la sel ba zhugs pa/ bag bag ni chung chung / beg ge ni 'brum chenasnyidang thor yan gang yang ma yin pa'i thor rims/ dmar skam zhes pa: yig nor te dmar snyam yin/ mgo thang gsum ni/ phyi rgyud las/ mi —thod rnying pa 'brug rus tig ta gsum/ /gsum gnyis bsdus grangs mgo nad sel bar byed/ /ces so/ /dpa' bo bcu gsum par/ bi ṣa nag spang gang zho do/ gla rtsi zho gang skar lnga/ shu dag zho do/ ru rta zhornabazhi skar gsum/ a ru'i sha zho dgu skar brgyad/ stag sha zho gang skar bdun/ gu gul nag zho do/ dngul chu tsha 'dul zho lnga skar bdun/ mu zi ser zho gsum/ kyi rtse'i me lo 'dres pa zho do skar do/ stong len zhod skar bzhi/ gi wang zho gsum skar brgyad/ spang rtsi rtsa lo 'dres pa zhon bzhi skar bzhi sbyar/ de'inang nas/ a ru zho dgu skar gsum/ ru rta zho do skar dgu/ shu dag zho gang skar lnga/ bi ṣa zho do/ gu gul skar bdun/ gi wang zho gang skar bzhi sbyar ba la dpa' bo drug pa zer zhingakade'i stengs rtsi skar bdun sbyar ba la dpa' bo bdun pa zhes bya'o/ /a ru bcu gcig par/ a ru zho brgyad skar lnga/ 'dzin dkar zho bdun/spang rtsi zho lnga skar lnga/ gla ji zho gang skar bdun/ cu gang zho bdun skar do / gur gum zho gang skar brgyad/ tsan dkar gi wang zho do skar lnga re/sro lo zho bzhi/ brag zhun srang gang zho do/ dug nyung zho gsum skar lnga sbyar / skur shor ni zas bcud shor ba/ 'dogs ni bla gnyan/ speshā sa

'phul/ khrag gcod brdzang ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ kun la mkhan skya'am spru ma'i reng bu yi/ /mgo la gur gum dom mkhris zab mgron thal/ / lde gu byugs la phugs su speb par brdzangs/ /zhes so/ /ga le'u nyer dgu pa/ cham rims bcos pa/ mchil ma bkag ni yig nor te mchi ma/ snag ni yig nor te nag zhi sbyang ni zhi ba'i nyams/ brum bur 'gyur ni yig nor 'brum bur 'gyur zhes pa yin/spe tres bdun thang la/ spe tres spang bcu gcig 'bras gsum srang bzhi re/ rgya tig gsum tig 'dres pa srang bdun/ ma nu sung bzhi/hong len srang do zho lnga sbyar/ cham 'joms dpa' bo bcu bzhir/'dzin pa gi wang sum gsum re/ gla ji zho do/ gu gul sung do/ cu gang tsan dan dkar sung gang re/ bal gur zho lnga/ bong dkar brag zhun stag sha spangartsi do bo rnams srang do re/ lug mur zho lnga/ gsang sman gnyis srang gsum re bcas sbyar/ de'i gsang sman gnyis ni/ snyi ba'i me tog dang sgong thog gi 'bru gnam ma mthong ba/ gre bar 'bab na tshar bong gi 'bru gtong ba'ang yod/ khyung sngon dgu par/ gtum po ste 'dzin pa'i rtsa lo 'dres pa zho lnga skar do/ a ru spang ji zhi dgu/ gu gul zho gang skar bdun/ ma nu srang gang zho gsum re/ hong len zho do skar bdun/ ga dur zho gsum skar bdun/ sro lo zho gang skar drug stag sha ni sngo stag sha zho gsum skar bzhi sbyar/ gur khyung ni gur gum li shi gi /byi gser me bcod mtshal tsan dan dmar po gla rtsi 'jam 'bras bong

dkar ru rta skyu ru ba ru rnams zho re/ a ru zho bdun/ bi gasrang gnyis/shu dag thang phrom dkar po'i 'bru zho re/ mi thod 'brug rus rgya tig: rnams zho lnga re sbyar/ li shi drug pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ li shi cu gang shing mngar spang rgyan dkar/ /ru rta a ru ra dang ka ra sbyar/ /li shi drug pa lo brgyad dri chus dbul/ /glo nad gre ba tsha skams skad 'gags sel/ /zhes so/ /li shi bcu drug par/ li shi cu gang spang rgyan sgong thog spang: ji 'dzin lo ru rta a ru tshar bong a krong dkarastso lo star bu rnams zho re re / gla ji skar lnga/ gu gul skar bdun/ skyer shun shingasangar zho gang skar lnga re sbyar/ bong dkar drug par/ bong dkar spang rgyan dkar shing mngar rnams zho do re/ cu gang zho gang skar gangaka 'u su skar bdun/ so phag zho brgyad skar bzhi sbyar/ lab khus bdug ni la phug: khu bas gre ba zhal zhal bya/ spang rgyan bco lnga/ spang dkar zho gsum/a gar nag po shing mngar skar brgyad re/ snying zho dzā ti zho re/ tsan dkar skar lnga/ cu gang ba ru zho gang skar lnga/ sro lo myu ru spe tres sko— gang re/ a ru zho gang re/ ru rta zho gang skar do/ ba sha ka zho gang skar gsum/ li shi skar drug sbyar/ rgyud nang ni rgyud bzhi'i mjug don — bsdus pa'i le'u'i nang / a lo dkar po ni/ rgyud bzhi'i mjug don las / chal pa bsrung ba ni/ oṃ a lo dkar po she sa hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa de yin/ hur hur zhes pa yig nor te tur tur/ rten snying ni rten 'brel snying po'i sngags yongs grags/ dkris nag ni thum nag yo/ 7

ni nas kyi dral thun tshan mo/ na gi ni sngo'i chu srin sder mo/ nas sna ske gnyis ni nas dkar nag gur gum bcu gsum ni/ phyi rgyud las/gur gum li shi gi wang bse ru mtshal/ /tsan dan gla rtsi 'jam 'bras bong nga dkar/ /ru rta 'bras bu gsum dang ka ra sbyar/ /gur gum bcu gsum mchin rgud sbyar dug dang / /mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri tshal sbos dngaka /ya ma nag po'ilhan nad sel bar byed/ /zhes so/ // le'u sum cu pa/ klad gzer bcos pa/ gnyan ni/ bon lugs la srid pa chags pa'i thog mar 'byung ba/ gnyan dung mgo g.yu'i smin ma can zhes pa las gyes pa nyi zla gza' skar nub tu 'dren pa dang /sprin byang du 'dren pa dngaka gnas sa rdo chu sogs la gnas pa'i gnyan legs nyes mang po ston pa 'khor bye ba stong bcas bar snang khams su gnas pa dpag tu med pa yod zer ba ltar gyi nad bdagabazhi cha ni cha bzhir byas pa'i cha gcig du shes ni ci tsam shes kyang /brgyan rje ni slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ khrisong lde'u btsan ni bod kyi chos rgyal zhig zab dgu ni zab pa'i man ngag thams cad/bye ni mang po/ log gnon ni sman dpyad gzhan las nus pa gnyis log gis gnon pa/ sde brgyad la sogs drag po'i gdon zhes pa la/ snga 'gyur pa snubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ sde brgyad la phyi dang nang dang gsang dang mchog dang sprul pa'i sde brgyad de lnga tshan brgyad yodaske ༵༵ bshad la/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin nam mkha' lding mi

'am ci lto 'bye chen po ste brgyad la rgyud sde bzhi ka las bshad/ bod rnams kyis/ dkar po lha yi sde/ dmar po btsan gyi sde/ nag posnyebadud kyi sde/ khra bo gza' yi sde/ smug po dmu yi sde/ sha za srin po'iskyisde / dkor bdag rgyal po'i sde/ nad bdag ma mo'i sde rnams su: 'dod/ gzhan yang rtog ldan 'ga' zhig gis/ dbang phyug ma hāde ba / srog bdag li byin ha ra/ 'chi bdag gshiban rje rgyal po/ gza' bdud chen porā hu la/ klu rgyal gdol pa nag po/ btsan rgyal yam — shud dmar po/ srid rgyal e ka tsa (dza )ti/ bdud mgon tras nag po rnams la 'dod cing / de rnams la lha srin sde brgyad zhes kyang bya ske zhing / skabs 'gar phan pa'i las byed pas mgon dang lha/ res 'ga' gnod pa'i las byed pas 'dre srin yang zhes bya/ thog ma nas phan gnod so sor byed pa yang yod do/ /drag po'i gdon ni/ sngon — rgyal posal 'khor srung gi bu thu po rgyal po bshes gnyen can gyis lha'i gtso bo rnams bsnyen bkur la bos pa las dbang phyug chen po drag po mig gsum zhes bya ba kun gyi rjes su bos pas khro khros te dpral ba'i — dkyil du mig ser la 'bur ba zhig byung ba des gang bltas su nad byung zhing / de'i chung ma u mas kyang rlung lha la nad bskur nas btang bas nad yams byung ba gzhan bus kyang ma shes pa 'jam dpal gyis mkhyen nas nad de'i gnyen po mdzad ces paṇa chen bi ma la mi tras bdud rtsi bam po bzhi pa las bshad do/ /mi bsrun ni rgyud ma rungs pa/ snyigasdu

ma zhes pa/ gzhung chen mo rnams su tshe snyigs ma tshe lo brgya pa mar grib/nyon mongs snyigs ma drag la rgyun ring ba/ lta ba snyigs ma phyin ci log bsgyur dka' ba/ sems can snyigs ma rgyud 'dul dka' ba/ dus snyigs ma rtsod ldan zhes pa ltar yin/ gzhan yangan ma gcig gi lung bstan las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas pa'i lnga brgya phrag bdun gyi rjes su lo bdun rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus 'byung /tshe lo lnga bcu la lo'i snyigs ma me pho stag gi lo la hor dmag bod du 'byung / zla ba'i snyigs ma bdun dmar sa mo yos/ zhag gi snyigs ma drug dkar lcags pho 'brug dus tshod snyigs ma gsum mthing lcags pho khyi / mi'i snyigs ma lnga bcu kha ral/ lcags pho khyi'i lo la mtha' dmag bod du 'byung / bod rnams phal cher mtha' la rgyug pa 'ong / de yang 'di nas bzung ste/ lo brgya phrag lnga dang bcu phrag lnga 'das pa nas/lo drug cu kha ral gyi dkyil du phyin nas 'ong ngo / /de nas bzung ste/mthar tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du je 'grib la 'gro bas/ tshe dang bsod — nams kha rje rnams rje zhan du 'gro bas/ spyod pa ngan pa sna tshogs pa 'byung ngo / /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /khrims la mi gnas ni btsun pa dang mi skya rnams chos dang rgyal khrims la mi gnas/ mna' za ni rdo rje'i dam tshig can rnams nang phan tshun du dug sbyor mthu byad sogs kyis dme grib byed pa/ tho co ni tho 'tsham pa/ bsdos ni 'khon 'gras rdinā pa/ ma rungs ni 'dul dka' ba/ ma mo'i kha rlangs gdug pa —

zhes pa la/ ma mo ni dbang phyug chen pos bha ga'i thab tu sbyin༄〉nalhas pa'i rdul gyi thig pa me gang du song ba las skyes pa'i srid pa'i ma moskobadun du grags pa de gnas gtso cher ri rab dang nye ba ke la sha'i gling du gnas pa de yin/ yang na/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti sum cu rtsalagasum gyi byang shar phyogs na mu li deng gi rgya mtsho chen por yongs 'du'i shing la brten nas sman mo'i gzugs su gnas pa la byang sman ces bya — zhing mtsho sman yang de yin/ kha rlangs gdug pa ni/ ma mo de dag gis rims gtsor gyur gyi nad kyi kha rlangs mdog ser dmar nag rnams — btang bas sprin ltar du chags pa las bsod nams dman pa'i 'gro ba rnams la 'phog ste ser po las bal nad dang cham pa/ dmar po las rgyu gzer dang khrag bshal/ nag po las gag lhog dang 'brum nag sogs 'byung ba/ tre tre ho ni mi spyon pa su 'phrad la mtshon bdeg pa ltar rims smyon nad bdag dang bcas pa 'di su phog la 'khrugs — gzer sogs gtong / 'di dang par pa ta zhes pa don gcig zungs pa'i mgo dbyibs ni/ rtsangs pa de la nags rtsangs sam nags sbrularna dang klung rtsangs gnyisayod cing / gnyis na'i mgo bo sbal ba dang 'dra bas de'i dbyibs canano/ /rta bla ni phyogs 'dir med pas ma mthongarkoyang dpe ris su phye leb dang 'dra la khad pa las lus sbom la rwa ringasheba'i srin bu zhig bris snang gnyen nad ni rgyu'i ming 'bras bu la btags pa ste dkyil che ba'i don/ nywa lhog ces pa yig nor te lha 1swā/

dag po gsum 'khril ni gnyan tshad rlung gsum bsdongs pa/ che ge'i zhes pa'i skabs su nad kyi ming sbyar dgos/ kha nang du zhes pa'i du yig mchan yin/ sngags sam zhes pa'i sam la ba 'phrul yod pa dgos/ha la dang sprel zhes pa'i ha la ni/ hal hun te/ hal rtse/ na ga ra dza tu na la/ krug la/ krug le/ ha la ha la/ tun nas/ sa ma yā/ bud rtsi yang sar/ ku ru ṇi/ khrung khrung phu phu/ tri tri maphe lam hum/hal tun te hal rtse nā ga rā dza tun ya krug la krug le hal hal nas las ma ya bung rtsi yang sar gtun khrung khrung tun dun phu phu tri tri/ zhes sngags gong ma dang sgrol/ phag rgod snying gar bskyed la btags/ zhes pa la/ sgrub bya phag rgod du bsgom pa'i snying gar rtsibs lnga'i sngagasam bskyed la cung zad re bzlas/ de'i rjes su rtsibs lnga'i sngags dang ha la'i sngags gnyis sprel la bzlas zhing 'khor lo sgrub bya la btags/ ra phyar ni phya ra/ yugs sa ni bu khyo nor gsum dang bral ba'i mo reng / lha rje ni sman pa/ ka ca khyer len ni yo byad phyir khyer ba dang nang du len pa / 'chi bsru ni 'chi dgos kyistsog rin gyis bslu ba/ chings ni mdo —ru / man ngag gur gum bcu gsum ni/ 'og tu le'u zhe brgyad par/des kyang ma zhi mgo thang gsum pa'i steng / /gur gum g.ya' kyi a byag 'dzin pa dkar//bong dkar dom mkhris gangs thigs gser me tog/thang phrom dkar po rdo dreg sbyar ba 'di/ /man ngag gur gum bcu /stasna zhes grags pa/ /khrag mkhris mgo nad ya ma dkar nag dang /

klad pa'i tshad rigs mtha' dag 'joms zhes bshad/ /ces so/ /phan pa kun ldan la/ thang phrom zho gsum skar bdun/ ra khrag zholagasum/ rgya tshos zho bzhi sbyar/ nad stong ni yig nor te nad steng / rtsa sto ni rtsa sbyongs sto bshal/ gong bshad phag rgod 'khor lo'i lte ba dkar po / rtsibs ser po/ rtsibs mchan dmar po/ de'i mtha' sngon po/ mu khyud phyi ma dmar por byed do/ // le'u so gcig pa/ gag pa bcos pa/ zho chal ni zho sla mo/ ral gyi sna ma'i gzhung 'dra ni/ ral gri so gnyis ma'i gzhung 'dra ba nya rgyabacuyod pa sngo breng le ba/ rus sbal rgyab 'dra ni/ 'bar 'bur dang grol sheg ge ba/ migs sha ni bye myug gam bye ma myu gu zhes pa'i sbal chung bye mar khung bu byas nas gnas pa ser skya phra la myur mgyogs can mjug ma ring ba gzugs mthe bong tsam gyi ga zung ni gnyis/ me tog brgyad pa/kyi lce spang ji spang rgyan dkar tshar bong zho lnga re/ stag sha zho bdun/'dzin pasrang gang / a ru shu dag zho lnga sbyar/ rgyud chen sman sbyor chen mo ni/ man ngag rgyud kyi le'u nyer drug par bshad pa byings che bas 'dir ma bkod/ 'phreng la gdab pa ni/ mgo bo la sngags mchil med pa'i skam pos g.yas g.yon du 'phreng la gdab/ thur la brda' ni/yan lag rnams la sngags mchil dang bcas pa'i rlon pas sor mo'iskyirtse'i bar thur la gdab/ sham bu ni/ 'chang ba po la gag lhag rigs las bsrung zhig ces pa lta bu/ 'phreng gcig ni thig phreng gcig 173

bris / sa nad ni gnyan nad/ lhog dug ni re lcag pa/ dug pu ṣa pa ni ra dug gi me tog chig chod ni lhan gcig kha la rgyas 'debs ni 'og tu gzer thung skabs bshad/ pho tshos ni rgya tshos/ mtshur gnyis ni ser mtshur nag mtshur gnyis/ bsreg ni lcags kyi tel pas so/ /chu grog — ni bskol grangs la rtsam pa mdog 'gyur tsam du btab pa/ rdzong ni gnas 'cha' sa/ sna bshal ni phyi rgyud ltar/ rtse mgo ni rtse chungan /1 le'u so gnyis pa/ gzer thung bcos pa/ sbrud spud ni bud — bud rang yin/ god pa g.yon ni snying ga'i thad/ sna khrag ni yig nor te rnag khrag 'bur tshugs lta ni trig ge lta ba/ 'tshor ('tsher )ni mi gsal ba'am skad 'dzer ba/ sre bo ni nag la smug mdangs pa'am smug la dmar mdangs can/ zhag zhag ni 'chi nyen che ba'i zhag grangs/ glo tsha ni rgyas tshad tsha skugs/ dug thabs ni 'khrugs tshad stobs rdzogs nas lus zungs khyab pa/ dud khu ni mdog dud pa ral pa'i khu ba lta bu la ngo bo sha skyo bu/ 'dre kha rgod ni gnod pa mang po ldang ba/ gsang — ba'i sman ni ming can nag po/ khun gros ni thang phrom dag po/ khun pa yang di yin/ kha la rgyas 'debs la/ spru dag a byag zho do re/ gla rtsi skar gsum mu zi zho gang / gu gul ser mtshur zho do re/ shu dag skar dgu sman chen thar nu zho gsum/ ldong ros skar brgyad/ mchu skung rtse mo zhod skar drug nag mtshur zho gang skar gsum/ yung ba zho do skar: /sdu / brag zhun zho brgyad skar do/ 'di la brag zhun chus sbrusaskyi

gsungs kyang thar nu dur byid chu rtsa gsum gyi khu bar sbyangs pa ma ngagayin / snying rtsa seng ni sems spro seng bde ba/ zhi byed lhogs pa gi zhi byed kyis bzlog pa/ /1 le'u so gsum pa/ pho glang bcos pa/ gyis dkrugs ni gyisaskogatubs/ pho ba sgrim ni lto ba phra ru song ba/ nywa 'bros ni lha gzhi 'bros pa / mkhrang ni gsan cha/ gze ma ni ji ma/ zhom ni babs/ gar nag ni phagazun nus bsreg gsang sman ni bsosar yan lag ma nyams pa'am bying bying thu lu phyi ma 'di la 'tshom pa byung na bod kyi yul skad du sho mo rdzab log zer/ sog po'i yul skad du kola'e zer ba de yin/ngag las nyan ni/ bya khyung bcu gsum pa tshad ldan te/ 'di la khyung lnga mnyam sbyor ni/ sman chen a ru zho bzhi re/ ru rta zho gang shu dag zho gang skar lnga/ gla rtsi skar brgyad kyi steng rgyam tshwa zho gang skar brgyad/ pi ling zho gang ma ru rtse skogs bshus byi tang thang phrom dkar zho gang skar lnga re/gar nag zho do phur dag khaṇ+ḍa zho gsum skar bdun/ gsang sman skar brgyad sbyar/ ru rta bcu par ru rta drug pa ni phyi rgyud las/ ru rta skyu ru se 'bru ba sha ka /sug smel pi pi ling dang ka ra sbyar/ /ru rta drug pas smug po 'thab pa'i nad/ /glang thabs sgreg skyugs pho khar zug pa — sel/ / zhes so/ /'di dag gi sbyar tshad la/ ru rta zho do skar lnga/ ba sha sku ru se 'bru thang phrom rtsa byi tang a ru rnams zho re/ pi pi ling zhom bdun sug smel skar bdun/ gi wang zho gang skar lnga sbyar/ / 105

/ le'u so bzhi pa/ rgyu gzer bcos pa/ za khu ni khrag rtsi 'dres pa/rtsa ni bshang ba dang 'dra ba'i rnyogs ma/ dugs ni nya rul dri mnam pa/bcar la thebs ni gnya' pa rnams kyi 'khris su bcar la thebs pa ste lus zungs 'chor ba/ 'khor lo'i lte ba ser po/ chu ris dkar po/me ris dmar po byed do/ /rtsi srung lag len ngag ni/ til nag thur mgo gang gangs chur sbangs/ ri bong klad pa ma rul pa thun gnyis mi'i rgyu ma ma rul ba thun re rnams btab la lan gnyis gsum tsam gtong /in+d+ra bco lngar/ dug nyung zho gang skar do/ bong dkar rtsa lo 'dres pa zho do skar brgyad/ ga dur zho gsum/ ba le ka zho gang skar bdun/ gi wang zho do skar brgyad/ cu gang zho dgu skar drug gur gum zho gsum/bdud rtsi lo ma zho do/ brag zhun zho lnga skar bzhi/ phag brun gnam mdze mthong ba nus ldan bsreg pa'i gar nag srang gang skar gsum/ gla jisnyeskar bzhi/ gu gul zhod skar gang / gser me zho gang skar bzhi/ pi pi ling zho do/ rgyam tshwa skar lnga rnams sbyar/ 'dir mchan gyi gnod tshad yig nor te snod tshad yin/ brag khyung bcu gsum par/ brag zhun zho do skar gsum/ gla rtsi skar gsum/ kha tsheskar drug ru rta zho gang /dom mkhris skar lnga/ bong dkar charu zho do re/ pri yang ku shu dag nag sug smel skar dgu re/ ga dur zho gang skar bzhi sman chen zho lnga/ sngar bshad pa ltar chig rgyud can gyi gar dag zho drug sbyar/ gur gum mchog dihā/ ni/ phyi rgyud las/ gur gum cu gang ut+pal ba le ka /tig ta a

ru mtshe ldum ka ra sbyar/ /gur gum mchog bdun mchin nad gsarabarnyings dngan mchin pa bsnad 'grams khrag rgyas mig ser sel/ / zhos so/ /snod kyi gnyan tshad bcos pa'i sman ni gong bshad in+d+ra bco lnga pa/ nyi ma ni mtshal/ zla ba ni 'dzin pa/ ha bo ni brag skya ha bo/dom ni dom mkhris/ gnyen po zang dang sbyar gsungs kyang zang miskobatang ba lag len yin/ ming po bdun gyi sring gcig ma ni brag skya ha bo'i me tog me tog dmar po'i khu ba la bshad pa ma mthong yang /gsang ba'i chu bcos las srad ma dmar po bshad pa na/ khrag bshal — sman la mchog tu bzangan /khrag gzer 'joms shing khrag lam — mthud/ /ces gsungs pa'i nus pa bcas srad ma dmar po la byed kyang rung snyam/ zagasasdoms ngag las nyan ni ha lo'i me tog zer ba — yod kyangad gur gum mchog bdun steng du dom mkhris ri bong klad pa sbyar ba dang / yang bsil gsum brag zhun gla rtsi bong dkar dug nyung: dom mkhris sbyar/ gsang sman chig rgyud ni/ sman ma song ba'i bshal — khrag dang / rang shi'i thod pa rkang mar gang rnyed yin/ bud med — gzhon nu ma mngal nad med pa'i zla mtshan skabs 'di'i gsang sman gyi mchog ste 'di khong du speb na rgyu gzer gyis 'chi mi da gsungs/ skyer pa'i 'bru lag len dus ngag ni skyer nag gi 'bras bu dmar po gtong ba yin / mtshal sbyor bcu pa/ lha min bu re skon zho bdun re/ zla ba'i bcud srang gang / ri'i rtse bong dkar dug zhung brag zhun brag skya'i 10 7

tog spang gang zho gsum re/ dom mkhris zho drug gla rtsi zho lnga sbyar/'di'i lha min bu ni mtshal/ zla ba'i bcud ni 'dzin pa dkar po/ri'i rtse ni spang rtsi do bo/ chu bzang ni char chu gangs chu rgyug chu rim pas gong ma bzang / lag len ngag ni gces bsdus su/ kha che brag zhun skyer thun gsum/ /thun ni mnyam po byas nas ni/ /dar ram ras sam gtsang mas phur/ / tho rangs skar ma ma yal gong /skyog ni thur la kha bstan pa/ /lan gcig bcus pas yan la blangs/ /chu nang de'u — gnam ma mthong / /lag pas ma reg skyogs blangs der/ /sngags de — de'u re skar chur skyur/ /sman rnams sngags chur sbangs pa rnams/ /yang yang bcir zhing btung du gzhug /gos kyis phebs (khebs )par byib par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ gsang ba sngags ni rang sngags de ga yin/ sgrom tshos ni sbug tshos/ brda' shes ni cung zad tsam/rim pas bskyed ni sgrol ma gnyis kyi yun sogs bskyed/ rtsa chu bral ni chu bshang ba 'dres pa'i rnyog dang bral ba/ skyo ma ni sla ba/ skya mdog ni ska ba/ mar mig ni gar po/ kheng po ni rad pa/ dkar chos ni sdig —dang ma 'dres pa'i dge rtsa'o/ // le'u so lnga pa/ me dbal bcos pa/ btsag ni rdo dmar po'iskyi rigs khang pa'i tshon bya ba/ sran chung ni mon sran las chung la leb mo/nim pa ni dri ngan pa'i shing phran tsher ma can/ /7103'u so drug pa/ chen bu bcosapa/ rigs brgyad ni man ngagaske

rgyud las/ dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dngan /sha tshil rtsa dang 'bras dang brgyad du bshad/ /ces so/ /ngag ni 'byar/ 'dzim pa zhes ma mtha' byung ba yig nor te mtha' rten na dgos/ bya bra nisnye phug ron gyi brun/ sbang ma ni 'bru'i chang gi sbang ma/ /1 le'u so bdun pa/ nywa log bcos pa/ dpa' bo chig thub ni sman chen/ spyi sman a ru ra/ sor mo'i tshigs ni shu dag ri bcud ni phur nag gdugs dkar 'khor lo ni spru dag gi rtsa ba/ 'dod chags rtse mo ni bya pho'i ze khrag zhe snang tshil bu ni sbrul tshil/ gti mug 'khor lo ni phag gi sna/ ban+de'i mkhris pa ni chu bya ngur pa'i mkhris pa/ ma rnyed na ngang pa'i nywa sha/ bon po'i thal ba ni rta bon pa/ 'dre 'jigs thang chu ni gu gul/ brtan po'i dreg pa ni brag dreg dri can lte ba ni gla rtsi'o / / rgod sha ni bya rgod sha/ ram bu'i mkhar bu ni rgya skyegs kyi khu ba bton pa'i snyigs ma la las zer ba de yin zer ba dang / dpag — bsam ljon par/ ram bus grang ba'i 'khru bar phan/ /zhes pa'i nus pa bcas tha ram gyi rigs gtogs kyi ram bu yin zer ba'ang yod/sngags kyis ngar btags ni/ rang sngags te/ char dza nas yam rbad: bar srog sngags stong phrag lnga dang / tri nas skyo'i blo'i bar bsrung sngags te stong phrag gsum btab la/ skud pa dmar po pho'i g.yas/ mo'i g.yon gyi dpyad par btags pas nges par thub bo/ // le'u so brgyad pa/ lhog pa bcos pa/ rgod dang yang rgod ༵༵

bu gsum tsha gnyan dang yu mo grang gnyan yin pa khyad par ro/ /sgal ni sog 'dab/ mchan ni mchan khung / nag po gsum ni gu gul nag po shu dag gla rtsi/ 'phar zhib ni 'phel grib/ phyis sul ni yig nor te phyi yul / ldang dub ni res 'gar na res 'ga' bde/ 'bros skyen ni mched myur/ 'phro ni 'go/ yams thabs ni gzhan la 'go ba/ snyi la 'dol ni reg bya 'jam la dbyibs phya le ba/ 'gul ba ni skrangs po'i ngos gcig nas mnan na ngos gzhan du 'pho ba/ rnyid po ni g.yung /khrab ma ni dri chu chu ngan dang bcos pa'i 'doms spu/ thums btang ni yig nor te thums btags/ tshig ni tshig pa za ba/ sman nad thon nges ni sman gyi nus pas zi ber byung ba/ bu ni yig nor te bus/ nan ni sman 'byar ba/ gnyan dug ni thang phrom nag po/ so thog ni mgar ba'i so thog bya bal ni chu bal ljang khu/ bya brun ni khyim bya'i brun/skrangs tshad mi shig ni skrangs pa'i dkyil nas mi byug par mtha' nas byug / 'bros na zhes pa'i na ni yig nor te 'bros sna mnon/ de yang skrangs sna lha sna rtsa sna nas byug mnon ni skrangs sna mnon na/ phyin nan bya zhes pa yig nor te phying nan/ de yang shog bu 'am spu 'am phying pa la bag chu dang spyin chu byug pas mnan/ lag len zab gnad zhal shes ni / 'byung ba'i lhog pa gang shas che ba de'i/ sman mgo mtho zhing gzhi —dang gzhan rnams cha snyoms sbyar/ 'di la da dung zhal shes dgos/ ma /sdu/ ni ma thon na/ byil ni dkyil/ deb ni dkyis ma/ rol med ni
