shol med/ sra mkhar sgyel ni lcags mkhar sra ba sgo med ltar nang 'jug mi nus/ skyogs ni lpags gas pa/ lung pa'i mgo bkag pa ni/ rkang par byung na snying rtsa mig dmar lag par byung na a so mgo la byung na rtse chung dang tshangs bug gzhan gar bros kyang bsreg me rgyas gdab pa ni/khong du shor ram sbubs su byung na spyi gtsug dang rtsa 'phrad rgyas pa sdom —na sngon po dkar nag mtshams tshigs pa drug pa srin lag bzhi'i rtsa ba— rkang lag gi mthil bzhi rnams bsreg dmag gis bskor ba ni/skrangs dang ma skrangs kyi mtha' mtshams nas sor re bar mtshams byas te bsreg gnam lcags dbab ltar ni/ nya'i ze ba sogs dang khyad par skrangs gang che'i steng du 'bur po yod na rgya gram du bsreg ces pa dze+e/ rgya blums zhes pa ni ma dag pa yin 'dra/ 'di rnams la bka' — mchan gnang yang rgya par la 'dogs tshul nor pa dang tshig chad kha shas byung bas gsarasbra byas so/ /lcags kyi tel pa ni/ gri lcags la mgar nag gis lo zad zla zad kyi nyer dgur brdungs pa dgos/ /( le'u so dgu pa/ gnyan 'bras bcos pa/ bem ni zhen/ rma chen ni yig nor te rma can/ khren pa risred pa che ba/ gsang ba'i sman ni / ri kha byang bltas su skyes pa'i phur nag nus bsreg thal ba'am der skyes pa'i phur nag sad kyis ma khyer ba'i khaṇ+ḍa rab de min lo ma gtong ba'ang yod/ se 'bras ni ma nu khrag can/ go tsan ni thang shing la go tsan zer ba yod kyang skabs 'dir mi klad/ thang chu ni thang ma /snyi/

shing gi thang chu/ mtshal dkar ni rgya mtshal dmar po/ chu ser sman gsum ni spos thal so/ gnam lcags zil ba ni/ 'og tu le'u gya lnga — /ra zlo/ dab/zhi/ bcu pa/ 'dzum bu ltag dgye bcos pa/ gsang sman ni / pho rog gi sha/ lugs gcig la phag brun gnam ma mthong ba/khrag rkang ni myang rtsi sprus sam re skon pa/ rtsa lnga ni/ ra mnye nye shing lca — ba ba spru gze ma/ /ཿ le'u zhe gcig pa/ mkhris pa rtsar rgyug bcos pa/ klu bdud ni klu dang bdud gnyis bsdongs pa'i sras/ rgyu ba zhan ni khams ngan/dugs ni dri ngan/ tshan chen ni tshan mo/ nag po'i khrag gsum ni bya nag khyi nag phag nag gsum gyi khrag chos sman ni/ bdud rtsi sman grub rab ma rnyed na dge slong gtsang ma 'am sngags pa nus ldan gyi chu'o/ /bzhi thang ni ma nu bzhi thang / gyi sha ni mi glo bur du shi ba'i sha/ ga bur drag po nyer gsum par/ ga bur dkar sngon 'brug rus mi thod spang rtsi a byag 'dzin pa tsher sngon rgya tig bong dag rnams spang gang re/ gar nag srang gang zho gangan ga bur smug a gar cu gang gur gum gi wangasnyebong dkar ba sha ka hong len gser mdog rnams zho brgyad re/ gu gul zho bdun se 'bru susmrel zho lnga re sbyar/ 'di'i ga bur dkar po ni ga bur dngos/ ga bur nag po ni phag ril nus bsreg ga bur sngon po ni /sdus kyis/ ga bur smug po ni gla rtsi'o/ /ya lud med ni 'dogs pasnye

med / gtso bo lnga gyur ni a ru mchu skung lnga 'gyur/ rbab ni chu brub pa/khun ni thang phrom/ pha lam ni rin po che/ brngan pa ni rgyags zad/ // le'u zhe gnyis pa/ nang lhog bcos pa/ lus rdul ni yig nor te lus rdul/ skad 'thams ni skad 'gag srin sman rgyal blon dmag mi mtshon char bcas zhes pa la/ man ngag rgyud dang 'di'i le'udon lnga pa gnyis kur/ kun la byi tang ka dang ma ru tse/ /gla rtsi shing kun sgog skya g.yer ma dang / /thang phrom phur thal lang thang rtse dang 'brum/ /tres 'bru spru ma dkar po chig thub rnams/ /mngar gsum 'o mar sbyar — ba khong du btang / /shwa ba'i tshil dang sbyar ba sna ru bdug /zo mar — reng bu byas la mas yar btang / /dwa ba'i khaṇ+ḍa sbyar la lpags la byug /bya khyung ril bu yun bsten srin kun 'joms/ zhes so/ /'di la mngar gsum 'o ma sbyar gsungs pa srin kha dkar mngar la 'byed pas de dus sman gyi nus pa srin bu'i khong du song nas gsod pa la dgongs pa yin zhing / lhan thabs 'di'i mchan du bskol grangs chu la sbyar gsungs pa dkar mngar srin la gnod phyir mi rung snyam du dgongs pa'o / / gsang sman ni/ thang phrom dkar po'i rtsa 'bras gang rung ngam phur nag gi lo rtsa 'am/ phag nag brun gnam ma mthong ba gtong ba yang yod/ blon po zhal kha bsgyur ni/ ma gi ta/ dmag mi sa bcud pho mo ni/ dngul chu dang mu zi/ gtum po ni sman chen/ sgos kyi gnyen po'i thang ni phur mong dang gla rtsi'i thang / mchan gyi sbyor snon phran 1sdu/

ngag ni/ mi khyi phag gsum gyi brun phur mong gi thang la btab ste gdus pa'i khu bas dbul/ nang ma re ni zhogs pa re/ tshani ni pi pi ling spru bsdu btug shās pa'i btug ni yig nor te dugs/ de yang dri chur — sna sdu ༵ sazhe ga/ su/ma pa/ gnyan kha med bcos pa/ rtsa chu ni dri chen dri chu / spyi sman ni a ru ra/ dpa' bo ni sman chen nam btsan dug ser po/rgya yi ril bu ni rgya tshwa/ 'di la snag tsha zer ba'ang 'dug nag ring ni ra dug srib ngos phyogs kyi chig skyes/ gnyan dug ni stag sha nag po/ // le'u zhe bzhi pa/ 'khyam po nyag gcig bcos pa ser po zab lag ni chu rtsa/ nu zho 'dzag pa'i btsun mo mdzes ma ni thar nu/ chu rlung 'thab pa'i dpal bo ni sman chen/ /ga le'u zhe lnga pa/ 'bar 'bur bcos pa/ mthing nag khros pa ni — bong nag 'brum rtse ni ri sho'i rtsa ba/ lcags kyi spyang ni spyang tsher/stag lag can ni mkhan pa/ gdon gshed khra bo ni spru nag gi rtsa ba/ gyi ling bdud rtsi ni rta gseb sngon po'i spangs khu/ seng ge lcags ral ni lca ba/ lte ba'i dri ni ma gi ta/ mtshan mo'i 'od can ni cong zhi/ 'dod 'jo'i ba smug po ni brag zhun/ dug gi me tog ni ra dug gnyan — 'joms dpa' bo ni stag sha/ klad pa ni ra klad/ rgyal po'i snying khrag ni star zhun/ btsun mo'i mchin pa ni sid+dha ra/ e kro ni lo brgyad drim stardo 4/ / bong nag bco lnga par/ bong nag ga dur stag sha sung re/ ri

sho spyang tsher mkhan pa rta sbangs lca ba brag zhun ra klad zho lnga re/ sbo dag cong zhi star bu sid+dha ra zho brgyad re/ gla rtsi zho do sbyar/ /( le'u zhe drug pa/ rna rtsa bus 'debs bcos pa/ sman chen bzhi sbyor ni/ sman chen a ru spang rtsi bzhi la zer ba 'dug rang byung gnyis ni dri chen dri chu/ zab lag can ni chu rtsa/ za 'og ber gsol ni chu rtsa/rtsal ldan rgyal po ni dur byid/ nu zho 'dzag pa'i btsun mo ni thar nu/dung thod bcings pa'i blon po ni re lcag pa/ kha lo ni stag sha// le'u zhe bdun pa/ ngam ru bcos pa/ rngabs rwa zhes pa la — rngabs ra'i cho ga lag len gces bsdus las gsungs pa ltar man ngag rgyud kyi brda bkrol du bkod zin/ lang tsho ldan pa'i khrag ni bong thor gyi khrag bde byed chung ngu zhes par mchan yig sbyor sde ngag ces yod pa chad song / de yang cu gang gur gum li shi se 'bru pi pi ling ut+pal shing tsha rnams tshad rlung gi nyams la dpag /1 le'u zhe brgyad pa/ mgo nad bcos pa/ gtso bo'i nad brgyad phal pa drug ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ dbye ba gtso bo'i nad brgyad phal pa drug /dang po rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun dang / /ldang ba'i nad gsum mgo yisan dang brgyad/ /phal pa ma rlung chen 'bras glog — pa can/ /skra byi spyi ther skra dkar rnam pa drug /ces so/ /rtse chung rgyangs ni sbom por song ba snyam byed/ 'khyoms ni 'gro ba'i tshe lus 'phyor ba/ 'thoms ni gnyid kyis thebs pa ltar 'thibs pa/ /snyi/

gong ni nyin byed mtshan byed kyi gong tsam der/ 'gangs chung ni tshabs chung / thang phrom dkar po zhes pa la de'i tshab tu byi tang ka btang: ba'ang yod/ ril dkar pad sdong ma ngag tu nyan ni 'og tu le'u re — gsum par bshad pa'i grub thob ril dkar la se ba'i me tog bongs: cher bsnan/ thang dang ni ma nu bzhi thang dang / spyi ther ni spyi bo'i skra 'byi ba/ rta dkar 'og can ni rta thug dkar po/ drang srong me lha'i — zhal du btab ni sla ngar me la sreg ngag sdoms ni du ba ma shor bar — nus ldan bsreg cing ba'i mdog can ni/ rdo byung ba ltar nag pa ste — thal ba nag po 'od ldan du gyur pa/ rtsis rgyal po ni gla rtsi/ dal 'gro'i rtar bskyon ni chus sbrus pa/ tshi gu ni nang gi rkang / a rag ni gar chang / glum gyi nye'u ni 'bru chang gi sbang ma/ bad ma phog ni ba mo ma phog pa/ rlung sho ni yig nor te klung sho/ dkar mo nya ni thar nu'i ming yin yang 'dir ldab pas shu dag byas pa rung min dpyad/ sa'i me tog ni mu zi ser po/ rin chen sngon po'i na bza' ni dngul chu 'dul ma/dbas so'i dus ni skar ma dbas so shar ba'i nyin/ lhog khol ni bskol tsam byas pa/ dung gi a long ni kyi rtse yin zer ba 'dug dbyar zho ni yig nor te dbyar sho/ rgya ni za 'gram gyi steng gi spu/ // le'u zhe dgu pa/ mgo srin bcos pa/ ya ma ni rgya skad min yang mgo srin gyi btags ming / byur chags ni gzhan gyi le lan/ 'khri ni di/sdu/ re ni klad spris/ klad rgya ni rgya srubs/ 'jib pa ni mchu

'dzugs pa/ ldang dub ni res che res chung / 'khor gong steng du nidzo dkar gor mer bsreg pa'i dmar po'i steng du/ rtse ni na/ sdum bu nag ni bong nag yin zer/ chus phan ni yig nor te chus bran/ phan pa kun ldan ni/ thang phrom zho lnga/ ra khrag zho gsum skar lnga/ rgya tshos zho gsum sbyar ba'i steng du/ bcod 'brug rus mi thod btsa' ma zho gsum re / byi tang ka zho bzhi sbyar/ gcun ni gnan/ sngo yi tsha ba gsum ni rtse tsha dbyi mong srub ska ba ko tsam byugs la/ zhes pa skra bzhar ma thag bul chus bkrus te/ de rjes su chus bkru/ de rjes g.yer ma'i khu ba dron mos bkru/ de rjes dngos gzhi'i sman tshan mo srab mthug ba ko tsam byug 'di dus skra mtshams nas bal thil dkri/ de phyin gyis ngo sogs la sman khu mi 'dzag pa'i thabs bya/ thang khug ni sman gyi skyo mas/ /1 le'u lnga bcu pa/ mig nad bcos pa/ sha zhin ni mig sprin/ se ba ni srab mo/ mthong byedani mthong byed rgyal mo/ zangs gzer 'dra ni dkyil kyong / sha mdzer mig khebs gsal par ma gyur na zhes pa yig nor te/ sha mdzer mig khebs dmar gsal mi 'gyur zhes pa yin gsungs/ gad pa chad 'dra thib ste 'ong ni steng ngos nas glo bur du ling gis 'ong / mtsho la dar chags rim gyis 'ong ni mtsho 'khyag pa'i tshe sna nas rim gyis 'khyag pa ltar mas ngos nas rim gyis thong /gsal byed lde gu zhes pa la/ phyi rgyud las/ 'bras bu gsum dang a ba lcags phye dang / /go snyod shing mngar mar gsar ka ra sbyar/ /lde 1sta 7

mig nad dmar tshag rab rib 'joms/ /zhes gsal byed bdun pa'i lde gu dang / de'i steng du mdung rtse dkar po dang lcags sbrul gyi sha bsnan pa'i gsal byed dgu pa'i lde gu 'am phyi rgyud kyi sman mar skabs bshad gsal byed dgu pa'i na rnams lde gur byas pa/ 'bras gsum mar ni/ phyi rgyud las/ grang sel a ru bar skyur byed cha skyung / /bsdus khu dwangs ma mar phyung bu ram sbyar/ /dza ti kha ru tshwa dang pi pi ling / /sug smel bca' sga kha tshar btab pa yi/ /'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar rgas ka sra/ /mig dang rna ba so dang sna yi nad/ /mgo nad rtsa byer rnag 'byams rlung nad sel/ /khyad par snying la rlung zhugs 'joms pa'i — mchog ces so/ /a ba bco lnga ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ cong zhi bsil gsum ut+pal 'bras bu gsum/ /go snyod shing mngar brag zhun sbrul gyi sha /lcags bye a ba rnam gnyis ka ra sbyar/ /yun du bsten na mig gi bcud len 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'di la a ba rnam gnyis ni/rtswa a ba yongs grags dang rdo a ba mdung rtse dkar po/ gsal byed —spos reng chen mor/ shing mngar lcags sbrul zho lnga re/ gur gum zho do skar gsum/ gi wang skar brgyad/ ba sha ka skar drug skyu ru zho gang: skar gsum/ mdung rtse dmar ti tsha dung bsregs zho gang skar dgu re/mtshal dkar zho gsum/ shu dag gla rtsi skar re/ ru rta ba rusham mkhris g.yag mkhris pho ba ris rtsa a ba skar gsum re/ skya ku'i mkhris pa yung:di sdug ram rtsi zho re/ nya mkhris skar lnga mi mkhris li shi sga skya skar do re/

tshal zho do/ pi pi ling go snyod cu gang skar bzhi re/ skyedacakhan zho gang ’ skar lnga/ 'jigs med zho gang skar gang / shel rgyal skar bdun khyi la ha shig zho gang skar do re/ lcags phye zho do skar drug sbyar/ 'di'i shingang gi nor bu ni shing mngar/ lcags sbrul gyi mgo dang mi tshang ba dgos la gdong la gwa zhur yod pa bzang rab yin/ gang ltar yang gla rtsi'i chur zhag gcig sbangs la bzhag pas dug phral lo/ /mdung rtse ni mdung sbal mkhris sna mang po ma 'dzoms yang g.yag rog gi mkhris pa dang /nya mkhris gnyis gal che/ lcags khu'i 'dam btags ni lcags phye a rus bshig pa'i khu ba'o/ /mtshal dkar ni rgya mtshal cog la ma/'jigs med ni a ru nag chung / khyi la ni seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa/ sag ram rtsi ni / kha che bal po'i lag nas yong pa'i tshur 'dra ba de yin yang zer/zangs snod sogs la byugs nas skam pa'i g.yang sngon po de yin/gsal byed spos reng chung bar/ a ru gser mdog gi sha zho gang skar drug / gur gum skar gsum gi wang skar bdun/ li shi skar do/ dbang lag ha shig skar dgu re/ mdung rtse zho gang skar bzhi/ dom mkhris skar bzhi/ lcog la ma skar drug rgya tshwa skar gang / yung ba zho gsum skar bzhi sbyar/ nur du ni chu rub kyi tshul du/ mu khyud 'dzin gyi lugs kyi gsal byed ni/ cu gang suklel tsan dan gnyis ba ru ra mig sman sangs rgyas rnams zho re/ kha che li shi bya rgod mkhris pa skar bzhi re/ dzā ti me tog 'ba' zhig skar do re/ ka ko la gla rtsi dom mkhris skar lnga/11sta

ru kha sha shā ba'i rwa rnams skar bdun re/ bse ru zho gang skar brgyad/rag rdo zho do skar do/ sbal rgyab zho brgyad skar do/ ti tsha 'dul ma zho do skar gang / gangs thigs bzang po zho gsum skar bzhi/ lcags sbrul mdung rtse zho bzhi re/ go snyod zho gang skar drug a ba seng ldeng lcags phye rnams zho do re/ a ru skyu ru'i sha gnyis zho gsum re/ dbang lag zho gang skar brgyad/ gi wang skar dgu/ mdung rtse dkar po sung do zho brgyad sbyar/ 'di'i bzang drug ni/ cu gang kha che li shi dzā ti'i me tog susmrel ka ko la/ sug ka gnyis thun pa dor pa'i 'bru dgos/ rgya ru dang bse ru dkar nag gnyis rtsi zog bsreg sbal rgyab pho mo dkar nag bzhi ka/ lcags sbrul a ru lcags phye gsum gong ltar/ mdung rtse dmar smug ser gsum/ rgod mkhris ni bya rgod kyi'o/ /mig sman sangs rgyas ni zhim thig le/ gsal byed dkar po chig thub ni mdung rtse dkar po/ thun ldab ni nyis 'gyur/ 'ba' zhig a gar ni a gar nag po'am go snyod a gar/ gsal byed sum cu khyad par can la/ ghi wang brag zhun ut+pal gangs thigs mtshal/ /zhes pa man chad zho phyed re sbyar gsungs kyang lag len la/ dzā ti skar ma gcig tshos kyi khaṇ+ḍa skar ma gnyis gtong ba dmigs bsal yin/ glang chen mkhris pa ma rnyed na g.yag rog gi mkhris pa gtong / me long g.ya' ni me long phyis par mar gsar zhag 'ga' glan pa'i g.yang/ spang mthing ni tshon byed /sdo 0spang ma dang mthing thun/ bab brdal ni yang yang zum pa/ bung

la ni bus la/ ba nu lnga bar sbyar tshad zhal las shesani/ bcu skar dgu/dom mkhris skar lnga mdung rtse zho gcig gur gum skar lnga zhim thig le rko—lnga sbyar/ nas zan ni nas zan gyisan/ de la gur gum khyi la gnyis po bsnan/ /zhes pa'i gur gum ni yig nor te gla rtsi yin/ rgya tshwa zhes pa dzo/ rgya tshu'i thal ba'am dud pa dgos pas de'i lag len ni/ rgya tshwa zhib par btags pa'i bye ma thur mgo re tsam lcags bsreg gam bong me'i steng du blug pa'i steng nas li phor gyis bkab/ de'i steng nas bye ma rlon pas nub bar byibs te du rlangs ma shor ba byas/ grang nas ting phor gyi nang gi dud pa phug ron gyi dung rus bsdus pa de/ ling thog rwa dang ling ro sogs la 'debs sman gyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /rgya tshwa rgodalo btab na mig brdol par 'gyur pas gzab dgos so/ /rwa — de gcod pa'i lag leg mthong ba dgos/ /zhes pa la/ mtshal dkar: te rgya dag pas da chu zer pa'i bzo tshon nyan pa'i rgyal mtshal zho gsum ti tsha dkar ser zho gcig rang byung gi rgya mtshal cog la ma 'dul ma zho gcig sbyar ba rnams sha ro dang sha mdzer ling thog ra 'bur sogs la skams 'debs byas pas rtsa ba nas thon zhong gcod mi dgos pa'i myong grub rma rgan gang gis ma phan pa'i sha ro yang gcod/ mig tu btig pas gis g.yogs rab rib sel/ /zhes pa la/ sman 'di rnams shin tu zhib par btags dar tshags nas gton la ting phor gyi nang du chu khyor gang la sman mdog dmar ser thon tsam gcig btab la snga dro swā/

gang 'byed de steng du bstan la mgo sngas la bzhag mig kha phye la bal yes mig gi steng du gtig go/ /de zin pa dang dar re nyal la bsdud/de'i bar du mig la gnod pa'i zas dang spyod lam bsrung zhag bcu'am zla ba byed du bya/ des mig gsal gyis 'ong ngo / /yang na a ru bzhag la ga bur dang ka ra btang ngon /rgyas mo chu 'byed kyi man ngag go/ /de la mig 'byed pa'i cha byad dgos pas de bzo tshul ni/ lcags bzang — pos a long mig 'bras tshud tsam byas pa la tshag yu lta bu'i yu ba skyog po mtho gang tsam dngad ngos gzhan la yang dbyibs sngar dang 'dra ba'i yu ba sngar las ring ba byas pa'i yu ba'i rtse mo gnyis ltag par bcings a — long gis mig mi 'gul bar gnon 'ong / de nas sog spubs tsam gyi — bu g.yod pa'i spubs thur rtse bug yungs dkar shong ba sman gyi phye mas gang ste/ dra ling dra ro ling thog sogs nad dmigs kyi steng du mi 'gul bar bzung la dbugs kyis bus te 'debs nas yun tsam — bsdud la chu yis bran no/ /mig sman 'debs pa'i man ngag go/ /ha shig ni thod le kor/ mig gdangs ni mig phye ba/ sngo la dul ni sngo la rdul te rdul 'tshub pa ltar snangan g.yugs ni g.yo ba/ gar sha ni zur mkhar pa'i sdom tshigalas/ mtheb mdzub bar gyi gar sha gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /thur gsham ni bur ma'i yu ba/ gangs ni grib / thur ma ni khyim bu/ mig dral btub ni mig sor chud/ chu yi diltos lo ni bran/ kha gung ni gangs kyi khrod du/ /

/ le'u nga gcig pa/ rna ba'i nad bcos pa/ med pa ni zug med/mug chos lnga pa la lag len ngag ni/ ug chos 'bru/ gla rtsi/ laphugaru rta/ sgog gcig ma'o/ /lag len gces btus su bshad ces pa la/rna ba'i mtha' la snum byugs sogs zhag gsum sngon nas byed/ sgyug spugs nas sor gang rna ba'i phug pa'i nang du btang / la phug khu ba cha gnyis 'bru mar cha gnyis rna nang du btang / nyal nas rnar blugs/lag len ngag ces pa la/ sug pa'i khu ba gseg ma med pa bal la tshags pa dang / de bzhin byas pa'i g.yer khu bsreg pas rna ba bkangaske la mdzub mos legs par bsrub pas bkrus khu ba dor rjes sman drod yod tsam blugs la bag zan gyis 'gag de ltar lan 'ga' btang rjes rngabs kyis drangs/ 'dren par byed pa'i 'dren lugs kyang de ga —yin / ug chos lnga par/ ug chos 'bru zho lnga gla rtsi la phug ru rta rnams zho gsum re/ sgog pa zho gsum mam bzhi sbyar/ mdongs thal lnga par/rma bya'i sgro gzhob ru rta zho lnga re/ sga skya gur gum zho bzhi re/ rgya tshwa zhisne gsum sbyar/ 'dur pa'i khu ba ni gar po/ a ga ka ra a gar sgo khu sgog skya'i khu ba zer ba 'dug 'ba' sam sman mar ni/ phyi rgyud las/'bras bu gsum dang rtsa ba lnga bsres pa/ /'ba' sam zhes bya stod smad kun la bsngags/ /zhes so/ // le'u nga gnyis pa/ sna nad bcos pa/ sna sub ni sna gag sna shu ni sna shu shu zer ba/ sha lu ni sha lhag bod tshwa ni bul tog ru rta /byerdo

blugs ni chur sbyar/ nang gsum ni nang ma gsum/ pad+me ni byang khra/lag len gdams pa chig brgyud ngag tu nyan/ /zhes pa la/ sna sbyongarkochig rgyud ma 'di'i sngon 'gror mgo bo bul tog bug pa gang rung gi chus bkrus la snum byugs/ snyag ma mtho gang sna'i nang du sor gcig tsam btang la yung ba brgyad pa mer btab pa'i du bas sna nas bdug de nas bod tshwa brgyad pa rta chu gtsang mar sbyar tshad cha mnyam sbyar ba sna'i — nang blug dngos gzhi la slar yang mgo bor snum byugs nas pad+me thun —ldab sman gzhan cha mnyam pa'i pad+me lnga pa zhu mkhan bar sbyar/ drodakod tsam thigs pa lnga bdun snar blugs la zan za yun tsam bsdud/ blugs dus ltag pa sa la phab ste gan rkyal gyis nyal/ dbugs rgyu ba sna nas spangs la kha nas bya/ tsha zhing g.yo ba byung na ldang / dang por ngar snabs mang po 'ong de rjes chu ser mang tsam 'ong / de rjes nad gang yin 'don 'ong / gal te khrag shor na/ dom mkhris dang spru rtswa'am/de la zab thal sbyar pa'i reng bu snar bcug mgo stod chus bran la: dpral bar rdo grang gis dugs/ de la kha sgyur gong gi steng du cham rgan la bong dkar dang gla sgang bsnan pa sogs kha bsgyur lugs gces btus su bshad/ glo ba 'grams pa la/ 'phyi ba'i mkhris pa cung zad bsnan/ rjes la rta sbangs khu bar ka ra dang zhunasar sbyar blugs/ gla sgang spos dkar mar gsar sbyar ba'i dud pas bdug dur byid gtso sdidī 4smos pa chur sbyar ba'i gtong lugs gong ltar bya/ sna sbyong 'di smug

po khrag mtsho rdol rgyu dang sna khrag 'byams langayod rigs la spangs yin / mtha' bzhi'i bsdus khu ni/ 'bri ta sa 'dzin kyi rtse dkar po ba sha ka 'bri smug bzhi'o/ /ram pa ni dur ba'i rtsa ba/ dong ral ni 'bri:smug dang mkhan par bshad pa'angayod/ tshal lu kha sdoms la/ mtshal dkar srad dag zho bdun re/ dom mkhris 'bri ta sa 'dzin spang re/a ru zho gsum gur gum zho gnyis sbyar/ 'di la bsil gsum tsan dan dkar po bcas kyi khaṇ+ḍa dang mkhris sna kha tshar btab pa man ngag yin/'di'i na kha'i spra ba chung ni srad nag yin/ tshos ni btsod/ 'bri ni 'bri smug mkhan skya spru ma gang rung reng bu'i rtser/ /zhes pa la/mkhan skya rtsa lo bcas pa 'am/ spru ma'i rtsa ba zhib btags kyi reng bu: byas pa'ispog shing lta bur skud pa ma chad pa gcig bcug pa'i reng bu — de kho'i snar shong tsam byas pa'i rtse mor gur gum sogs sman gyi phye ma lde gu byugs la phugs su spebs tshan kyi bar du brdzangs la bzhag khrag — 'bab pa chad nas snabs byung tshe reng bu ldog tu 'ong bas de dus skud pa nas 'then na sman ro ma lus par thon no/ /'ol kha sgyur ni lamadze gzhan du sgyur/ rta sbangs ni rta seb drug phrom gyi sbangs/ zin la ni bsres la/ mthe bong zhes pa la lugs gcig la ras thum la byed/ /( le'u nga gsum pa/ kha nad bcos pa/ mchu yi nad drug ni/man ngag rgyud las/ mchu nad gre mchu sho re bad kun dngan /gcen dang khrag rgyas kha shu drug tu bshad/ /ces dang / so nad lnga ni/ ༵ ༵

nad bad rlung khrag mkhris so 'bras srin/ /zhes dang / lce nad lnga ni/rtse nad rlung mkhris bad kun rtse lhag skrangs/ /zhes dngaka rkan nad drug ni/ rkan nad rtse chung babs dang lce 'dra dngan /rkan 'brum chu bur rus sbal rkan chen no/ /zhes dang / gre ba'i nad bdun ni/ grel ba'i nad la rlung dang mkhris pa khrag /bad kun 'dus pa 'bras dang — chen bu'o/ /zhes so/ /skya tshos ni skya bor tshos pa lta bu/ g.yas g.yon mtha' dras zhes pa la/ sho re la g.yas g.yon gyi mtha' nas srab mor dras la dom mkhris sogs mkhris sna byugs nas dar skud kyis sbal 'gros su btsem/ de'i steng hel ge srab mo snum med spyin chu gar mas ske sbyar te legs par bsdams/ de'i khar slar yang lhal ge spyin chu sbyarasne yang legs/ rma kha ma 'grigs bar du dgod byas pa dang zas sra ba ldad pa sogs byas na rma skyon 'byung bas gzab/ rma 'grigs pa na gong gi skud pa bcad cing bton/ rma sman gdab la dmar dkar dang 'bri mog byugs nas kha zas bcud can btang ngon /chu dwa ni chu rtsa dwa ba/rgya tsha dur byid gla rtsi gsum po de'i byed/ mjug sgro ni mjug rtse/ sdig pa ni rig pa nag po/ a ru btso bsregs ces pa la/ a ru btso ba'i lag len ni/ a ru ra skem po bul mang rang dang lcid mnyam pa'i dur byid kyi chur bsdus nas sig ma dor ba'i khu ba'i nang du gtong yul khyad kyi a ru ra zhag gsum sbangs nas rus pa dor ba'i khu ba ma tshig par — zhi~X 6thim byas nas skem mo/ /a ru bsreg pa ni/ a ru ra de rang gi

gsum 'gyur bag zan gyi dang du btums/ de'i rgyab nas na gyi nyisa'agyur ba lci gar pos btums nas me mur na (nang )du dal busayan ring bsreg pas/ ba lci thal bar song / zan de sol bar songan ma ru ra'i phyi rtsi ser thog song nas nang cha ma 'tshig pa tshos tshad yin pas phyi —thum dang nang gi rus pa 'dor ro/ /so bya ni nya khra'i rigs mgo rkangarkoring ba mdog nag pa kha la so yod pa/ byed bcad bsreg ces pa la/lcags kyu rtse mo khab rtse tsam bkug pa mtho gang tsam khab sbom po'i tshad la shing gi yu bkod pas rtse chung gi nang ngos nas phug ste thur la 'then byed mtshams nas cha byad zor ba lta bu'i chan pas breg cha byad ma 'byor tshe btsags bu la yu ba bcug la bcad do/ khrag babs tshad 'don rjes gser gyi tel ba skug ma sbugs can gyi dang du 'jug pas bsreg go/ /ldum stag ni ko byi la/ /( le'u nga bzhi pa/ so nad bcos pa/ ber ba langs ni ber re na zhing mtho bar langs pa/ shing kun bcu gsum par shing kun gur gum a ru ma ru rtse 'bras zho lnga re/ byi tang zho bdun thang phrom srang gang /gla rtsi ru rta zho bzhi re/ phur thal zho brgyad/ dres 'bru 'dzin pa sman: chen rnams zho drug re/ sha tshil srang do sbyar/ dha ra ni thang phrom/ sna sor bdug ni/ sla nga chus bkang ba'i dbus su rdo'i sgyid bu mgo gsum btsugs pa'i steng du rdo leb bzhag pa'i steng rdza ma mer bsreg pa dmar lam me ba bzhag de'i steng sman bye gdab pa'i du ba cha byad spubs sdushā

gyis so na sar bdug pasasrin bu dngos su chu nang du brul yong ngo / /rjes gcod cong zhi bcu par/ cong zhi gu gul khyi la wa ri zho gnyis re/shing kun gla rtsi sha chen mig 'bras spen ma dwa ba rnams zho gcig re/ go yu zho bzhi sbyar/ sbyor sde ngag ni/ a ru'i sha dom mkhris sman chen bsnan/ khyi la wa ri ni stod ja/ rnam par ni yu gu shing / // le'u nga lnga pa/ lnga ba bcos pa/ khog stong ni khong stong / phur tshe ni phur sub byas tshe/ dbugs bsub ni/ sba ba rang gi dang du rlung rgyu ba / ngar pa ni ngar ngar zhes pa'i sgra 'byung ba/ spang rgyan bco lnga par/spang rgyan spang do/ a ru sba tshwa skya ga'i sha srang gsum re/ tig ta hong — len ma nu nya sha go bo spyang kyi so bya'i gre ba rnams spang re/ tsan dan dkar po srang gang zho lnga/ tshar bong skyu ru zho drug ba sha ka srang gang zho bdun skar lnga sbyar/ sba tshwa ni tsha mo rong nas yong ba'i tshwa 'am zhing la chags pa'i ba tshwas tsharbe rung / chu tshan dbul bas sba ba 'joms pa zhes thos/ yang na tsi na'i gsang ba sman gcig bsten/ /zhes pa'i — tshig rkang phyi ma 'di par rnying la chad song / gsang ba sman gcig kyang /mdo smad nas 'ong ba'i lo ma se lo ljang pa 'dra ba lan tshwa'i ro bro ba yod pa ma rnyed na/ skya ga'i shas tshab rung / bzlas shing btab pas — 'joms pa rgyud nas gsungs/ /zhes pa la/ man ngag rgyud las/thog mar dgu pa lnga brgyad de rjes sgrol/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don be+e rdo/ ཿdu/ phyi nas gdab dgos pa/ chan ga sogs dang / khong du

btang ba/ chami sogs dngan kha sogs dgu pa gang rig dang kauchadamar mo 'dzin du zhes lnga pa/ 'dzin du man chad brgyad pa rnams rim bzhin thog mar dgu pa dang de rjes la lnga pa brgyad pa/ de rjebasnyethel la bzlas shing phyi nas gdab pa dang chu la btab nas khong duskyibatang zhes bshad/ nang du log stesbyi sol la zhes pa'i lag len slar: rdzongs/ g.yang lnga ni g.yang chen po 'khor ba'i sba ba/ de la g.yang ni nor gyi snying po 'dus pa'idon/ byur wa ni byur chen po 'ong ba'i lnga ba/'di la yid ches pa'i lo rgyus zhig yod la man ngag rgyud kyi brda bkrol du gsal/ tsha bur rgyab ces pa la/ 'phar rtsa gting narlud la khrag rtsa kha nas yod pas 'phar rtsa chad 'dogs chung zhing khrag rtsa med pa'i lnga ba gang che ba'i dkyil du sbang ma gar po zhigaglan la bzhag de rjes lcags kyi mde'u bsregs la gting gi gnad la mi 'gro bar phreng du phug pas chu ser 'byung na de gas sel/ ma byung na rul gcod gzhug la 'bras ltar gso/ 'di bya sla ba yin pas thur ma rgyag mi nus zhes snying chung mi bya — bar lag len mdzad pas chog langs na ni skur dri mnam na/ tsha ba ni —byug pa/ hol ge ni pags pa srab mo 'dul ma/ bu la ha ri ni rgya ser — gyi skad de lham byed pa'i ko ba gru bzhi ris can/( le'u nga drug pa/ snying nad bcos pa/ mu cor sani bla 'chol ma thu na ni stobs che bar gyur na/ a gar bcu par/ a gar shing kun sha chen zho lnga re/ dzā ti go snyod zho bzhi re/ gsang sman ta179 —

kun zho drug re/ ru rta li shi zho do sbyar/ 'di'i gsang ba'i sman ni/snying zho sha/ zhib pa ngag la nyan/ zhes pa la/ gces btus su/dkar pojig thub mthe bong tsam zhag gcig chang la sbangs pa'i khu bar sbyar / byang khra dgu/ rgya tshwa de dang mnyam/ rgyam tshwa lug ril tsam/zed (thod )le kor smug po/ rgya mtshal/ tsha la 'dul ma/ dzā ti/shing kun rnamasasran ma tsam re/ byi tang ka rdog po bdun/ de rnams zhib btags dar gyis btum la sbangs ba'i khu ba de nad stobs dang sbyar la btung bar bshad/ lcag tu sings po'i thang gis 'phul la dag par sbyangs gsungs so/ // le'u nga bdun pa/ glo nad bcos pa/ thang po ni glo sud ces: kyang bya ste ngo bo glo rlung glo rgyas ni glo bar khrag rgyas pa/ thes po ni glo bar bad kun bzhugs pa/ glo gcong ni glo bar lud pa 'dril pa/bung tshang ni glo rnag 'di la bungs zhes yang 'jug sa 'byung ba lhagarngam rgod ni dbugs thung / sngo ljob ni lud pa sngon po be snabs can/byi la'i mgul 'dra ni ngare ngar zer/ dmar po gsum ni btsod tshos 'bri smug gam zhu mkhan/ a grong ni yongs grags ltar/ a krong nag tshang ni gnam mtsho phyug mo'i sa cha dag tshang zhes pa nas byung ba la dag —tshang a krong zhes bya zhing / don la a krong rigs bzhi'i nang gi mkhan pa a krong yin/ bzhur pa'i ni bcir pa'i/ mi pher ni mi pheb/ glo /rdo ni glo lu bas dbugs 'tshangs nas brgyal 'gro ba/ tsha khag ni phyi

nang gnyis kur tsha rum me/ bdun thang ni bshad ma thagapa'i 4lo bdun thang / gnyis 'gros byed ni bdud lo dang mtshalaganyisamanyam bsres/ rgyangs ni rgyangs pa ltar byed pa/ tsha subs ni tsha ba'i rlangs:'khyims pa/ ga dor ni kha sha'i rwa/ ge sar ni gnyis pad+ma nā ga li shi drug pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ li shi cu gang shing mngar spang rgyan dkar/ /ru rta a ru ra dang ka ra sbyar/ /li shi drug pa lo brgyad dri chus dbul/ /glo nad spe ba tsha skam skad 'gag sel/ /zhes so/ /star bu pañtsas lud pa gyen du drang / /zhes pa la/ sha pho ru rta shing mngar skyu ru ra/ /pi pi ling rnams thun ni che ba re/ /star bu thun tshad bcu dang kur gsum ma/ / zhib par btags nas rnag 'drongs chung na ni/ /star bu thun— bskyed pa yag rtsa ba'i gye/ /sman gyi zla la bsres nas gtong ba gnad/ /grang ba che na pi ling thun gsum bsnan/ /gtong dus dpyid lud 'don pa'i dus de nas/ /zhing ma thebs pa'i bar la gong giske sman / / tshad ldan thengs gsum bar btang glo rnag la/ /shin tu phan zhing lo re bzhin bsten dgos/ /rnag 'drong rjes su khrag 'byung tshosam 'bri mog /dom mkhris gur gum sran ma'i me tog rnams/ /thang btang rtsa kha sdoms shing khrag gcod cing / /ba zho spris med bre byed legs dkrugs 'debs/ /snga dro bdun gyi bar du sto stong bsten/ /zhes bya'o/ /glo bud ni glo mngan / / le'u nga brgyad pa/ glo rnag bcos pa/ btsan dmar ni dpa/1 ske

thang / mgo mjug ni thog mtha'/ bse ru nyer lnga par/ bse ru kha che li shi gi wang skar gsum re/ cu gang skar dgu/ dzā ti sug smel ka ko la zi ra dkar ge sar gnyis rnams skar lnga re/ ru rta tsan dan dmar — ut+pal skar drug re/ tsan dan dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra dza skyu ru skar brgyad re/ rgya ru ba ru zho gang skar re/ ba sha ka skar do/ ga dur zho gang / a ru zho gang skar do star bu zho gang skar gsum/ kha sha ga doraskyibase ru dang mnyam pa/ gsang sman bsreg thal zho gsum sbyar/ gsang sman ni/ 'bri smug ba'i 'o mar bcos la du ba ma shor bar bsregs pa'i thal ba'o/ /cig shos ni/ spang tshan spu ru/ zangs thal zhe gsum par / zangs thal zho lnga/ bcod tshos 'bri smug pa yag rtsa ba sa 'dzin —zhu mkhan sungado zho re/ star bu bse ru dung mgron spang rtsi zho gsum re/ga dur zho gang skar lnga/ bya rog nyung ma'i rtsa ba shu mo za 'dam bu zho gang skar re/ a krong sro lo zho lnga re/ shing mngar zho gang sbyar la/ de dang ga bur nyer lnga bong tshad mnyam par sbyar/ glo dum ni glo ba dum bur chad —pa / tshangs ni rnag 'khyimasapa/ mchan gyi dngos kyi rgyas bshad gces btus su bshad/ ces pa la/ gtsug gi nor bur grags pa de/ /skye gnas ljongs dang 'brel ba ste/ /me tog smug la lo ma leb 'bras — bu nyung la kha smug 'dra/ /de rnams dus su btus pa yis/ /rtsa ba glo rnag 'joms zhing 'dren/ /lo mas lpags nad sel bar byed/ /me rdo/ 2sngon po mchin nad sel/ /'bras bu mo nad mtha' dag sel/ /

zhes gsungs so/ /pa yag bcu par/ spa yag rtsa ba༄gang da ru rta srang re/ shing tsha pi pi ling srang do re/ a ru skyu ru bod so tsobargyad re/ la cha zho gang / ri sho'i myu gu zho gang sbyar/ zangasnar༄khani zang dkar bsres/ ca ne ni phor chung gzhan yang so bya zhes pa la/ somachu zhes bcos par snang yang gnyis ke'i yig don dpyad dgos/ drod pa ni lug gi grod pa dbugs kyis rgyangs pa/ rna mchog ni yig nor te rnag chog zur nu bcu drug par/ khaṇ+ḍa'i tshad gzhung ltar la/ zangs thal tsha la zho re/ shing mngar rgun 'brum rgya tshwa shing tsha re/ byang pa dmar khra sbub dgu star bu'i khu bar 'dam btags byas pa sbyar/zangs thal nyer gcig par/ mu zi tsha la grang gang re/ zangs thal dngul chu 'dul ma zho do re/ ma nu zho brgyad chang dang sbyar ba nus ldan bsreg pa'i steng du phur yog sogs kha tshar gyi sman rnams zho gang rol sbyar / phur yog zab 'gron ni/ phur mo yog mo gos chen skud ris ma —'gron bu mtho/ /rgyangs ni gri thag byas pa/ dmar gsum gyi mar ni/phyi rgyud las/ 'bri mog tshos btsod a ru ra'i mar/ /ka ra sbyar bas glo tshad rnag khrag skem/ /zhes so/ // le'u nga dgu pa/ mchin nad bcosapa/ ldem bu ni tsha ba subs pa / dug thabs ni tsha ba rmugs pa/ 'or lhung ni 'og sar lhung ba/khad kyis ni rim gyis/ 'dur ni rul/ khol ni tsam tsag na/ 'phyong ni mchin dri las lhung snyam byed/ nad la zhes pa yig nor te rdo 31/

mchin sman rnams nyis 'gyur ni/ ut+pal gi wang gur gum gangs thigs rnams so/ /a ru bcu pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ a ru ra dang gur gum sug smel dang / /brag zhun tig ta mkhal ma zho sha dang / /seng: phrom btsod dang rgya skyegs thug tsher can/ /ka ra sbyar ba'i ma ru bcu pa gle/ / mkhalas bsnad 'grams chu mi da pa 'khor/ /bshal 'phyes: mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed/ /ces so/ /gur gum bcu drug par/ba le ka gangs thigs zho drug re/ ma nu pa tra se rgod zho lnga re/ hong len skyu ru zho gsum re/ mtshal dkar sum cu tig ta zho gsum re/ kha che brag zhun zho brgyad re/ cu gang gi wang ut+pal sngon po zho drug re/skyer shun ba sha ka zho lnga re/ bri yang ku zho bdun sbyar/ de la tsha ba 'bring la tsan dan bsnan pas gur gum bcu bdun dang / tsha ba rab — la ga bur bsnan pas gur gum bco brgyad zer/ 'di la gzhung gdos bstan la gur gum bco lnga dang / lcang lung pas tig ta bsnan nas gur gum bcu drug par mdzad pa ltar 'dir yang bcu drug par byas ṅge/ / ri ṣi'i chu ni/ skar ma ri ṣi shar ba'i zhag bdun du chu thams cad yan lag brgyad ldan du gyur par bshad pa ltar yin/ // le'u drug cu pa/ mcher nad bcos pa/ mcher nad lnga ni/man ngag rgyud las/ dbye ba mcher nad tsha ba khrag sbos dngan /mcher rlung mcher pa'i bad kun rlugs pa lnga/ /zhes so/ /zhe 'khun byed ni — sdi/ 4jus mi bzod par khong nas 'khun sgra 'byin pa/ ri tshos ni 'bri

smug/ mcher glo lu ni glo ba nas mi lu bar mcher pa nas lu ba/ ma rurta bdun ni/ phyi rgyud las/ a ru ra dang li shi gser me tog /spang spos nā ga ge sar pi pi ling / /ka ko ka ra sbyar ba'i a ru bdun/ /mcherasnyepa bsnad 'grams tsha rgyas sbos gzer 'joms/ /zhes so/ /rtol niṣ+kamadzo mo dang ba lang 'dus pa las 'byung ba skom po'am rtol zhes bya/ /ga le'u re gcig pa/ mkhal nad bcos pa/ gur gum bdun ni/phyi rgyud las/ gur gum cu gang gi wang gtso bo la/ /sug smel brag zhun thug pa tsher ma can/ /a ru ra bsdebs mkhal ma'i tshad pa sel/ /zhes so/ /gyong po rlon sbangs ni/ 'bras gsum spe tres tig ta bcas —kyi thang yun bsring nas btang / gi wang bcu gnyis pa'i 'bras bu gsum ni smad 'bras gsum ste a 'jam sra/ bdud rtsi lnga ni/ shug pa mkhan pa ba lu mtshe 'om bu/ zags khus ni rtsa lto zags bshal/ dur byid kyi grang 'dul khaṇ+ḍa ni/ rkang thun dug phral ba chur bsdus nas khaṇ+ḍa byas pa yin zer ba 'dug sug smel bcu pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ sug — smel sga dang rgyam tshwa pi pi ling / /gla rtsi sdig srin lcam pa 'bras snacu gsum/ /bur dkar sbyar ba'i sug smel bcu pa ste/ /mkhal ma'i grang ba de'u nad chu 'gag sel/ /zhes so/ /sbyar bdun pa ni yig nor te sbyar brgyad pa/ gze ma'i chang ni/ phyi rgyud las/ gze chang gze ma nas bsres glum dang du/ /gze ma chur bsdus khu bas bsings pa ni/ /rus tshigs mkhal ma'i rlung dang chu ser 'joms/ /khyad par zhi~X

tshabs mkhal mar babs pa 'don/ /zhes so/ /zan chang ni/ de nyid las / zan chang sbyor ba ra mnye lca ba dang / /gze ma lcam pa yos bsres byer btags la/ /zan dron phabs bran langs nas chang du bsings/ /rnyings nas mnyes la bu ram sga dang mar/ /btab btsos stor bsten grang rlung ma lus 'joms/ /khyad par mkhal rked gzeram dang rkang lag bshal/ /tshigs gzhi skrangs dang da gon rna ba 'on/ /grang bas chu 'gags smad kyi drod shor sel/ /rked pa man chad grang — rnag 'byams pa gcod/ /ces so/ // le'u re gnyis pa/ sa bon 'dzag pa bcos pa/ sā ra'i khyung lnga 'dzag sdom la/ a ru sman chen spang gang zho lnga skar do re/ shu dag zho gsum ru rta zho lnga gla rtsi skar dgu/ ha lo zho do skar do/ nya phyis zho do — skar gang gu gul zho gang skar drug zhu mkhan zho do skar bzhi/ tshos skozho bzhi skar bzhi/ bcod rgya snag zho gang skar lnga/ kha che zho gang skar do/dom mkhris zho gang skar drug mtshal bzang zho bzhi skar drug sug smel zho do skar lnga/ mkhal zho zho gsum skar lnga sbyar/ 'di'i nya phyis dngos ni bud med rnams kyi dkar rgyan tha na zer ba de yin la/ mdog ldan ni ha lo'i me tog ces pho lcam pa'i me tog skyer shun lnga par/ skyer thun srang do/ pi pi ling shing mngaragla rtsi zho brgyad re/ skyu ru zho lnga/ kha tshar gyi kha che zho lnga/ dom mkhris rgya snag srang gang zho lnga re sbyar/ a ru — /rdo 6brgyad par/ ka ka ru ni rig srin/ tsher ma can ni/ byi tsher

rims dug mkhal ma'i tsha ba sel/ /zhes pa ltar byi tsherayin mod kyang gces btus su lcam 'bru la ngos 'dzin gnang 'dug ma gi ta nigla ji/rkyang na ni che na/ dbang lag bcu par/ dbang lag dom mkhris biṣ+ka ṣa'i rtsa zho lnga re/ lug ril gri klad gla rtsi zho gsum re/ kha che gu gul sug smel mkhal zho rnams zho bzhi re sbyar/ rgyud kyi 'dzag gcod bcu bzhi ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ cong zhi tsha ba gsum dang 'bras sna gsum/ /zho sha gsum dang dzā ti sdig srin dang / /sug smel bre ga bu ram sbyar la btang / /khyad par gcin snyi sa bon 'dzag pa gcod/ /ces so/ /dbang phyug thal skya ni lha dbang phyug chen po sku mdog thal skya/'gying ba ni sku 'gying ba'i nyams/ ku ba ni phyag tshang ku ba/ rdo rje'i sbrugs ni pho mtshan gyi sbugs pa ha ri/ thams cad khengs pa ni yul — phyogs thams cad de'i nang du chud pa/ sna rer ni skud pa tshos sna re re dze+e/ 'khor lo'i lte ba dkar po/ rtsibs sngon po/ rtsibs mchan dmar po / mu khyud ser po de'i mtha' sngon por byed do/ /sre mo ni/ byi ba'i rigs gzhan gyi ske bcad nas bsad pa yul skad du so long ko zer ba de yin/ pad chog ni grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i mngal khrag ze tsha lnga par/ ze tsha nā ga ge sar sug smel ba bla rnams zho do re/ shel dkar srang do sbyar/ shel dkar ni ka ra dkar po/ lug 'og ni yig nor te lug 'os/ skabs 'di'i gun 'dur sogs dang dgas li zhes pa sogs dang / /rmig rlugs skabs kyi tsi ta zhes pa sogs dang / ro stuX

skabs kyi sa de pi dang zhes pa sogs dang mogs tsa ra zhes pa sogs dang lpags phud ces pa sogs sman ming 'di rnams shes thabs med de/rgyu mtshan kun mkhyen lnga pa'i dus su bod phebs kusmira'i paṇ+ḍi tas gsar bsgyur bstan bcos nas bshad pa'i sman rgya bod du ma grags pas lnga pa chen po'i dus su rgya bal la em chi ched mngags kyis len pa rnam thar du ku lar gsal/ gsar bsgyur bstan bcos de bstan 'gyur na yod/ dar mo ba'i man ngag bka' rgya mar gsar 'gyur las zhes lung 'dren gyi yod pa 'di yin zhing / lhan thabs 'dir bshad pa'i sman gyi gab ming 'di dag der yang med pas so/ /'on kyang med pa las yod pa drag zer ba'i dpe ltar gang nas 'byung cha med pa'i yig rnying hrul po 'ga' zhig las byung ba shog gron tsam du bkod na/ gun 'dur ni mkhal zho/ ho ra pa ni go yu'am 'bras/ nas bhab rtsis niṣ+ka dngul chu/ dgas li ni bug smel/ se pags ni gser bye/ gas pha la ni dzā ti/ tijiṭa ni purmye ge ser ram shing tsha'i me tog su si li khaṇ+ḍa ni brag zhun/ ka tsu ra ni dar tshur/ kun dang mnyam ni so so nas cha mnyam re/ rlig rlugs skabs kyi/ rtsabs ni lham rtsa/ tsi ta ni byi bzung / ga bur rtse la ni g.yang kyi ma go snyod zer ba'ang 'dug bha ri a ra ni bag khrag spags sbrigs ni mgrin bzang mtshal/ ha ru rtse ra ni lang thang tse/ de ba da ru ni lha shing ste shug pa/ rtsam dpal ni sman chen/di spya gan ni ba spru/ dri bzang dri ngan dbye ba'i phye ma ni sga pho pi gsum/

e raṇ+ḍa'i 'bras bu ni dan rog bye kur ni shel kur/ ro tsa'i skabs/a ka la ka ra ni spos dkar/ tsi ta ni byi bzung / ga ped pha la ni dzā ti pha la/ sa de pi ni tsan dan dmar po/ gor+ṣa mu ṭi ni bong dkar/ gyi dha ra dzā ni mu zi ser po/ mu sa li ni dwa ba'i rtsa ba 'am mu zi ser po yang zer / gas pha la ni dzā ti/ mogs tsa ra ni 'bri smug dha ri gan+da ni ma nu pa tra/ si ta lpa ri ni seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa/ ke la kun ni ra mnye/ a rdzu mu ti ni gla rtsi/ ma si ni ra sa ga bur/ dzā ti sbags na ni dzā ti'i me togabhi ma ra si ni mar nag kar kur shing gini shing tsha'i lo ma/ ce ta spun nan ni byi bzung / in+d+ra 'job ni dug nyung / mis bhasde ni ra thugasnye'abras/ sro ma seng ge ni bod kyi me tog gangs la dkar po'i thur gyi 'o ma'i lde gu/ tshes bharnye 'bru ni lug thug gi 'bras/ lpags phud ni la la phud / sa mu tra sa ni pho cong zhi/ a phi ma ni bong nag srid ni rigs /da le/ 'u / re gsum pa/ pho ba'i nad bcos pa/ me drod rnam gsum ni mnyam gnas 'ju byed myag byed gsum/ rtsa ma mdog ni zas mdogalag len zab mo ngag dang mthong rgyud ltos zhes pa la/ ra lug ni rwa sogs sde tshan dang po nus ldan bsreg pa'i steng du/ rgyas par byed naske kha tshar phye ma btab la slar yang nus ldan bsreg grub thob ril dkar la / gtso bo 'du ba spyi snyoms ni a ru ra/ srid pa'i bcud bsdus ni: cong zhi/ kun 'byed rgyal sdo ni byang lugs hong len/ zur lugs 11)

spang rtsi/ rin chen snying po kun 'dus ni brag zhun/ me tog sna tshogs bcud bsdus ni ma nu pa tra/ ting 'dzin bsgom bzlas gnyen po'i kha bsgyur sogs/ /zhes pa la/ bskyed rim gyi lha bskyed pa sngags bzlas nas sman sgrub cing bsten pa kha bsgyur sbyor tshul sogs logs su /sa~X/'u/ re bzhi pa/ rgyu ma'i nad gso ba/ spu 'khril dgye dgu zhes pa dang spu 'khril sman pa zhes pa'i spu ni yig nor te gnyis ku'ang rgyu 'khril yin/ rgyu tshad sel bas gur gum bdun pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/gur gum cu gang gi wang gtso bo la/ /in+d+ra bzhi bsdebs rgyu long snod tshad sel/ /zhes so/ /dbyu gus bsnun ni thog la btags pa'i thag pa de la cung zad tsam brdeg sto tshil ma zhu ni lto tshil 'khyag pa/ tshwa na ni yig nor te tshwa sna/ tshogs chang ni tshogs tshad/ /ga le'u re lnga pa/ rgyu rgan bcos pa/ se 'bru dgu pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ se 'bru tsha ba gsum po gzhir bzhag ste/ /shing tsha bzang po gsum dang la la phud/ /bsdebs pa'i se 'bru dgu pas me drod bskyed/ /'khru ba gsar rnying ma lus gcod par byed/ /ces so/ /da trig bdun pa ni/ de nyid las/ /da trig smag dang tha rams lo tsan spod / / gtsod khrag lug mur da trig bdun pa ni/ /tsha grang rtas 6sgyur 'khru ba gcod pa'i mchog /ces so/ /drag po sman nag ni/ sbyor tshul sdidī 0yang man ngag rin chen 'byung gnas kyi dang du bkod pa/ cong zhi

bzang po khyor gang lan tshwa ni/de mnyam sla nga'i nang gnu ldan bsreg/de steng dbyi mong dkar po ba lu yi/ /'dab ma gnyisapo khyor ba gang re bsnan/ /slar yang du ba ma shor nus ldan bsreg /kha tsharadzisman ni dzā ti 'u su dang / /bca' sga pho ba ris dang pi pi ling mabong nga dkar po dpa' bo dkar po rnams/ /thun re rgya tshwa kha ru tshwa gnyis po / / sran ma tsam re ze tshwa thur mgo gang / /ma nu lug ril 'bring po'i tshad rnams ni/ /zhib par btags pas nam mkha'i mdog 'drar: 'gyur/ /de nyid dgongs dang tho rangs chu skol 'phul/ /phan yon rgyu nad rtag tu 'khru ba dang / /sgreg mang pho ba stong sdeb zas mi 'ju/ /pho log pho bar spu 'gyings lcags dreg chags/ /pho ba dug thabs pho nad mchin pa gle /mchin chu rgyu gzer grol ma glang thabs rigs/ /srin bu gong bur 'dril ba la sogs pa/ /mdor na snod nad kun la bdud rtsir mtshungs/ /zhes so/ /glud ces pa la/ de yang bod kyi rang bzo min te ngang pa'i rgyal bo'i glud du ngang pa'i blon po 'gro bar mdo las gsungs pas so/ /sa sbyor gsum par mgar thab kyi sa skar bzhi/ byi khung gi sa dang thab khung gi sa gnyis skar ma re re/ kha tshar gyi bul tog skar ma gnyis/ gar nag gsum sbyor la/ gar nag phul gang / a ru shā /nyis/ ma nu zho gang / kha tshar gyi gla ji zhad tsam/ byi phur leb ni ༈ rnazlo/'u /re drug pa/ long nad bcos pa/ tsha rnyings ni yig no/ ༵

tsha rnyongs yin/ phyi ma rgyud bzhin bshal ni/ phyi rgyud las bshad pa'i ded dpon bzhi pa dang bcu pa gang rung gi steng du snya lo bcod kha ru tshwa /susdu ༵ sna/ /bdu/ na pa/ pho mtshan gyi nad bcos pa/ gra ma ni tsher ma lta bu'i zug byed kyi rigs/ ngo bor ni khyung lngar/ brling bya ni bshol bya / seng phrom ni zhu mkhan/ // le'u re brgyad pa/ mo mtshan gyi nad bcos pa/ rlugs ni rgyun par 'dzag pa/ spyin bag ni spyin chu ltar nal nal po/ mdog ldan ni lcam 'bru/ thang shing ni sgron shing / ye lus ni shing phran nam bal gyis dkris te phyir bton tshe dkris ma nang du ma lus pa'i thabs byas pa/rtsa sbugs 'jam pos mngal nad sbyangs ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ rtsa sbugs 'jam pos mngal nad kun sbyangs te/ /go snyod shu dag rgyam tshwa pi pi ling / /zi ra nas tshig thal ba ba sha ka /la la phud dang tsi tra ka rnams ni/ /chang dang mar bcos mngal nad gzhang 'brum sel/ /zhes pa'i bkru 'jam mo/ /ru rta'i sman mar ni/ de nyid las/ kun la ru rta rgya spos 'bras bu gsum/ /shu dag shing kun ra mnye hong len btsod/ /shing mngar nye shing yung skyer la la phud/ /sman mar mangs /spya ṅgi zlo/ na/ /kā sel/ /gdon 'joms mngal chags dus zos bu 1143'u re dgu pa/ skad 'gags nad bcos pa/ dbye ba bdun

ni / man ngag rgyud las/ dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad kun—dang / / zad byed tshil gyur das chad bdun du bshad/ /ces so/ /so/ ma /kar mo ni nas kyi sog ma/ myos khu ni chang / yib ni lo lon / shāzi/ ba/dun chu pa/ yi ga 'chus pa bcos pa/ ro bska ni kha la /ska ༵ 'u /do/na gcig pa/ skom nad bcos pa/ mchan gyi mi dgos dbang ni yig nor te mi dgos par/ rtse myul ni rtses rkan dang mchu nyul ba/ zang chus zhes pa yig nor te sbrang rtsi yin/ /1 le'u don gnyis pa/ skyigs bu bcos pa/ rings stabs ni rtab rtab por zos pa/ bstud 'byung gsang ni bstud nas 'byung bas mig ces pa'i sgra gsang bar 'byung / chu grang hub gsum lag len ngag ni / chu dang dri chu bsres la hub gsum btang rjes rgyu zhabs su shes pa gtad la steng rlung drag tu mnan/ shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa ngag las nyan ni/ rkang rgyus kyi rtse sbangs la rgyus sne sna bug gnyis su 'gro tshad bcug na sbrid pa 'chor yong nges skyigs bu chad/ skyugs khrus 'jam pos sbyang zhes pa'i skyugs ni/ gtso bor ri sho spyang tsher dur byid gsum/ /bye ma la skyes 'bus sos dus bskos/ /shu dag rgyam tshwa pi pi ling dang sbyar/ /'jam po khu ba drag po ril bu dril/ /zhes pa'i 'jam po'o/ /khrus ni/ phyi rgyud las/ tshom rtsa a ru mchu snyang cha ma~X

ste / / nyi dga' shing mngar rgyam tshwa pi pi lingaka /bskol thang ma zhum gsar dang rims nad dang / /khyad par pho mchin nad rnams sbyong ba'i mchog /ces so/ /rlung 'khyims sel ni/ sngon la gcig ring: zhing drag par bgrangs rjes kha sna'i dbugs gang thub par nang du bsnams te rtsa sbrugs su drangs pas rlung 'khyims pa sel/ // le'u don gsum pa/ dbugs mi bde ba bcos pa/ gzha' ni gab pa'am bag la nyal ba/ gsang gtam skyab ni gsang gtam lta bur sab/ nga ro che ni gang thon pa de ngar che ba/ li shi bcu gcig par sbyor sde ngag ni/ li shi gtsor bskyed li shi drug pa dang / rgyan 'brum bdun pa gnyis la/ shing mngar cu gang gnyis bcas bsre ba'o/ /'di'i sbyar tshad la/ rgun 'brum zho gsum/ cu gang zho do skar lnga/ kha che zho gang skar gang / shing mngar zho gang skar brgyad/ gla sgang zho do— skar gsum/ shing tsha zho gang skar gang / se 'bru zho do skar do/ li shi drug pa'i li shi gtsor bskyed de sbyar/ star bu pañtsa ni pañtsa lnga'i grangs —te star bu ru rta skyu ru pi pi ling shing mngar bcas so/ /ga le'u don bzhi pa/ glang thabs bcos pa/ dru bur 'gril ni — dum bur 'dril/ sreg ni nyen che/ zhi byed drug par/ ma nu zho gangaske skar gsum/ sga skya zho do skar drug sa ru zho gsum skar dgu/ lham rtsa —zho gang skar brgyad/ cong zhi zho bzhi skar bzhi/ byang bul zho gang skar /nā sbyar/ rgyam tshwa bcu gnyis zhes pa yig skyon te bcu gsum/ 'chi:

med srin sel ngag ni/ khyung lnga tshad ldan sbyar ba dngad byi tang na: mnyam par byas la skyes pa la bud med kyi dri chu dang bud med kyi lagatsogayas bkrus khus 'phul/ de bzhin du bud med la skyes pa'i dri chu dang skyes pa'i lag g.yon bkrus pa'i chu bsres pas 'phul/ yang na rta gseb sbangs dang phur mong bdug /gzhan yang khyad 'phags dam pasnyengag tu nyan/ /zhes yod pa'i rkang pa phyi ma 'di chad song / 'di'i ngag tu nyan ni/ shin tu che na nad pa kha sbub pa'i rgyab kyi tshigs rnams re re bzhin mnan pas thug pa che ba gcig yod/ de dbyug pas brdungs pas 'bur te skrangs yong / des phral du zug rngu zhi ba 6rgyan myong grub kyi man ngag yin zhes gsungs/ rgyu las zhes pa yig nor te rgyud las/gtso bo ri sho sogs skyugs bshad pa de pho glang dang / dur byid star bu sogs sbyongs bshad pa de rgyu glang la sbyar dgos shing / bar ba dur byid sug pa sogs ni long glang la sbyar ba shes dgos/ mas 'dres dgos zhes pa ni ru ha/ byang tsha zhes pa yig nor te byang pa yin/ /sa le'u don lnga pa/ srin nad bcos pa/ lo btsan ni bya rkang pa/ra dug ni me tog phung por yod pa dgos/ bskol grangs chu la sbyar/zhes pa mchan la de ltar yang / mngar dang sbyar bas srin bu'i kha mngar la 'byed pas de dus sman nus 'phrod stabs la dgongs pa'i ཿsna tram̐ tā /rdotā pa yang snang ngo / /zo mar ni 'o ma'i snod kyi ldebs 1༷ 5

ga le'u don drug pa/ 'khru nad bcos pa/ 'khru gcod se 'bru brgyad pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ se 'bru shing tsha sug smel pi pi ling /de nyid gzhir bzhag brgyad pa'i kha bsgyur ba/ /da trig ka bed tha ram mon cha ra/ /bsdebs pas 'ur 'khrog rtsam pa 'khru ba gcod/ /ces so / / da trig dgu pa ni/ de nyid las/ da trig se 'gru shing tsha pi pi lingam/ / bca' sga ka bed tha ram mon cha ra/ /na ram bur dkar sbyar ba'i da trig dgu/ /'ur 'khrog sgreg cing 'khru ba gcod par byed/ /ces so/ /smug po 'khru ltar bcos ni/ smug po'i skabs kyi khrag gcod gur gum brgyad pa'i steng du re skon pa da trig bya rkang pa bsnan/gsum gyi spu zhes pa ra rgya bo'i sol/ khyi nag snying dkar gyi mjug ma'i —spu / lug thug dkar po'i rmig spu/ skyugs kyi dus bzhin ni/ rang nyid skas kyi gsham du phyin la rkang g.yon thog gi sa blangs nas mdud pa'i da/la hā 'jug sngags btab/ 'khru ba la go bzlog byed tshul shes — / kā 'u/ do/na bdun pa/ skyugs pa bcos pa/ spod nar ni pi pi ling / dri nga ni dri mi zhim pa/ /( le'u don brgyad pa/ dri 'gags bcos pa/ ug chos drug par / ug chos rtsa ba bod tshwa dung thal zho bzhi re/ gla rtsi gi wang dom mkhris skar gsum re/ ug chos me tog zhor/ la phug zho lnga/ sbrul sha sdo kāsum sbyar/ gtum po bcu pa'am rdo rje can la/ sman chen rgya tshwa zho

gang / shug tsher re ral spang spos gur gum zho do re/ mtshal rgod skar /rgya~X sbyo rado/na/ dgu pa/ gcin 'gags bcos pa/ gcin sri'i nad bzhi 'gags pa brgyad ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ sri ba rlung mkhris bad kun 'dus pa bzhi/ /'gags pa kha 'chus rlung 'khyil khrag dang spu/ /skrangs dang khu ba bshang ba de 'gags brgyad/ /ces so/ /gser bye brgyad par/ gser bye gze ma rgya tshwa zho gsum re/ sdig srin ba spru zho bzhi re/ lcam 'bru gsang sman zho lnga re/ sug spel zho gsum skar lnga — sbyar / gsang sman ni/ chu nang gi srog chags chu sbur/ a sho garnya ni ba spru / 'doms spu'i dbye ba ngag ni pho la mo dang mo la pho'i 'doms spu'o/bgrungs ni sbangs/ pang pas brten ni mi gzhan gyi pang pas brten/phur de ni nges med 'chol pa'i de/ gcun pa ni bsnams pa/ rlig 'og sor la gzhal pa'i phug bde sar/ /zhes pa ni/ a long kha nas rgyab mdun g.yas g.yon du tshon re'i sa/ ga le ni dal bus/ /sna le'u brgyad ca pa/ gcin snyi'i nad bcos pa/ nas 'tshig ni nas tshig gi khu ba lta bu/ glang chen ni glang chen gyi kha chu/ za khu ni bad kun 'dra ba/ chu ni sla ba/ chang ni ska ba/ bur shing ni bur shing gi khu ba ltar rnyogs can/ gar po ni zhag lon nas ska bar gyur zhing spu rtse can / 'bras phye ni dkar ba/ khu chu ni skyes pa'i sa bon/ bye ma can ni dri ma can bye jig 'dra ba/ bsil ni reg bya grang ba/ bags 'byudi ༵

nyung zad dal bus byung ba/ bcod khu ni dri mnam zhing dmar ba/skyer khu ni tsha zhing ser ba/ khrag 'dra ni dri nga tsha zhing ro lan tshwa/ zang 'dra ni mdog ser smug ro mngar ba/ gnyid la brtse ni nyal ba bsred pa / de yang brtsi byung ba yig skyon/ bsil la lci ni yig skyon te rtsi/nges ma yin ni mdog tsam la za khu yin pa'i nges pa med/ yung ba bzhi thang la/ yung ba skyer pa zho lnga re/ skyu ru zho drug gze ma zho bdun sbyar/'bras rtsa bco lnga par/ a ru ba spru gangs sbal tshos bcod se 'bru zhol bzhi re/ ba ru ra mnye lca ba zho gsum re/ skyu ru sug smel gur gum zho — lnga re/ dom mkhris zho drug nye shing gze ma zho do sbyar/ gangs sbal ni —da byid de pho sbal smug po dang mo sbal ser po gnyis yod pa btang yul —go ldog pa gzang / bla gnyan thor ba gcin blud rma ltar gso/ /zhes pa la/ man ngag rgyud las bshad pa ltar bla gnyan gyi thor ba bcu 'byungaske na ra thug gi gcin blud la rma spyi ltar gso/ /ཿ le'u gya gcig pa/ tshad 'khru bcos pa/ rgya nad ni rgya gar rgya nag sogs tshad rlangs che sar mang du byung ba/ zur pa ni ma nu shu zur/'jam po'i bshal ni/ byi tang ka 'bras bu gsum pi pi ling bskol ba'i thang khrus la man ngag rgyud las bshad/ gur gum grungs chu ni gur gum chu la sbangs pa'i khu ba/ thun ldab ni nyis gyur/ bil pa bcu gcig ni/jil pa zho brgyad/ gla sgang ba le ka smag dang da trig mon cha ra gser me //sdu zho bzhi re/ re skon zho gsum/ bong dkar kha che dug zhung zho lnga

re sbyar/ man ngag gdams pa ngag du nyan ni/ tshad pa gnyan gyi 'khris med par/ da trig bdun pa chang zhim pos 'phul/ des bajisnyeber 'byung na chad gsungs/ bzang po bzhi ni cu gur dzā li/ /ga le'u gya gnyis pa/ dreg nad bcos pa/ bsre ni mkhregs/khyung lnga chu rta lag na thogs/ /zhes pa bar gyi yi ge chad song ste/ khyung —lnga chu rta lag na dbyug rdo thogs/ zhes pa yin pas so/ /de la chu rta ni dngul chu tsha 'dul/ dbyug ni seng ldeng / rdo ni mu med/ spos dkar bcu pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra/ /ru rta ba sha ka dang 'bras bu gsum/ /spe tres brag zhun ka ra gu gul bcu/ /dreg grum chu ser ko ler tsha 'khyug 'joms/ /zhes so/ /spos khyung bco lnga'i sbyor sde ngag ni/ spos dkar bcu dang khyung lnga bsres pa ste/ de la a ru ra dang ru rta gnyis ldab skyon gyis bco lnga ma tshang bar/ gu gul dang khyi la wa ri bsnan pas bco lnga 'grig pa sbyor sde khyad 'phags so/ /bong khrag nyer lngar/ bong khrag zho lnga/ tsan dan dkar skar drug tsan dan dmar spe tres skyu ru ba sha ka zho re/ gi wang kha che ka ko la sug smel tig ta a ru ba ru gla rtsi spang rgyan spang rtsi do bo skar bdun re/ cu gang skar do/ dzā ti zho gang skar do/ spos thal so zho gang skar lnga/ li shi ge sar gnyis spyi bzhur rnams skar brgyad re sbyar/ seng ldeng nyer gsum par / seng ldeng zho lnga a ru ba ru gur gum cu gang skar bdun re/ skyu ru skyer thun tsan dan dmar ba le ba sha ka gi wang chu ser sman gsum 1rdo 9

sor zho re/ gu gul gnyis gla ji zi ra gnyis skar lnga re/ hong len zho — bdun kyi lce zho gsum/ tsan dan dkar skar drug zag spos zho do sbyar/lug gi btso ni lug shi phral gyi grod nang gi slo/ bya khyung sngon por/ stag sha nag srang do/ chu rtsa srang gang / sman chen sung gang zho lnga/ a ru sha rus 'dres pa ba ru srang do re/ skyu ru grang do zho lnga/ gu gul zho bdun/spe tres sung gsum/ gla rtsi zho lnga sbyar/ 'di la bya khyung sngon po nus — mdog gnyis las nus pa bskyed phyir re lcag yang phran bu btang / khyung gzugs ltar byed na mthing gis kha bsgyur/ // le'u gya gsum pa/ grum bu bcos pa/ tres ni grum bu/ mtshan mo mthu zhes pa'i mas 'phul yig lhag ste mtshan mo thu/ g.yo skam ni gang yod pa'i ngos skam/ sngo la zhugs na ni dpyid dus zhugs na/ skya la thon ni ston dus thon/ gdong lhog ni ngo bzlog klu bdud bco: brgyad par/ klu bdud rdo rjesrang gang zho lnga/ bi ṣa srang gsum/ thal rdor 'bru zho brgyad/ stong zil brag zhun zho re/ shu dag nag zho do/ sle tres ru rta zho bdun/ a ru dbang lag skar bdun re/ ba ru skar brgyad gla rtsi skar lnga spos dkar so ma ra dza zho bdun re/ gu gul zho lnga/seng ldeng li shi skyu ru zho drug re sbyar/ 'di la gzhung du sbyor sde bcu bdun las med pa la klu bdud rdo rje sngon po mchogade dang dkar po klu —gdon du bshad pa gnyis ka dgongs gsungs pa ltar na de gnyis sbyoram rdi /nyis su 'dren pa ltar snang yang 'dir de gnyis bsres pa sbyor sde

gcig tu bya ba'am/ sngon po gcig pu btang nas ru rta sbyar ba mnasnyengag tu mdzad pa ltar byas so/ /dngul chu bco brgyad par/ dngul chu srang do/ mu zi seng ldeng chu ser sman gsum spang gang zho lnga re/ cu gang sug smel zho bzhi re/ kha che li shi dzā ti ka ko la gla rtsi gu gul zho gsum re/a ru sman chen srang do/ ru rta spang gang / shu dag zho bdun sbyar/'bras gsum bcu par/ a ru ba ru zho gsum re/ skyu ru tig ta zho lnga/spe tres zho brgyad/ seng ldeng chu ser sman gsum srang re/ bong khragasnyesrang do sbyar/ mgrin bzang mtshal ni bong bu dar ma nad med cing ma — 'khrug pa'i khrag bong mtshal ni bong khrag dres thag ni dres mtho/ /( le'u gya bzhi pa/ grum gsar bcos pa/ stob ni rmongs pa/g.yo ni spangs pa/ bar rta ni rmig pa/ a ru bco brgyad pa la/ a ru ba ru'i sha zho gsum/ skyu ru brag zhun zho lnga re/ spyi bzhur spang rgyan dkar rdo dreg tig ta ba le ka ge sar gnyis gla ji rnams zho bzhi re/ gi wang so ma ra dza thal ka rdo rje spos dkar zho brgyad re/ seng ldengasagrin bzang mtshal srang re sbyar/ da lta ni yig nor te de lta/ gzer gyi sman ser po ni ming can ser po/ mon srang gre'u ni/ rgya dag du bzhin hwang dhi'u zer / 'di la leb mo gong mo dang zur gsum gyi nyams can gnyis yod pa las 'di ni phyi ma'o/ /a sa ni drod dugs/ /ཿ le'u gya lnga pa/ chu ser bcos pa/ 'drugs pa ni spu rtsa ba nas 'don zhing de shul rul ba/ zas 'phrug ni yig lhag ste za 'phrug stu sdu

ni nas kyi rtse mo lta bu zug byed dang phub ma ni 'bru gang bu can gyi shun pa / nam zhod ni char che ba'i dus/ chu yi rta ni dngul chu/ 'bru bcud ni 'bru'i chang / dngul chu bcu bzhi ni/ 'og tu bshad pa de'am/yang na ji skad du/ btsan dug a ru mu zi gla rtsi dang / /gul nag shing kun shu dag bzang po drug /dngul chu bcas pa dri chus sbyangs pa yi/ /ril bu sran ma tsam dril lnga bdun sogs/ /chu bskol gyis 'phul gag lhog mdze nad dang / /gza' nad bse dug 'brum pa la sogs sel/ /zhes so/ /gtum po ni sman chen/ kyi rtse sbrang rus zhes pa'i rus ni yig nor te rul/ byug sman rgyal po bya khyung dmar po/ sman chen a ru ba ru bsregs thal sung gang zho lnga re/ kham bu'i nang tshig spang gang zho brgyad/ thal ka rdo rje zho bzhi skar brgyad/ so ma ra dza zho gsum skar lnga/spos dkar zho lnga skar do/ rdo rgyus srang gang skar brgyad/ mthing rgyus srang gang zho gang skar lnga/ ba nu sung do skar bzhi/ btsag rdo srang bdun zho do sbyar/ zho rtsi zhes pa yig nor te zho tsam/ gnam lcags zil par/ dngul chu tsha 'dul zho bzhi/ mu zi zho gang skar bzhi/ byang pa zho bzhi skar gang / rgya tshwa zho bzhi skar drug dur byid zho drug spang spos zho gang skar bzhi/ re ral zho gang skar do/ gla rtsi skar do/ bal — gur skar lnga/ shug tsher zho gang sbyar/ gnam lcags zil pa ni dngul chu / sa bcud dwangs ma ni mu zi ser po/ stag chung dmar khra ni byang pa dpa/ khra/ chu yi snying po ni rgya tshwa/ myur mgyogs pho nya ni dur byid/

sprel mdzug ni re ral/ ma snyi ta nigla rtsi/ li khri'i 'od ldan snyobadzigur/g.yu 'brug ze ba ni shug tsher/ e kro ta ni lo brgyad dri chu/ myur mgyogs ni dur byid/ pho nya ni spang spos zer ba'ang 'dug // le'u gya drug pa/ rtsa dkar bcos pa/ gyes tshul zhes pa la/rgyud sde rnams su rtsa rlung thig le sems bcas la rdo rje lus zhes bya/ de yang rtsa khyim lta bu/ thig re nor lta bu/ rlung sems bdag po'i tshul du gnas par gsungs/ srog rtsa ni 'og tu/ sgal pa'i nang gzhung thang ske shing bslang pa 'dra/ /zhes pa de'o/ /rtsa nag ni khrag gtso bor rgyu ba/rtsa dkar ni rlung gtso bor rgyu ba/ nang rtsa rlung bzhi zhes sogs bcu gsum po glo snying sogs dang rang rang gi thad nas 'brel/ de dag kyang dar skud drangs shing gnyan pas dar gyi dpyangs thag ces bya/ phyi rtsa sbru gu zhes pa nang stong par gnas pas sbu gu can te klad dkyil nas thon ltag pa'i sdud sgor don/ gzhung pa'i rtsa ni rgyungs pa yin/ bcu gnyis pa nas bsam bso mkhal mar 'brel/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ bcu bzhi pa nas rtsa bzhir gyes pa'i gnyis/ /zhes yod pa ltar go dgos/ byin —brla'i phyi sul phyi long zhes pa la/ brla'i phyi sul du 'grims pa de sre long dang phyi long gi bar brgyud de/ sre long phyi long bar na rgyungs rtsa'i gnad/ /ces pa de yin/ brla sgang zhes pa la/ brla sgang brgyud pa'i rtsa de gnyan gong du song ba na/ bus mo'i gnyan gong rus rtsa sgyid bu'i gnad/ /ces pa de yin/ pir mgor 'brel zhes pa ni/ mthe bo/ sbyo

skyes rgyus pa pir mgo'i gnad/ /ces pa der 'brel/ gong dang rkang mthil 'dus zhes pa la/ rkang pa'i nang ngos rgyu ba 'di gnyis gong gi phyi sul 'grims pa gnyis dang gung mtheb bsdongs mtshams rkang mthil brang gi gnyer ma'i 'og tu 'dus la/ sre long phyi long bar nas rtsa sna gcig rting pa'i mthil du yod gsungs/ 'ja' byed ni skyon phog na zha bar byed pa/ man stong 'grams nas zhes sogs la/ 'ja' byed de an stong 'grams nas gnyis su gyes pa'i rtsa gcig glo rtsa tshigs 'grams gnyis dang 'brel ba/ glo ma rtsibs las byung ba'i tshigs 'grams gnyis/ /tshigs pa'i g.yas g.yon mtshon re phun re na/ /kun tu rgyu ste bzhi pa'i thad kur gnyan/ /zhes so/ /gong gi rtsa sne — gcig phrag par brgyud dpung sog gi mtshams su nub/ de nas rtsa sne gnyis su gyes pa'i gcig dpung 'dzum gyi tshigs dmigs/ lug gzhug brgyud nas gru mor song / rtsa sne gcig phyi mchan du 'grims pa las / dpung pa'i lug gzhug phyi mchan chu rtsa'i gnad/ /ces pa de byung nas gru mo'i gcig shos dang 'brel ba tshigs skor gyi gong zur brgyud lag pa'i mthe bong rgyab ngos tshigs 'og spu skyes su 'brel nas lag mthil du 'gro/ rat+na ni rin chen lta bu'i ngo mtshar ba/ de klad zhabs nas 'byung ba'i rtse mgo rna shal 'og tu thon/ sgrog rus nang du nub pa mchan khung brgyud gru mo'i tshigs dang de la bkab pa'i gzhu /rdo/ gi bar du 'don pa la za bi ri zhes bya zhing / spu mo'i bar na rlung

rtsa rat+na'i gnad/ /ces pa de yin/ de nas rgyab zur thur 'grimasalasrin mtheb tu 'brel nas lag mthil dbus gnyer ma'i 'og 'ja' byed kyi sna dang 'dus so/ /g.yo la spe ni sngar gyi sa na mi gnas bsnyernams gzhan du gyur pa/ nying lag ni sor mo/ tsha grang sbyor sde gnad dang ldan pa ni/ tsha na bsil sman bskyed grang na drod sman bskyed/ gram ra ni rgya mtsho ste bstan bcos rtsom pa po'i mtshan zur/ bsam 'phel nor bu la/ gur gum li shi sug smel pi pi ling zi ra dkar nag gnyis gser bye rig srin a ru ba ru rnams skar bdun re/ shing mngar sa — 'dzin chu ser sman gsum skar brgyad re/ dzā ti zho gang skar do/ cu — gang ka ko la skar do/ mu zi zho do/ gi wang se 'bru skyu ru ra zho re/ gla rtsi tsan dan dkar ar dag skar drug re/ tsan dan dmar zho brgyad/shing tsha skar lnga/ ru rta ma nu skar bzhi re sbyar/ 'di'i shing gi rgyal po dri ldan gsum ni tsan dan dkar dmar a ga ru/ srog chags las byung gnyis ni gla rtsi gi wang / chu dang gangs kyi rus pa ni mu tig bse ru/'bras mchog gsum ni a bar skur/ smod kyi rgyal po gnyis ni shing tsha — pi pi ling / chu ser sman gsum ni thal rdor so ma ra dza nyi dga'/ ru — rta gnyis ni sha pho ru rta ma nu ru rta/ shing bcud ni shing mngar/ sa: 'dzin ni 'bri ta sa 'dzin/ bye ma ni gser bye/ ka ka ru ni sdig — pa'o / / mu tig nyer lnga ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ nya phyis bzang drug gi wang tsan dan dkar dmar a ga ru bse ru gla rtsi ru rta pi ling shing ༵ ṭā

'bras bu gsum sdig na gser bye lcam pa zi ra gnyis 'bri ta sa 'dzin la bshad/ rin chen sbyor ba ni/ de nyid las/ gser zangs g.yu rnying thog lcags byu ru nya skyogs zhes so/ /gtsang ma'i byang sems dkar — dmar ni/ grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i byang sems dkar dmar/nad dmigs gar yod steng du me btsa' gdab/ /ces pa la me dngos mi dgos pa'i rigs la rgya nag chu yi me btsa' ni rdo zho'i thal ba'am cong zhi'i thal ba de nad dmigs steng du chus sbyangs la blugade'i mgo brdal nas chu grang mo thigs pa lan gsum bzhir blugathengs gcig me chu gnyis ngo zad de khol nas me btsa' babs yon——— do / / hor me lugs gcig la cong zhi bcod dang pi pi ling de rnamasaskyilegs par cha mnyam pa zhib par btags pa'i phyes nad dmigs steng du bzhag de'i steng du dar dmar bkab/ de'i steng du shing leb larkosogs bsrab leb gcig gzhag de'i steng du spra ba gsum lnga bdun —bzhag la me spar/ des chu ser 'dren pa dang skrangs dang lnga ba la ngo mtshar che'o/ /nas rtab rtsis ni dngul chu/ nyi ma mtshal ni rgya mtshal/ses sbal ra si ni ga bur zhes ngag rgyun las thos so/ /rtsa gas ni rtsa gang khums pa zhar ba 'grams pa sogs rtsa skyon te rtsa 'chus dang rtsa dkar gnyis ma gtogs so/ /bzos pa'i chu lums ni bdud rtsi lnga'i — lums kha tshar can/ /(153'u gya bdun pa/ mkhal rtsa bral ba bcos pa/ nya phyis nyer lnga

ni gong bshad mu tig nyer lnga/ rang 'thag kha ru'i sa ni rang 'a gaste ba'i phye/ rtsa 'chus ni rtsa 'gyus/ // le'u gya brgyad pa/ lpags nad bcos pa/ sha bkra ni sha mdog 'gyur te khra bor gyur pas sha khra zhes kyang bya/ de la yang nang tshan rlung gyur smug nag rtsub pa/ mkhris gyur ba spu 'byi zhing dmar la tsha zabacu byed pa/ bad gyur g.ya' zhing skya la mthug pa'o/ /glang shu ni sha mdog 'gyur te khra bor gyur pas pags mdog skya ba seng bo la gzhigs nashe'abrum chung skya gsobayod par bas ldags kyang zer zhes bzhed pa dang /glang shu ni dkyil srab la 'jam/ mtha' mthug la tsub/ mched par byed pas bas ldags zhes bya zhes bzhed tshul gnyis yod/ mdzer pa ni rang bzhin dkar po dang rkang mthil sogs su byung ba la rgya mdzer ram mdzer nag ces bya/ za rkong ni spu 'byi mdog sngo 'gos mched skyen/'di la rjo dang zan 'ja' za 'phrug gi rigs kyang 'byung / 'dul bcu nas bshad pa'i khyi rdo dang g.yan pa sogs phal cher za skong gi rigs yin par sems so/ /shu ba ni rtsub pa drod che'am yang na grang zhing za 'phug byed/ srin thor ni thor pa rtse dkar zhing snag pa cho lo ba 'byung /ngo shig ni gdong la ze ba lta bu srab mos khyab ste ngo khabs gro thig ces kyang bya/ khabs ni lpags mdog dkyus dang mi 'dra bar skya ther sna — tshogs shar/ khye ma ni sha mdog gcig gis ma khebs par srub lus pa yin / sgra yi ni ming gis/ lpags nad spyi sman la kyi rtse khyi la zho ga~X/

dur byid sngon bu ba bla chu rtsi mu zi zho re/ gla rtsi skar drug shu dag chu rtsa yung ba tshwa spos dkar so ma ra dza skar bdun re/ re lcags skyer pa a ru ba ru thal ka rdo rje bi ṣa brag zhun yungs dkar zho re/ sdong ros zho gang skar lnga sbyar/ ser po gnyis ni yung ba skyer pa/ gtum po ni bong nga /kuṇ+ḍa ni kuṇ+ḍa ka ri/ gang 'phrod rta la sbyar ni/ tsha ba la ba chu chu serasnyekābam la la phug gi khu ba/ shu thor la phag tshil rlung shas che la mar rnying ༈gasdu/'u /gya dgu pa/ mdzer pa bcos pa/ gyur chags ni ltas ngan dang skeg shel 'od ni me shel gyi 'od spra ba la 'dus pa'o/ /1 le'u dgu bcu pa/ phran bu'i nad bcos pa/ khab len bzhi sbyor la/ a ru zho drug ba ru zho lnga/ skyu ru zho bzhi/ khab len zho gsum sbyar / brnangs ni nang du mid kyang mi thub phyir 'don yang mi btub — par mgul du bsdad pa/ ska rags rdo ni ras sam ska rags sra bar 'dril ba/ rgyab ni khu tshur rgyab pa/ sked de ni yig nor te sne de/ bang rtsar ni gong par/ ram pa ni dur pa'i rtsa ba/ sne'u lhags ni rmen bu skrangs pa/ tshwa gsum ni rgya rgyam kha/ bsgreng ni bran/ btsan thabs ni brdungs thems sogs/ ma le ni za 'gram gyi rus pa'o/ // le'u go gcig pa/ mes tshig bcos pa/ zab lag can ni chu rtsa/mthong ba brgyud las shes ni/ so ma ra dza gtso bor gyur pa'i phyed cha sditāzlo mar dang spos dkar de'i byed cha kha tshar rnams gtong / nus

ldan ni nus bsreg ri ril ni ri bong ril ma/ bya bal ma ni chu bal ljang gu/ 'drag ni nad stobs chag nya mkhris brgyad par/ nya dang skyar mo'i mkhris —pa zho gsum re/ stag sha sid+dha ra sbal khrag srang re/brag spos dom mkhris bdud rtsi lo ma zho brgyad re sbyar/ /ga le'u go gnyis pa/ nu ma skrangs pa bcos pa 'ba' cha ni til gyi mar phyung pa'i spang ma/ spel thal zhes pa la mchan yig chur sbrus zhes yod/ byis pa'i tshul sbyar zhes pa lcam 'bru sdig srin byang pa rnams/ jigs na ni sbyong thebs na/ dpyi rus ni lug gi'o/ /( le'u go gsum pa/ bse dri bcos pa/ bse dri ni bse bur gyi dri mnam pa/ khyi 'ur ni yig nor te khyi gur/ lan 'ga' bkru zhes pa la/chu dron mo bzod tsam gyis mchan khung bzhag sha gnyis bcas bkrus/yang na rang gi dri chus dag par bkrus/ tang kun sar 'byar ni skyes ma thag pa/ spru nag stor 'byar ni spru nag gang bu ma phye ba/ me tog dril bu 'dam 'byar ni shang 'dril lam sug pa/ 'di gsum ni lung med pa'i bshad 'bum yin/ snum byes zhes pa'i phyes ni yig nor te phyis/'ba' zhig ni go snyod a gar/ dam rtsi ni sbrus pa'o/ /1 le'u go bzhi pa/ tsher lhog bcos pa/ me 'dur ni sol me phra mo/tsha tsha ni me stag chung ngu / e thon ni thon nam/ chas ni chas kyi sman/'grig ni khebs byed/ lug tshil zhag par ni lug gi sto tshil ma btsos pa / lce chung zhes pa yig nor te rtse chung yin/ / 159

/ le'u go lnga pa/ 'bras nad bcos pa/ mchan gyi rkang ni yig nor te sgang yin/ 'khren ni zos 'phral skyug ces bzhed pa dngasred pa che ba zhes bzhed pa 'angayod/ nya yi sha ni chu nang gi nya yi sha dang rkangaske lag gi nywa bzhi'i shar bzhed pa'am yod/ zug 'byil ni zug 'bri/khugs ni smin pa/ gtso bo cha gcig ni 'og tu/ gtso bo tsha la cong zhi — bzang po yin/ /zhes pa ltar tsha la/ stag dom dkar ni stag sha dom mkhris spos dkar/ rus sman sde bzhi ni sbal rgyab mdung rtse gangs thigs cong zhi/ gsang sman gnyis ni yu gu shing rtsa a ba'am brag spos/ da tshur ni tshur dkar/ dwa tsha ni shing tsha thug po/ de la da tsha —zhes pa yig nor/ pad+me ni byang pa/ du chad ni rtsi chad/ rus 'dul che 'bring chung gsum ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ rus la stag sha rtse tsha khabasnelen gsum/ /zang spyod sbyar byugs chod dka' brud dam bsreg /gson gshin sbrang zhing byer na mgo ltar bcos/ /zhes pas kyang chogasha gyirtsa gsum la zhes pa yung ba shing mngar chu rtsa/ rus 'bras 'dra bcos bya/ zhes pa'i 'dra la 'phul lhag go/ /dwa tsha bzhi par/ rgya tshwa zho gang gzhan gsum zho drug re byer/ // le'u go drug pa/ gzhang 'brum bcos pa/ gsang lam ni yig — nor te bshang lam/ kro si ni yi rdo ni be snabs zer/ shing sol ni yig nor te shing so ma/ /(17le'u go bdun pa/ me dbal bcos pa/ rlon ni myug chu ngan ske

ni pho mo gnyis 'khrig paspyod pa'i skabs kyi chu nal nal/ /1 le'u go brgyad pa/ gur ya bcos pa/ gtar ma 'chun nisnyegatar gyis ma 'drongs/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bshal sman ni dedasnyedapon bzhi sbyor ram bcu pa gang rung / 'bab pa'i kha sgyur ni globamachin mkhal ma pho long so so'i kha sgyur phyi rgyud ltar/ dngul chu ril bu:ni / man ngag rgyud las/ dngul chu mu zi seng ldeng so ma ra/ thal ka rdo rje gu gul dkar nag gnyis/ skyer pa brag zhun sngo yi tsha ba gsum /byang pa tsa ba lnga dang bong bu'i sha zang rnams chu ser 'joms pa'irna/// po // so/ /nad gang bsdongs pa'i gnyen po bsdebs te:( le'u go dgu pa/ chen bu bcos pa/ dbye ba brgyad ni/ mnasgrongag rgyud las/ dbye ba rlung mkhris khrag dang bad nan dang / /sha tshil shā dang 'bras dang brgyad du bshad/ /ces so/ /ze ze ni sbra sme ste sbrel gtā/'u /brgya tham pa/ rmig rlugs kyi nad bcos pa/ rnam pa drug ni/man ngag rgyud las/ dbye ba rlung mkhris bad kun tshil gyur dang /gcin las gyur dang rgyu rlugs drug tu bshad/ ces so/ /bar rta ni: rlig pa/ sbal gu ni phyag tshang ku ba///le'u brgya gcig pa/ rkang 'bam bcos pa/ nang bsnur ni sos —la khad nas phyir bsnur pa/ nal ni byi bo byas pa/ ben+da ni btsurdo 61/

bla gnyan zhes pa'i bla ni yig nor te klu/ yu mo'i gnyan ni gnyan g.yung / gcer mthong ni mngon sum mthong / dreb can ni sra bar/rnag dri kha ni rnag dri mnam pa/ sna bu ni sna 'brum/ btsan thabs ni glo bur / chu sgang ni chu bur/ dang khrid ni dang ga 'byed pa/ dri ma mi tshor ni yig nor te mi 'chor/ sman dkar ni la phug khrag gi bdud rtsi ni chu klung 'gram du skyes pa'i dar ya kun te khrag khrog pa/ smyo med ni dugatsomed / mchan gyi dbang ni nag po'i dbang du byas pa/ bya khyung bcu bdun par/ sman chen zho drug skar drug ma ru zho gsum skar drug ru rta lcags kyu ba zho gang skar gsum/ shu dag skar drug gla rtsi skar lnga/dbang lag gi wang gur gum rgu drus par pa ta zho re/ spe tres skar dgu/brag zhun gu gul zho gang skar lnga/ sdig na dkar nag stag sha zho do re sbyar / 'di'i brda sman ni klu bdud rdo rje ste sngon po mchog gnam lcags thogs 'bebs ni/ cu gang ka ko la zho gang skar do re/ kha che zho gang skar do/ dzā ti sug smel li shi skar do re/ thal ka rdo rje bcod tshos zho do re/ zhu mkhan zho gang skar dgu/ a ru sman chenasrang gang skar do/ru rta zho gsum/ shu dag sbi yang ku zho do skar do re/ gla rtsi rgya tshwa skar lnga re / cog la ma zho gsum skar gangad gur gum skar gsum/ domadze mkhris skar bzhi/ nya lcibs zho gang / thug tsher seng ldeng skar dgu re/spos dkar zho do skar gsum/ so ma ra dza skar brgyad/ bong dmar zho rdi ñtshar gang / dngul chu zho drug skar lnga sbyar/ lab bcos ni la phug gi

bcos ma chab 'dren gzhon nu ni gri yang ku me tog ma bye gong btu thepa / chu yi snying po ni rgya tshwa/ stag mo kha ral ni stag sha nagapo/ bragarnasman gzhon nu ni khrag khrog pa/ dug sbrul sbal pa'i kha rgyan ni chu rug pa ste chu dang skyes pa'i dbyar dgun sngon por yod pa de la zer/ chig brgyud gsang sman rnam gnyis ni 'u su'am pyi yang ku'i lo ma nyi ma markolog gong btus pa/ gur gum mdog mi 'gyur tsam dang rgya tshwa bzhi nam sbyar ba'ang 'dug 'di la zhib cha chig brgyud ces gsungs pa rang rang nad kyis 'gyur pa de ga yin/ gnyan 'joms ril bu ni gong du bshad/ dmar khrag ces pa'i khrag ni yig nor te bra/ bcings lums ni spyings lums/ gdags kyi g.yam rul ni nyin mo'i phyogs kyi 'dag skerul/ rdo rgyus gsum ni ba nu rdo rgyus mthing rgyus/ dom nag ni khyi nagagaya' yi rta ni g.ya' chu/ thun tshad byed phri ni/ spyin chu bre gang la bag phye phul gsum chu rtsa phul do bul tog phul gang dud pa khyor gang tsha ba'i sman ni tsan dan dkar po ga bur gi wang rnams spang re re/ rdo sbyor bco brgyad par/ sbal rgyab mdung rtse rag rdo cong zhi gseng dngul rdo ba nu rdo rgyus mthing rgyus rnams zho brgyad re/ sman chen thar nu kyi lce zho do re/ re lcags spos dkar thal ka rdo rje so ma ra dza zho brgyad re/stag sha sga tig nag to zho re sbyar/ spru nan zhes pa'i spru ni yig nor te spu / rtse chen rtse chung ni/ ma la ya'i dka' 'grel las/ rdo chu rtsi chen rtsi chung gnyis/ /ser dkar drag po rdo chu lnga/ /zhes pa'i rtsi chen rtsi staX 3

/nyidri // ba/rgya gnyis pa/ mtshan bar rdol ba bcos pa/ 'di la spyi rtags mtshan dbrag nang du 'brum thor 'ong zhing de nas chu ser 'dzag pa dang / smin nas rnag khrag dang srin bu bcas 'dzag pas 'tsho bar — mi 'dod cing / lan re zhi yang slar ldang gzhug tu bshang gci dang khu khrag kyang de nas 'dzag go/ // le'u brgya gsum pa/ byis pa btsa' thabs/ dom pa la ni dom nag gam byi la nag po/ 'tshas ni drod/ // le'u brgya bzhi pa/ byis pa nyer spyod gso ba/ se'u ni so/lugs 'byung ni mgo sngon la 'byung ba/ 'dar zhing dngangs ni lus — tshor che ba/ dgu ni thams cad/ lte ba sor bzhir bcings ni/ ste ba'i khrag bu ngos su bzhur la sor bzhir bal skud cig gis yas mas gnyis su bcings/ gri yig bris ni gli thel rgyag mel tshe ni nyin mtshan kun tu bya ra byas/ sri'u ni can/ thar thar ni zla ba re rer/ a sbo ta ni chos sman nam bdud rtsi ril bu/ phya tshan ni bu skyes ma thag pa'i brun / zo sha ni mdong mo'i ldebs la chags pa'i mar te zo sha dang zom mar dang zom rtsi don gcig pas so/ /sa ni sa bcudade mu zi ser po'i ming yin yang sbyor sde la mkhan pa gtongaka 'gong po ni phrag dog che: ba'i 'byung po'i ming sha tshod ni lug gam g.yag gi'o/ /pa tra ni ma sta / dzimana' la ni sngon la/ gtang rag phul ni bka' drin nam sku drin —

gsob phyir gsol mchod phul ba'o/ / / le'u brgya lnga pa/ byis pa'i nad bcos pa/ shwa ni sho re/ bu ji3 khye'u'i gam du gnas pa sogs/ zhib tshags ni chan cung tsha bsubs ni glo tshad/ 'ju ni 'dzin pa/ skad gnya' ni skad gdangs zhan pa/glo kun ni yig nor te glo rkun/ glo rgyalani yig nor te glo brgyal zhesalhasalu bas brgyal ba/ 'phar sgo ni mtshogs ma/ bsub ni nyed/ lte nad rigs bzhi ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ lte nad lte mkhrang lte 'khor ste 'khrigs dang / /ste rnag bzhi ste/ zhes so/ /'khor rnams ni nye 'khor rnams btang gcod ni shan byed/ hrid pa ni rnying pa/ ba skya ni ba mo lta bu skya khol/ lte bar speb ni mchin pa'i zungs shor te/ bur 'byangasnyenas lte bar sleb/ 'drug ni rdul/ zas 'bros ni yig nor te zas 'dres/ kha blang ni kha bsgyur/ lag mgo ni mdzub mo'i tshigs 'og mdze dang bar rtsa/ cham 'joms ril bu ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ dri bzang bzhi dang zho sbyar cham pa sel/ /zhes pa la byed na/ shing tsha zho do/sug smel zho gsum/ gca pa tra zho drug cu gang zho brgyad sbyar/ blon po gsum sbyor la/ cu gang spang gang / gur gum gi wang zho brgyad re sbyar / ha bo'i me tog ni brag maho bo/ gnas gnyis ni ske dang sked pa/leb rgan ni dar dmar/ gcig shes kun grol la/ blon po gsum sbyor sngar ltar gyi steng / bong dkar srang gangan ga dur shing mngaraspo lo zho brgyad re/ hong len tsan dan skar re sbyar/ glo tshad kun sel la/ 1swā

rtsi skar bdun/ gu gul zho gang / 'dzin pa zho do skar do/ a ru zho lnga/ru rta zho gsum/ rgya mtshal zho lnga skar lnga/ shing mngar zho gsum skar — gsum/ cu gang zho lnga skar brgyad/ kha che zho gang skar bzhi/ gi wang tsan dan dkar zho gang skar lnga/ tsan dmar zho gang / ga dur zho bzhi skar brgyad/ sro lo zho gsum skar do sbyar/ rlung tshad ldan 'dus gong steng a gar spe tres sgog thal rnams zho gsum re/ dzā ti'i me tog zho do sbyar / sdug zlo ni gcig gsum lnga lta bu/ chung dpyad ni chung dpyad /d+ma /bye sab py-i /ga/ pa/ byis gdon bcos pa/ ya ga can bsdos ni dregs pa can gnyan po'i rigs la rgol pa/ 'dre can ni gdon can/pho gdon lnga ni/ skem byed sa ga lug gdong khyi yi dwags/ mo gdon bdun ni/ bya gdon srul mo grang ba'i srul mo srul mo long ba bzhin rgyas nam gru skem po/ rgyal bsen gnyis ni rgyal po bsen mo gnyis/sprul bzhi ni lha chen po/ bco lngar grags ni de ltar man ngag rgyud las bshad/ mchan gyi bco zhes pa yig nor te bcos/ gnya' ni smyu/gzungs chen grwa lnga ni stong chen rab 'joms/ rma bya chen mo/ so sor 'brang ma/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi mdo/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ zla ba'i grangs ni skyes nas zla ba du lon gyi grangs/ shwa gzugs ni shā ba'i gzugs/ phong ra ni khyo ga med pa/ zhum ni byi la/ sri dang za 'dre mdista/ ba'i 'khor lor/ rdo rje shar dkar sto ser nub dmar byang ljang

dbus sngo ba/ rtsibs brgyad kyi shar nub gnyis ser po lho byang gnyis༄ dmar po me rlung gnyis sngon po bden bral dang dbang ldan ljang gu/ mu khyud kyi phyi ma sngon po me ris dmar po/ tri mu zhes bkod pa shar dang trig nan nub rtsibs g.yas skor du brtsi ba'o/ /za 'dre'i liṅga bris pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs sngo rtsibs mchan dmar sto ba ser/ /za 'dre mi —sha'i mdog mu khyud sngon po/ me ris dmar po/ tshon skud sna lngasashebacings pas thub/ ces pa ma'i nyal 'og tu chungs nan chogaspya mthun gyis mnan/ drag sngags brab cing mnanasreg 'khor lo bskor/ ces pa / drag sngags bzlas pa'i thun gyis brab cing cho ga ltar mnan pa —dang / drag po'i sbyinasreg dang bsad pa'i 'khor lo bskor bar bya/ /1 le'u brgya bdun pa/ bya 'dre bcos pa/ stong phrag brgyad cu'i byed dbang ni/ khri phrag bzhi la dbang ba/ mi bzod ni yig nor te mi bzad/ de yang drag shul che ba'i brda rnying yin/ zha ba ni smyu ba/ phyis gson por 'byung ni bshang ba nyid gang zos pa de gar 'byung / g.ya' chags ni ba skya chags pa/ skad chen rus ni sbal pa'i rus/ dbyi mong risre mong gi rigs/ gzugs mo ni sems can che chung 'phyi ba tsam la —yan lag thung ba gdong so mche ba gnyis yod pa 'phyi ba bra ba ri bong gzugs mo rnams so skyes lugs 'dra ba las gcan gzan gzhan ltar g.yas g.yon mche ring dang sngon po zhib min spu thams cad sgang thur yin / gsang sman ni/ byi la khyi nag snying dkar phag dag de rnams spya —

brun / sman sna bzhi mnyam sbyor sogs chig brgyud ni/ pho rog byi la'i brun khyi nag snying dkar phag gi brun dang bzhi 'am/ dri chen khyi brun bong nga phag gi brun bzhi/ 'di la skya ku'i sha'am 'ol sha bcas lngar bshad kyang 'di la skya ku'i sha sbas pa'i dbang gis bzhir gsungs/drod ltan (ldan )ni srog ldan/ stag sha bcu par/ sbrul dug ni sbrul ba gsar dug zhes pa yin snyam te sbrul dug gla rtsi zhes pa ltar byas na sbyor sde dgu las med par 'gyur bas dpyad/ sngags kyis gso ba ste/ zhes pa la/ 6 cig cig tsub tsub nan nan gā hā/ zhes pa'i bsrung sngags 'di yi dam gyi sngags kyi sham la gdags/ chabum bum bya bum tshub tshub bya tshub sogs ni spur sngags so/ /spur sngags rang nyid khyung chen po gcig tu bsgoms la bya gdon rnams nam mkha' la spur bar bas/yang lugs gcig la/ rtsub rtsub bya rtsub sogs dngaka gsang sngags ni/mi bya tra dza zhes sogs so/ /bro g.yo'i yi ge zhes pa'i bro ni yig nor ske byung bas/ grogs g.yo'i yin/ grogs g.yo'i yi ge zhes pa/ tra'i thar/gong gi cig cig sogs bya sngags dang / 'og tu bshad pa'i 〉trig trig nan sogs drag sngags re re gnyis kyi sham bur/ bya 'dre stam+bha ya — nan / sogs kyi 'dod gsol dang yig bzhi zhes pa rtsibs bzhir miyig re dang / stam+bha ya nan/ zhesasbras na rung gru khung tshang tshing zhes pa'i tshing ni yig nor byung bas rtsi yin/ man ngag drag sngags ni/ khro sdiX8 sngags so/ /tsug tsug dang gā hā/ zhes pa'i bar du nan zhesasgod

| cha/ // ba/rgya brgyad pa/ mo nad rags pa bcos pa/ za ma ni dman pa/ gor ba ni zho ltar chags pa/ rtse'u 'grang ni rtse chung rengs te ske 'gyur dka'/ 'doms g.ya' ni 'doms dbrag g.ya' ste za 'phrug byed pa/ rked so ni sked pa dang chu so/ bzod pa che ni tshor bske bral/ khre 'ur ni spel mar/ gsher ni bshal/ ded dpon bcu bzhi par / sbyor 'grol ngag ces pa la/ gtso bo gsum ni ba spru rgya tshwa 'ol mo se'am ya bak+ṣar/ dpa' bo gnyis ni byang khra bco lnga ha ta shig lug ril tsam/ 'khru byed bzhi ni dan rog lnga dur byid mtheb tshigs tsamarkothar nu mtheb tshigs byed re lcags lug ril tsam bzhi/ rlung gnon: gsum nisga pi pho gsum thun re/ zhe snang sha ni sbrul sha 'di la rgya ruṣ+kabasnan nas bco lnga yang zer/ 'di'i tshad ma gsungs pas sbyor sde'i tshad skabs sbyor/ mngal dang zhes pa la gce'us so/ /grog zhing ni gyang rnying sogs la chags pa'i sa spang ma lta bu ro kha nyams yod pa/'ba' cha ni til mar byung ba'i sbang ma/ dor rta ni smad gos/ tshang btsos nas ni yig nor te chang la btsos nas/ g.yu ril bcu gsum par / ru rta zho gang skar lnga/ sku ru se 'bru ba sha ka spru yang ku ut+pal re skon go thal byi tang ka rnams zho re/ sug pa pi pi ling bca' sga 'u su: rnams skar bdun sbyar/ pad+ma'i kha sdoms 'khor lo'i lte ba dkar po/jib bsngon po/ mchan dmar po/ mu khyud dkar po/ mtha' sngo/ 6sbya/
