me ris dmar por byed/ de bzhin rang rang don snod rtsa gtar zhing //gsang bsreg sman mar gnyen po'i sbyor ba bsten/ /zhes pa la/ glo: tshabs drug 'go gtar dmar po gsum gyi sman mar sbyar bzhi lnga bsregamachin tshabs la ru thung gtar gur gum bdun pa sbyar brgyad pa bsregamacher tshabs la rgya tshwa shing tsha dur byid kyis sbyangs se 'bru brgyad pa bcu gcig mcher steng bsreg mkhris tshabs la a ru khron bu gser me'i thang khrus tig ta brgyad pa sbyar/ mkhris rtsa gtar tshigs pa bcu pa bsreg mkhal tshabs la shing tsha chang la bskol rgya tshwa rgya ru ba sprul 'ol me (mo )se btab btang byin gzhug gtar rtsa ba lnga sbyar bcu bzhi bsregargyu tshabs la lham rtsa a rus sbyangs 'om bu bdud rtsi'i bdug bcu bdun bsreg 'khreb che ni mkhregs che/ rdo sbyor ni gong bshad/ nyam ldan chis pa nyam ni yang 'jug sa chad/ de yang lug tshon po/ gsum yar ni dus gsum/ mar chang zhes pa la/ phyi rgyud las/ mar chang sbyor ba chang nang bu ram zang / /mar dang go stod pi pi ling du sbyar/ /rtse — 'jam zhag gsum mnan pas grang rlung sel/ /rlung tshabs mgo dang —mig la bros pa 'don/ /zhes so/ /sdud sgo gsum ni/ spyi gtsug ltag pa mtshog gsang / thong tsher ni lug pho lo gnyis lon pa la pho thong dang lug mo lo gnyis lon pa la tsher mo zhes bya/ smyug shun ni smyug rtsi ste smyug ma gzhon nu'i phyi rtsi/ spod sna nisga go stod sogs/ se 'bru curanis ni/rdi spyad las/ se 'bru tsha ba gsum po gzhir bzhag ste/ /dzā ti ka ko la —

dang kha ru tshwa/ /rgyam tshwa shing tsha dbyi mong tsa tra ka /a ru ra dang la phug sa bon bsdebs/ /se 'bru cur nis bad rlung ma zhu sbo/ /pho mkhal bu btsas grang ba rgyas pa 'joms/ /zhes so/ /me nyams gsang ni/ de nyid las/ nyen sna'i rtse nas tshon gang lhen gyi gsang / /de'i 'og tshon gang kha gsum skran gyi gsang / de'i 'og tshon gang kha gsum me nyams — gsang / zhes pa ltar ro/ /brgyangs btsos ni gyi thag byas te btsos ṭ+wāṃ / le /'u brgya dgu pa/ mo nad kha thor bcos pa/ gong 'thus ni — gong bshad kyis chog dal rked ces pa'i dal ni yig nor te mkhal/star bu bzhi ni star bu ru rta mdze tshwa ze tshwa/ 'chi med srog ster gong bzhin sbyar/ zhes pa 'dir byi tang ka zhim thig le ske tshe lca ba sne'u 'bam po'o/ /byi rug brgyad pa ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ byi rug byi tang ka dang zhim thig le/ /ske tshe lca ba sne'u 'bam po dang / /sha sna bskol khu/ /zhes so/ // le'u brgya bcu pa/ mo nad phal pa bcos pa/ 'khri ba'i nad ni 'khri zhes pa ldan pa'i don yin pas 'dir bu dang ldan pa/ sha ma ni bu rog nying lo 'byung ni nad gzhi rnying pa 'byung zer ro/ /gsang sman me tog ni/ yu mo mde'u 'byin/ byi sa sa dugs ni byi khung shar ltas kyi sa chang bran gyis so/ /mda' rgyus ni dmar ru mgo nag bya ma byi'u ni byi ba lpags gshog can/ ya re ni ya gcig tso chang ni chang ga~X/

mig tu bcug ni/ rdzong 'phrang du/ g.yer ma khyem gang gcig chang gis 'phul nas btang bas ig byung nas nang du nges par 'gro gsungs pa skyigs bu byung ba'i don yin/ yog thong ni/ phying pa'i yog pa mgo zlum mdzub mo bas sbom tsam pa mtho do ba gcig la phu ma spangs pas — gnyis rim gsum rim du gril la de la mar byug rgya tshwa btags pa bu ram gyi ril bur 'dril ba zhig mgo la bkab la/ bu snod lug pa chu 'jam dang 'o mas bkru/ skam yang des spangs/ yog mgo de bu snod lug pa'i rtse mo long kha'i sne 'dra ba de'i dkyil du btsugs nas tho gang tsam 'phul bas bang rim phyi nang slog pa bzhin du 'gro/ gting du na lhang byung na nang du sleb pa yin pas yog pa 'don/ phying pa snum can gyi drod dugs bya/ mi bcir bar 'phongs gyen du gtod la nyal lo/ /'gro 'dug langs pa spang ngo / /skra gzhob ni smra gong ltar gyi gzhob/mchan gyi sra mo ni yig nor te srab mo/ chu srin sder mo dgu pa ni/ phyi rgyud las/ chu srin sder mo bsil gsum ba le ka /ut+pal rdo dreg gasnye dur pi pi ling / /ka ra sbyar ba'i chu srin sder mo dgu/ /snod du tsha grang 'thab dang smug ser 'joms/ /zhes so/ /ga bur gsum sbyor ni/ ga bur cu gang chur sbyangs la tsan dan dkar po bsnan/ /ga le'u brgya bcu gcig pa/ skyergyun gcod pa/ gsang sman ni/mdzo pho dang drel pho'i rgyungs pa/ sung ga'i klad pa la 'dod pa'angarkosditā 2/ stag sha ni srog chags stag gi sha dug ni btsan bdug /

/ le'u brgya bcu gnyis pa/ 'byung po'i gdon bcos pa yang ni 'jigs 'jigs par/ ya ga can ni dkor bdag pe har sogs dregs can/ 'bags ni de dag gi nor la longs spyod pa/ gtses ni:gnod pa bskyel ba/ brnyas pa ni khyad gsod pa/ mchod 'os chag nisnye'adas ma 'das gang yang mchod bzhin pa yod pa de chag pa/ mi 'tsham ni rtsing sprod byed pa/ kha ze ni dug can/ bya tri ni kuṇ+ḍa ka ri/ gcin drug ni ba lang glang g.yag rta bong ra lug gi'o/ /lugs mthun ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs pa/ gsang ba'i rdzas bzhi bsregs pa'i thal/ /zhes pa ni/ gri rus gla rtsi mu zi nag po khyi rgya bo'i gson khrag yang na gri rus rta gseb dag po'i rta bon pa ra thug dang glang thug gnyis kyi 'brel kha'i spu/ man ngag smyu gus 'dri yul chig brgyud par/ /zhes pa mchan dang bcas par man ngag smyu gu ni byi thur gyi smyu gu/ 'dri yul ni mtshan mo gnam ma mthong zhing mi khyi'i skad mi thos pa'i sar gzhan gyis mi mthong par bris/ mchan gyi bris dus ni skar ma rgyal mchu dbo sa ri ma ga rnams shar dus/ rgyal 'gong bsrung 'khor gyi lte ba ser po ste ba'i srog yig sngon po/ mu khyud kyi nang skor sngon po/ mu khyud dngos dkar/ rtsibs ser/ rtsibs mchan dmar/ pad 'dab brgyad kyi shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang / shar sto ljang / lho nub sngo/ nub byang ser/ byang shar dmar/ dbyangs gsal gyi mu khyud ser de'i mtha' mu khyud ljang / de'i mtha' mu khyud dkar/ rdo rje sngon po/ /nā

chen sngo dmar ram ser po yin snyam dpyod/ pad+ma dmar/ ral gri ljang / me ris dmar po'o/ /srung 'brum zhes pa'i 'brum ni yig nor te 'bum/ de yang bla ma dgongs dus ltar yin/ dwangs ru ni sbu gu'i sgro / btsan gyi bsrung 'khor gyi ste ba dkar/ lte ba'i yi ge dmar/ mu khyud nang ma sngon/ mu khyud dmar/ gre bo'i bsrung 'khor gyi lte ba dkar/ ste ba'i yi ge dmar/ mu khyud kyi nang skor sngon/ mu khyud dngos dkar po byed/ zhib pa zab mo ngag las nyan ni/ bsrung 'khor gyi lte bar gnod byed gre bo khug cing bcings pas mi thar par bsam/gtor ma zhes pa cha gsum gtor ma gzhung ltar btang / shar sogs — phyogs dang rang rang sa ru btang / /zhes pa la/ man ngag rgyud las/lha dang bla ma drang srong grub pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis bstan pa ltar yin / 'dzin pa'i dus ces pa la/ lha'i gdon ni yar ngo'i tshes gcig bcu gsum la/ lha min yang ngo'i bcu gsum mar ngo'i bcu bzhi la/dri za bcu bzhi bcu gnyis la/ klu tshes lnga la gnod sbyin tshes bdun bcu gcig la/ tshangs pa srin po tshes brgyad bco lnga la/ srin po sha za tshes gcig tshes dgu bcu gcig la/ mtshun lha gnam stong tshes bcu dang brgyad dang dgu pa la/ rgan po la sogs gzhan dag ni phal cher dus de'i thun mtshams la 'dzin no/ /( le'u brgya bcu gsum pa/ spyo byed bcos pa/ de yi yid log sdo/sdu pas shes pa g.yeng / /zhes pa la/ snying dkyil pad+ma 'dab

brgyad kyi dbus su rtsa'i rgyal po a wa dhū ti rta rnga tsam gnas/ dezhi stengasa'og phyogs bzhir rtsa 'dab bzhi dang steng 'og gnyis te drug gi nangasnyestong par gnas pa la steng ljang 'og sngo/ shar dag lho dmar nub serasnyebyang dkar por gnas pa'i shar mdun gyi 'dab mar rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / lho g.yas su mig nub rgyal tu sna/ byang g.yon rtse/steng gi dhū tir lus/ 'og gi dhū tir yid kyi rnam shes rgyu zhing / mdun gyi 'dab ma rna ba'i rtsa srin lag gis brgyud de gdon zhugs te 'og gi dhū tir song bas yid kyi lam bkag de yis yid log ste shes pa g.yeng /btsan dug sman mar ni/ man ngag rgyud kyi brda bkrol du gsal/ zho sha rgod ni snang zho sha dang g.yag rgod kyi snying / tig ta'i sman mar ni phyi /da // ba/rgya/ bcu bzhi pa/ brjed byed bcos pa/ bu ga dag par sbyangs ni/ rlung la ni ru ha dug gdon la sna bshal/ bad kun la skyugs/ mkhris pa la khrus rnams rnon por sbyar/ sor mo nyi shu bsreg ni ne'u le dang sen mo'i rtsa ba pa'o/ /srog rtsa myos byed ni nu rgyab tshon gang / phugs bcas ni brten bcas/ bden bdar ni dkon mchog gi bden pa bdar ba/ mtha' ru bskyal ni lhag ma med par gzhom | / le/'u brgya bco lnga pa/ mir khi bcos pa/ gti mug 'khor lo ni phag nag sna/ bdud rtsi ni rdo ja/ wa ra skad chen ni sbal sha'o/ / 175

ཿ le'u brgya bcu drug pa/ gza' nad bcos pa/ grung ba ni gsal ba/ kha spe ni kha phyogs gcig tu yo ba/ rgyal mo 'dal ni mig — 'bras che bar song ba/ ra ma lug gnyis ni rtse'i 'og gi rtsa gnyis/ rgyu ma phug 'dra zhes pa'i phug ni yig nor te phus/ drug lnga ni sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i drug rdzab ma ni gzab ma/ gser gyi zhes pa las yig chad de gser gyis/ 'khor lo'i lte ba dkar po/ de'i mu khyud dmar po/rtsibs sngon po/ rtsibs mchan dmar po/ mu khyud phyi ma ser po'o/ /ri dwags dri ni gla rtsi/ gsang sman gnyis ni/ ston ka lug chung gi nang du gnas pa'i 'bu/ 'bu ben+da zhes pa mdog gsal chung ngu myur mgyogs can de'o/ /'di la ming gzhan pa dmar po yang zer yang lugs gcig la/ nal bu'i sha dang rabs chad dor rta yang bshad/ zi nag ni yig nor te zir nag bzo bo zhes pa de ga yin du chug kyang gso byas na legs/ mchan gyi hal ma ni da dung / ku sgra ni ca co/ lus gsogs ni lus kyi khams mthun/ de'i mchan du sdum bu li zhes yod pa mi gsal/ tsha'u ni skyogs sogs la mig mang phug pa/ dug dbyung ni — rā hu la'i dug dbyung / klu chog rgyab bcos ni/ gza'i rgyab klu yin pas de bcos/ smrang gis bkrol ni rgyu mtshan smras pas bkrol ba/ de shul ni gtor ma bskyel pa'i rjes su/ rgyab sprad la ni/ shug leb che ba zhig nad pa de dang rgyab sprad la bcings/ gtam kha 'dri ni/ kha shag di pyog ces brjod la khams bde 'am zhes 'dri/ byad thag ni/ skud

pa sngo dmar ram gza' so so'i mdog gsang sman ni/ pho rog gi snying / 'jigs byed ni dngul chu 'dul ma/ btsun mo ni sazi/dpa' bo ni sman chen/ dri ldan gnyis ni shing kun shu dag 'dri 'jigs ni gu gul/ gsang sman sngags kyis dar btags bya/ /zhes pa'i gsang sman ni bshad ma thag pa dang sngags ni 'byung ba lnga'i sngags de'o / / dngul chu bcu bzhi pa 'di la/ dngul chu zho drug mu zi zho bzhi/sman chen zho lnga/ shing kun zho gang skar drug shu dag zho lnga skar drug gu gul zho bzhi skar dgu/ cu gang zho gang skar gsum/ gur gum gla ji skar do re/ li shi sug smel skar lnga re/ dzā ti skar gsum/ ka ko la skar /nga / stag sha zho gang sbyar/ khyung lnga'i gsang sman ni gong bshad ltar —/ le'u brgya bcu bdun pa/ klu gdon bcos pa/ lan gcig lnga brgya tha ma'i dus tshod du/ /zhes sogs la/ bskal pa la spyir sangs: rgyas byon pa la sgron bskal dang / sangs rgyas mi byon pa la mun bskal:du bshad la/ sgron bskal bzang po 'di la yang yar 'phel rdzogs ldan la thug gi bar du 'byung ba'am bcud thams cad yar 'phel zhing mi: rnams kyis kyang chos kyi rkang pa bzhi ga rdzogs bar byed de/ de nas lo:re bzhin bskal pa'i cha nyams shing 'byung ba'i bcud shor bas mi — rnams kyi za thang bri nas dbus por gyur te/ nyon mongs je rags su: song nas chos kyi rkang pa gcig shor bas gsum ldan/ gnyis shor /shā

gnyis ldan/ gsum shor bas rtsod ldan/ bzhi shor bas rtags tsam 'dzin pa'am tha mtho/ /za thang ni dbang thang ngam mnga' thang zhes bsgos tshad de la bya/ dbul ni/ dus kyis ma thub cing ngan pa'i las kyis sdug bsngal ba/ spang thang ni spang dang thang / ne'u gsing ni steng ka / 'degs ni sa de nas bkog pa/ mi gtsang ni klu gnyan sar grib can gyi rdzas bskyel ba/ 'thab ni me thog tu chu shor nas me gsod pa nag 'thab/ khrag dang sha khu shor na dmar 'thab/ 'o dar sogs shor na dkar 'tharbe/ gzhob ni/ sha lpags rus spus sogs 'tshig pa'i dud pa ngan pa/ bshan dmar ni/ gnyan sar sems can bsad pa'i sha khrag dmar po/ 'jol nyog ni/ nyes pa nyes dmigs su ma mthong bar bab col du byed pa/ bad bon ni/ ban+de btsun pa dang bon po/dkrugs ni/ mnan gtad char 'bebs sogs kyi don du rdzas ngan gnyan sar rgyab pa/ klu ni lha'i rigs dang lha ma yin yi dwags su gtogs pa'ang yod la/ phal cher dud 'gro yin zhing / rgyal rigs/rje'u rigs/ bram ze'i rigs/ dmangs rigs/ gdol pa'i rigs rnams su yod/ gnyan ni/ sa chu sogs kyi bdag po rang rang la gces pa de la thug reg byung na bzod thabs med pa/ sa bdag ni/sa'i lha mo bstan ma dngade'i 'khor du gtogs pa dang lhan du byung bas gzhug mar gnas pa zhes bya ste sa'i bdag por rlom pa/ lha srin ni sde /lha/ do/ /reg mthong kha rlangs bsam pa'i dug phog pas/ /tsi ti dzā

la 'bar pa'i bskal pa dar/ /zhes yod pa'i rkang pa phyi ma chad/ tsita dzā la zhes pa skabs 'dir mdze nad la 'jug rang ro rang gis mthong ni rkang lag chad pa sogs mthong ba/ sum cu rtsa drug rgyud nas gsungs ni / man ngag rgyud las/ dbye ba gnas dang rigs kyis bco brgyad 'gyur/ /zhugs tshul gnas kyis dbye ba skyisprigs rtsi/ /mdog stobs —sha tshil chu ba rtsa dang khrag /chu ser rus tshigs lha ba klad rkang khu/ /don la zhugs pas dbye ba bcu dang brgyad/ /rigs kyis dbye ba rkyang pa ldan 'dug bdun/ /thod 'dra zlum po glang shu u dum war/ /ri sha'i rtse dang lpags mdze gcig bu dang / /'brum phran sha bkra 'bras byer ser ga dang / /shu ba kha brgya pad ma dkar po dang / /'brum pa g.yan pa pags pa myags pa dang / /'ol se 'dra dang sum cu rtsa drug go /zhes so / / sbal spyong nas ded pa'i bar gdon gyi rtags/ sgo 'phrang 'dzul dang g.yang lhung gnyis mnan par tshud pa'i rtags/ nyi nub nas mda' 'thu pa'i bar byad kha spyi rtags/ sgong sogs ni pho gdon gyi rtags/ bud med ni mo gdon gyi rtags/ lhas tshor ni lha 'dre'i rtags kyis tshor ba/ me tog ni mtshan ma/ dod ni byung / myags ni rnag 'dzag nying lag ni sor mo/ gsang bar thub ni gzhan la bshad mi 'dod pa/ bteg ni sbos pa/ mnan rjes ni skya smug sogs kyi thig le/me tog skabs ni sha rus sogs skams shing mnan shul mi 'ong dri chur ni nad pa'i dri chur/ sha khrag byin ni gcod lugs pa la grags1 ༵ mi

ltar 'gyed gsum gyi sgo nas so/ /skam sad ni yig nor te sings po/sman mar bzhag ni zhag gsum bar du sman mi bsten/ sha rus rgyus pa — snying khrag bya khyung lnga/ /bzhi gcig gsum gnyis byed dang sum cha sbyar / / zhes pa la/ sha ni a ru ra/ rus ni ru rta/ rgyus ni shu dgasnying ni sman chen/ khrag ni gla rtsi/ 'di la a ru ra cha bzhi/ ru rta cha — gcig shu dag gsum cha gnyis/ sman chen cha brgyad/ gla rtsi gsum cha gcig 'di yang dper na/ a ru spang gang zho do/ ru rta zho gsum/shu dag zho dgu/ sman chen zho drug gla rtsi zho gang skar lnga sbyar ba yin/'og tu sha snying mnyam zhes pa'i dgongs pa ltar ma ru sman chen gnyis cha mnyam sbyor ba la mnyam sbyor khyung rgod drag po zhes bya'o/ /byang pa'i tshad ni thems pa'i tshad/ klu bdud dkar nag ni kyi rtse dkar po dang: spang rtsi do bo gnyis/ gsang sman chig brgyud ni/ gi wang a ru nag chung / 'di la gu gul nag po bsnan pa man ngag yin/ tshad ldan ni sngar bshad ltar/ 'bru lngas dbang bskur zhes pa'i 'bru lnga ni/ man ngag rgyud kyi be+e sngon las/ chasagli kha hūṃ zhes byung / dka' 'grel las rgyu gi tshab tu smi 'byung / gnyis kur yang spyi dang mthun na cha tram̐ gri phywazhes 'byung / bdud rtsi'i gter bum du i.ud+mā kha ni zhes 'byung /dbar bskur ni/ sman re re nas lhar bskyed bstim byas te byin gyis — brlabs pa/ zla 'od nor khyung sbyor sde ngag ces pa la/ a ru sman chen sdi nāgu skar re/ ru rta zho gsum skar bzhi/ shu dag zho gang skar dgu/

gla rtsi sdig srin gi wang skar drug re/ cu gang gser bye so ma ra dza zho gang skar do re/ rgya tshwa skar dgu/ spos dkar zho gang skar bzhi/ thal ka rdo rje zho gang / gu gul nag zho gsum/ mu zi zho lnga skar gang ka ko larkoskar lnga/ li shi sug smel skar do/ dzā ti skar gsum/ dngul chu zho dgu sbyar / 'di'i chu sman gsum ni rgya tshwa sdigasan gser bye ma/ sa bcud mu zi/ khyung lnga chu rta can la/ chu yi rta ni dngul chu/ seng ldeng dbyug ni khyi la wa ri/ rdo ni mu med/ chu ser sman ni spos thal lo/ /gzhan yang chu ser skem byed rgyud chen nas/ /gsungs pa'i dngul chu rin chen sbyor ba de/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkang phyi ma/ grum bu'i le'ur rgyas par bshad pa'i zhes pa'i mchan dang bcas pa chad/ re rim dra ba'i mig 'dra tshon skudabres/ /zhes pa tshon skud sna lngas pha tse'i re so 'dra ba'i dra ba mig mang ris sabres/ skyer nag ni skyer pa la dkar nag gnyis su phye ba'i nag po/ gla shing ni star ku'i shing / 1sreg ni shal ma li/ tsher nag ni mdzo mo seng ldeng / sbyor ba'i sman bsregs pa ni yig nor te sbyor ba'i sman bsres pa/ gnas gsum ni spyi gtsug dpral ba mgrin pa/nag po gsum ni bong dag spru nag mu zi nag po sbyor sde gcig tu 'dren/ka tan ni ras dkar/ chos sman ni bdud rtsi sman sgrub/ pir ni chu nang gi nya zed ma'i rigs/ sa dug ni zi ra ser po/ klu bdud nag ni stag sha nag po/ nal bu ni pha ma gcig pa'i pho mo gnyis kyi bu/ gsang sman chig brgyud ni mdze pho'i so dang mu med gang rung / lugs gardi/ 1

la phag gi so dang sna yang bshad/ /1 le'u brgya bco brgyad pa/ rma spyi bcos pa/ rma ba ni dma' ba/bshus ni pags pa bshus pa/ gshags pa ni gyen thur du gshags pa/bcad pa ni sha 'phred la bcad pa/ rnam par bcad ni rus la thug pa'i bar bcad pa/ rab tu 'phyang ba ni rus pa bcad nas sha rab tu lhab lhab por 'phyang ba/ lhung ni sha rus gnyis ka lhu tshigs bral/grum ni rus pa sogs grum pa/ phug pa ni mtshon rtsis phug pa/ lhag — thabs ni myur bar/ zug rngu las ni mtshon dum lus pa/ sha'u 'brum — phran bcas ni sha chung 'brum phran ltar thor thor skyes pa/ lcags g.yas ni lcags g.ya' ltar sngo skya se ba/ chang 'gags sbang ma ni chus ma — bsings pa'i spang glum gyi spang ma/ sings po'i sbang ma ni khu ba bton zin pa'o/ /chu nas bton ni bro ba gang yang med pa'i sbang ma/ rma — 'byer ni rma kha cher song / sha'u rlig pa 'phyid ni sha'u phyir bton pa dang rlig 'bras phyir 'byin/ nang brtol ni byang khog nang brtol/mched ni khong du tsha ba sdud cing rul la chu ser gyi skyon gyis myags shing —rma mched pa/ zhun ni rma la phan pa'i bsil sman zhib btags tshos par bcos pa ska sla 'o zan tsam 'dag pa ltar byugs la nyel srab sogs kyi steng dkris mas dkri ba/ nan ni bsil sman zhib btags byas pa'i skamasla lug zho tsam rtse 'jam bsros pa byugs steng shog deb bam spu deb di/zlo / a sa ni zan dron/ zug pa ni phan nga / khyi khul ni khyi bal/

nan ltar ni thal ches pa/ dam ni mde'u dam par zugapa/ tsho'i tshe mdzer ni rus pa grums pa/ rnag sha ni rnag thubs/ dri chu bar rgazhesangapa'i lag len man ngag rgyud kyi brda dkrol du shes/ tri shu ni mdu —thung / sding ni bgrad pa/ srid spor ni dbang phyug chen po'i mtshan ma/me sbor ni me 'bar/ sib ni thim/ rma lhog ni yig nor te ma ldog gro lu ni rma'i stod smad bar gsum du dru bu lta bur chag chings byas te bsnams la/ de nas bsnams de zhag gsum gyi thog bshig ste kha gye/zam bu btang ni mi gyes pa'i thabs bya/ khad spu gzhug ni mtha' gnyis sbyar la snum bsreg byas te 'thud/ // le'u brgya bcu dgu pa/ mgo rma bcos pa/ spyi ring ni spyi bo 'jong mo ring ba/ 'phred nyal ni ltag pa dang mtshog ma ring ba spyi leb ni rgyab mdun nas g.yas g.yon du nar mo/ bung tshang ni shin tu — dkar ba zang rtsi lta bu dum bu kham tsam phyi klad rgyas gtums te spubs gsob pa bung ba'i tshang 'dra/ mtshul pa nyag ni sna gong nyag pa/ skyon ni khro ba/ dar steng ni klad rgya'i steng / 'dus so gsum nisbyi bo tshangs bug ltag pa/ 'dom rtsa ni dbang po bzhi 'dom pa'i rtsa/ mtshul pa ni rna'i bya gshog gi g.yas g.yon/ mur gong gshongs ni smin ma'i thad/sgo bzhi ni mig rna ba sna lce/ sdud sgo bzhi ni/ rgyab kyi ltag pa'i thod mtshams sna lce dang thad mnyam pa'i sdud sgo de dang g.yas g.yon rna ltag gi skra mtshams ri dang bcas gsum/ mdun dpral ba'i skra mtshadisdu

nas sor bzhi mar bcal ba smin dbrag gi thod mtshalas bcas wa lung ni bug par phugs brdugs pa/ gshol brkos ni gshong mor brkos pa/ gtam zug ni mde'u lus pa'i phug pa/ gzhogs ni steng nas gzhogs pa/ rdzogs ni sha rdzogs rus rdzogs su 'jug pa/ bcad pa ni steng 'og bcad pa/ gas pa ni ser ga gas pa/ chag pa ni tshal bur chag pa/ 'them pa ni bar du 'thems pa/ reg myang ni reg pas shes par byas pa/ ma thog na ni ma mthong na/ khab mgo ni cha byad/ rtsi ni mdog khred khred ni she hur/ khral khral ni shar shar/ thug thug ni mnan mnan/ gog skad ni chag pa'i sgra/ rgya ber ni klad khyim 'grams pa / mtshor 'khyoms ni klad pa lhung ba/ gzha' ni gab pa/ zas la dang 'jab cing hab hab rngam ni/ zas la dang ga 'gags pa'am yang na zas 'dod shin tu che ba/ dur 'khun ni gnyid log tshe ngur ngur sgra 'byung zhing zhe 'khun byed/ mi choms ni ldang mi nus/ bye dmar ni migs bu/ krad rnying ni lham krad rnying pa/ 'dag ru ni 'jib ru/phrug byas zhes pa'i phrug ni yig nor te phugs dbugs bzung 'dab pa khar bzung sbyor ba yin/ zhes pa la/ dbugs kyis bzungs te 'theng 'dab ste 'jib pa khar bzung ste kham bur sbyor ba ste 'gag yin/ kun byed rgyal por/ gangs thigs zho gang skar gsum/ cong zhi zho gsum/a ba zho gang skar lnga/ gzhan rnams zho re mnyam par sbyar/ 'di la /sdu 4rgyab ni pho mo gnyis 'dres/ mdung rtse ni dkar smug gnyis 'dres/

ha'u ba pa ni rta lpags/ 'ju rtse ni ze tsha/ dar sman ni tsha la/ spri btsan ni klad rmi 'grams pa/ a'u rtsi ni a bi ṣi/ gsum mtshoms ni kha — gsum/ bsreg dmigs bcu bzhi ni/ 'dus so gsum dang chu rtsa sbru gu can gyi mgo gnyis/ an stong tshigs pa dang po/ rna ba'i mdun rgyabacu ni ljon shing bzhi/ rna shal 'og gshong ni rat+na gnyis/ rna rgyab spu — 'khyil ni 'ja' byed gnyis/ me g.yus ni me btsa'/ dres 'khor ni rtswa dres ma'am shing jig ma sgril ba 'khor mor chags pa ci tsam gyi phyi rgyaladang mnyam pa/ bal med sor mo bye drag ces pa la yig nor 'byung sternabar med sor mo je drag ring stabs che na zhes pa'i ring la yang 'jug sa chad/ nang bog ni dang du zhugs pa/ dar steng ni klad khyim/ ther buni skam po/ thobs ni sbubs/ gseng bug ni gsong mig ga le dbyung ni rang gi ngang gis phyung / sha'u zam thogs ni sha'u gsar du skyes pa/ dar bzhag ni dar de bsal/ 'ol skom ni mar bcas phye ma/dra mi btub ni dra mi rung ba/ zlum bcos ni 'dum bcos/ srid pa'i byang sems dkar dmar ni cong zhi dang mtshal rgod/ ser po ni gser rdo / ba ri ba ya ti gibre gu gser thig kaṇ+ḍa ni la ni tsher sngon/ gsang sman ni/ rdo gru bzhi rdo sman khyad 'phags par/ srid pa'i byang sems dkar po srang drug sgo byed sman dang ṭam kur srang re/ gsang sman khra bo cig shos srang gang zho lnga re/ shing sngon pho sbal lha zho bla rdo bye'u mgo rtsa sdom thugs can a ga sta rnams zho bzhi re/ nya lcibs sbrul dug zho rdi ༵

mnyam par sbyar/ gzhan gyis ma mthong bya/ 'debs sman thar lo'i sbyor bar/ stag sha zho do/ rdo sol zho gang skar lnga/ gzhan rnams cha mnyam zho re sbyar/ 'di'i srid pa'i byang sems dkar po ni cong zhi dang cu gang yang zer/ sgo 'byed ni rtsa a ba/ ṭam ka ra gnyis ni da chu dang mtshal/ gsang sman khra bo ni mi ma shi ba'i thod pa dras pa'i lha khrag dang rus pa bsres pa ste/ zur mkhar ba'i gsung las/ kun gyi tshod 'dzin gsang blon dung thod can/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /lugs gcig la/ bre gu gser thig gi lo ma yang snang ngo / /yang gcig mgo chag gson thod lha khrag rus pa gsum ma rnyed na/ shi thod lha khrag rus pa gsum mo/ /gcig shos me tog lo ma byed khyer ni/ a byag tsher sngon/ shing sngon ni spyi bzhur/ lha zho ni gangs thigs/ sman gyi drang srong ni rdo gru bzhi/ bla rdo ni pha wang long bu'am 'dre sho rog po/ rtsa sdom thugs can ni dom mkhris/ sbrul dug ni gla rtsi/ a ga sta ni khab len no/ /bsil 'jib ni cu gang sho mang sogs bsil ba'i 'jib/ // le'u brgya nyi shu pa/ ske rma bcos pa/ gsum 'dus ni sha rus rtsa gsum 'dus pa/ 'khar ni tshogs pa'i mkhar dngos/ bya 'dabs ni mkhar gyi g.yas g.yon du gshog pa ltar btags pa/ ltag pa mkhar — mtshams ni ltag pa'i rus pa dngos kyi mkhar mtshams/ brgyud pa ni yig nor te rgyungs pa/ skyid 'khril ni sgyid pa lhod pa'am sgyid skyur/di/ 6'dag ni bag phye'i 'dag pa/ kha sha ldem ni rma kha gab/ a cang che

ni shin tu nyen che/ rbad kyis chod ni thag pa ltar chad pa/ phun re nisnyesor phyed/ bor ni brgyal/ btsan brdungs ni 'grams pa dang: brdungs pa/ 'thems ni rdo gnyis kyi bar du 'thems pa lta bu/ modam du ni 'phral du/ rgya khyim bca' ni mchod kong lta bus mnan nas mabacings pa/ nya tsa mo ni nya zed ma/ rma bug khol bton ni rma'i thad du mthongs ka bzhag sna bsnol ni gang ma chad pa de na bar byed/ me rgyal gang ba ni me btsa' gdab/ tshan dos ni drod dugs/ chu sman ni rgya tshwa gser byi sdigasan nyi dga'/ nang rtsa bcu gsum ni nang don snod bcu gsum dang 'brel ba'i rtsa bcu gsum/ gcud la bor zhes pa'i bcud skeka ni yan lag bsnam pa ltar 'gul mi nus/ bor ni rang gi min snyam du sems/ rgyangs sha las byed ni wa sha ste sol gong gi sha hal 'dres ni nyal ba dang bsgres pa/ /ga le'u brgya nyer gcig pa/ byang khog rma bcos pa/ rgya skar ni —khang pa'i skar khung / lha ru rtse ni rtsib ma'i sne mo/ sta zur ni sog pa dang dpyi'i sta zur/ bzhag sha ni mdun ngos dkar po gnyis dang rgyab ngos nag po gnyis/ thal gong ni phrag pa'i steng / gnya' 'khor nisnyesog pa'i rtsib logasangos kyi kha 'khor/ long ga ni rgyu yodang 'brel ba/rgyu ma ni pho ba dang 'brel ba/ g.yang bzhag bskor ba ni g.yang zad gyi ril bu skor nas mar khu blugs pa/ tshil shubs dkar nag ni/ rgyu dkar dag dang ljang rgyu dkar dag gam gzhang dkar nag dmyus 1sdud

ni dar la dkyus pa/ bsam bse zhes pa la/ so ma ra dza las bsam bse zhes bya 'dzag snod de/ /che chung byed pa sgang lpags 'dra/ lte ba —dag nas g.yon du 'khyil/ /mkhal ma g.yon pa dag dang 'brel/ /zhes pa ltar/ lte ba'i thad nas g.yal g.yon du 'khyil ba mkhal maske g.yon dang 'brel zhing tshigs pa bcu gsum pa'i 'og na gnas pa de nas pho ba'i mar sna dang 'brel ba snang pa ltar che chung byed pa don snod kun gyi 'dus sa zhig go/ /'di'i shugs las mngal lam dku'am bu snod ni/ mo la bsam bse dang stod smad 'brel ba tshigs pa bcu gsum pa nas bco lnga ba'i thad bar gyi nang ngos nas gnas shing / lhang pa: ltar che chung byed do/ /'di'i rtags bcos phal cher ni bsam bsem dang mthun par bzhag dkyus ni srid du/ dpangs ni mtho khyad/dpung 'dzum ni lag pa 'gul bskyod byas na 'dzum shig shig 'ong ba/tsa ra khung ni gshongs pa/ chu babs ni rim gyis gzhol ba/ mchin dri nag po ni mchin pa dang 'brel ba'i sha 'thug po/ mchin dri dkar pocu ni sha min lpags min gyi dkar po/ gseg ni drang thad min pa/skabs 'di'i yul thig gi rnam bzhag man ngag rgyud kyi brda bkrol du — gsal bas 'dir masbras so/ /gzhal tshod la tshom pa byung na/ rang gi lag pa'i mthe bong gi sen mo'i dreg pa yod med kyi mtshams der tshon zhes bya/ de'i byed la rang sor gcig de'i byed la phun/ sor de nyid ba/ci la chag gang / sor lnga la mkhyid gangan sor drug la mdzum gang /

sor bcu gnyis la mtho gang mtho do la khru gang zhes bya la/ khrurda yis mi lus tshad ldan la khru bzhi/ mi'u thung la byed dang bzhir gsungagastag tshang lo chen gyi rig gnas kun shes las/ mi lus phal pa srid du gya bzhi dang / /zheng du go drug chu zheng mi mnyam gsungs/ /zhes 'byung ngo / / phug ron gsang ni phug ron shong ba tsam/ dkar nag mtshams ni snying gi phyi sha kartika ni shes gyi spu gu can/ sog phon ni sog ma'i — phon bu/ li kha ni ma so likha/ bcu gsum pa nas rtsa gnyis g.yasangos su/ / zhes pa'i bcu gsum pa ni yig nor te/ tshigs pa dgu nas zhes pa yin/ bcu bzhi g.yon phyogs zhes pa'i bcu bzhi yang yig nor te: bcu gsum yin/ mthong ga ni snying gi thad kyi gos la mthong chung ngam mthong ga zer/ bu rtsayod ni a long ltar 'khor ba yod/ ma bu sgrog ni glo ba ma bu sbrag pa/ u zur kha la bkal ni rus pa nyag po yod pa'i steng du 'phred la gnas/ rta sha ni sog zur dang dpyi zur gyi sha la'ang: bzhed/ rgyu rtsa de'i mjug ni rgyu ma'i rtsa long rtsa de'i mjug nas/mtshan dbrag ni skyes pa'i rmig pa dang bud med kyi mo mtshan gyi bar gyisko'og sgo'i ngos su/ 'phongs ni rkub ste bshang ba'i rgyu lam/ stod gsang phyal mo ni phug ron gyi gsungs/ bcur 'byin thubani stod gsangade ga mda' gsang yin pas rgyab mdun nas thal mar phug kyang mi 'chi/brung khudani de'u thad nas stong sa gcigayod/ sog ya ni yig nor te:sog pa/ gnyis rgyug ni ma bu gnyis na'i rnag rgyug pa'i sa/ them di spya

rim pa/ gsog la ni rnag gsog la/ rtsa gzhan tha ni rtsa gzhan pa — rnams mi gnyan/ 'tshebs pa ni gnad las 'byol pa/ snyeg ni speb/ljid ni skyon/ stangs zhan ni 'gro lugs shor ba/ glo ser gyi ser ni yig nor te glo sor gyis yang yang lu ba/ gang rgyab ni mtshon gang nas rgyab pa/ mdangs dkar ni byad bzhin gyi mdangs dkar ba/ ngam nag ni ngo nag gol sa ni 'khrul sa/ khug pa ni mchin dri khug pa/stod dgu ni stod sgur bar 'gro/ pang 'chos ni bu chung pang du blang bskyeltar 'chos/ 'ur gyis ni glo bur/ spungs ni shes pa dwangs ba/ stag —mgo zhes pa'i mchan gyi glo ming ni glo mang zhes pa yin 'dra/ lo dus ni sang phod de tsam/ btsan dmar ni btsan dan dmar po lta bu/ 'phyes ni bem zhing zha ba/ mgo rma zhes pa'i rma ni yig nor te dma' ba/'char bu ni phyir rgyug zhes mkhas ni snyan ming nas 'bod pa/ rtsi nyams ni phyi'i rtsi nyams pa/ cha ga ni mtha' 'am mu/ ther phog ni dbus la phog pa/ rdzems ni rgyu ma dang pho ba 'brel mtshams long stod lu gu mgor sog ni khrag long la long gi stod rgyu ma dang 'brel mtshams kyi mgo/ long zer ni rtsam long gi dbus/ sbo ldeng ni sbo zhing rgyangs/ has 'debs ni kha nas dbug ha zhes byung / dri ma sdug ni: 'khru / sdugs ni blugs/ 'dzum kha ni 'dzum dka'/ bya gtong gsum ni gong bshad ltar rtsa rlung zungs gsum/ de yang bya gtong zhes pa ngag sdirā 'phrin smras pa ltar rtags kyis 'phrin bskyal ba/ rtsal bzhi nisnye

gnyen po bzhi/ la chen 'da' ni 'chi bar nges/ 'tshams pa bcadasnyedagos ni che chung 'tsham par khrag byung nas bcad dgos/ mgyogs me —ni myur bar speb pa'i sman/ ti gu lam skyes ni tha ram gyi lo ma/ rems ni rengs pa/ chas med kyi mar bzhag ni chas med kyi rma yan par bzhagagi wang bzhi sbyor la/ gi wang cha bzhi rtsangs pa'i sha dang khrag cha gcig da byid cha gnyis rgya ru cha gcig sbyar/ rma nas 'byin ni rma nas mde'u 'byin/ skya sbyor ni gong bshad/ zhal gcig 'byung ni mtshon phyir bton pa dang khrag babs pa dus gcig la byung/ khugs shing steng du rma kha thur la bstan/ /dbugs bsnams khrag 'byung yon tan brjod misnyelang / / zhes pa la/ khugs shing steng ni ring thung lus shong tsam sbom phra lag ngar tsam bzhi re mig tu bsnol pa'i steng du/ rma kha thur bstan ni/rma kha re mig gi nang du thur du bstan/ dbugs bsdams ni/ khrag ci thon bya phyir dbugs bsdams te 'tshir ba sogs bya/ 'di'i mchan gyi —gsang ni gseng yin/ sngas dam zhes pa'i dam la rjes 'jug 'a chadaskyipas sngas dma'/ zab ni gos chen za 'og ga dor ni rwa ba'i rwa 'bur tsam thon pa/ tshad mdangs ni tshad rtags/ gsar 'jam ni chang gsar 'jam/ ting khrol ni chu chod par zho tsam du bskol ba/ 'gongs 'degs bdeg sogs ni gzhu 'gongs pa lcid che ba 'degs pa do— bdeg pa sogs/ char rlung gcig phebs ni char rlung lhan cig phebs pa / 'khyag pa ar thebs ni grang pa'i snang la thebs pa/ chad nisdus

bzhi po 'di dpyid dbyar ston dgun la rim bzhin sbyar/ mi mang ni mi ches pa/ pho ba tsha zhes pa'i tsha ni yig nor te tshwa/ skam chas rlan dang mi 'bral ni skam chad kyi dkris ma rlan dang mi 'bral ba/ na 'gyur ni na —la khad pa/ mde phugs ni mde'u slebs tshabs kyi phugs thad/ mdun rgyab rang gsang ni pho gsang dbus dang tshigs pa bcu gnyis pa/ pho stong zhes pa'i stong ni yig nor te pho stod/ tsha rum ni tsha brab/ spod sna ni go snyod 'u su pi pi ling sga skya sogs/ drod phab ni lug bsad 'phral gyi lto tshil dron mos drod phab/ ma chud ni mtshud ces pa yin/ rma sman ni dom mkhris cu gang stag sha gur gum mtshal/ skyom ni bsgrul bskyod byas pa/ sbos na dugs bya ni lan tshwa bsros pas so/ /tsha 'brab che na gtar ni mjug rtse gtar/ bsam bse'i rtsa rnams zhes pa long rtsa dang byin gzhug drod dugs ni spa'u bsros pas so/ /( le'u brgya nyer gnyis pa/ yan lag gi rma bcos pa me long —ni sog pa'i me longaka 'bros sha ni phar 'bros tshur 'bros byed pa/'dar sha ni bya ba byed dus 'dar ba/ lug gzhug ni lug gi mjug ma dang 'dra ba/ gdang la rgyus pa ni gshibs te rgyus pa/ chang bzung ni sked pa/ sha rgod ni rta sha dar sbams 'dra ni dar phon gyi sul 'dra/gnyan gong sor gnyis zhes pa'i gnyis ni yig nor te bzhi/ sgyug ma sbams pa ni mda' thug gi phon po/ nya med kyi med ni yig nor te zed/sdo bying nya rjed dang dbyibs 'dra ba'i nya gsum yod/ sre long ni rtingarko

pa'i rus 'bur/ skyogs rus ni sog mgo'i rus pa/ khyi khros ni lag — pa bskyon tshe mchan khung du khyi khros pa'i sna ltar nyer nyer byed pa/ snam nas ni de'i rtse nas/ pus mo'i gnyan gong ni pus mo'i tshigs mtshams nas yar la sor bzhi gzhal ba/ mthe bong spu skyes ni mthe bong giske tshigs bar/ snag chen gnyer ring ni 'phongs kyi sha thug gi ldebs su — langs nas gnyer ma ring po 'ong ba/ mchin rtsa smad gsum ni byin — gzhug gnyis/ kha gzer ni srab mo/ bzhag 'dra nispar 'khyil ba 'dra ba / sgab khungani skyid khung / mdzod bu chung ni mdzub mo chung khug par rgyus pa ni sha'i 'og tu 'dzul te rgyus pa/ lha ngani bus mo'i tshigs kyi steng gi rus pa/ phran rtse ni rkang lag sor tshigs yan mkhrig masan:gyi rus pa/ spun mang ni sor mo so so'i rkang rdos bu bcug pa 'dra ni bcings pa'am nya dang ri dwags rgyar tshung (tshud )pa lta bur 'gul mi shes pa/ gnad la phebs par byed ni nyam thag pas ci yang bya thabs zad pa/ zhar na ni chag gam 'jig na/ legs bsros ni sbang ma bzang po me la bsros pa/ zho yi kha sgru btab ni zho dang bsres pa/ thal ni phye ma/ gar po ni sbang ma dkar po/ smod ni tsha ba gsum/ rjen phye ni nas ma bsngos pa'i bag phye/ zhun ni byug pa/ nan ni chas/ so thog ni lcags skyag za med byas pas 'tsho ces pa la/ gserabre las/ rma med kyi gdams pa la/ rang a tsar nag po gcig tu sgom/ de rdzas kyi dkyil du a gcig sgom/ rtsa'i nang du a gcig bsam/ lce steng gi1 sdurdo

las 'od zer tsha tsha 'phros/ rma 'jam ldan song bar bsam/ nyal po dang nyin gnyid spang / tshon skud sna lngas dkris/ de sbrul du bsam/sngags la/ 6pa ru sod sod rag ta sga to la gā hā/ rdzas ni/ rta sbangs dar btsags ma/ dri chen bsregs pa/ spru dkar lo ma/ mi rus bsreg pa / lo tsan/ dom mkhris rnams rma khar spangs la dam du dkris/ 'di las zab pa med gsungs/ 'byar sman chen mo la/ bag phye chu rtsa phul gsum re/ bul tog phul gcig dud pa phul byed/ spyin bre gang rnams ma 'dregs par btsos pa'i skyo ma la/ rdo sman gang 'dzom rnams zho — brgyad re stag sha shu dag sman chen brag zhun rnams srang gang re/ re — lcag chu ser sman gsum zho brgyad re/ gla ji skar dgu sbyar/ bcar ni gtsir/ kha 'dzin ni kha bsnam/ 'phrul bsdoms ni dbyung ngam shor ram lhod pa bsdoms/ 'jum ni bongs chung bar 'gro/ 'phar zhi bani 'phel grib/ sreb ni treb/ rnag g.yos ni rnag gugs/ skabs su ldang dub tsha 'khyug ba spu 'gyel/ /mthe bos skrangs pa kun snyoms brdzis pa'i tshe/ /zhes yod pa'i rkang pa phyi ma chad 'dug sbubs ni stongarkoba'am sbub/ rngul chu'i sbyor bas zhes pa'i rngul ni yig nor te dngul/rtsa chad khad spu ni rtsa chad 'thud pa/ dmigs su ni rma gang yod sar/mchan gyi rtsi stag mo ni chu ma rtsi/ mi dkrog ni mi 'gul/ lan nas:dbyung zhes pa'i lan ni lon/ seng ge kha ni cha byad sbom la thung ba//sbya 4chung ni phra la mchu ring ba/ gang ka mchu ni sbom la mchu ring ba/

'phrul skam ni sbu gu nang nas sdom pa/ 'jab rtse ni so shin caza mo—gnyis kha sbyar ba'i rtsa ba gdu bus bsnams pa/ sbru gu sdom pa dang spu gu so leb mde sor rnams sgras bstan no/ /a byag ni gzer 'jom/ ma tsol bu thog ni/ tshigs kyi ske chag pa dang rkang kha dbrag gi gcig chag pa/smyu gu kha ni gsog khar chag pa/ stum chag ni mnyam par chag pa/grums pa ni chag sna 'khrugs pa/ 'khrog la ni har har zer ba tshil bus drod phab ni 'o ma'i rlangs par bsros pas so/ /bstungs ni — bregs/ lu dang bral ni yal ga chag pa'i lhag ma/ khong ldem ni nang ngos gzer te gnyan pa/ shed mnyam ni srab thug med pa/ brer zug spangs pa ni bar mtshams yangs dog med pa/ rus mdud chag pa so zin ni rus pa'i thug po chag pa sbyor zin nas/ lhang skyog ni hang hang tson ba/ sor mi sdod ni rang sar mi gnas/ chag ngos sbyar ni chag ngos su gting nas dkris/ khams gso ba'i zhes pa lus kyi khams mthun pa'i mdog dong brum bcug ni dong brus pa der gong gi 'jag ma — mnan/ e 'byar ni e 'byar zhes brjod pa la 'byar zhes lan btab/li thur ni li las byas pa'i thur ma/ dbyi yi btug thag ni mtho ril bu'i go thal/ sog pa'i mnyen thag ni sog pa dang lag rkang gnyis — 'brel ba'i chu ba/ bkon ni bkan byas te phul ba/ skyogs ni shing — skyogs/ zur 'debs ni man ngag zur bas brgyan pa/ rked pa mnyams la zhes pa la ma 'phul lhag 'bras tshigs ni 'bras kyi // 5

tshigs/ khad spu ni rtsa chad pa'i phan tshun gnyis la spu'i rnam pa zing nge yod pa/ byang sdebs bya ni shing leb kyis bsdoms pa/ ur la mnan pa ni cham la phabs pa'am lam 'gags pa/ rma khol gtad ni rma'i thad nas bu ga gtad/ zor pa ni ram pa ste dur ba'i rtsa ba/ rlung khrag — bsdengs na zhes pa'i bsdengs ni bsdongs/ rgyus gsum ni ba nu rdo rgyus mthing rgyus/ spyin gyi zam bur ni hel gisrab mo la sbyin chu sbyar te sgrog btang / yang na sbang skam rta rkyang lug ril lums/ /yang na phur mong tsan dan smug po dang /zhes yod pa'i rkang pa phyi ma chad 'dug rtser gyis brgyangs ni dal bus 'then la brgyangs/ // le'u brgya nyer gsum pa/ sbyar dug bcos pa/ pra yas ni shig cing thor nas/ mu stegs ni lta ba log par zhugs pa/ bskur pa'i rta lnga ni/ man ngag rgyud las/ mthong ba nyi ma'i zer la bskur ba dang /du ba rlung gi ji la bskur ba dang / /'goms pa sa yi rlangs la bskur ba dngan /reg pa snum gyi rta la bskur ba dang / /khong par zas la bskur ba rnam lnga'o/ /zhes dang / yul rigs bzhi ni/ yul ni rgya gar rgya nag dol po mon/ /zhes dang / rdzas rigs drug ni/ rdzas sbyor rin chen rdo dang sha sbyor dang / /rtsi sbyor dngos dang sngo las sbyar ba drug /ces dngaka nad rigs nyer gsum ni/ nad rigs mdze dug spyo dug ma gri rgod dug /kha rma rgyu skam za rem ltag dgye dngan /rgya nad rengs dis/sa srin bu sna zan dngan /smug po 'ju skems mkhris nad mig:

ser dang / /rims nad rtsa byer nag po thog deg dang / /'khyam po gza' nad gzer nad chu 'gags sogs/ /ngo mtshar na lugs du ma 'byung ba yod/ /ces dang / ldang ba'i dus gsum ni/ zhag dug zla dug lo dug gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes dngaka 'jug tshul lnga ni/ 'jug tshul zer la bskur ba mdangs la 'jug /ji la bskur ba rtsa sgo sna nas 'jug /rlangs la bskur ba sna sgo ba spu gnyis/ /snum la bskur ba ba spu'i sgo nas 'jug /zas la bskur ba so lam kha nas 'jug /ces so/'khren ni skabs 'dir dang ga med pa la 'jug gzhung ni rgyungs pa/mdangs 'phrog ni gzi brjid nyams pa/ rgyab sha bcad ni so sor phral ba ste 'du ba gzhan gnod bya bcu gnod byed bco lnga dang ma 'khrul par rtags so sor bral ba/ ma langs ni mal nas ma 'gul bar/ rang lugs ni ji ltar yod pa de ltar/ ra med ni lhad med/ brtod niwad bus brtod la/ phyi ba dka' ni g.ya' dag dka' ba/ ming bdun sman gcig ni brag skya ha bo/ 'byung bya ni lug pa/ dang bar ni 'og sgor thon pa'i tshe/ lcam dral ni gnyis gshibs su 'phar ba/ dag rnyings ni rnyog ma nag po/ li sor dang khrag blug ces pa'i dang ni nad yin/brtag mi thub ni 'gyur ldog mang ba/ byas med dar re drag ni sman dpyad sogs byas pa med par skabs skabs su sos la khad pa 'byung /gtar khrag tsha ba ni dud 'gro gang rung gtar ba'i khrag tshod/ chu chung ba yi tsha ba ni chu rtsa'i thug pa/ rak+ṣa ni ru rak+ṣa zhes bzhed pa dang sdokā/

chags grog ma sbub ril lnga zhes bzhed tshul gnyis yod/ re ral ba 'or btab ni re ral thun gcig ba 'o phul brgyad la btab pa/ rnam yug ni yu gu shing / se skyer ni se rgod skyer pa/ pran rtse ni mkhrig ma man chad rus pa/ chur btsos ni/ dgongs mo se rgod dang 'om bu'i bar shun gyi thang btang nas zhogs kha'i dri chu snod gtsang mar btsos pas chu chad de so sor 'dril/ gsang sman ni/ tsan dan dkar po mar khu — btung zhes pa'i mchad gyi bzang drug bzhi po zhes yod pa'i po la rjes 'jug 'i yig chad pa yin te gsang sman bzhi po'i phyed mnyam pa'i — bzang drug sbyar zhes pa'i don yin pas so/ /yang na gsang sman ni ko ṣa btu lugasaspya 'dra ni rtsa phran ma lus par brkos pa/ g.yas skor bya ni yas bebs ma byas par 'dam thag g.yas skor bya/ ngag bsnams ni tshig gzhan mi brjod/ 'bru gnyis ni ko ṣa zhes pa'i yig 'bru gnyis/khrag tu 'byang ni khrag tu 'khru/ mid pa lte ba ni mid pa 'gag rgyu khrag 'dres ni rgyu ma khrag gis zos pa/ ngo sha skam zhes pa'i ngo la rjes 'jug sa chad de ngos sha skam/ mchin dri 'khor ni khong nang du 'khril nyams byed pa 'ong / ru shing na ni sgal tshigs sgrog rus dpyi rus rnams na/se khyug song ni ser ris 'byung ba/ ser thig ni bre gu gser thig se ril song ni ril bu ser por song ba/ shugs ring byed ni kha nas 'byung pa'i dbugs hu khyu zhes byung / tsha 'gyur ni tsha la 'gyur 'gyur rdi/ 8/ grims chung ni tshigs pa lhod pa/ sdud byed yungs sbyor la/

yungs dkar zho gsum/ shing mngar zho drug bong dkar zhod/ phag khrag sung gang / re ral gser mdog dzā ti zho lnga re sbyar/ a gita ni chos sman/ re ral ni be skyes re ral/ phya tshan gsum ni mi rta khyi gsum skyes ma thag pa'i brun/ lcags zhun ni brag zhun lcags khams/ dri chen ni nad pa'i'o/ /mang sbyor chen mo la/ a ru brag zhun zho brgyad re/gser me khyung sder bya phur sleb dpa' bo ser po bong nga dmar ser dkar po gang ga chung re ral 'om bu gla ji gi wang zir gangs thigasasnyebase ru tsan dan dkar phya tshan gsum rnams rjen par zho lnga re/ ru rta dug nyung hong len brag spos sbi yang ku mu tig rgya mtshal ba sha ka tig ta ba le ka tsan dan dmar na ga ge sar se 'bru so ma ra dza thal ka rdo rje dzā ti zho bzhi re sbyar/ g.yu zho bdun/ g.ya' kyi ma mu men byu ru pad+ma goske sar putha ge sar spos dkar li shi cu gang sug smel zho gsum re/ gur gum ka ko la zho re sbyar/ khyon gcig tu ni sdeb gcig tu/ dngul chu — dug phral gsang ba'i sman/ /zhes pa'i gsang sman ni/ dug nad phal cher mchin par babs pas dong kha'i tho gu bdun gtong / sbyor 'khor tshar re ni sbyor ba skor gcig bse ru bcu bdun par/ bse ru re ral thom bu rma bya'i sha gser mdog phag khrag rnams spang re/ gi wang zho gang / khyung sder gur gum spang rtsi do bong dkar brag zhun zho drug re/gla rtsi se rgod skyer shun zho brgyad re sbyar/ brag zhun rtsi yi gsang ba'i ma sman bsnan pa/ zhes pa'i yi ni yig skyon te rtsi sngo zhes pa yin/ 'a/9 sdu

rtsi'i gsang sman ni tsan dan dkar po/ sngo'i sman ni/ yu gu shing /sbyor sde snga ma bco lnga las med kyang gsang sman 'di gnyis bsnan pas bcu bdun pa yin/ gsang sman brag zhun zhes pa'i gsang sman ni/ rma bya'i mkhris pa'am ma rnyed na dug gis shi ba ma yin pa'i mi mkhris/gsang sman rnam pa gnyis ni/ gla rtsi nag dang su mi dmar po/ khaṇ+ḍargya —mu ra ni drel phrug gi phya tshan/ gsang ba'i sman ni/ g.yu rnying / 'bras su zhes pa'i su ni yig nor te bu/ dkar po ni sa zhes pa'i ni sa ni yig skyon te bzhi yin/ de yang phar phyin pa nang du rten te gnas zhes pa la mkhas pa 'gas/ pha phyir sa nang du rten te gnas/ zhes pa yin gsungs/ ste bar gnas pa'i zhes pa lta bu 'brel sgra 'byung ba rnams la lte bar gnas pas zhes pa lta bu'i byed tshig sbyar dgos snyam/ yang na — gi gu gnyis dang zhabs kyu gcig thig le gcig dang ra btags rnam pa gsum/ ha na ka gcig la gnyis kha ni gsum/ zhes pa ni/ kri hra lo/khi na sgri la /pha/ zhal shes yod/ dred ni khong par mi chag lo dus ni — snang le/ bye /ma nye/ ra/ bzhi pa/ gyar dug bcos pa/ so ma ni gsar pa / log rtogs zhes pa'i rtogs ༵ yang 'jug sa lhag da lis bzhi ni/phyi rgyud las/ da lis tsha ba gsum gyi gtso bo la/ /zhes pa ltar yin/nad stobs tshe na zhes pa'i tshe ni yig nor te che yin/ gnyen pos — dīsdus par bya ni gi wang bco lnga'i hong len phri ba/ sto sbyongs rtsa sbol ni

go/ bshad/ sto sbyongs steng byang pa sdig srin spos dkar rnamasadzi/ rārā/ ba/rgya nyer lnga pa/ sha dug bcos pa/ bem ni rul pa/rlangs pa bsrubs pa zhes pa'i bsrubs ni yig nor te bsubs/ dbre ni mngal khrag gam ze mo'i dri chu gtong ba/ be log ni be'u khong du yod pa'i ma shi nas ro'i khong par be'u zhag lnga drug lus pa/ shad pa'i khrag ni dbyar dgun nyis log dus bshan pa'i lag pa la rma 'byung pa'i khraga'abras bu 'dapa ni mig gi a 'bras nag po tshod ma zin par ldal ba sto don la mchin par sha dug speb pa'i skyon no/ /mid pa lteb ni mid bsnye'abyar/ gtad mi tshugs ni gom pa 'khyor ba/ ser skyer ba shun zhes pa'i ser dang ba ni yig nor te se skyer bar shun yin/ gson khrag ngag ces pa glang dmar po'i gson khrag mgyogs pa'i rta ni dur byid/dpang bo ni tshos dang stong len/ rnon po ni rgya tshwa/ sna khrid ni mgronaskyithal gla rtsi/ gser mdog drag pa ni a ru ra byi'u la phug lug ru smug po 'om bu brag skya'i me tog bong nga dmar po/ ming bdun na gcig ces pa'i srin ni yig nor te ming bdun sring gcig de yang brag skya ha bo/gzi mdangs med ni srad nag bod tshwa ni bul tog rtse gur ni thunasnyechung yang yangan gsang sman rgod spos zhes pa'i gsang sman ni/ byi'u la phug dang dgu thub/ 'di'i ngos 'dzin lugs gcig la/ monas sna nas 'ong ba'i rin chen jig zer ba de la byed par snang gsuḥspya

rgod spos ni bya rgod spos/ nyung gzhi ni lo lnga lon pa dgos/ ri dwags dri ni gla rtsi/ me sprin bzang po ni dud pa ral ba/ mangs na zhes pa'i yang 'jug sa lhag // le'u brgya nyer drug pa/ sha nad bcos pa/ sgong thog pu ṣa ni sgong thog pa'i me tog byi la ni byi'u la phug /( le'u brgya nyer bdun pa/ dngos dug bcos pa/ rengs shing 'gel zhes pa'i 'gel ni yig nor te 'gyel/ gson khrag dron mo ni glang dmar po'i gson khrag bul tog gsum sbyor la/ bul tog sgong skogs gang ngam do yung ba mdog 'gyur tsam a ru ra gcig bcas/pir phub ni bug rdol med pa'i shing snod che ba/ pha ba dgo dgo ni 'dre sha mang se shing ni ma nu khrag can/ rta spu ni/ rta ngang pa gseb kyi spu dbyar dus mi'i khong bar song steng du chang skur btung zhing lus brel par 'khrugs pa na rta spu rnams 'bur gyur nas dang khrol za ba 'di la spu dug gam rta spu zhes bya/ ba ni sbrul gyi bshang gci dang sgo nga rul pa las skyes pa lus kyi cha ma nges pa la 'dzin pa/ lte ba yan chad 'dzin pa gzhan las skyes pa'o/ /sos zin ni sbrul gyi sos zin pa gting du zug pa khrag byung ba/ po so cha ni lung thang / // le'u brgya nyer brgyad pa/ reg dug bcos pa/ ro tshan gsum ni mi khyi rta gsum ma'i khong par shi ba'i brun/ seng ldeng bzhi thang ni/zhi ༵da las/ seng ldeng a ru ra dang kyi lci ba/ /skyer pa'i thang gis chu

ser tsha ba skem/ /zhes so/ /su mi bzhi sbyor la/ /su mi bse ru cha —mnyam/ a ru de'i byed gla rtsi de'i byed sbyar/ gsang sman rgod po ni/dngul chu bco bkru byas pa byung na rab/ de ma rnyed na dngul chu tsha 'dul rung tsam mo/ /yang dngul chu gla rtsi ril ma tsam gyi dang du 'dul dgos zhes pa'ang 'dug yang gcig mu zi zhes snang / gsang sman rgod po'i sbyor tshad la/ byi tang ka zho gang skar drug hong len pho ba ris lang thang tse g.yer ma khyi la wa ri zho gang skar bzhi re/ sbal rgyab btsag rdo zho re shel dkar bzhi cha sbyar la ril bu dril/ 'di bud med la gtong tshe skyes pas gtong / 'di'i khyi la wa ri ni rdo ja 'di sbyar thabs dang bsten tshul ni/ gong gi sman rnams kyi steng du thal ka rdo rje cung zad bsnan la rtsi bzhin btags/ de'i steng du gsang sman bsnan la btags nas shel dkar btab/ de nas chu gtsang mas bran la chu thag chod chod kyi bar du 'dam btags bya/ ril bu sran 'phos tsam du dril la ril tshags byas te mtshal gyi na bza' gsol/ sman sbyar dus dang sbyar zin kyang dang tshig nyi zer ma reg khyi dang byi la dang / bud glu med sbrum mas ma 'gos nad pa rgan gzhon dang lus zungs bzang ngan nad tshabs che chung gi tshod la dpag te ril bu lce so'i rtse/ mi su gang gi sor mo'i rtse yis ma reg par/ thur ma lta bus lce'i steng du nub rer — ril bu gsum mam lnga bdun dgu re chu tshan dbul/ de ltar nyin re bzhin ma chad par bsten pas nad mgo chog ste mgul rnyil skrangs /sdu

skom mid dka' ba snyam byed tshe sman 'phro bcad/ glang lug gang rung gi sha gsar bsreg pa dang / chang bzang po cung zad re btang bas zug rngu zhi bar 'gyur/ sman gtong ba'i ring lo ma rul skyur sngo ngad tshwa 'o rjen rigs rnams dang me dang nyi mas gdungs pa dngan sa rlan gsher che sar 'dug pa nyin gnyid drag shul gyi las rnams spangs/ jamaphye thug ra sha mar dkar rnams bsten zhing rlung shas ha cang che zhing zungs ngan na glang lug gi sha gsar bsten kyang rung ha cang rnying — zhing mkhregs par song ba la nya phag btsong la bug sogs dmigs bsal gyis gtong / smyug shing dang skyer pa'i khaṇ+ḍa chur sbyangs par rma khar byugs rjes ni la tho ṣa'i phye ma cung zad tsam re rma khar btab naskyimyur du skem par 'gyur ro/ /ra glo zhes pa'i glo ni slo/ ga bur bcu gsum par/ ga bur skar gang / jig pan 'dulam gi wang skar gsum re/ gsang sman skar lnga re gzhan rnams skar do sbyar/ gsang: ba'i sman gnyis ni/ la la phug (phud )dang rgya mtshal/ ko byi dngul chu rgod po mnyam du brdar/ /zhes pa la/ ko byisang do zho bzhi/ dngul chu zho gsum/ khrag rlung shas che na gu gul ko byi'i bzhi cha/ mkhris pa shas che na gla rtsi ko byi'i brgyad cha/ rdo ja dkar po log mnyam ste kun dngasnyebongs tshad mnyam pa/ ba mar zho gsum dang sbyar/ 'di la a rdzu ta ni a rdzu mu ta ste ba mar yin gsungs payod kyangagla ji yin zer ba dag po rdinā snyam/ da dung dpyad/ a dkar ka ra ni spos dkar/ ka kurasnye

shing ni shing tsha'i lo ma/ tsi rtsi tra ni tsi tra ga tsi rtsir ra ni rgya tshwa/ rag tan dha le ni dngul chu/ e sa bha na ni rgya mtshal/ 'di dag kyang yig hrul gyi bshad 'bum yin/ mchan gyi nus pa bskyed thabs zhes pa ser tsam bsreg pa yin/ btsong rtsa bskol pa'i ro ma dbyung zhes pa de'i snyigs ma dor/ se ba gang gi skar ma gang / 'di la snum nag dang btsong gi rtsa ba gnyis spar byed dang gla rtsi zho gang tsam/ /( le'u brgya nyer dgu pa/ khyi dug bcos pa/ skyes bu ni ha la nag po gdong dgu pa/ kha nag bang zhes pa'i kha la rjes 'jug ma chad pas kham nag dro kha sngon po yi zhes pa'i dro dang yi gnyis la rjes 'jug sa chad de de dros kha sngon po yis/ ra ri ni snyoms pa/ chen bu chags ni sha ro ril ma chags pa/ mi dang chung ba thong zhes pa mi'i bya spyod la dga' ba chung nas de'i shugs la khyi'i bya spyod la dga' ba 'ong / nag ngam can ni nag mdangs can/ dogs zos ni the tshom zos pa/ ste ba dkar ni gdan dkar/ bang btang ni rgyug btang / khyi 'dzog ni khyi tshugs/ spu ris 'khyug ni spu lta bu'i ris mo 'khyug ge byung / khag theg ni lus pa med pa/ bya gdang ni bya ldang ba'i dus yin zer/ ras 'jag ni ras gshags kyi tshal bu/ gsang ba'i sman rnams gnyis ni/sre mong gi sder mo dang pho rog gi mig chos sman ni bdud ji sman sgrubaske ril bu/ gsang sman gnyis ni bshad ma thag pa de gnyis/ sdum stag ni ko byi la/ rgyab pa ni rmugs pa/ bsrung 'khor gyi lte ba dkar po ༵༵

ser po/ rtsibs sngo/ rtsibs mchan dmar po/ mu khyud ljang gu/ me ris dmar po'o/ /chu snying nan ni snying gar sleb pa'i chu la brgal ba/ // le'u brgya sum cu pa/ ro tsa bar bya ba/ gdung ni rigs rgyud/khrus kyis sbyang bar byas ni/ bshad rgyud las/ 'bras bu gsum dang rgyam tshwa pi pi ling / /bca' sga shu dag yung ba byi tang ka /bu ram ba chu sbyar bas khong pa sbyangs/ /zhes so/ /'tsher ni mdog gsal ba/ chu zheng gab ni srid dang zheng mnyam pa/ dug 'don zhal shes sman gsum ni / a ru ragla rtsi go bo'i shā khyim bya ni mdog mtshal lu pho/ mchil pa ni nas zan gyi rigs rgya mchil mgo dmar zhes pa mgo dmar shas che ba 'di la rdo rje khri bo yang zer/ 'dab chags bcu gcig pa yang zer te/'dis dus gcig la 'dod pa lan bcu gcig spyod par nus pas de skad zer/ nas zan ni byi'u brang dmar sgro rgya la dngul mdog can la mchog ni gangs khrod dang mtho sar 'ong ba'i rlig pa can/ gtsang nya thang phrom zhes pa chu klung gang byung gi nya dang thang phrom dkar po'i 'bru/nye shing pa dang cong zhi zhes pa nye shing pa 'o ma can dang ma ning cong zhi/ra thug 'bras bu zhes pa 'o mar bcos pa khu ba rang thim/ til bsres ni dkar nag gnyis bsres/ stobs ldan mu tig gos can ni gangs sbal te da byid yin/ gsang ba'i sha chen ni/ mi dar ma bud med la ma spyad pa rab/ ma rnyed na khu ba cher ma nyams pa'i rlig 'bras dang mi kānā ma'i sha yin/ sbyar thabs dug 'don sogs ngag la nyan ni/ dug

'den pa rno 'don pa ngar 'don pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ sbal paṃrtsangs nya sbrul rmig bu sogs klu nor gang gtong yang / gser mdogam rtsi go bo'i sha dang gsum tshwa 'debs tsam re gtong / go bo'i sha ni mang—yang legs/ yang dngul chu dug phral dang gla rtsi zhib par btags la: sings por sbangs/ de nas sbrul sha'i pags pa bshus la dar sogs kyis btum la zhag gcig spangs/ nangs par khu ba dor/ sha de ma bsnur bar chu gtsang gis bshal chu dor/ de nas yos tshan nang du: btum la yud tsam bzhag dug gsum spyi 'joms go bo'i sha tshom— gcig btab bo/ /bya sha gang gtong yang ma rul ma sungs pa shin tu gal che/ de nyid khram khum du brdungs la tshags sha rlon pa gyis gshags pa'i gseb tu bya sha bcug btsem me la bsreg tshags sha de phyi nang thams cad tshos nas bton pa tshags shadar/ bya sha sman du gtang ngo / / yang na sha gang gtong yang til dkar phon gcig btab pas dug thon no/ /gnyis pa rno 'don pa'i man ngag ni/ klu nor rnams kyi rno 'don ni/ gtsang g.yeng tshwa 'debs tsam gcig 'debs/ bya sha'i rigs kyi rno 'don ni/ rgya tshwa lcam pa'i 'bru gtong ba yin/ zhes so/ /gsum pa ngar 'don pa ni/ klu nor thal ka rdo rjes ngar 'don/ bya sha dbang po lag pas ngar 'don/ de yang klu nor thams cad phyogs — gcig tu 'dul/ rno 'don dang ngar 'don sman kyang so sor 'dul/dang po rno 'don dang bsres la de 'o mas sbags la ja yun tsam 'a)sdu 7 —

btags bya/ de rjes ngar 'don sman bsres la bu ram rdog gcig btab la ja yun tsam 'dam btags bya/ de bzhin bya sha la yang bya/de nas phyogs gcig tu bsres la sman gzhan rnams zhib par btags pa dang bsres la 'dam btags bya zhing ril bur dril lo/ /lag len 'di dag ni shin tu zab la rgya che ba gsang ba las kyang ches gsang zhing gud du sbas pa'o/ /gal srid da byid kyi rigs ma rnyid na sum sha dang sum brun gnyis gtsor bskyed gtong ba yod/ rgya mchil de pho'i sha zhes pa la bya de pho ni khyim bya ste/ rgya bya bod bya gnyis/ rgya bya go'i ze ba star ga'i tshi gu 'dra ba zin thob thob ba dang / bod bya ze ba ma ru rtse'i 'bras bu 'dra ba'i rting pa sog le kha can no/ /rgya bya bzang spyir sbal rigs sogs rul pa dang tshig pa shas che bas der ma song ba dgos/ rul tshig gis gnod pa las phan pa med gsungs/ 'od ldan ni sngo 'od ldan pa / dngul zho zhes pa dngul chu zho gcig gur gum zho bzhi/ dzā ti me tog bcas so sor nas zho gsum skar brgyad re/ zang dang ba mar nyag bcu bcas blug gsang ba'i sman cha mnyam zhes pa'i gsang sman ni/so ma seṅge ste gangs sbal yin/ sman rnams log pa'i bye kur ni/ sman de kun gyi ljid so sor mnyam pa'i byed ma ka ra/ // le'u brgya so gcig pa/ bud med btsa' thabs bstan pa/ bu rtsi btang ni bu mi 'byung ba'i sman btang ba/ mo gsham ni bu byung mi swāhāḥ ba/ gto yis ni bcos kyis/ har por ni sbrug pa ha re/ sdom

zhing sbo ni mngal khrag sdom zhing rgyu zhabs sbo/ sge gsherachas ma grog zhing ni khang thog du skyeb spang ngam tha ma kha 'dra ba/ rtsabs shing snam rtsa / a ru brgyad par/ a ru mchu skung rdog gcig dwa tsha ste shing tshalamathug po rtsabs shing rnams zho re re so sor bsdus nas bsres pa'i khu ba la / dur byid 'ol mo se rgya tshwa rnams zho re re khron bu lug ril tsam shing tsha srab mo zho byed rnams btab la khye'u sus te tho rangs dus su btang /shing tsha bcu gcig par/ tsha ba gsum bre byed/ a ru rdog po lnga/ rgyam tshwa dwa tsha lham rtsa zho gang rnams so sor bsdus pa'i khu ba bsres la/ dur byid mdzub gang tsam/ 'ol mo se lug ril tsam/ rgya tshwa zho gang / shing tsha zho byed rnams btab la sbyar/ rdo dang 'bru dugs bya ni pho bar rdo — bsros pa dang rgyu zhabs su 'bru dugs bya/ pad+ma kha 'byed la ba sprul bsnan pa man ngag ril bu gsum bzhi spar zhes pa la ril bu gsum bzhi sngar ltar btang des kyang 'khrur ma 'don na ril bu gsum chum la sbyar te btang na mi 'khru pa mi srid de yas mas kha sprad ces bya/gtsug lag ni gzhung lugs/ be bum ni paṇa chen na bza' pa'i be — /ma/le'u/ brgya so gnyis pa/ tshangs dbyangs skad kyi gdams pa — bstan pa/ dal brgyad ni mi khom brgyad spong pa'i dal ba brgyad /'byor bcu ni rang 'byor lnga gzhan 'byor lnga ste bcu/ dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad po 'di lam rim sogs las bshad pa ltar shes da/sdu

gsungs/ kun 'bebs ni kun la gnang ba/ tshogs bshad rigs ni tshogs langs dang bshad pa rgyag pa'i rigs/ cong zhi'i khrol bu ni cong zhi'i sbyor ba thor bu gang rigs/ sog tshigs ni sog ma dmar po ma rul pa'i tshigs/ gsang ba'i sman chig brgyud ni/ byi'u 'jol mo'i gre ba / phra gsang zhes pa'i gsang la yang 'jug sa chad/ bur len zhes pa'i bur ni yig nor te sbyar/ gsang sman ra thor sbyar ba zhes pa'i gsang sman ni bong bu'i gre ba'i mdud pa/ ngo bo ni sbyor sde rang yin/se 'bru a krong cha mnyam gsang ba'i sman/ /zhes pa'i gsang sman ni/'brug gi gre ba/ dam can 'khor ni dam can rang la 'khor/ sgra snyan zol la brten ni sgra snyan pa la dgyes pa'i mdzum dkar ston/ mes po — ni lha tshangs pa/ chu gteng gdong gis blta ni mchi ma zags pa'i zhal gyis blta/ srid rtser 'bros zhes pa la/ srid rtse gzugs med khams — yin zhing stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa gzugs khams pa yin pas gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun gyi ya mtha' 'og min la srid rtse'i sgras bshad lce chung gtar ba ni lce rtsa gtar ba/ // le'u brgya so gsum pa/ rgas pa gso ba bcud len bstan pa/dri bcas tshos ni dri ma dang bcas par tshon byug pa/ brag zhun ni lcags zhun/ cong zhi ni ma ning cong zhi dmar po/ mar dkar ni 'bri'i mar dkar/ mdzub mos tshugs ni mdzub mos dkrugs tshugs pa2 / 10gro gong ni zas kyi gong du/ bdud rtsi lnga ni lha klu mi drang srong mkha'

'gro'i bdud rtsi/ 'jam dbyangs zil can bcud len gyi tshad ni/ ji skad du/ 'jam dbyangs zil can grib skam byas pa ni/ /sung bzhi a skeru ra ni rdog po brgyad/ /ba ru nyer lnga tshi gu dang bral ba/ /skyu ru rus mamed srang do zho bdun dang / /dug phral dbang lag bzang po spang bcu gcig /zho drug pi ling srang gang skar ma bzhi/ /bras zhun cong zhi rnam gnyis srang do re/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni so sor srang do dang skar bzhi tsha shas che na ba mar ni/ nyag gsum sbar gsum khu phyung dwangs ma la/ a ru — rdog gsum se 'bru zho gang dang skar gsum/ shing tsha pi ling sug smel —rnams zho gang skar do 'jam dbyangs zil can dang / a wa rnam gnyis zho tshad bzhi bzhi mnyam/ gur gum skar lnga rgya mtshal zho do dang skar: gsum/ dbang lag zho bzhi skar do/ lcags sbrul zho gsum shel kur nyag bcu dang / zang btulasrang gang zho bzhi/ bu ram zho brgyad zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma 'di/ 'du ba snyoms phyir kha tshar btab na'ang legs/ zhes bya'o/ //smra bshad dang mdzad byang la/ kye ma ni ngo mtshar ba'i tshig brdzu bag ni brdzus ma te rang bzo/ gnang rigs bla sman ni chos rgyal rim byon — dang dam pa rnam gnyis lta bu'i phyag sman par gnang ba'i rigs/ rig pa'i lam 'di ni gso ba rig pa/ kho bor ni bdag la/ spobs pa dge bas ni blo gros gsal bas/ mthon por bteg ni gsal por smras/zab dgu ni zab pa thams cad/ taku ra ni rgyud mangs/ dpyid /1 —

dpal/ thog 'khel ni nad steng du nges par 'gro/ g.yur za ni yu bar snyid pa/ nag po 'gro shes ni go sla ba/ yongs 'du'i dbang po ni sngon shing gi rgyal po/ 'on tang ni 'on kyang / rgya drug ni/ bshad rgyud las / rgyu ni blo ldan bsam pa dkar ba dang / /dam tshigs ldan zhing rnam pa gzo ba dang / /bya ba la brtson mi chos mkhas dang drug /ces so / / bgrod pa ngal ni bgrod mi nus/ 'pho ba grong 'jug ces pa rang gi lus bor nas gzhan gyi ro la rnam shes 'jug ste gnas pa'i gdams ngag / 'phongs skyen ni mda' legs par 'phen mkhan/ sgrol byed ni rgyu skar/ phyi ma yi ltad mo ni skyeb phyi ma/ drin gzor ni bka' drin gzo bar / rtsod zings ni rigs pa ltar snang / e ho ni 'bod pa'i sgra/ chu skyes ni pad+ma/ rkang drug ni bung ba/ dpyad gsum ni gzhung 'di'i mngon gyur gyi don la mngon sum gyi gnod pa mi 'jug don lkog gyur pa la rjes dpag gis gnod mi nus/ shin tu lkog gyur gyi cha la yid ches rjes dpag gis rnyed pa/ bsregs bcad brdar pa'i gser bzhin ni/ gser gyi skyon yon rtogs tshul te gzhung don dpyad gsum gyi dag pa'i dpe don sbyar/ rgya la ni 'ga' re/ gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo ni ri bo po ta la'i rtse mo/ pad dkar 'chang ni 'phags pa spyan ras — gzigs/ bsil ldan ni bod kha can/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag ni rig pa'i yi shes rigs lnga nang tshan nyi shu re phye ba'i sprul gzhi rigs /snyisna sman rgyal rdo rje 'chang / gser mdog cod pan 'dzin pa'i rmad

byung bstan/ /zhes pa rgyal ba gnyis pa shar tsong kha ba'i lta :khagarnam dag zung du 'brel ba'i bstan pa/ lugs zung ni cho srid kyi phugs gnyis/ pho brang ni skabs 'dir gong sa che mo'i gzhung sa/ rnardzog rin ni spyir tshe lo dpag med pa'i dus dang bstan pa 'di'i dbang dusasar sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs pa'i dus/ bgrang bya ni lo bgrang / dngosasnye po'i 'du shes ni nor gyi 'du shes/ don dam ni don zab mo/ 'bod grogs ni srin po/ si ta ni dkar mo/ lus phra ma ni lha'i bu mo/ gyin pa ni phal pa/ 'dzin dbang btang ni gzhung tshig blor 'dzin pa'i dbang —du btang ba/ mun nag 'dom 'jal ni mun pa'i gnas su nor gyi dngos po lag myang gis btsal ba/ byings ni kun/ kher rkyang ni gcig bu kho na/ zon skyor ni log gnon dang rjes gcod lta bu/ nem nur ni the chom/ ma bsgrigs lhun 'grig ni ched du ma bsgrigs kyang rang 'grig tu byung ba/ sman bsod ni sman gyi bsod nams che ba/ lha rje ni sman pa/rgyug ni gzhung tshig blo nas thon pa/ de ma kha ni dam kha/ tshogs chung ba ni yig nor te tshegs chung ba/ nyin mor byed pa ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dga' ba dang po ni yar ngo'i tshes gcig lha'i bla ma ni drang srong phur bu ste las skar rgyal dga' ba dang rtse ba zhes phur bu rgyal gyiske grub sbyor/ bsti gnas ni bzhugs gnas/ ar po ni 'bul ba zhu mi/zab mchor ni bzang 'grig pa/ 'di la mchod brjod kyi mtshams sbyar gyi sgra sgrub tshul dang / sman rnams kyi 'dul thabs sogs lag len 2rdo3

skor dang / thang stong ril sgrub khyung lnga ril sgrub bcud len ril sgrub/gza' chog klu chog bya 'dre'i bcos thabs sogs gzhung 'di'i cha lag tu nye bar mkho ba'i rim pa du ma rnams dkyus su bkod na dngos don tso bye/ba par 'gyur bas zur 'debs kyi tshul du logs su bkod par /smras pa/ rmad byung mdzad pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho bdag gir mdzad pa gang / /'gro 'di'i nyes brgya'i zug — rngu drungs 'byin pa'i/ /bka' drin dran te slar yang gus phyag 'tshal/ /mgon de'i gsung gsang man ngag 'o ma'i mtsho/ /gting mtha' 'di zhes dpag par nus min yang / /tshig don cha tsam dad pa'i snyim pa yis/ /bcus 'di rmongs pa'i dri ma 'khrud byed yin/ /gzhung 'dir sngon chad dkyus 'grel ma byung bas/ /zur bshad 'ga'amal brten cing rang gi blos/ /dpyad de bris la nor 'khrul gang mchis — pa / / rtsa gsum spyan sngar bshags so tshangs par stsol/ /'dir 'bad legs byas zla ba'i ma ma de/ /zug ju'i gdung sel mchog tu rtag 'phel zhing / /tshe nor bde ba'i dngos grub yid bzhin nor/ /sku gsum tshangs pa'i gnas su 'phyur par shog /ces mang ngag lhan — thabs kyi brda bkrol rnam rgyal gser mdog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di — yang / snga sor/ sa skyong mi'i dbang po khe spe am sban tshe brtan bsod gā/sdu kyis gsung bskul mdzad de shog gu'i mthun rkyen bstsal par

brten shog bu kha shas tsam bris pa/ 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen bsnyeskyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po dang / bla sman mkhan rin po che gnyis kyi gzigs lam du phebs par/ mjug rdzogs par bya dgos kyi —gser gyi bka' lung spyi bor bstsal pa gus bsam nos te/ dam pa gong ma rnams kyi bka' 'bangs tha shal pa sman ming lung rigs bstan dar gyis bgyis pa'i ye ge ba ni sdom brtson rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa dge slong blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan no// //215

shā/dzi/pog/ nga lhanazas kyis/spya//sdu//ratso/sa ga zeng ga/shākya gtār+sha/gyur ga chirngoḥr+shahābs7swā sko /kāḥshā' nākār+sha/pa/ thesta/sabyormi hāsduX//spo dpa/ //rdo sdusabasta pa/ba bzo sa~X /klu/ ༷/rlo ཿ/dri /dri mi baspub/k+ṣiṃ /spring/rtalo /29737—22—045—5par ga sger bdagayin pas 'dra bcos par 'debs mi chos
